title: 1st-Level-Support für Autohaussoftware (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen, arbeitest gerne strukturiert und möchtest Kunden dabei unterstützen, schnell die passende Lösung zu finden? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Wer sind wir?

Die BWSolution GmbH entwickelt seit über 25 Jahren mit CarLiner eine der führenden Softwarelösungen für den Automobilhandel. Mehr als 5.000 Anwender nutzen unsere Software zur Fahrzeugverwaltung, Vermarktung und Digitalisierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse.

Von unserem modernen Büro direkt an der Hamburger Binnenalster aus betreuen wir Autohäuser und Automobilgruppen in ganz Deutschland. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir CarLiner kontinuierlich weiter und legen großen Wert auf einen persönlichen und kompetenten Kundenservice.

Da unser Kundenstamm stetig wächst, erweitern wir unser Support-Team und suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden im 1st-Level-Support freundlich, kompetent und lösungsorientiert unterstützt.

Aufgaben

  • Telefonische und schriftliche Betreuung unserer Kunden als erster Ansprechpartner im Support

  • Aufnahme, Analyse und eigenständige Lösung von Anwenderfragen sowie technischen Störungen im 1st-Level-Support

  • Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Anfragen in unserem Ticketsystem

  • Qualifizierte Weiterleitung komplexer Themen an die zuständigen Fachbereiche (2nd-Level-Support, Projektleitung oder Entwicklung)

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb, Projektleitung, Qualitätssicherung und Entwicklung

  • Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei administrativen Aufgaben und allgemeinen organisatorischen Tätigkeiten

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein abgeschlossenes Studium – idealerweise im IT-Bereich oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Erste Berufserfahrung im IT-Support, Helpdesk oder Customer Support ist von Vorteil

  • Begeisterung für IT sowie Interesse daran, sich in unsere Software und deren technische Zusammenhänge einzuarbeiten

  • Ausgeprägte Service- und Kundenorientierung sowie Freude am Umgang mit MenschenHohes Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

  • Ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten nach Absprache

  • Modernes Büro in bester Lage direkt an der Hamburger Binnenalster – fußläufig zum Hauptbahnhof und Jungfernstieg

title: 3D Data Operator (w/m/d) | 3D Scans to Digital Twins of Real Factories
descriptionHtml:
Transforming factory scans into digital reality

At RIIICO, we're reimagining how factories adapt to change. Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts.

We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. This is an entry-level role with defined workflows and plenty of support, ideal if you’re starting your career or moving into 3D and tech. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D.

In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline.

At a glance:

  • Location: Düsseldorf, hybrid, with regular days in our Düsseldorf office

  • Full time (40h/week), 12-month fixed-term contract

  • Level: entry-level, a first step into 3D data work

Your daily work

  • Process 3D scan data (point clouds) and transform it into usable digital factory models using our internal tools and workflows.

  • Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing.

  • Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others).

  • Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results.

  • Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues).

  • Track and report your weekly processing output.

  • Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges.

What we are looking for

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to reliably handle repetitive tasks with care.

  • Self-motivated and dependable: you take responsibility and get things done.

  • Comfortable following defined workflows and standards, and asking for help when something is unclear.

  • Team player with a proactive mindset: you enjoy working in a collaborative team.

  • Fast learner: no prior experience with point clouds required; you're comfortable picking up new tools and workflows quickly.

  • Basic digital literacy: you're confident navigating structured software tools, browser-based interfaces and Microsoft Office.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with 3D environments (e.g., through gaming, CAD, or similar), or a general spatial intuition.

  • English is a must; proficiency in German is a plus for clear communication with the team.

  • Right to work in Germany: You already have the right to work full time in Germany. We can’t offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Based in or near Düsseldorf: This is a hybrid role with regular days in our Düsseldorf office, so you should be able to commute there regularly.

Nice to have

  • Experience with 3D tools or software (e.g., CAD, 3D modelling, game engines) or 3D scan data, or a general spatial intuition.

  • Familiarity with industrial or manufacturing environments, for example through a technical apprenticeship, studies, or work in production or engineering.

This is a 12-month fixed-term position, with the opportunity to extend or move to a permanent contract based on performance and business development.

Benefits

  • Additional vacation days

  • Flexible working hours

  • Hybrid office culture

  • Public transport subsidy

Why You Should Join

  • Build something that makes a tangible difference in the world's most important sector: manufacturing.

  • Help shape a product that is being built from first principles.

  • Collaborate with a sharp, hands-on team that values speed, clarity, and ownership.

  • Backed by top international investors and preparing to scale.

title: Account Director | Healthcare Communications | London
descriptionHtml:
About us

Hanover is an award-winning communications consultancy that advises enterprises, institutions, and individuals on building recognition and enhancing reputation.

From our offices across Europe and the Middle East, we adopt an integrated approach that connects the dots across channels, audiences and issues.

Our collective of smart, curious people think differently and live by a shared mission, purpose, vision, and values. These shape how we work, not just with our colleagues, but with clients and partners too.

Our mission is to ‘rewire communications for impact’ and harness its transformative power to advocate, trailblaze and make a difference.

We do this by igniting and empowering the potential of every individual within our company, recognising that each person is a unique spark, capable of creating extraordinary impact. We believe that by nurturing and harnessing the collective brilliance of our people, we can drive innovation, foster an uncommon work culture, and make a positive difference to society.

Embracing the complete range of skills and services across the communications spectrum without constraint, we create the best outcomes for our clients and deliver world-class work.

We're in search of a driven professional to take on the role of Account Director (or Senior Account Director for the right candidate) in our Healthcare Communications team.

You will play a pivotal role in delivering strategic guidance to our esteemed public relations clientele, overseeing account management, team leadership, and budgeting. The role involves spearheading new business initiatives, from identifying prospects to leading pitches, and nurturing the professional growth of junior team members up to the Consultant level.

Passionate about propelling innovative healthcare products, services, and organisations to new heights of success, you will engage with a varied client portfolio, ranging from leading global healthcare corporations to dynamic startups, all while making a meaningful impact on patient care and the healthcare community. Our client roster boasts prominent names like Lilly, AstraZeneca and Merck..

Joining our team means bringing your expertise to a diverse array of projects, spanning product PR, patient advocacy, corporate communications, and media relations, within stimulating therapeutic fields such as neuroscience, immunology, and cardiometabolic health.

Our team's excellence hasn't gone unnoticed—we've earned accolades from PRWeek, SABRE, and PharmaTimes, and we've been contenders for an agency award at the Communiqué Awards. Join us and be part of a team that's not just winning awards, but also making a real difference in healthcare communications.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide timely and relevant strategic advice to clients informed by broad intelligence-gathering on client, sector and competitors and policy environment
  • Project manage and supervise the delivery of all client services across multiple accounts
  • Exhibit a willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Lead regular client meetings and internal account management meetings, reviewing progress and allocating tasks
  • Manage account teams, providing direction and support to ensure high-quality client service
  • Manage client budgets and adhere to company budget setting and management processes
  • Ensure timely and accurate billing to ensure client needs are met within budget
  • Project manage activities focused on new business development, including marketing and new business pipeline management
  • Demonstrate an active and ever-expanding new business network that can provide significant opportunities for Hanover
  • Identify opportunities to cross-sell services between Hanover teams and/or offices
  • Provide personal management and mentoring of junior members of the team, up to Consultant level, providing guidance to improve quality of work, overall efficiency and foster a culture of excellence
  • Conduct performance reviews and support career progression for team members
  • Champion diversity and inclusion within the team and in client work, ensuring a range of perspectives are considered and valued.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven track record of experience working in a healthcare / pharmaceutical PR role, ideally within a consultancy or in-house team
  • Proven media relations expertise with network of UK or international media connections
  • Proficient in both healthcare product and corporate communications
  • A willingness to challenge the status quo, innovate, and embrace new ideas to drive the business forward
  • Ability to lead teams and drive client accounts
  • Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively
  • Effective time, project and financial management
  • Client focused with close attention to detail
  • Familiarity with relevant media (print, broadcast and digital) and digital communication channels
  • Proactive and experienced in developing new business

BENEFITS:

In addition to a competitive salary, your core benefits package will include:

  • An annual performance-related bonus plus additional bonus potential linked to recruitment, new business and long service
  • 25 days’ annual leave (plus bank holidays)
  • Private healthcare and dental insurance
  • Travel insurance
  • A company pension plan, including 5% employer contribution

You’ll also have access to a wide range of opportunities and initiatives, including:

  • Flexible working policies, plus eligibility to apply for a sabbatical after 2 years’ service
  • Summer Fridays finish (3pm) – early Friday finish the rest of the year (4pm)
  • The Hanover Academy, which incorporates training, coaching, mentoring and reverse-mentoring opportunities to support personal development and career progression across all levels, with a generous training budget
  • International secondments as well as the opportunity to collaborate with all offices across the AVENIR GLOBAL’s network
  • A wellbeing programme, featuring (but not limited to) pre- and post-maternity leave coaching, a working parents’ group, subsidised gym membership
  • Our Culture Club, with a robust social calendar all year round and CSR activity

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Statement + 

Hanover Communications is an equal opportunities employer, committed to creating and ensuring a fair, inclusive, and diverse work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We believe that equality and diversity are essential to high performance and a thriving culture.

We maintain a strict no-tolerance stance against any form of discrimination and harassment, ensuring all individuals are treated equitably, irrespective of their race, ethnicity, religion, beliefs, age, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, marital or pregnancy status, genetic background, or any other attribute safeguarded under our company policies or federal, state or local laws and legislation.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please send an email to

We are committed to transparency about how we collect and use your data, including ensuring we comply with legal obligations relating to data protection. You can view our data privacy policy here. 

Hanover is part of AVENIR GLOBAL’s powerhouse of specialist communications consultancies across EMEA and North America. Collectively we rank among the top 15 largest communication firms in the world.

title: Account Executive - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the Benelux market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in Benelux: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in Benelux. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the Benelux market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in Benelux, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Hunt for new pipeline (around 50% of your time): Prospect by phone, email and LinkedIn, consistently hit your daily and weekly activity targets, and maintain 3–4x pipeline coverage. Partner, CS and marketing leads are a bonus, not the plan.

  • Drive expansion: Prospect into existing Tellent customers to cross-sell and upsell, e.g. Recruitee customers adding Tellent HR, or Manage customers adding Grow.

  • Sell on value: Run consultative discovery and tailored demos, position on business outcomes, and handle objections, including against key competitors (with support from PMM).

  • Manage deals with discipline: Use mutual action plans, keep HubSpot accurate (including SPICED), forecast reliably and disqualify early.

  • Test and build, alongside selling: Experiment with sales motions, sequences and verticals, help build the playbook with our PMM, and bring customer and competitive insights from the Benelux market back to Product and Marketing.

What You Bring

  • Early-stage DNA: You've sold in a startup or early scale-up and built pipeline and processes where none existed. You know what it means to be an early sales hire.

  • Proven hunter: A track record of self-generating pipeline through outbound and consistently hitting ambitious activity targets. You genuinely enjoy picking up the phone and creating opportunities from scratch.

  • B2B SaaS sales experience: You've closed new business (ideally expansion too) as a fully autonomous AE in a startup or early scale-up, running 1–5 month, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. HR tech experience is a plus, not essential.

  • Self-sufficient and resilient: You don't wait for leads, support teams or perfect processes. You bounce back from rejection and stay disciplined through the ups and downs of building something new.

  • Consultative and data-driven: Strong discovery, demo and negotiation skills. You anchor on value before price and know your numbers (pipeline, conversion, win rate and cycle time).

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent Dutch are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the Benelux market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

  • Compensation: €55000–€70000 gross annual base salary, plus commission.

  • Ownership and impact: Real autonomy to shape the sales motion, playbook and market strategy for a growing product line.

  • Hybrid working: Work from our canal-side Amsterdam office 2–3 days per week.

  • International environment: Join a diverse and international team working across multiple markets.

  • Learning & Development: €1,500 annual learning budget and 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Pension & Wellness: Pension plan and wellness perks.

  • Time Off: 28 paid holiday days, plus 2 additional days in 2026.

  • Work from Anywhere: Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year.

  • Commuting: Commuting and travel reimbursement.

  • Home Office: €200 home office budget and a work-from-home allowance.

  • Equipment: Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed.

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we're just getting started.

AI in Our Recruitment Process

We use our internally developed AI tools to help streamline our recruitment process. However, technology never makes a decision. Every candidate is personally reviewed by our team. Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at

If you require accommodations or support during the recruitment process, please let us know — we're happy to help.

title: Account Executive, Deployments
descriptionHtml:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Most sales roles hand you a territory, a playbook and a quota. This one hands you a market that does not exist yet. We are looking for a builder: someone who would rather create a market than inherit one. Our first enterprise customers are live and the signal is clear. Everything after that is yours to build.

Putting physical AI onto a production line is not a software sale. It reaches the plant manager, the COO, the unions, health and safety, IT, procurement, and often the CEO. Deals take time, run through site visits and technical assessments, and are won on trust. Your job is to close our first deals in the UK and turn them into a market we own.

 

We look for ownership, high agency and low ego, someone who wants to shape both our customer base, shape how we sell and succeed.

What You Will Do

  • Close our first enterprise deals in the UK. Own each one end to end, from first conversation to signed contract.

  • Run the full cycle: discovery, NDAs, use cases and footage, site visits, and a technical deployment assessment covering hardware, data, investment and timeline.

  • Seek the truth on every deal. Find out what Atlas can and cannot do on each customer’s line, say it plainly, and never sell what we cannot deliver, even when it costs the deal.

  • Navigate the whole buying group: plant managers, COOs, trade unions, health and safety, procurement, and the board. Bring each of them along.

  • Build your own pipeline from zero. There is no SDR behind you yet. Find the industrial champions in the UK and get in the room.

  • Develop the playbook as you go: who we sell to, how we price, what wins and what does not. The next ten sellers will run on what you build.

  • Take what you learn on the floor back to product, research and deployment.

Requirements

  • A track record of building, wherever you earned it: a market, a team, a company, a product line. Something that exists because you made it.

  • Enterprise sales experience. You have closed long, complex deals with many stakeholders, and you know how to keep them moving when they stall.

  • At your best in ambiguity. No map, no precedent, no one to ask.

  • You sell a vision and people trust you with it. Honest, likeable, low ego, high standards.

  • Willing to get your hands dirty. You build the account lists, write the proposals, and go to site yourself.

  • Based in London, in the office, with regular travel to customer sites.

Nice to Have

  • You have sold to operations buyers: plant or site managers, COOs, heads of manufacturing or logistics.

  • You have run pilots, POCs, or hardware-plus-software deals.

  • You have been early somewhere: founding AE, first sales hire, or early Head of Sales.

  • A background in operations consulting, VC, or as a founder.

Who Will Thrive at microagi

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

microagi welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Account Executive - EMEA Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking a high-impact, strategic seller to lead the go-to-market execution for our newest frontiers in Connected Equipment. As an Enterprise Specialist (Overlay), you will partner with our Account Executives (AEs) to build deep partnerships with our largest, most complex accounts. You aren't just selling a tool; you are pioneering GTM, ensuring our customers realize continuous value from new products as a part of the overall platform.

This specialist reports into the VP of Sales, EMEA and will be aligned by segment and product. AEs on the team are charged with accelerating the growth of one or more new product(s) and will be incentivized on quarterly product sales targets mapped to mainline sellers in the segment. Product Specialist sellers drive growth through strategic, high-value deal executing and enabling the segment overall to be successful.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you're meeting with a VP of Operations in waste management; the next, you're diving into the logistics of a global food distributor. You seek to understand the "unit of value" for every customer.
  • You build genuine, high-stakes relationships: Our customers operate in "boots-on-the-ground" industries. They value earned trust and partners who understand their operational realities.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team Player: In an overlay role, your success is tied to the success of the broader account team. You lead through influence, not just authority.

In this role, you will:

  • Architect deals that align Samsara's new products value with customer use cases to provide maximum value and return on investment
  • Co-generate new product pipeline with ADRs/AEs across high propensity to buy accounts
  • Drive strategy and pilot/trial success
  • Provide commercial insights and pricing benchmarks often for unique set of competitors in the market
  • Partner with GTM and Product to feed back insights and help shape roadmap
  • Build frameworks, assets and insights that scale across the sales org
  • Travel 20%+ to meet customers where they physically operate and to advance solutions and deals
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years in complex, full-cycle Enterprise sales.
  • Proven Track Record: Consistent quota over-achievement in complex accounts with £500k+/€500k+ ARR transactions.
  • Deal Complexity: Demonstrated success navigating 6- and 7-figure deals involving multiple stakeholders (Legal, Procurement, InfoSec, and C-Suite).
  • Entrepreneurial Agility: Experience selling new products where the playbook is still being written.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working in a specialist/overlay co-selling with a mainline AE team.
  • Second language experience in French or German at business-level proficiency.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

title: Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

Commercial AE is where incident.io's growth gets made real - you're in front of the most ambitious digital-native companies out there, and the deals you close show up in the trajectory of the whole business.

What that looks like day to day

This is a full-cycle AE role with a strong outbound bias. Yes, inbound comes in - but the AEs who thrive here are the ones who don't wait for it. You'll own your own pipeline from the ground up, building target lists, running creative outreach campaigns, and picking up the phone without being asked twice. Outbound here is a craft, not a numbers game.

You'll be selling into VP Engineering, CTO, and SRE leaders at some of the most forward-thinking digital-native companies in the world. Deals typically land in the $40k–$50k range with a clear path into six figures, and a sales cycle of around 45 days means you're moving fast and closing regularly.

We run a pod model - you'll work closely with a BDR and Solutions Engineer rather than whoever happens to be free. That means real partnerships, shared context, and accountability that goes both ways. You'll also work alongside CS from early in the deal, which means handoffs that don't lose the thread.

What makes the selling here different is the product and the story behind it. incident.io is an AI-native platform built by engineers, for engineers - our founders have been on-call, they've felt the 2am page, and they built something to fix it. When you're in a room with a CTO or an SRE lead, you're not pitching software - you're talking to someone about a problem they've lived, and you understand it. That's the edge.

AEs here are AI-forward in how they operate - whether that's building business cases, running research, or finding smarter ways to work a territory. We expect you to bring ideas, not just execute a playbook.

The progression is real. Commercial AEs have moved into Enterprise and into management - and we'll be straight with you about what the path looks like and what it takes to get there.

Who you are

  • You've closed deals at a similar size and pace before - $40k–$50k ACV, sub-60-day cycles - and you've got the numbers to back it up.

  • Outbound doesn't feel like a chore to you. You see it as a craft - you build your own lists, think creatively about how to get in front of the right people, and don't rely on a sequence template to do the work for you.

  • You're genuinely curious about what it's like to be an on-call engineer. Not just the technical side - the stress, the 2am pages, the pressure of being the person whose job it is to fix things fast. That empathy shows up in how you sell.

  • You can hold a technical conversation without leaning on your SE every time. You'll have support when you need it, but you're comfortable going deep on your own.

  • You're scrappy in the best sense - you don't wait for resources, you figure it out. A bigger company with more tools, more inbound, and more hand-holding would actually frustrate you.

  • You pick up the phone. Cold calling doesn't make you wince, and a voicemail doesn't derail your afternoon.

  • Startup life genuinely appeals to you - not as a stepping stone, but because you want to be somewhere your work is visible and your impact is real.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover, we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy.

You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€.

Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew.

title: Account Executive, MidMarket (German)
descriptionHtml:
Fin, now part of Salesforce, is on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.

Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What's the opportunity? 

As a MidMarket Account Executive, you’ll be at the forefront of growth. You’ll own both sides of your territory: winning new logos and growing a portfolio of existing customers to realize the full power of Fin. We’re building a world-class sales organization that is fast, ambitious and driven, and the road ahead is very exciting.

This is a seat at the center of the biggest shift selling has seen in decades. You’ll be selling AI agents to fast-growing businesses rethinking how their entire customer experience works, so the conversations are strategic, technical and interesting. You’ll also use AI every day to run your own territory, from qualification to research to how you run a deal. You won’t just talk about the technology, you’ll work with it.

At Fin, we do sales differently. We don’t just pitch; we partner. We’re asking customers to make Fin the heartbeat of their business. That takes salespeople who can think bigger, move faster and win with integrity. We invest deeply in every seller’s growth, and development is built into how we promote, learn and lead. In a high-velocity environment that rewards ownership, creativity and ambition, you’ll find room to stretch, influence and make your mark.

What will I be doing? 

  • Lead the growth and adoption of Fin across your MidMarket territory, with both new prospects and existing customers
  • Manage the full new business sales cycle, from prospecting to close, through a highly consultative approach
  • Own and grow a portfolio of existing customers, driving expansion, retention, renewals and long-term loyalty
  • Engage key buyer personas to uncover pain points, position AI-driven solutions and tie Fin directly to business impact
  • Build data-backed territory and account plans that target new logos, upsell, cross-sell and multi-business-unit expansion
  • Manage a high volume of deals, including complex six-figure opportunities across new and existing business
  • Articulate Fin’s value and differentiation using Command of the Message and MEDDPICC. If these are new to you, you’ll be trained on them
  • Run your business with discipline through QBRs, territory planning, and weekly and monthly forecasting across new business and renewal pipeline
  • Track and communicate the metrics behind your growth, including retention, adoption and platform expansion
  • Partner with Sales Leaders, Sales Engineers, Customer Success and the wider solutions team to win flagship logos and grow strategic accounts
  • Bring the voice of the customer to R&D, Product and Marketing, turning real customer needs into product innovation and GTM alignment
  • Stay at the cutting edge of AI using the best internal tooling and enablement in the market
  • Raise the bar for the team by mentoring peers and sharing winning plays

What skills do I need? 

  • 4+ years in a quota-carrying closing role selling SaaS or DBaaS, with a track record of meeting and exceeding quota
  • Business-level fluency in German
  • Experience winning new business and managing a book of existing customers through retention, renewals and expansion. Strong experience in one with a clear appetite for the other is also welcome
  • Experience, passion and success in outbound prospecting
  • Proven success navigating procurement, complex renewals and senior decision makers 
  • Experience selling products with technical complexity or thorough implementation
  • AI fluency or a deep interest in AI tooling, with the ability to turn technical capability into customer value
  • Energized by working in a fast-moving, evolving organization across inbound, outbound and existing customer opportunities

Bonus skills & attributes 

  • Experience selling AI-powered products
  • Sharp written and verbal communication, adapted to senior stakeholders and technical teams alike
  • A trusted-advisor mindset, building long-term partnerships across multiple levels of complex organizations
  • Demonstrated leadership and influence within your team and across functions
  • A growth mindset, intellectual curiosity and ambition

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. At Fin, we want to give people what they need to do the best work of their careers. Our benefits and programs are designed to support your health and wellbeing, your family, your time away from work, and your financial future. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at fin.ai/careers. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Salesforce will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. 

Policies 

Fin has a hybrid working policy. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.

We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We avoid spending time on divisive subjects to foster a safe and cohesive work environment for everyone. As an organization, our policy is to not advocate on behalf of the company or our employees on any social or political topics out of our internal or external communications. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our core values.  

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Account Executive - Southern Africa
descriptionHtml:
About Everfield

Everfield buys, builds, and grows European vertical market and specialist software companies, providing them with the tools they need to move to the next level. Our mission is to foster ambition, fuel growth, and unlock opportunities for Europe’s software ecosystem.

Companies in the Everfield ecosystem follow a decentralised model, maintaining their team, brand, and offices, while focusing on what they do best - building products and supporting customers. Everfield provides support in talent acquisition, HR, and access to a team of experts in building and growing European B2B SaaS companies who consult on financial and operational topics. Founded in 2022, Everfield has an ecosystem presence in 9 countries, and growing.

About Frontu

Frontu is a B2B SaaS Field Service Management (FSM) platform built for the companies that keep the world running - heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, material handling, and mining. Our platform digitises field operations for 7,000+ technicians across 20 countries, plugging directly into existing ERP systems as a powerful mobile layer.

We are part of Everfield, a European private equity group that builds and grows vertical SaaS businesses. Through Everfield, you will be joining a network of 1,000+ professionals across Europe with shared knowledge, resources, and commercial muscle behind you, but at the same time will work with a small 20 person team at Frontu.

We are now expanding into Southern Africa. Frontu is already used by a few companies in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Indian Ocean islands so we need local support in the region.

The Role

This is a hunter role. You will own new business development across Southern Africa. We already have customers in Southern Africa and early traction across the region - proof that the market works. We also come with a mapped prospect database covering the region. What we do not have yet is someone pushing things forward at the pace this opportunity deserves.

This is not a role for someone who needs everything built for them. The foundation is there - customers, data, product. What it needs is someone who moves fast, takes ownership, and turns existing signals into closed deals.

What You Will Do

  • Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting and outbound outreach to discovery, demo, proposal, and close

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, referrals, industry events, and partner channels in heavy machinery, agriculture, construction, and material handling verticals

  • Run consultative discovery with your core champions - aftersales directors, service managers, and C-level executives - understand their ERP landscape and position Frontu as the field service layer their technicians are missing

  • Deliver tailored demos and ROI-driven proposals adapted to the buyer context

  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts in CRM (Pipedrive) - we run a tight ship

  • Work closely with Head of Sales on GTM strategy, pricing, and market feedback loops

  • Hand closed accounts to Customer Success

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience, with a track record of owning and closing full-cycle deals

  • Background in SaaS, ERP, CRM, or adjacent enterprise software - you know what a software sales cycle looks like and how to navigate procurement

  • Native or business-level Afrikaans and professional English (written and spoken - both are required)

  • Self-managed and autonomous - you will operate with a 6 - 8 hour time zone difference from the European team; asynchronous discipline is non-negotiable

  • Consultative, senior selling mindset - you influence C-level and operations stakeholders, not just fill out forms

  • CRM proficiency, ideally Pipedrive

  • Comfortable working as an independent contractor

Nice to Have

In Frankreich ist Pennylane in diesem Segment innerhalb von fünf Jahren zum Marktführer geworden. Du übernimmst das in Frankreich bewährte Playbook, entwickelst es gemeinsam mit dem Team für den deutschen Kanzleimarkt weiter und bringst zurück, was in deiner Region funktioniert. Standort Berlin: Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Berliner Office – an Kundentagen bist du in Kanzleien in Berlin und Brandenburg unterwegs, die übrigen Tage flexibel. Zwei Account Executives verkaufen bereits in Deutschland an Steuerkanzleien, du kommst als Nächste:r dazu. Etwa einmal im Monat kommt das ganze deutsche Sales-Team für zwei Tage in Berlin zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben als Account Executive – Steuerkanzleien:

  • Du baust deine Pipeline auf: Rund 50 % kommen aus deinem eigenen Outbound – Cold Outreach, LinkedIn, Empfehlungen, Branchenevents –, die andere Hälfte aus qualifizierten Inbound-Leads. Du bleibst dran, auch wenn die ersten Antworten ein Nein sind.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Kanzleien an unser Customer-Success-Team in Berlin, das Onboarding und Betreuung übernimmt, baust dir Promoter-Kanzleien für Empfehlungen auf und hältst Salesforce und Forecast verlässlich aktuell.

Woran du gemessen wirst:

  • Du verantwortest den Umsatz aus Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region – gemessen an neu gewonnenen Kanzleien und an den Mandanten, die über diese Kanzleien aktiv auf Pennylane arbeiten.

  • Du hältst deine Vertriebsziele konstant und baust den Marktanteil von Pennylane im Kanzleisegment deiner Region aus.

  • Du bringst dein Wissen aus dem Markt in Playbook, Produkt-Feedback und die Go-to-Market-Strategie von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im beratenden B2B-Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Lösungen – mehrstufige Deals, mehrere Stakeholder – idealerweise mit SaaS, Kanzleisoftware oder Fintech und gern im Scale-up-Umfeld.

  • Du verkaufst gern persönlich: Kundentermine vor Ort, Kanzleibesuche und Branchenevents in deiner Region gehören für dich dazu – nicht nur Telefon und Video-Call.

  • Ein Plus: Du kennst den Markt der Steuerkanzleien oder das Accounting-/Fintech-Ökosystem (E-Rechnung, GoBD, Kanzleialltag) – oder bringst die Neugier mit, dich schnell einzuarbeiten.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast den Drive, einen neuen Markt aufzubauen, und übernimmst Ownership für deine Zahlen, dein CRM und deinen Prozess.

  • Du hörst aktiv zu, trittst bescheiden auf und baust Vertrauen zu traditionell arbeitenden Kanzleien auf – auf Augenhöhe mit Partner:innen und Steuerberater:innen.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit Paris – und du lebst in Berlin oder im Umkreis und kannst zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt starten.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • 📍 Berlin, hybrid: Office in Berlin, Homeoffice und Kundentermine in deiner Region.

  • 🚀 Start zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt – du steigst in der Gründungsphase von Pennylane Deutschland ein.

title: Account Manager - SMB
descriptionHtml:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

About the Role

Hiya is growing its SMB customer base across the UK and Europe, and this role exists to ensure those customers stay, grow, and succeed.

This role sits within Hiya Connect - our branded calling product. Hiya Connect Branded Call enables businesses to display their verified brand name, logo, and call reason on outbound calls, helping customers recognize trusted calls, increase answer rates, and improve engagement.

As an Account Manager, SMB, you’ll own a high-volume portfolio of 300+ customers. You’ll make commercial decisions every day about how to prioritise your time, engage customers, and create growth across your book of business. The pace is fast and the portfolio is broad.

Our European base is growing quickly, and this role is for someone who can work with customers in German, French or Spanish as well as English. Holding a renewal or pricing conversation in a customer’s own language builds trust faster, and at this end of the market that speed matters.

This role is perfect for someone who enjoys autonomy, thrives in a high-velocity environment and wants genuine ownership of customer outcomes, with a clear path into more strategic account management as Hiya continues to scale across Europe.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Own a portfolio of 300+ SMB accounts across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for renewals and expansion

  • Manage your European accounts in German, French or Spanish as well as English

  • Triage your book daily - identify which accounts need intervention and which are healthy enough to run digitally

  • Run proactive outreach to at-risk accounts before they become churn conversations

  • Identify natural expansion signals - usage growth, new teams, new use cases and convert them into upsell opportunities

  • Forecast portfolio performance and maintain accurate CRM records

  • Surface patterns from your book of business that help Sales, Product, and Support improve how Hiya serves SMB customers

  • Balance short-term renewal pressure with longer-term account health, making clear tradeoffs under volume

What We Are Looking For

  • 2+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a commercial SaaS role

  • Must have - Business-level German, French or Spanish - confident holding renewal, pricing, and expansion conversations in that language

  • Demonstrated ownership of renewals, expansions, or quota

  • Commercial instinct - able to spot a growth opportunity, build a case for it, and close it without heavy support

  • Clear, direct communication with customers and internal stakeholders

  • Comfortable working independently in an environment where not every process is fully defined

You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have

  • Experience managing SMB or Mid-Market customers

  • Experience working across UK and European markets

  • More than one of German, French or Spanish, or an additional European language

  • Experience balancing personalised customer engagement with scale

  • Exposure to conversation intelligence, caller ID, or communications technology

Role details

  • Status: Full-time

  • Type: Hybrid

  • Location: London, United Kingdom

  • Travel: Up to 25%

  • Department: Sales – Customer Success

  • Reports to: Sr. Manager: Customer Success, UK & EU

 

Come Work With Us!

We're building a team with diverse perspectives, identities, and professional experiences. We evaluate candidates through a business lens and believe that diversity and unique viewpoints make our company stronger, more dynamic, and a great place to build a career.

We've been recognized by Built In, GeekWire, Comparably, G2, Forbes, and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 for our culture, innovation, leadership, compensation, and more. At Hiya, we're a people-centric company focused on helping each employee grow both personally and professionally. We create a culture of support and empowerment that challenges the status quo, resulting in an energized team that's passionate about their work. You'll love working here if you're looking for an innovative challenge that's disrupting an industry. Come join us!

Hiya is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Account Manager, SME & Growth
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As an Account Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll own a portfolio of strategic DACH accounts, with accountability for gross profit, retention, and expansion. You’ll act as a trusted commercial advisor, strengthening executive relationships and helping customers expand their use of Airwallex across products and markets.

  • Own strategic account plans and lead executive-level Quarterly Business Reviews at least once per quarter.

  • Lead complex, consultative commercial negotiations and multi-product opportunities across FX, Global Accounts, Cards and Issuing, Spend, and Payouts.

  • Manage multi-entity and multi-country customers with multiple stakeholders, translating technical requirements into clear customer solutions.

  • Identify expansion signals, convert them into well-documented Salesforce opportunities, and contribute to an accurate, stage-weighted forecast.

  • Own the client through operational and compliance events, gathering facts, setting expectations, driving internal teams to resolution, and keeping the relationship intact.

  • Represent the customer internally across Product, Risk, FinOps, and Support, translating customer feedback and recurring themes into actionable insights for the wider business.

  • Help build the foundations of a scalable DACH Post-Sales function by developing repeatable processes, playbooks, and operating standards for account planning, QBRs, handovers, and expansion.

You’ll work from our Berlin office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 3+ years of successful experience in Account Management, Customer Success or Sales, ideally working with a technical product and a consistent track record of strong performance.

  • Experience managing complex, consultative sales cycles and multi-product accounts, including the development and execution of strategic account plans.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data to shape account strategy, prepare QBRs, and identify commercial opportunities.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and a strong commitment to accurate, consistent Salesforce hygiene.

  • The ability to understand complex technical concepts and a solid foundational understanding of APIs.

  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and a high degree of ownership.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English.

Preferred

  • Experience working with fintech, payments, SaaS, or another technical product.

  • Experience managing multi-entity or multi-country customers and engaging stakeholders at executive level.

  • A track record of leading bespoke commercial negotiations and driving retention or expansion across existing accounts.

You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You know when to align and when to just decide. Collaboration isn't a way to avoid accountability.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. title: Administrateur Systèmes, Réseaux & Cloud (F/H)
descriptionHtml:
À propos de nous
E-Finances est un éditeur de logiciels B2B spécialisé dans la gestion financière et la trésorerie. Nos solutions aident les entreprises à optimiser leurs flux financiers et à gagner en visibilité sur leur trésorerie. Nous les déployons en SaaS et en on-premise chez nos clients, avec de forts enjeux de sécurité et de disponibilité.

Nous sommes en pleine phase de modernisation : refonte technique de nos produits historiques, nouvelles fonctionnalités, montée en puissance de nos stacks. Dans une équipe à taille humaine, c’est le bon moment pour laisser une vraie empreinte.

Le poste
Rattaché(e) au responsable R&D et IT, vous êtes la personne de référence sur l’infrastructure et l’IT de l’entreprise. Vous partagez votre temps entre le quotidien et les sujets de fond.

Au quotidien

  • Gérer les arrivées et départs : postes, comptes, accès
  • Gérer les accès et les échanges de fichiers sécurisés avec nos clients (SFTP, FTPS, listes blanches)
  • Assurer l’assistance aux utilisateurs et appuyer le support sur les questions d’infrastructure de nos clients en on-premise
  • Administrer Windows Server, Active Directory, Linux, DNS et certificats
  • Superviser les systèmes, gérer sauvegardes, mises à jour et patching
  • Être l’interlocuteur du groupe pour les sujets Microsoft 365 et le relais auprès de nos prestataires IT

Pour faire avancer l’entreprise

  • Faire évoluer et optimiser nos environnements cloud et Microsoft (Azure, Entra ID) : sécurité, coûts, bonnes pratiques
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes et documenter l’existant
  • Renforcer la sécurité : durcissement des postes et serveurs, suivi des vulnérabilités, réponse aux incidents
  • Contribuer à la conformité (ISO 27001, RGPD), aux réponses aux questionnaires de sécurité et aux audits de nos clients
  • Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des améliorations continues

Votre profil

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux
  • Très bonne connaissance de Windows Server et d’Active Directory
  • Connaissances Linux (Ubuntu et Debian)
  • Connaissances en réseau
  • Connaissances en virtualisation, supervision, sauvegarde et sécurité des systèmes d’information
  • Notions d’Azure (paramétrage, administration courante) ou envie de monter en compétence sur le cloud public
  • Connaissance de Microsoft 365 appréciée : son administration est assurée par le groupe, vous serez notre interlocuteur sur les besoins locaux
  • Bases de scripting (PowerShell idéalement)
  • Autonome : vous prenez les sujets en charge de bout en bout et vous tenez l’équipe informée de votre avancement
  • Rigoureux(se) et capable d’expliquer simplement des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques
  • Français courant, anglais technique lu et écrit
  • Une certification (Azure AZ-104, Security+, ISO 27001) est un atout

Ce que nous offrons

  • Une équipe de 16 personnes dynamique avec une possibilité de prise de responsabilité
  • Un poste à fort impact et visibilité au sein d’une équipe R&D et IT à taille humaine
  • Une stratégie IT à construire et faire évoluer avec la direction
  • Une prise de poste accompagnée et des certifications cloud prises en charge
  • Avantages : télétravail, tickets restaurant, mutuelle, RTT.

Processus de recrutement : échange de 30 minutes avec le manager, entretien technique sur place, rencontre avec l’équipe.

title: Affiliate Marketing Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace under a newly-appointed CMO. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Finding and signing new affiliate and influencer partners is the core of our growth engine going forward, and we’re building the team to power it. We’re looking for an Affiliate & Influencer Acquisition Executive whose core mission is sourcing brand-new partners — not just managing the ones we already have. Reporting to a Head of Growth Partnerships, you’ll own the full new-partner funnel end-to-end: mapping affiliates and influencers we don’t work with yet, running outbound outreach, and negotiating CPA or fixed-fee deals structured so every partnership delivers measurable, incremental customer acquisition.

This is an acquisition-first partnership seat: you’ll spend as much time prospecting and pitching new affiliates and influencers as you do modelling payback economics. If you think in CPA, fixed-fee and incremental CAC as naturally as you think in relationships, this role is built for you.

What we're looking for:

Essential:

• Proven track record sourcing and closing brand-new affiliate or influencer partnerships from scratch this is a new-business role, not just account management

• 2-3+ years in affiliate marketing, acquisition or performance marketing roles for a consumer brand

• Fluent in core acquisition performance metrics – CPA, fixed-fee, LTV, ROI and blended CAC and confident structuring CPA or fixed-fee deals that guarantee incremental acquisition

• Working knowledge of channel economics: payback period, cohort behaviour, and how partnership spend compares against other acquisition channels

• Direct experience running affiliate and/or influencer partnership end to end, including commercial negotiation (not just relationship management)

• Track record of running activations end-to-end and delivering measurable results

• Strong account / relationship management skills

• Comfortable with the data — channel economics, attribution and ROI

• Highly organised and detail-oriented — you can run multiple activations in parallel

• Strong commercial communicator — you can hold your own with senior partners

• Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow

Desirable:

• Experience in fintech or financial services

• Experience with sport, entertainment, media or large brand sponsorships

• Experience with an affiliate network or tracking platform (e.g. Impact, Awin, CJ, Partnerize, Income access) and reading platform-level reporting unassisted

• Experience building an affiliate or influencer programme from 0 to 1 in a consumer brand

You’re a good fit if you’re:

• An experienced affiliate marketer who has sourced new customer-acquisition channels, not just managed existing ones

• A natural relationship-builder — partners trust you, and so does your team

• Commercially literate first, relationship-led second – you measure success in growth, not vanity

• Data-fluent – you build your own view on what’s working from raw performance data, not just a dashboard summary

• Hands-on and resourceful — you make things happen

• Curious about AI and how it changes the partnerships discipline

What you'll be doing

New Partner Acquisition:

• Proactively map the affiliate and influencer landscape to identify new partners who can drive incremental customer acquisition

• Run outbound outreach and pitch new affiliates and influencers, building and working a pipeline of prospective partners

• Negotiate and close new commercial deals primarily CPA or fixed-fee structured so every new partner is measurably incremental

• Own onboarding and activation of every new partner, from signed deal through to first live campaign

Commercial & Performance:

• Negotiate commercial terms with affiliates, influencers and sponsorship partners —

prioritising CPA and fixed-fee structures that tie partner pay to genuine incremental customer acquisition — and know which model fits each partner

• Own the unit economics of every live partnership: track CAC by channel and partner against LTV, and flag anything trending the wrong way before it becomes a budget problem

• Build and maintain the channel-economics view that lets the team compare partnership spend against other acquisition channels

• Manage affiliate network/platform relationships (tracking, reconciliation, payout accuracy) and be the first port of call when number don’t match

Activation:

• Run sponsorship and partnership activations end-to-end — brief, plan, ship, measure

• Manage the day-to-day with partners: planning, comms, escalations

• Coordinate across creative, growth, lifecycle and legal

Affiliate Management:

• Own the affiliate relationship from first contact — be the trusted operator they call first, from outreach and onboarding through to ongoing management

• Manage budgets and timelines across activations

• Spot opportunities to expand existing partnerships based on their performance data

Performance & Optimisation:

• Track partnership performance against targets — CPA, CAC, LTV, ROI, Rev Share payout

• Build the playbooks and tooling that scale the function, including standard commercial terms by partner type

• Use AI to scale research, brief-writing and reporting

Cross-functional:

• Partner with creative on activation assets

• Partner with finance and legal on contracts and accruals and commission reconciliation

• Report on partnership performance to the Head of Growth Partnerships, with the numbers to back every recommendation

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.
