title: Complaints Officer (FOS)
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions.

If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you:

  • Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do

  • The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision

  • Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs

  • Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding.

  • The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed.

Also, even better if you have:

  • Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment

  • An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015

  • An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards

  • The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints

  • Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Your team’s objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

How you’ll impact those objectives

The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution.

  • You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers and prioritising cases where appropriate to be highly productive and efficient, and to maintain the required level of performance against our KPI minimum standards.

  • You will champion using our AI tools and technology to bring a first class service to our customers.

  • You will work well under pressure and be adaptable, being able to turn your hand to other areas of operational need, as the business may require.

  • You will ensure that you follow our complaint handling standards, have good record keeping skills and ensure that all decisions made are backed up with demonstrable evidence and rationale.

  • You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business.

  • You will be responsible for communicating with the complainant, either in writing or by phone and will enjoy finding solutions to issues raised, managing customer expectations and handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism.

  • You will have a good knowledge and understanding of FCA regulation as well as DISP complaint handling rules and guidance.

  • You will also ensure that you maintain up to date knowledge of Lendable’s products through effective use and review of policies, procedures and business tools made available to you.

  • You will have strong letter writing skills, being able to create professional final response letters which break down complex issues into comprehensible information for consumers to understand.

  • You will also have a sound moral compass, speaking up where necessary to ensure that good customer outcomes are always at the heart of what we do, striving to resolve complaints without the need for the customer to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service, and ensuring you are applying any learnings from both internal and FOS complaints to future complaint cases.

The Interview Process

  • A quick phone call with one of the team

  • An exercise to demonstrate your ability to resolve complaints

  • An assessment to evidence your knowledge of FCA regulations and DISP complaint handling rules/guidance.

  • Onsite Interview

  • Discuss the exercises you have completed

  • Meet the team you’ll work with daily

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

About the role

This role is for someone wanting to start a career in operations within a financial services firm. You'll join as a Graduate focused on working complaints and train to become a fully competent Complaints Officer, investigating and resolving our more complex customer interactions across loans, cards and auto-finance. A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

This is a casework role. From early on you will hold your own caseload, speak to customers directly, make decisions on whether we got it right, and put things right where we didn't. You will be supported through structured training, coaching and quality feedback as you develop in the role

Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

  • The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

  • Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

  • Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

  • Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

  • The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

  • Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.

No prior complaints experience needed, we care about how you think, not what you already know. This role requires an ability to learn quickly, work to deadlines and support our customers effectively.

Your team's objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. We are committed to providing excellent customer service and to reaching the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we evolve as a business. The team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insight back into the business so we can improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers and therefore for us as a business has never been more important than now, as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

What you'll be doing

  • Investigating and resolving complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, taking each case on its own merits

  • Self-managing a varied and increasingly complex caseload: prioritising cases, choosing the best contact mechanism for each customer, and working efficiently enough to meet our KPI minimum standards

  • Communicating with complainants in writing and by phone — managing expectations, handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism, and finding solutions to the issues raised

  • Writing professional final response letters that set out our decision, our rationale and the customer's right to refer to the Financial Ombudsman Service

  • Following our complaint handling standards and keeping clear records, making sure every decision is backed by demonstrable evidence and a documented rationale

  • Working to resolve complaints without the customer needing to refer to FOS, and applying the learnings from both internal and FOS outcomes to future cases

  • Feeding back to frontline and product teams on the product and process improvements your cases surface, across Operations and the wider Lendable business

  • Keeping your knowledge of Lendable's products current through effective use and review of our policies, procedures and business tools

  • Turning your hand to other areas of operational need as the business requires

What we're looking for

  • Educated to degree level

  • Exceptional written communication - you can structure an argument and explain a complex decision clearly to someone who is not an expert

  • An aptitude for investigation, analysis, problem-solving and dispute resolution

  • Strong organisation and self-management - you can hold a caseload, prioritise it and work to deadlines without being chased

  • Sound judgment and a sound moral compass: willing to speak up to make sure good customer outcomes stay at the heart of what we do

  • Resilience and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

  • A willingness to learn FCA regulation and the DISP complaint handling rules and guidance

The interview process

We're not a corporation so we try our best to get things moving as quickly as possible. For this role we'd expect:

    Du bekommst ein eigenes Budget und die Freiheit, neue Formate zu testen, ohne unnötige Hierarchieschleifen. Wir leben eine „Test-and-Learn“-Kultur: Du darfst Risiken eingehen, ausprobieren und auch Content machen, der polarisiert, solange er unsere Mission voranbringt.
  • Professionelles Equipment und High-End-Hardware
    Wir stellen dir professionelle Kameras, Mikrofone und Licht. Für die Postproduktion bekommst du die Maschine, auf der du am besten arbeitest, egal ob MacBook Pro oder Dell XPS mit Linux, dazu 4K-Monitore und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Große Reichweite
    Über die Jahre haben wir mit unserer Plattform schon sehr viele Menschen erreicht. Durch diesen Traffic siehst du schnell, was funktioniert, und bekommst direktes Feedback auf deine Arbeit.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Dein Content hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Content Creator (w/m/d) bist du nicht nur für den Schnitt verantwortlich. Du kannst Strateg:in, Regisseur:in oder Performance-Analyst:in sein.

  • Strategisches Video-Scripting
    Du entwickelst kreative Video-Konzepte und Skripte für alle relevanten Social-Media-Kanäle (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) und bringst sie bis zur finalen Fassung.
  • Produktionsmanagement
    Du planst, koordinierst und setzt Videodrehs um, von der Idee bis zum Upload.
  • Storytelling mit Impact
    Gemeinsam mit unserem Anwaltsteam verwandelst du komplexe juristische Themen in leicht verständliche, authentische und emotionale Geschichten.
  • Redaktionsplanung
    Du baust eine Content-Pipeline auf und sorgst mit deiner Redaktionsplanung für konstanten Output.
  • Content-Multiplikation
    Du planst Cross-Promotion und verwertest Content clever über verschiedene Plattformen hinweg.
  • Trend-Scouting
    Du erkennst aktuelle Social-Media-Trends und Formate früh und adaptierst sie schnell für Migrando.
  • Performance-Analyse
    Du analysierst laufend, wie dein Content performt (Views, Watch Time, Engagement), und optimierst ihn stetig.
  • A/B-Testing
    Du testest systematisch Thumbnails, Teaser, Titel und Call-to-Actions, um Klickrate und Performance zu maximieren.
  • Community- & Engagement-Management
    Du baust eine engagierte Community auf und pflegst sie, indem du aktiv auf Kommentare und DMs antwortest.

Dein Profil

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer in der Praxis gearbeitet und echte Hands-on-Erfahrung gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählen deine Erfahrung, dein Können und dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Praktische Erfahrung in der Content-Produktion
    Du hast bereits Social-Media-Content produziert, der wirklich online gegangen ist und funktioniert hat, und kannst uns Beispiele dafür zeigen. Du weißt, was es heißt, regelmäßig zu liefern, und hast aus Erfolgen wie Flops gelernt.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Bereitschaft, vor der Kamera zu stehen
    Du hast keine Scheu, selbst vor der Kamera zu stehen, und motivierst auch Kolleg:innen, ihre Geschichte zu teilen.
  • Video-Schnitt
    Idealerweise beherrschst du professionelle Schnittprogramme (z. B. Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve). In unserem Social-Media-Team gibt es aber auch Bedarf an Scripting, Ideenentwicklung und Content-Planung, ganz ohne Schnittsoftware.
  • Scripting-Können
    Du hast Erfahrung im Storytelling und Scripting von Kurzvideos mit fesselnden Hooks und CTAs, die wirken.
  • Social-Media-Algorithmen
    Du verstehst die Mechanismen, Algorithmen und Best Practices von TikTok, Instagram und YouTube.
  • Engagement-Fokus
    Du denkst nicht nur in Reichweite, sondern in Interaktion. Deine Metrik ist die Engagement Rate.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität
    Du packst lieber an, als lange zu planen, baust schnell Prototypen und stellst Output über Perfektion.
  • Trendgespür
    Du bleibst am Puls der Zeit, erkennst virale Trends und Formate und weißt, wie wir sie für unseren Content nutzen können.
  • Was dir helfen wird
    Du kannst dich in die Fragen und Herausforderungen von Menschen hineinversetzen, die nach Deutschland gekommen sind, und weißt, wie du dazu recherchierst, um daraus Content zu entwickeln.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.

title: Content & Growth Marketer
descriptionHtml:
About Tradeaze

Tradeaze is on-demand delivery for the built environment. Builders' merchants book a delivery in our app, and a vetted driver collects from the branch and delivers to site the same day. We work with national groups like Jewson, Travis Perkins, EH Smith and Lords, and we are growing fast. You would be the second person in growth and marketing, joining as the new brand and website go live.

The role

You are a content-leaning generalist marketer who uses AI to do the work of a bigger team. Your job is to bring new branches onto Tradeaze and turn them into regular customers. You make the message; we run the system behind it.

What you will do

  • Make content for two audiences: the people who use Tradeaze every day (branch staff and drivers), and the people who follow us on LinkedIn as a tech-forward start-up. Posts, short video, case studies, printed pieces, content from around the office
  • Turn one real delivery into three things in a week: a case study, a post and a one-pager sales can carry into a branch
  • Write the campaigns that turn a new branch into a regular customer, from the idea to the words to the design
  • Sit with the marketing team at a merchant head office and run a joint campaign across their branches
  • Keep socials and the blog moving, with AI doing the first draft and you deciding what's good
  • Be out at yards and branches with a camera, and at trade events with a stand

Who you are

  • Around 3 years in marketing, in a small team or start-up where you made the work yourself. Less is fine if your work shows it
  • You take ownership. You spot what needs doing and do it without being asked, and you treat the results as yours.
  • You've designed things people actually used: a post, a flyer, a deck. Use whatever tool you like (Figma, Adobe), as long as the work looks professional
  • You write for an audience, whether you write it yourself or set the lines and guidelines and have AI draft it. Either way you know what a counter manager will read and what a LinkedIn follower will stop for
  • You already use AI in your work. You can show us something you shipped with it and talk us through how you use it
  • You've taken a campaign from the idea to launch: the message, the words and the design
  • You come to a conversation with ideas and you enjoy bouncing them off someone
  • You're personable: comfortable with sales reps, a room full of branch managers, and sitting with a merchant head office's marketing team to run a joint campaign
  • You'd rather get it live this week and improve it than plan it for a month
  • Nice to have: paid ads (you've run paid social or search with a budget), events (you've helped run a trade show stand) and email copy (you've written emails that get people to take one clear action)

Not for you if:

  • You want a brief handed to you
  • You need an agency to make things
  • You'd rather plan than ship

How we work

You will report to our GTM Engineer, and you both report to Jack, our CEO. You will work with the GTM Engineer day to day. They own the systems: the CRM, the email platform, the data and the sends. You own the message and the content. You will plan together, brainstorm together, and look at the numbers together every Monday. Jack opens the door with merchant head offices; you and the GTM Engineer run what happens next.

You will see your work on a live dashboard: what shipped, what it reached, and which branches ordered because of it.

What you get

  • £40k to £48k
  • Stock options
  • 25 days holiday
  • A laptop

How to apply

With your application, send us:

  1. 3 to 5 pieces of content you made yourself, ideally including one video you filmed and cut yourself (a phone is fine). Other examples: a social post or carousel, a campaign from idea to launch, a printed piece, a case study. For each one, a line on what you did and what it led to
  2. A few lines on how you use AI: which tools, for what, and one thing it let you ship

How we will hire

  1. Send us 3 to 5 pieces you made and a few lines on how you work with AI
  2. A call with Jack, our CEO
  3. A short campaign task, then a call with our GTM Engineer to talk it through
  4. Present your idea to the team in person: the same idea, updated with what you'd change. 15 minutes, no new deck needed

title: Creative Technologist
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We're seeking an exceptional Design Engineer to build the tooling that makes AI-native brand production actually work at scale. You might call yourself a design engineer, creative technologist or even a full-stack product engineer who cares about craft. Here you’ll be someone who builds real infrastructure specifically in service of brand and creative output, working alongside brand designers who owns taste and direction.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What you'll do

In one sentence: build the front-end surfaces and the AI-generation systems that let Lovable’s brand team produce at scale without losing its taste.

  • Build pipelines connecting image/video generation APIs, internal tooling, and the systems brand and marketing already use (Lovable, Design tools, CMS, the marketing site, Slack)

  • Build internal apps for the brand team - plausibly on Lovable itself, which is both a good dogfooding story and just the fastest way to do it

  • Own reliability and versioning for the AI-generation system so brand output doesn't silently drift in quality or style over time

  • Work closely with a Brand Designer who owns taste and direction - you're building the system that lets their judgment scale, not just executing tickets

  • Constantly evaluate new models, APIs, and generation tooling as the landscape moves, and rebuild pipelines when something better comes along

What we're looking for

  • Solid engineering fundamentals - you have a track record of building, shipping, and maintaining real full-stack software

  • Genuine interest in AI generation systems (image/video models, fine-tuning, prompt pipelines) as a technical problem, not just as a user; you’ve built something with these APIs, even if only for yourself

  • Experience translating scrappy explorations into production-ready systems

  • Some design sensibility is a strong plus - you don’t need to be a designer, but you can tell when output is off-brand without it being spelled out, and you enjoy working closely with people who have strong taste

  • Comfortable building for a function with no internal precedent - you'll be making calls with no playbook to lean on

  • You’ll push the boundaries of what's possible with generative pipelines the way our Design Engineers push the boundaries of the web

Nice to have

  • Experience with Lovable or similar AI-native building tools

  • Prior work on marketing sites, design systems or brand tooling

  • Portfolio or side projects that show both craft and curiosity

Our tech stack

Lovable is built with tools that both humans and AI love:

  • Frontend: React, Tailwind

  • Backend: Golang and Rust

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, many LLM and generation providers

  • DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform)

And always on the lookout for what's next, especially in image/video generation APIs and pipelines. You’ll build custom tools in chorus with Lovable, while also contributing to Lovable upstream.

How we hire

  1. Fill in a short form then jump on an intro call with a recruiter.

  2. Show us some of your work you're really proud of.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

  4. In some cases, we may opt to do paid trial work.

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English. It's our company language so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join.

  • We are prioritizing candidates who are based in London or Stockholm, or those willing to relocate.

  • We treat all candidates equally and if you're interested please apply through our careers portal.

🌟 About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team is crucial in providing independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely and ensure that the models we use deliver good outcomes for our customers. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) to join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across our suite of credit models, covering critical business disciplines such as credit strategy and impairment.

You’ll have a particular focus on models used for customer-level decisioning and defining our credit strategies - such as underwriting scorecards, origination PD models and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models - across all our lending products.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is deep expertise in credit risk modelling. You’ll have hands-on experience in either model validation or model development within a financial services environment, including practical experience using Python to develop, validate or analyse machine learning and statistical models. . In-depth knowledge of credit decisioning models would be a strong plus. 

🔑 You’ll play a key role by…

  • Leading hands-on independent validation of models used for credit decisioning within our Borrowing strategies - covering a range of machine learning, decision science and NPV models. You will be ensuring that models are fit for purpose, appropriately governed, explainable and performing as expected
  • Supporting oversight and validation of broader credit risk models, including IFRS9, stress testing and economic response models
  • Developing deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers to improve our modelling capabilities
  • Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
  • Performing statistical analyses to independently assess model performance, including developing challenger models where appropriate to test model assumptions and strengthen validation conclusions
  • Improving our Model Risk Framework, including overseeing our policies, standards and procedures to help embed best practice across the business. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory guidelines, and adapt our processes to make sure they remain relevant as modelling techniques evolve
  • Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
  • Partnering with colleagues in the first line of defence credit strategy and modelling teams - and wider risk teams across Monzo - to support the embedding of our model risk framework and establishing consistent validation standards across the organisation
  • Embracing new and innovative technology, including leading the adoption of AI tools to enhance our model validation approach

 🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation - in particular with exposure to machine learning or statistical models used in credit decisioning, such as decision science scorecards, origination / underwriting PD models, and NPV / unit economics modelling
  • Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep understanding of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Being able to get hands on with data is critical - so strong SQL and Python skills are essential, and experience with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus!
  • Understand how models are used in real-time decisioning and lending strategies, and how to balance commercial and risk outcomes
  • Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
  • Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge
  • Are impact-driven, and proactive in identifying issues and opportunities to improve outcomes for both our customers and our business
  • Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

  • Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure
  • dbt and BigQuery SQL for our data modelling and warehousing
  • Python for data science and machine learning
  • Go to write our application code
  • AWS for most of our backend infrastructure

The interview process: 

Our interview process usually involves up to four main stages via Google Hangouts: 

  • An initial call with our recruiter
  • A call with our Senior Model Validation Manager, the hiring manager for the role 
  • A role-specific call with colleagues from our credit modelling teams. We’ll share a short case study in advance, but you won’t need to submit a written response; we’ll use it to guide the discussion during the interview.
  • A behavioural interview 

    🙌 What’s in it for you

    • 💰 £79,000 - £93,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance benefits.

    • 📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

    • ⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

    • 📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

    • 🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

    • ➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

title: Customer Care Associate – (Multilingual)
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

As Customer Care Associate, you will own customer issue resolution end to end and ensure distributors receive fast, reliable support in their day to day operations. You are accountable for ensuring customer order flow stays running and resolving customer issues as they arise.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer issues from first contact through resolution across French and Spanish-speaking markets

  • Build and deliver fast, reliable support workflows used by distributors in day-to-day operations

  • Work through messy, time-sensitive issues (order errors, blocked accounts, product problems) to keep operations running smoothly

  • Make decisions that directly impact customer satisfaction, retention, and order flow continuity

  • Improve support quality by identifying patterns in recurring issues and driving root-cause fixes

  • Take responsibility for clear escalation and coordination with internal teams when needed

  • Coaching and training of external agents supporting Choco customers

  • Collaborate with external support agents and internal teams to maintain high-quality service standards

What you bring

  • 1+ years of experience in customer support or operations in fast-paced, tech-enabled environments, with a track record of owning outcomes

  • Comfort operating across multiple tools and stakeholders in ambiguity and high-pressure situations

  • Strong judgment in prioritization and real-time problem solving

  • Accountability when things go wrong and the drive to resolve issues fully

  • Native level of French speaking & writing is required

  • Fluency in Spanish and English (C1+ written and spoken)

Working hours

This is a customer-facing operational role with fixed coverage requirements. You will work Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 18:00, including a daily upaid lunch break. You must be consistently available during these hours to support customers across both Choco and Goot.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. title: Customer Success Account Manager, Mid-Market
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

You help customers adopt the platform, realise measurable value, and renew and expand with confidence. You pick up where Implementation leaves off, learn each customer's fleet and challenges, and advise on tailoring Samsara to them. You manage 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to extend your reach and focus your time where it counts. Your understanding of the value customers get earns you the right to lead the ROI conversation, negotiate terms and close renewals that work for both sides, minimising financial attrition. You work with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together, and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will:

  • Deeply understand the Samsara platform's capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types, from field services and utilities to long-haul transportation and school buses.
  • Manage a portfolio of 100+ named accounts, using AI tooling to accelerate your engagement, prioritize proactively, and drive efficiency and outcomes across your book of business.
  • Lead the ROI and value conversation into the renewal, negotiate favorable terms, and close renewals that are a win for both the customer and Samsara while minimizing financial attrition.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to understand and explain technical issues to a non-technical audience and to engage the right cross-functional partners to drive resolution.
  • Conduct workshops with customers to understand their current operations and recommend workflow changes to maximize the value of their Samsara products.
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Deal Desk, Operations and Product to strategically solve problems and optimize customer experience and business outcomes.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Business fluency in French (spoken and written).
  • 2+ years in a customer-facing, quota-carrying role (renewals, customer success, account management or sales), ideally in SaaS, technology or logistics.
  • A record of consistent quota over-achievement.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, and the ability to build trust with executives, users and internal teams.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Gainsight, Gong or similar GTM tools.
  • Comfort in a fast-changing, high-growth environment.
  • A bachelor's degree from a 4-year institution, or equivalent practical experience.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • A strong bias towards action, big-picture thinking and high standards.
  • An AI-first approach: you use AI tooling to drive efficiency and outcomes.
  • Technical depth across a suite of products, with a bonus for hardware-software integration.
  • Industry Knowledge: Experience with routing, navigation, commercial trucking fleets, and logistics.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Als Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) bist du die persönliche Ansprechperson für unsere Abschlussjahrgänge, von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, das Onboarding läuft über Videos und Formulare. Du kümmerst dich um das, was Automatisierung nicht kann: echte Beziehungen zu den Jahrgängen aufbauen und dafür sorgen, dass jedes Projekt sicher ins Ziel kommt. Das heißt kurze Wege, direkte Wirkung und viel Verantwortung. Es heißt aber auch, dass du eigenständig arbeiten und priorisieren musst.

Aufgaben

  • Betreuung: Du betreust unsere Jahrgänge per Videocall, Chat und Telefon und bist für alles da, was über Chatbot und Helpcenter hinausgeht.

  • Projektbegleitung: Du begleitest jeden Jahrgang von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung, behältst Fristen und Freigaben im Blick und fasst nach, wenn ein Projekt hängt. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Operations-Team zusammen, das Produktion und Lieferung steuert.

  • Pipeline: Du hast deine Kunden eigenständig im Griff: Status, nächste Schritte, Risiken. Wo es eng wird, merkst du es vor dem Kunden.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Wir bauen buchbare Video-Calls auf, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Begleitung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen. Du gestaltest das Format mit und führst die Calls.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und sorgst dafür, dass Chatbot und Helpcenter sie künftig beantworten.

  • Wachstum: Wenn du Lust hast, wächst du in Upselling und Referral hinein: Textilien für Jahrbuch-Kunden, Jahrbuch für Textil-Kunden, Schulshops und Empfehlungen an andere Jahrgänge und Schulen.

So arbeiten wir

  • Persönlich ist unser Unterschied. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt und stemmen oft ihr erstes großes Projekt. Sie brauchen jemanden, der erreichbar ist, mitdenkt und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Support oder Customer Success gesammelt. Wie lange, interessiert uns weniger als das, was du daraus mitnimmst.

  • Quereinstieg ist willkommen, zum Beispiel aus dem Lehramt, auch ohne abgeschlossenes Referendariat.

  • Du kannst mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache.

  • Telefon und Kamera schrecken dich nicht ab, im Gegenteil.

  • Du organisierst dich selbst und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Projekten den Überblick.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig, auch wenn viel gleichzeitig läuft. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit CRM-Tools und digitalen Kanälen.

  • Du erkennst, wenn ein Kunde mehr braucht, und sprichst es an. Vertriebserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: vom Support hin zu echtem Customer Success mit Upselling und Referral

  • Ein kleines Team, in dem deine Arbeit direkt sichtbar ist

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Firmenlaptop, Sachgutscheine sowie D-Ticket oder JobRad

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. Wir begrüßen BewerberInnen verschiedenster Hintergründe, ungeachtet ihrer Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Ethnizität, nationaler Herkunft, sexuellen Orientierung, Migrationsgeschichte, Alter oder Einschränkungen.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

title: Data & AI Governance Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Help organisaties om data en AI verantwoord, betrouwbaar en effectief in te zetten.

Data- en AI-governance is meer dan beleid en procedures. Het zorgt ervoor dat organisaties grip krijgen op hun data, betere beslissingen nemen en AI op een verantwoorde manier kunnen inzetten.

Bij adesso helpen we organisaties om datagedreven en AI-gedreven werken duurzaam te organiseren. Niet door alleen modellen en policies te introduceren, maar door governance te verbinden aan businesswaarde, adoptie en de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als Data & AI Governance Consultant help jij klanten om structuur aan te brengen, eigenaarschap te organiseren en hun datamanagement en AI-governance verder te professionaliseren. Je vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar praktische oplossingen die daadwerkelijk werken.

Jouw rol

Jij brengt structuur in complexe data- en AI-vraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om hun governanceprocessen te verbeteren, verantwoordelijkheden helder te maken en data beter te benutten.

Je werkt zelfstandig aan analyses, workshops en verbeterinitiatieven en schakelt daarbij met stakeholders uit business en IT. Samen met collega's en klanten vertaal je strategische doelstellingen naar concrete acties.

Je krijgt de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, je expertise te verdiepen en steeds meer zelfstandig klanten te adviseren.


Wat je doet

Data- en AI-governance

  • Je adviseert klanten over data governance, datamanagement en verantwoord gebruik van AI.

  • Je helpt bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van governance operating models, inclusief rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en besluitvorming.

  • Je voert zelfstandig maturity assessments uit en vertaalt de resultaten naar concrete verbeteradviezen.

  • Je ondersteunt bij het ontwikkelen van datastrategieën, governanceprincipes, policies en praktische roadmaps.

  • Je helpt organisaties om data ownership en data stewardship goed in te richten.

Data quality, metadata & AI

  • Je analyseert en verbetert processen rondom datakwaliteit, metadata en data lineage.

  • Je helpt bij het definiëren van kwaliteitsafspraken, KPI's en verantwoordelijkheden.

  • Je werkt samen met data engineers, architecten en andere specialisten om governancevraagstukken te vertalen naar werkbare oplossingen.

  • Je onderzoekt hoe AI en automatisering datamanagementprocessen kunnen verbeteren.

  • Je houdt rekening met privacy, security, Responsible AI en relevante wet- en regelgeving, zoals de EU AI Act.

Consultancy & stakeholdermanagement

  • Je faciliteert workshops met business- en IT-stakeholders om behoeften, knelpunten en verbeterkansen in kaart te brengen.

  • Je vertaalt zakelijke doelstellingen naar concrete governance-initiatieven en meetbare resultaten.

  • Je presenteert analyses, bevindingen en aanbevelingen op een duidelijke en overtuigende manier.

  • Je ondersteunt klanten bij het invoeren van nieuwe processen en werkwijzen en helpt draagvlak te creëren.

  • Je signaleert kansen voor aanvullende dienstverlening en bespreekt deze met je team.

Samenwerking & ontwikkeling

  • Je neemt zelfstandig verantwoordelijkheid voor onderdelen van klantprojecten en bewaakt de voortgang en kwaliteit van je werkzaamheden.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines en schakelt tijdig wanneer ondersteuning nodig is.

  • Je gebruikt AI-tools waar ze waarde toevoegen en beoordeelt de uitkomsten kritisch, met aandacht voor vertrouwelijkheid en dataveiligheid.

  • Je deelt kennis, begeleidt waar mogelijk minder ervaren collega's en draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze dienstverlening.


Wat jij meebrengt
Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en weet complexe onderwerpen begrijpelijk te maken. Je vindt het leuk om met klanten samen te werken en krijgt energie van het verbeteren van processen en organisaties.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante ervaring binnen data governance, datamanagement of dataconsultancy.

  • Kennis van data governance, data quality, data stewardship en governanceprocessen.

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van analyses, begeleiden van workshops of adviseren van stakeholders.

  • Begrip van data-architectuur, datamodellering en de samenwerking tussen business en IT.

  • Interesse in AI-governance en het verantwoord toepassen van AI binnen organisaties.

  • Je gebruikt AI zelf in je werk en onderzoekt graag hoe het slimmer kan.

  • Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en weet wanneer je collega's moet betrekken.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om verschillende belangen samen te brengen.

  • Een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen

  • Ervaring met maturity assessments, governance operating models of het opstellen van RACI's.

  • Kennis van DAMA-DMBOK of een CDMP-certificering, of de ambitie om deze te behalen.

  • Ervaring met datacatalogustools zoals Microsoft Purview, Collibra of Alation.

  • Kennis van metadata, data lineage en data quality frameworks.

  • Kennis van Responsible AI, de EU AI Act of data-readiness voor AI.

Over ons team

Je komt terecht in een klein, enthousiast en leergierig team van drie collega's. De lijnen zijn kort, iedereen heeft invloed en ideeën worden niet alleen gehoord, maar ook uitgeprobeerd. Onze focus ligt op de consultancykant van data en AI. We begeleiden organisaties bij AI-transformaties en beginnen altijd bij het echte probleem van de klant. Van daaruit ontwikkelen we roadmaps en helpen we bij de implementatie.

We werken aan data- en AI-governance, datastrategie, change management en datakwaliteit. Daarbij onderzoeken we continu hoe AI ons werk en dat van onze klanten slimmer kan maken.

Ontwikkeling staat voorop. We delen kennis, proberen nieuwe werkwijzen uit en leren van elkaar. Heb je een andere achtergrond binnen datamanagement? Ook dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI First: samen bouwen aan de toekomst

Bij adesso Nederland ontwikkelen we ons tot een AI First-organisatie. We geloven dat AI de manier waarop we software ontwikkelen, met data werken en klanten helpen fundamenteel verandert.

Daarom kijken we verder dan losse AI-experimenten. We bouwen aan slimme dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die écht onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat betekent ook dat we onze eigen manier van werken blijven vernieuwen. We omarmen nieuwe technologie, maar blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.


En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een salaris van €5.400,- tot €6.600,- afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding boven op je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team.

Zullen we kennismaken?
Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

title: Data & AI Architect (m/w/d)

title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
FanDuel Group is a world-class team of brands and products that deliver sports betting, gaming and entertainment to millions of US sports fans every day. That’s no easy task and wouldn't be possible without a fantastic team who have helped us pioneer new products and innovative features that make us a leader in the industry.

The company is based in New York with US offices in Los Angeles, Atlanta, and Jersey City, as well as global offices in Canada and Scotland. The company’s affiliates have offices worldwide, including in Ireland, Portugal, Romania, and Australia.

FanDuel Group is a subsidiary of Flutter Entertainment, the world's largest sports betting and gaming operator with a portfolio of globally recognized brands and traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: FLUT).

THE POSITION

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We are seeking a Data Engineer to help lead the technical design and implementation of our most critical data infrastructure and products. You’ll be responsible for designing scalable systems, setting data architecture standards, and solving complex technical challenges that power analytics, data science, and business function use cases across the company.

You will work closely with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to architect data solutions that are performant, reliable, and built with a long-term, customer-centric mindset.

If you’re excited by this challenge and want to work within a dynamic company, then we’d love to hear from you.

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

Implement High-Impact Data Systems

  • Implement and help design scalable, maintainable, and secure real-time and streaming data infrastructure and architectures that support enterprise-wide data needs
  • Define standards for real-time system design and real-time tooling using modern tools and cloud-native technologies, and driving technical roadmaps for multi-phase and cross-team initiatives
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business and analytical requirements into end-to-end data solutions

Drive Engineering Best Practices

  • Embody engineering best practices around code quality, testing, documentation, and deployment
  • Contribute to the evolution of the data platform, ensuring systems are modular, interoperable, and resilient
  • Contribute to technical design and code reviews, mentoring peers and raising the bar for engineering excellence

Contribute to Strategic Initiatives

  • Partner with data platform, data engineering, analytics, data science, and product engineering teams to deliver reusable data assets and shared infrastructure
  • Identify and resolve structural and performance bottlenecks in the current data platform and propose improvements that reduce complexity and boost performance
  • Help define and deliver on metrics and initiatives that improve system reliability, scalability, data quality, lineage, and observability

THE STATS

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering or a related field, with a focus on building scalable data systems and platforms.
  • Expertise in modern streaming data tools and frameworks such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, and cloud-native services (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Deep understanding of streaming architectures, distributed systems, ETL/ELT pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and build processes.
  • Proficiency at least one object-oriented programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Scala) and scripting
  • Demonstrated experience working on complex technical systems end-to-end, from design through production
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on complex and large-scale data platforms that support analytics, machine learning, and operational workloads
  • Familiarity with data governance, privacy, and compliance frameworks
  • Background in customer-centric or product-driven environments (e.g., digital, eCommerce, SaaS)
  • Experience with data modelling and data processing tooling and best practices

PLAYER BENEFITS
We treat our team right
Interesting work - Working in a fast-paced and ever-changing industry, new problems and exciting solutions are never too far away. There are always opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your horizons.

  • A sense of achievement - Our teams own the outcome. When that awesome new feature ships to users and the positive feedback starts rolling in, you can feel really proud of what you and your team created.
  • Personal development – We strive to create clear and defined career pathways for every role at every level and give our employees the tools they need to learn, develop, and become leaders.
  • Belonging - Everyone at FanDuel supports one another: we win together, make mistakes together to learn from them and to focus on the future, and have lots of fun doing it.
  • Trust - A trusting work environment where productivity is valued above all else, giving you autonomy and ownership of your time and work.
  • Great financial package - Including salary, bonus, pension, private healthcare, share save scheme, flexible working & holiday policy, along with a number of other benefits.

FanDuel is an equal opportunities employer and we believe, as one of our principles states, “We are One Team!”. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. descriptionHtml:

Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

We're hiring full stack data scientists who love to get into the nitty gritty of the domain, have an instinct for commercial value, and own the entire process from data exploration to production.

title: Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission

As a Customer Data Scientist at Hawk, you're the person our customers trust to make their AML and fraud detection models actually work for them: tuned to their transaction patterns, defensible to their regulators, and provably effective in their own numbers. You sit inside the regional customer team, working directly alongside Customer Value Partners on live accounts, not behind a wall of tickets from a central data science function. Your work spans model and threshold tuning, deep analytical investigation into detection performance, and building the customer-facing narrative that shows exactly what's improved and why. You've done this in front of customers before, and you know the difference between a model that scores well in a notebook and one that survives contact with a real investigator's workload.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tune and optimize detection models and thresholds against each customer's live transaction data, balancing detection effectiveness against false positive load, not just against a benchmark dataset.

  • Investigate detection performance deeply: dig into missed cases, alert quality, and pattern drift, and turn what you find into concrete tuning or configuration changes.

  • Translate technical findings into customer-facing insight: build the analysis that shows investigator productivity gains, false positive cost reduction, and detection effectiveness improvements in language a customer's compliance and risk leadership actually uses.

  • Sit in the room with customers directly. Present findings, defend your methodology to a customer's own data science or compliance team, and answer the hard “why did the model do this” questions live.

  • Partner closely with your regional Customer Value Partners on account strategy, informing where the model needs to change to unlock the next stage of value realization or a renewal conversation.

  • Feed patterns and findings back into Hawk's broader model and product functions, distinguishing between “this customer needs local tuning” and “this is a systemic gap worth fixing centrally.”

  • Own the regulatory defensibility of the tuning decisions you make. Document your reasoning so a customer's audit or regulator review holds up.

  • Bring rigor to how you validate model changes before they go live: backtesting, sample review, and sign-off discipline that protects the customer's compliance posture.

Your Profile

  • 5-7 years as a data scientist in a customer-facing role, presenting analysis and defending model decisions directly to clients. This is not an internal-facing engineering or product data science background; you've sat across the table from a customer before.

  • Real experience in AML, fraud detection, or financial crime analytics is required. You understand transaction monitoring, typologies, and what a false positive actually costs an investigator, not just what one costs on a confusion matrix.

  • Strong hands-on skills in the standard data science stack (Python, SQL, and whatever ML tooling you've used in production), but your edge is judgment under ambiguity: knowing when a model change is safe to make and when it needs a human in the loop.

  • Comfortable being the technical voice in a room with a customer's risk, compliance, or data science stakeholders, and holding your own when questioned.

  • A track record of translating model performance into business value a non-technical stakeholder can act on: not just accuracy metrics, but investigator hours saved, false positive cost avoided, and cases caught.

  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and live production systems. You're not looking for a clean offline research problem, you're looking for the “why did this alert fire on a real customer's data at 2pm today” problem.

  • An ownership mentality. You don't wait for a ticket; you notice when an account's detection performance is drifting and you go find out why.

Bonus

  • Experience specifically in transaction monitoring or payments fraud detection at a bank, payment provider, or a vendor serving them.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI and rules-based hybrid detection approaches, since that's core to how Hawk's models work.

This role matters more now than ever. AI coding agents write more of our production code, and they ship whatever they find. A design system that's incomplete or inconsistent doesn't just slow designers down; it gets compounded at scale by every agent that builds against it. You'll make sure WRITER's core UI library is complete and trustworthy enough to build on, working closely with the designers, PMs, and engineers who rely on it every day. You'll help shape the surfaces that define how our product feels to use, and help set the standard and process for how the EPD org ships product.

This is a hybrid role based out of our San Francisco, Chicago, Austin, New York City, Seattle, or London hubs. This role will be reporting to the Director of product design.
