title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
descriptionHtml:
Mindset Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière. Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise. Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision, une stratégie claire, et une gouvernance solide. Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte.
Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer
pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents,
composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent
d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable.
Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence.
Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit
vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow
sans friction.
How we work together 🤝
  • Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes.
  • Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production.
  • Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits.
  • Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs.
  • Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme

    • How we get work done 🚀
  • Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme.
  • Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation.
  • Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code.
  • Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement.
  • Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes.
  • Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités

    • How our work creates impact 🎯
  • Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction
  • Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables
  • Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite
  • Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant
  • Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence

    • Compétences 💼
  • Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes.
  • Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions.

  • Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent.

title: DevOps, Core Platform
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

We are building software infrastructure to power AI development and delivery for operational use cases in defense. Our software needs to run in customers' data centers, on their hardware, often with no internet connection. You will own the continuous deployment of our software in these environments. That covers installations, upgrades with no downtime, and keeping track of dependencies between the services that make up the software.

This role involves hands-on coding. You will join the core platform team, with broad ownership and a direct effect on real defense deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Delivery: Take a change from a commit in CI to a running system on a customer site, and keep every step repeatable.

  • Safe upgrades: Roll out upgrades step by step with no downtime, watch the system as it changes, and stop and alert the team automatically when something goes wrong.

  • Disconnected sites: Make installs and upgrades work with no internet, using signed, self-contained packages.

  • Release checks: Work on the release system that checks that all our services work together, in CI and at release time.

  • Collaboration: Work with platform architects and developers so every new service is easy to package, deploy and upgrade. Work with our forward deployed engineers, who install and run the software at customer sites, so the same tools run in development and at the customer.

  • Documentation: Write the procedures that a person at a customer site can follow without our help.

  • Growth: Make it easier and faster for our engineers to ship changes to customer sites.

Candidate requirements

  • Experience: Several years of backend or infrastructure engineering, ideally on a product with many services and many deployments.

  • Coding: Strong skills in at least one language (Rust, Go, Python, Java).

  • Kubernetes and delivery: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and containers, and with Helm, GitOps (Argo CD or Flux) and CI systems.

  • Builder: You have built, not just used, tools that deploy or run software.

  • Production: You have run or debugged upgrades or deployments in production, and you know the basics of metrics, health checks and logs.

  • Educational background: Degree in computer science, software engineering or a similar field. Equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

  • Language: Clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Writing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Signing and supply-chain tools, such as Sigstore/cosign and SBOMs.

  • Packaging software for air-gapped sites, for example with Zarf and registry mirrors such as Harbor.

  • Bare-metal Kubernetes (OpenShift, RKE2 or Talos) with Ceph or MinIO.

Mindset

  • Pragmatic engineering: You choose simple solutions and proven tools first.

  • Attention to detail: You obsess over edge cases and robustness before you ship a change.

  • User-oriented: You treat other engineers as your users. You take care designing APIs and tools that are simple and pleasant to use.

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for ensuring the project works regardless of your job description.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: DevOps Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom
descriptionHtml:
DevOps Engineer - Research Participants - United Kingdom

 

 

Location: Remote (UK)
Type of contract: Freelance
Hourly Rate: £19 (pay based on actual study time)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.

The RoleDo you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting DevOps engineers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a DevOps engineer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts. 

Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.

The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.

What you’ll be doing

  • Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant
  • Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences
  • Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective
  • Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part

What you’ll bring

  • Residence in the UK
  • Fluent English
  • A device with a working microphone
  • No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.

Why join this project?This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.

Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.

Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

descriptionHtml:
Dein Team

Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen, ziehen Menschen an, die etwas bewegen wollen. Bei der fino data services arbeitest du mit Menschen, die neugierig sind, schnell denken und Dinge gerne selbst in die Hand nehmen. Die sich festbeißen, wenn etwas spannend wird, ihre Ideen laut aussprechen und nicht beim ersten Lösungsansatz aufhören. Hier treffen unterschiedliche Köpfe, Perspektiven und Stärken aufeinander. Wir diskutieren, challengen uns, lernen voneinander und bauen gemeinsam Lösungen, die wirklich etwas verändern. Du bekommst dabei nicht nur ein Team, sondern Rückenwind für deine Ideen, Raum zum Ausprobieren und Menschen, die mit dir aus einer guten Idee etwas Besonderes machen. Wenn du Lust hast, mit Leuten zu arbeiten, die genauso viel vorhaben wie du: Willkommen bei der fino data services.

Aufgaben

Was du bei uns verantwortest

Security Monitoring im Tagesgeschäft

  • Du überwachst täglich und hands-on unsere Security-Dashboards und hast den Sicherheitsstatus unserer Systeme jederzeit im Blick.

  • Du erkennst Auffälligkeiten frühzeitig, bewertest sie und leitest selbst die nötigen Schritte ein, statt sie nur weiterzugeben.

  • Du entwickelst unsere Dashboards, Alerts und Kennzahlen weiter, damit relevante Signale nicht im Rauschen untergehen.

  • Im Ernstfall behältst du den Überblick und arbeitest Sicherheitsvorfälle strukturiert ab.

Sicherheit in der Pipeline

  • Du verankerst Sicherheitsprüfungen fest in unseren CI/CD-Pipelines, von statischer Code-Analyse (SAST) über dynamische Tests (DAST) bis zur Prüfung von Abhängigkeiten (SCA).

  • Du wählst die passenden Werkzeuge aus und legst fest, welche Befunde einen Build stoppen. So schützt Sicherheit unsere Teams, statt sie auszubremsen.

  • Du bewertest Schwachstellen nach ihrem tatsächlichen Risiko und sorgst dafür, dass das Wichtige zuerst erledigt wird.

Software-Lieferkette & Infrastruktur

  • Du sicherst unsere Software-Lieferkette ab: Abhängigkeiten, Build-Artefakte und Container-Images werden nachvollziehbar dokumentiert (SBOM) und signiert.

  • Du bringst unser Secrets Management auf ein sauberes Niveau: Passwörter, Zertifikate und API-Schlüssel gehören in einen Tresor, nicht in den Code.

  • Du härtest Container- und Cloud-Umgebungen, vergibst Rechte nach dem Least-Privilege-Prinzip und erkennst Fehlkonfigurationen, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

  • Du schreibst Sicherheitsregeln als Code fest und setzt sie automatisiert durch (Policy as Code).

Security-Kultur & Compliance

  • Du führst gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungsteams Threat Modelings durch, schulst und baust Security Champions auf.

  • Du unterstützt die technische Umsetzung und den Nachweis der Anforderungen unserer ISO-Zertifizierung.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass auch KI-generierter Code und KI-Agenten sicher in unsere Prozesse eingebunden sind, und behältst regulatorische Anforderungen wie den Cyber Resilience Act im Blick.

Qualifikation

  • Ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä., eine IT-Ausbildung (z. B. in der Fachinformatik) oder einen vergleichbaren Weg. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst.

  • Mehrjährige Praxis in Softwareentwicklung, DevOps oder Plattformbetrieb: Du hast selbst Code geschrieben und Systeme betrieben.

  • Fundiertes Security-Know-how: OWASP Top 10 in der Praxis, Threat Modeling, Cloud- und Container-Security.

  • Erfahrung im aktiven Security Monitoring: Du arbeitest gern täglich mit Dashboards, Logs und Alerts und gehst Auffälligkeiten selbst auf den Grund.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD (z. B. GitLab CI oder GitHub Actions), Docker und Kubernetes sowie Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform).

  • Sicher in mindestens einer Programmier- oder Skriptsprache wie Python, Go oder Bash; Erfahrung mit Elixir/Phoenix ist ein Plus.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit Tools wie Semgrep, SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, HashiCorp Vault, Sigstore oder OPA sowie Zertifizierungen wie CKS.

  • Überzeugen statt anordnen: Du erklärst unseren Entwicklungsteams, warum der Build rot ist, und dem Management, welches Risiko im nächsten Release steckt.

  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten, auch wenn hunderte Befunde offen sind.

  • Sprachen: sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig an unseren Teamtagen teilzunehmen.

Benefits

Was wir bieten:

Klare Verantwortlichkeiten und Unterstützung:
Bei uns weißt du genau, was von dir erwartet wird, und du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem Fehler als wertvolle Lernchancen betrachtet werden.

Gemeinschaftliches Engagement für außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse:
Unser Team strebt leidenschaftlich nach Spitzenleistungen und sieht deinen Beitrag als unverzichtbar an. Gemeinsam erreichen wir Großartiges.

Individuelle Entwicklung und Selbstverantwortung:
Wir fördern Selbstmotivation und deine persönliche Verantwortung, um herausragende Leistungen zu erzielen.

Dynamisches Feedback für kontinuierliches Lernen:
Bei uns erhältst du direktes und zeitnahes Feedback, damit du schnell auf Veränderungen reagieren und dich kontinuierlich verbessern kannst.

Offene Kommunikation und persönliche Entwicklung:
Wir leben offene Kommunikation und unterstützen dich aktiv bei der Gestaltung deiner persönlichen und beruflichen Entwicklung.

Lösungsorientierung und Unternehmenserfolg im Fokus:
Unser Ziel ist es, Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die das Unternehmen voranbringen. Dein Engagement für diesen Erfolg wird bei uns hoch geschätzt.

Teamtage, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeiern: Gemeinsame Events für Teamspirit und Freude am Arbeitsplatz

title: Direct Mail Growth Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

title: Director - Business Development
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.  

DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS

Based in Munich, Germany, as the Director - Business Development, you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe

  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders
  • Professional fluency in German and English

  • Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business
  • Specialization in German or European government business development, with deep experience selling to German or European national security, defense, civil space, or government customers
  • Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms
  • Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs
  • Experience working with or within organizations such as DLR, Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, German federal government entities, ESA, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, EU defense bodies, NATO, or other European space and defense institutions
  • Experience pursuing European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways
  • Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense Fund (EDF), European Defense Industry Program (EDIP), EU Space Program initiatives, and related European defense modernization priorities

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English

WHAT TO EXPECT

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. Qualifications

A highly driven, dynamic, engaged and accomplished physician-scientist with experience and insight will thrive in this role. Specific qualifications include:

title: Director, European Government Operations
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab’s business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO

  • Build and lead Rocket Lab’s in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market
  • Develop and lead Rocket Lab’s government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives
  • Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies
  • Establish and grow Rocket Lab’s presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs
  • Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs
  • Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab’s interests are represented and understood
  • Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business
  • Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company’s visibility and credibility
  • Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field
  • 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions
  • Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring
  • Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes
  • Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

  • Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors
  • Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies
  • Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting
  • Experience working in Munich’s government, defense, or technology ecosystem
  • Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

By applying for the above position, you will confirm that you have reviewed and agreed to our: Data Privacy Policy.

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.   

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here.

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY:

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant.  These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. 

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality.  For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Director, Growth
descriptionHtml:
Location: This position is hybrid in London, United Kingdom.

This role requires travel across EMEA, including the client meetings, industry events, and relationship-building activities that support enterprise growth.

The role. 

Huge is accelerating its growth across EMEA and is looking for a growth leader who can turn market opportunities and senior relationships into new business. You’ll identify where Huge can win, build relationships with enterprise decision-makers, originate qualified opportunities, and lead pursuits from first conversation through close.

You’ll work closely with Huge’s Global Growth team, Marketing and Communications, Alliances, senior client partners, and practice leaders to build pipeline and convert it into revenue. Success is measured by qualified pipeline generated, new business won, and revenue closed.

What you’ll be doing. 

Generate new business.

  • Build and execute a prioritized EMEA target account strategy, using Huge’s ideal client profile, market signals, and buying triggers to focus on the opportunities most likely to convert.
  • Originate opportunities through direct outreach, senior relationships, referrals, industry events, and partner channels.
  • Build relationships with CMOs, CDOs, CTOs, and other decision-makers to uncover business challenges before they become formal briefs.
  • Qualify opportunities early, establishing business need, access to decision-makers, budget, timing, and a credible path to winning.
  • Turn conversations into defined next steps and qualified pipeline.

Build relationships and active channels. 

  • Develop a strong network of enterprise buyers, agency search consultants, advisors, former clients, and referral sources across EMEA.
  • Partner with Huge’s Alliances team to develop joint opportunities and co-sell with strategic technology partners, including Adobe, Google Cloud, Contentful, Optimizely, Shopify, and Salesforce.
  • Activate Huge’s existing relationships and partner ecosystem to create warm introductions and access to priority accounts.
  • Work with Marketing and Communications to turn campaigns, thought leadership, and events into relevant reasons to engage target buyers.

Lead pursuits and close deals. 

  • Own the commercial strategy for opportunities you originate, from qualification and pursuit planning through proposal, negotiation, and signature.
  • Develop a compelling why Huge, why now narrative grounded in the client’s business priorities, market context, and buying triggers.
  • Bring together the right leaders across strategy, experience, technology, data, and creative to build a differentiated, competitive proposition.
  • Align client partners and delivery leaders around the solution, scope, value proposition, and commercial model.
  • Maintain pursuit momentum, manage risks, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.
  • Partner with Growth Operations to maintain accurate CRM data, pipeline forecasts, and performance reporting.

Connect market insight to growth.

  • Align outbound priorities with account-based marketing, event strategy, and alliance partner plans.
  • Translate Huge’s capabilities across brand, experience, product, technology, data, and AI into relevant business outcomes for specific buyers.
  • Bring market intelligence back to the organization, including emerging client needs, competitive dynamics, objections, and messages that resonate.
  • Help refine Huge’s regional go-to-market strategy based on what you learn from buyers and the opportunities you pursue.

What we’d like to see.

  • 8+ years of experience in enterprise business development, new business, or growth at an agency, consultancy, or professional services firm.
  • A demonstrated record of originating and closing six- and seven-figure enterprise engagements across EMEA.
  • An established network of senior marketing, digital, technology, or business leaders in the region.
  • Experience selling complex services spanning digital transformation, customer experience, brand, marketing, technology, or related disciplines.
  • Familiarity with agency search consultants, competitive pitches, and enterprise procurement processes.
  • Experience with AI-enabled, data-led, or platform-based services is a plus.

About Huge.

Huge is an independent, human-first AI-native design and technology company. We make things that matter by bringing AI, people, design and technology together as one system. With more than 1,000 design and technology experts working in hub cities around the world, including Bogotá, Chicago, Ho Chi Minh City, London, Los Angeles, Medellín, New York, San Francisco, and Washington, DC, we partner with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, including Google, NBCU, PepsiCo, Vail Resorts, Atlantic Health, and Candescent. Learn more at hugeinc.com.

Huge is committed to creating an inclusive employee experience for all. Regardless of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, disability, or if you’re parenting the next generation of innovators, we firmly believe that our work is at its best when everyone feels free to be their most authentic self.

Huge is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We strongly support diversity in the workforce. We are committed to an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. title: Director, International Tax
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Director, International Tax 

We are looking for an Director, International Tax to build and own the international tax function at Quince. This is the first dedicated tax hire in the company, and it arrives at the moment we need it most: Quince is entering Europe, Mexico, Australia, and numerous other countries on an aggressive timeline, and every one of those markets brings tax questions we do not currently have an in-house answer to.

Entity structure. Permanent establishment. VAT and GST registration. Withholding tax. Transfer pricing. Customs and import duty treatment. Local filing obligations we may not know exist until we have already tripped over them. The International Tax Director is the person who knows where those blind spots are before we walk into them, and who tells us what we need to do about them while it is still a decision rather than a problem.

The role reports directly to the VP of Accounting and functions as their right hand on anything tax — the person who can answer any tax question, or knows exactly how to go get the answer. This role is also the first call for the Head of International on any tax question tied to a new market, and a close partner to Legal, People Ops, and Supply Chain as the international footprint is built.

Responsibilities

  •     Serve as the tax lead on every new-market launch — assess the tax profile of a market before we enter, flag what will and won't work, and define the registrations, filings, and structural decisions required to operate compliantly from day one.
  •     Build and maintain a market-entry tax playbook and a global filing calendar, so the tenth country launch is materially faster and cleaner than the first.
  •     Advise on legal entity structure and the tax consequences of each option — branch vs. subsidiary, holding structure, where IP and inventory sit, and how intercompany flows are designed — partnering with Legal on entity timing and sequencing.
  •     Identify and manage permanent establishment risk created by employees, contractors, EOR arrangements, warehouses, third-party logistics providers, and local agents, including the tax implications of transitioning employees from EOR to local entity.
  •     Own transfer pricing end to end: intercompany agreements, pricing methodology, master file and local file documentation, country-by-country reporting where applicable, and defense of the position under audit.
  •     Own indirect tax globally — EU VAT (including OSS/IOSS, distance-selling rules, import VAT, and reverse charge), UK VAT, Mexican IVA, Australian GST and low-value imported goods rules, and the considerably more complex South American regimes — covering registration, filing, recoverability, and the operational setup behind each.

Qualifications

  •     Deep international tax capability is essential given the scope of this role — cross-border structuring, transfer pricing, treaty analysis, permanent establishment, and indirect tax across multiple regimes.
  •     Working knowledge of US federal and state taxation, including ASC 740, is a plus rather than a requirement. Our US provision and returns are prepared by an external firm; what we need is someone who can manage that firm credibly, review its work, and recognize when an answer doesn't hold up.
  •     Genuine indirect tax depth, or a demonstrated ability to research an unfamiliar country's VAT/GST regime from scratch and return with a defensible, documented answer. Knowing how to find the right answer in a new jurisdiction matters more here than having memorized any one of them.
  •     Demonstrated ability to stand up tax infrastructure where none exists, and to apply rigorous technical judgment to ambiguous, fast-moving, and incompletely specified situations.
  •     Comfortable being the only tax person in the company. This role will not be hiring a team for at least 12–18 months, and in the meantime you are both the strategist and the person doing the work.
  •     Proactive risk identifier. The most valuable thing you will do in this role is raise the issue nobody else knew to ask about.
  •     Skilled at translating complex technical tax positions into clear business language that non-tax partners can act on with confidence.
  •     Collaborative partner with a positive, solutions-oriented mindset; able to build trust quickly with Accounting, Legal, People Ops, Supply Chain, and the International team.
  •     Agile and adaptable; comfortable building and evolving processes as the international footprint matures, without being constrained by legacy approaches.
  •     Entrepreneurial mindset; equally comfortable setting global tax strategy and rolling up their sleeves to file a return.
  •     Proactive problem-solver and self-starter; energized by ambiguity and motivated to find the right answer even when no playbook exists.

Preferred:

  •     Substantial international tax experience specifically — this is the center of the role, not an adjacent skill.
  •     Demonstrated experience supporting a company through multi-country international expansion, including entity setup, indirect tax registration, and cross-border structuring.
  •     Experience supporting direct-to-consumer, retail, e-commerce, or another goods-based business with a physical supply chain strongly preferred, including exposure to customs and import duty matters.
  •     Experience selecting and managing external tax advisors across multiple jurisdictions.
  •     Practical experience with tax engines (Avalara, Vertex, or similar) and ERP tax configuration preferred.

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Director, Partnerships & Enterprise International Growth
descriptionHtml:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. 

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Partnerships & B2B International to lead our Health commercial expansion strategy for Oura into global markets. This role requires a strategic thinker with hands-on experience in market entry, localization, and scaling revenue across diverse geographies. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of partnerships and enterprise growth experience along with a track record of driving growth for health tech products in new markets.

The ideal candidate has both a deep health industry experience and leadership experience in establishing new partnerships and growing accounts/markets over time. Given Oura’s more recent international expansion, no job is too big or too small. Scaling global and local Health partners in UK, European, MENA and APAC markets  is an essential frontier for Oura's future strategy. 

The Director of Partnerships & B2Bwill scale and lead our go-to-market efforts across the international health landscape. This leader will hold revenue and partnership responsibility for our ecosystem of international health partnerships including B2B partner programs and custom strategic partnerships and will drive commercialization across key DTC and B2B channels health’s point solutions, health plans, employers, insurers, brokers, health institutions and health systems.

This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of product, partnerships, marketing, and sales. The ideal candidate brings a track record of international commercial leadership in healthcare or digital health, deep understanding of the international health landscape across different markets of UK, Europe, MENA, APAC, and a passion for building solutions that meet the unique needs of customers across all markets and stages of life.

What you will do

Consumer & Enterprise Business Development

  • Lead end-to-end business development of health partnerships, from identifying strategic consumer health platforms and emerging digital brands to negotiating and closing enterprise agreements with health systems, insurers, medical institutions, and employers 
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline of long-term prospects across different health categories including cardiohealth, metabolic health, women’s health, wellness, mental health, and chronic condition management 
  • Represent the brand in high-level partner engagements, acting as a subject matter expert on digital health, general health and insurance models 

Partner Program Development & Management

  • Build and scale a partner program infrastructure that allows for onboarding and managing health partners with consistent processes, tiering, and program benefits 
  • Design and lead customized, strategic partnerships for larger and more complex partners (health systems, multinational employers, insurers, consumer platforms), ensuring tailored solutions that drive measurable business and health outcomes 
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic partners, with the ability to serve 10-20 simultaneous accounts with varying needs.
  • Establish partner enablement tools, resources, and communications to ensure partner success and scalable growth 

Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams (Product, Marketing, Clinical, Regulatory affairs, Legal, Operations) to design, launch, and optimize partnership integrations and programs. Ensure alignment of goals, accountability, and execution across scaled programs and complex deals  

Performance, Optimization & Insights

  • Define, track, and optimize success metrics for both scaled partner programs and bespoke enterprise deals; identify and address challenges in internal processes that may slow innovation in partnerships 
  • Champion a culture of experimentation by testing new partnership models, incentive structures, and go-to-market approaches for health programs

Strategic Communication & Reporting

  • Leverage user research, behavioral data, and partner feedback to guide health partnership strategy 
  • Regularly communicate partnership program performance, enterprise deal progress, and overall health market traction to executive leadership 

We would love to have you on our team if you have: 

  • 15+ years in outbound enterprise or corporate sales and business development, with a track record of growing accounts from first deal to major enterprise customer and representing a brand in executive-level commercial conversations.
  • Deep knowledge of the consumer health landscape (apps, digital health, retail wellness) and enterprise stakeholders (insurers, employers, health systems, providers), ideally across international markets.
  • Experience designing and scaling structured partner programs alongside bespoke, high-value enterprise deals — balancing repeatable growth with the customisation complex partners require.
  • Experience using performance, partner adoption, and consumer engagement data to build partnership models that expand reach, engagement, and retention.
  • A cross-functional operator who aligns product, clinical, operations, and marketing to deliver measurable health and business outcomes.
  • An entrepreneurial, commercially minded builder: sharp written and verbal communicator, comfortable bringing clarity to ambiguity in a fast-paced environment, and relentless about the quality and measurability of your work.

Considered a strong asset: additional language skills, an established network in your market, and willingness to travel up to 50%.

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • An Oura Ring of your own + employee discounts for friends & family

We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

title: Director Space Business
descriptionHtml:
Destinus is seeking a Director, Space Business to establish and grow its space business, with military satellite communications (Satcom) as the initial priority. The role covers the complete communications system, including the space segment, user terminals, ground infrastructure and integration with tactical networks.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Director will lead business development and programme delivery, supported by programme managers and a Technical Lead with communications systems expertise. The Director must have enough technical depth to challenge proposals and lead informed decisions.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop the business. Define the Satcom business plan, customer priorities, investment needs and Destinus' role in the industrial partnership. Align proposals with technical feasibility, funding and delivery capacity.
  • Secure customers and programmes. Build relationships with defence customers, space agencies and industrial partners. Lead proposals, commercial negotiations and funding opportunities in coordination with the group commercial team.
  • Deliver agreed programmes. Own programme budgets, milestones and customer commitments. Lead programme managers and coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, testing and entry into service.
  • Build the required team. Recruit business and programme staff within approved plans. Define engineering capability needs with the CTO and establish clear responsibilities for internal teams and external partners.
  • Manage industrial partnerships. Select and manage partners and suppliers with the relevant functions. Establish workshare, interfaces and delivery commitments across the complete Satcom system.
  • Develop future opportunities. Assess early warning and interceptor opportunities through customer engagement, partnerships and funding proposals. Present staged investment recommendations before committing development resources.
  • Maintain delivery discipline. Track costs, risks and progress. Resolve issues within the agreed mandate and escalate material changes to scope, investment or portfolio priorities.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Substantial experience in space, aerospace or defence, typically 12+ years, including at least five years leading complex programmes, multidisciplinary teams or a business.
  • A proven record of delivering satellite communications programmes or substantial parts of an integrated Satcom system, with direct responsibility for budgets, schedules and customer commitments.
  • Business development experience with government or defence customers, including shaping requirements, preparing proposals and negotiating contracts or programme funding.
  • An engineering degree or equivalent technical background, with a system-level understanding of satellites, communications payloads, user terminals and the ground segment.
  • Understanding of protected waveforms, anti-jam capabilities and secure tactical datalinks sufficient to assess requirements, risks and integration needs with technical specialists.
  • Experience leading programme managers and coordinating engineering teams in a matrix organisation, with clear resource commitments and accountability for delivery.
  • The ability to build teams, manage industrial partners and make commercial decisions that reflect technical maturity, available resources and funding.
  • The ability to work independently, present clear recommendations to the CEO and execute within an agreed mandate. Fluent English and willingness to travel regularly.

German language skills as well as experience with German defense customers and space programmes are advantages. We value programme delivery and commercial judgement, especially in the context of establishing a new business line or taking a programme from concept to funding and delivery. Deep expertise across all space applications is not required.

title: Dispenser
descriptionHtml:
About Bolt Pharmacy and AIOS

AIOS is building the world’s first full-stack AI doctor.

We’re at $450M ARR, growing from $7M/yr in April 2025. We’re faithfully serving >200k/mo patients via Bolt Pharmacy, our main UK brand. We’ve just launched Bolt Med, our international brand. We’re profitable.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  1. The AI doctor that wins will get to escape velocity using GLP-1s, the fastest growing consumer product in history.

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

  • Step 0 → $100M/yr by end of 2025: We went from $10M to $100M in 6 months serving the UK GLP-1 market.

  • Step 1 → $1B ARR by end of 2026: Since April 2025 we've grown from 3k to 200k UK active GLP-1 patients. We’ll continue this growth curve to hit $1B ARR.

  • Step 2 → $10B ARR by end of 2028: Blitzscale Europe. We’ll be Europe’s largest GLP-1 provider.

  • Step 3 → $100B/yr by end of 2030: Get regulatory approval across Europe for our Full Autonomous Prescribing (FAP) system. Win contracts at scale with European payers to mass replace human labor. We’ll be the dominant full-stack AI doctor in Europe.

  • Step 4 → $1T/yr by end of 2035: With one line of code and zero human time, you can use AIOS to treat any patient globally with any medication.

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy

We are building a world-class team.

As a Dispenser at Bolt Pharmacy (part of AIOS), your fundamental role is to turn prescriptions into treatment patients can count on - safely, accurately and at pace.

You'll be at the heart of our dispensing operation, selecting, labelling and securely packing medicines for patients across the UK. You'll take ownership of your work within your qualified scope, follow dispensing procedures precisely and escalate clinical questions to our pharmacists. Every prescription has a person behind it.

You'll keep quality high as volumes grow. From protecting the cold chain and monitoring storage temperatures to managing stock and checking deliveries, you'll help keep medicines safe and orders moving. You'll report errors and near misses promptly, so we learn quickly and keep improving.

Working alongside pharmacists, fellow dispensers and our stock and customer service teams, you'll help resolve issues before they delay treatment. You'll also support trainee dispensers and spot practical ways to make Bolt Pharmacy's operation more efficient. Your experience will help raise the standard of the whole team.

Great performance means consistently processing 30+ orders per hour while maintaining over 99.5% dispensing accuracy, zero critical errors and full compliance with our procedures. Patients receive the right treatment, colleagues trust your work and we can serve more people with confidence.

This is a full-time, on-site role at Bolt Pharmacy in Blackburn, UK, working standard business hours with possible shift patterns.

You'll report directly to our Shift Lead and work closely with our Site Operations Lead, Michal Binkowski.

You'll work most closely with Bolt Pharmacy's pharmacists, qualified and trainee dispensers, Stock Control and Customer Service, combining dispensing oversight, shared workloads and patient support.

Key responsibilities

  • Get every prescription right: Select, label and prepare medicines accurately within your qualified scope, following SOPs and escalating clinical queries to pharmacists.

  • Keep treatment moving: Process and securely pack 30+ orders per hour while maintaining accuracy, safety and compliance.

  • Protect every medicine: Maintain cold-chain controls, monitor fridge and room temperatures, and escalate storage deviations immediately.

  • Take ownership of stock: Check incoming deliveries, maintain correct storage and rotation, and support stock takes so medicines are available when needed.

  • Make quality everyone's business: Record errors, near misses and incidents promptly, keep workstations clean and compliant, follow hygiene and PPE procedures, and suggest practical improvements.

  • Raise the team's standard: Guide trainee dispensers, support colleagues and work with Customer Service to resolve patient queries and order updates.

Need to have

  • Dispensing qualification: You hold a valid Buttercups certification or equivalent dispensing qualification.

  • Experience at pace: You've worked in high-volume dispensing and can consistently meet a target of 30+ orders per hour without compromising safety.

  • Attention to detail: You bring exceptional accuracy to medicine selection, labelling and prescription preparation.

  • Ownership within your scope: You organise your workload independently, follow SOPs precisely and know when to involve a pharmacist.

  • Professionalism: You're reliable, punctual and committed to patient safety and regulatory compliance.

Nice to have

  • Qualified experience: You've spent at least a year working as a qualified dispenser.

  • Online pharmacy: You understand the demands of dispensing and dispatching treatment to patients remotely.

  • Mentoring: You've trained or supported junior colleagues and can explain procedures clearly.

  • Stock management: You bring experience in inventory control, stock rotation and keeping a busy dispensary supplied.

  • Patient support: You've handled healthcare queries with care, clarity and professionalism.

  • Pharmacy standards: You're familiar with GPhC requirements and how they translate into everyday practice.

Our cultural standards

We aim to make this your life's work. This should be the most challenging, most rewarding role of your life. Accordingly, these are the core cultural standards to which we hold ourselves & our team-members:

  1. Belief in the mission: We will have served 100 million patients by the end of 2035 and we transform the life of most patients who join. We have a lot of work to do. We are obsessed with our patients and are dedicated to the mission.

  2. Unwavering integrity: We are at the frontier, so we often live in ambiguity with no trodden path. When we can't look to others for guidance, we must maintain impeccable ethics and unwavering integrity.

  3. Only the paranoid survive: Bad sh*t is coming. By joining us, you're choosing to sail straight towards the storms with unhesitating conviction. However much we've already done, however far we've already come — it's still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

  4. If we're average we fail: We are only interested in "insanely great", a focus on the quality of our execution that in everyday life would be considered pathological. We have a dedication to excellence and reject incompetence.

  5. Commitment to candor: That which can be destroyed by the truth should be. You get full transparency from the company and the company expects full transparency from you. We never say anything about someone that we wouldn't say to them directly. We give feedback with love and do not need to protect people from fleeting physical sensations.

  6. A maniacal sense of urgency: We execute at an intensity that most people think is impossible. Speed is critical and we need things done yesterday. We all work very hard and in such a competitive world there really is no other way to win.

  7. Enduring frugality: We are frugal. We hate being wasteful and we are anti-luxury. A culture of cheapness keeps us young. We spend our cash wisely & carefully — in a way that would make our grandmas proud.

  8. Bulldozing barriers: The world is malleable and we shape it. We truly believe this and act accordingly. We are relentlessly resourceful and are at the mercy of no-one but ourselves. You'll be shocked how capable you are and how much you can achieve.

  9. Keep your head down: We're boring people doing exciting work. We don't chase short-term status — we ignore short-term dopamine hits and focus on what matters. Outsiders will underestimate us and we revel in that.

  10. The power of focus: We live in a world of power laws and we cannot overestimate the unimportance of practically everything. Know your One Thing, and nail it.

🎯 "You just build a f*ing amazing experience. Make each step amazing. Make every decision in the long term interest of the customer. Give the customer massively more value than you take."

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation package includes equity, giving you the opportunity to share in what we build.

  • Training role: £13 per hour while you complete the required training and sign-off.

  • Qualified role: £15 per hour in total compensation, including equity, once you have completed the required training and are qualified and signed off for the role.

Benefits

The stuff below is cool as well.

  • Personal development: A £400 budget for books, courses and coaching to keep building your skills.

  • Personal wellness: A £400 budget for the gym and health apps to support your wellbeing.

  • GLP-1s: Get free membership with a clinic offering GLP-1s, if clinically applicable.

  • Health coaching: Access free biweekly health coaching to help you stay healthy.

  • Work coaching: Access free biweekly work coaching to stay sharp and calm.

  • What are we missing? We're still early, so your ideas can help shape our culture.

title: Doctorant : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”
descriptionHtml:
Contexte :

ENSTA est un établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées. L’école a pour mission la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, dont les ingénieurs de l'armement et les ingénieurs des études et techniques de l'armement, ainsi que des cadres et docteurs hautement qualifiés pour les secteurs public et privé, en particulier dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et des technologies de pointe.

ENSTA accompagne par sa recherche, son innovation et son offre de formation la transformation des grands secteurs stratégiques nationaux répondant ainsi aux enjeux de souveraineté nationale. Elle dispose de 3 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR) organisées autour de 9 laboratoires de recherche (UER) qui mènent une recherche appliquée en relation étroite avec l’industrie.

ENSTA est membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris). Dans le cadre d’IP Paris, l’école participe aux activités des centres interdisciplinaires notamment du centre interdisciplinaire d'études pour la Défense et la Sécurité (CIEDS, soutenu par le ministère des armées et l’agence de l’innovation de défense (AID)). Elle est à l’origine de la création du Centre interdisciplinaire Mers & Océans, inauguré en janvier 2025. Des chercheurs de l’école travaillent également en collaboration dans le cadre d'études portées par les centres Hi-Paris, lauréat en 2024 IA Cluster, E4C ou E4H notamment.

ENSTA résulte de la fusion le 1er janvier 2025 d’ENSTA Paris et d’ENSTA Bretagne. Son siège est situé à Palaiseau (91), sur le campus de Paris-Saclay et elle a un autre campus à Brest. Elle met en place une nouvelle formation d’ingénieur unifiée sur les deux campus (Paris-Saclay et Brest) à la rentrée académique 2026/2027.

Rejoindre l'école, c'est intégrer un établissement engagé pour la parité et l'égalité professionnelle, la diversité et l'accompagnement de ses agents en situation de handicap, dès le recrutement et tout au long de la carrière. Afin de préserver le bien-être au travail, l'école mène une politique active en matière de conditions de travail, reposant notamment sur un juste équilibre entre vie personnelle et vie professionnelle.

Sujet : “Experimental Geomechanics for Induced Seismicity and Control”

Le poste fait partie du projet ERC-CdG « Preventing human-induced seismicity to fight climate change » (INJECT), financé par le Conseil européen de la recherche (ERC). La recherche sera menée à l'ENSTA, Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Le poste offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet de recherche stimulant et à fort impact. Les connaissances, l'innovation et les compétences développées dans le cadre de ce poste offriront d'excellentes perspectives d'évolution de carrière tant dans l'industrie que dans le monde universitaire.

Le changement climatique constitue une menace imminente pour notre civilisation. Les nouvelles technologies les plus en vue pour lutter contre le changement climatique font appel aux ressources énergétiques renouvelables et durables du sous-sol de la Terre et au stockage souterrain. Cependant, toutes ces technologies dépendent de l'injection de fluides dans la croûte terrestre, ce qui peut provoquer d'importants tremblements de terre. INJECT résoudra ce problème en s'appuyant sur une nouvelle méthode scientifique révolutionnaire qui empêchera la sismicité induite par l'homme et maximisera la production et le stockage d'énergie à partir de ressources naturelles renouvelables et durables.

La méthodologie interdisciplinaire d'INJECT repose sur un programme scientifique astucieux qui place la théorie du contrôle et les mathématiques au cœur de ce nouveau défi. Sur la base de développements théoriques de pointe, des contrôleurs et des observateurs robustes seront conçus pour ajuster de manière optimale les taux d'injection de fluides, prévenir les événements sismiques induits sur de vastes régions et optimiser la production et le stockage d'énergie. Les méthodes théoriques innovantes d'INJECT seront testées en profondeur à l'aide de modèles numériques de haute fidélité qui tiendront compte de la dynamique poro-élasto, du frottement de Coulomb, de la multiphysique et de la modélisation d'ordre réduit. Le plan expérimental s'appuiera sur des démonstrateurs et des essais hybrides laboratoire-ordinateur pour tester la théorie. Pour plus d'informations : https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101087771 ----- class="Default" style="text-align:justify;">Missions / Activités principales :

Le thème de recherche se concentre sur le développement d'un dispositif innovant conçu pour reproduire et contrôler la sismicité induite dans un cadre de laboratoire.

En tant que chercheur doctorant, vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conception et la construction de démonstrateurs innovants adaptés à la méthodologie d'INJECT. Cette opportunité englobe l'ensemble de la chaîne de développement, c'est-à-dire de la conceptualisation des idées à l'assemblage et au test rigoureux de prototypes de laboratoire avancés pour des expériences géomécaniques. Vous intégrerez la conception mécanique, l'ingénierie des matériaux, la mise en œuvre des capteurs et des contrôleurs, l'analyse des données et la modélisation numérique. L'objectif ultime est de reproduire et de contrôler les instabilités sismiques causées par des injections de fluides dans un environnement de laboratoire contrôlé, ouvrant ainsi la voie à des applications dans le monde réel.
