title: E-Commerce Marketplace Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du liebst das dynamische E-Commerce-Game und brennst für Plattformen wie Walmart, Bol, Otto, eBay und Kaufland? Dann passt du perfekt zu uns.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Marktplätze nicht nur versteht, sondern sie aktiv steuert, optimiert und skaliert. Als Marketplace Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die operative und strategische Führung verschiedener Marktplatz-Accounts. Du sorgst für maximale Sichtbarkeit, optimierst Listings bis ins kleinste Detail, steuerst Werbekampagnen und hebst die Performance unserer Kund*innen auf das nächste Level.

Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann bist du hier genau richtig!

Aufgaben

  • Marktplatz-Management mit Weitblick: Du steuerst und betreust die Accounts auf Plattformen wie Amazon, Otto, eBay und Kaufland eigenverantwortlich – vom Tagesgeschäft bis zur langfristigen Roadmap.

  • Listing- & Conversion-Optimierung: Du optimierst Produktdaten, Keywords, Titel, Bullet Points und A+/Rich Content, um Rankings und Conversion Rates stetig zu steigern.

  • Performance & Advertising: Du setzt gezielte Werbekampagnen (z. B. Sponsored Ads) auf, steuerst Budgets effizient aus und optimierst kontinuierlich auf ROAS, ACoS und Umsatz.

  • Sortiment & Buy-Box-Management: Du behältst Lagerbestände, Buy-Box-Anteile, Preisstrategien sowie Kundenfeedback im Auge und reagierst schnell auf Marktbewegungen.

  • Zahlen & Learnings teilen: Du analysierst die Performance-Daten aller Kanäle, erstellst aussagekräftige Reportings und leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst fundierte praktische Erfahrung im Marktplatz-Management mit – insbesondere im Amazon-Ökosystem (Seller/Vendor Central); Erfahrungen mit Otto, eBay oder Kaufland sind ein klares Plus.

  • Du beherrschst Marktplatz-Tools (z. B. Helium 10, Jungle Scout oder ähnliche Analytics- & Repricing-Tools) und verstehst die Algorithmen hinter der Plattformsuche.

  • Du hast ein starkes Zahlenverständnis und weißt genau, wie du KPIs wie TACoS, CVR, CTR und Buy-Box-Raten interpretierst und steuerst.

  • Du arbeitest analytisch, detailorientiert und packst technische Herausforderungen wie Datenfeed-Fehler oder Ticketeröffnungen strukturiert an.

  • Du bist kommunikativ, denkst unternehmerisch und hast Freude daran, Marken im Plattformgeschäft nachhaltig wachsen zu lassen.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.

  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.

  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.

  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben.

  • Sie analysieren Störungen, finden Fehlerursachen und sorgen für eine schnelle, nachhaltige Behebung.

  • Sie nehmen neue Maschinen und Produktionsanlagen in Betrieb.

  • Sie übernehmen Elektroinstallationen und unterstützen beim Aufbau und der Verdrahtung von Schaltschränken.

  • Sie bringen eigene Ideen zur Verbesserung von Anlagen und Produktionsprozessen ein.

  • Sie arbeiten eng mit Ihren Kollegen zusammen, um die Anlagenverfügbarkeit und einen sicheren Produktionsablauf zu gewährleisten.

Das bringen Sie mit

  • Sie haben eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker für Betriebstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik oder Anlagentechnik, als Mechatroniker, Industriemechatroniker oder Industrieelektroniker (m/w/d) – oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

title: EMEA Statutory Reporting Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

Applied Intuition is scaling quickly across entities and geographies, and statutory reporting, clean audits, and compliant local filings are essential. In this London-based role, you will be the accountable owner of statutory reporting, audit, and compliance for our EMEA entities, including the UK, Germany, Sweden, and Saudi Arabia, with more to come.

Reporting to the Director of Accounting, you will lead the EMEA local close and statutory audits, own the filing calendar, oversee the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion work produced by our India-based outsourced accounting team, and partner with Tax, Legal, and Business Technology to automate statutory and compliance processes in NetSuite. This is a hands-on opportunity to build a best-in-class statutory and compliance function across EMEA for a high-growth company.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own the preparation, review, and sign-off of statutory financial statements for our EMEA entities under local GAAP (UK GAAP/FRS 102, German HGB, Swedish K2/K3, and IFRS as endorsed in Saudi Arabia), including the US GAAP to local GAAP conversion and bridge work papers.

  • Lead each statutory audit end to end with our external auditors, from planning and PBC lists through audit queries, adjustments, and management representation letters, closing audits on schedule.

  • Run the EMEA month-end on the US close calendar: review and sign off statutory balance sheet reconciliations, drive aged reconciling items to zero, and maintain local GAAP schedules such as leases and accrued vacation.

  • Own the EMEA statutory and compliance filing calendar, covering VAT, corporate income tax and zakat (with Tax and external advisers), company registry filings, and annual accounts, so every filing goes in on time with no notices from authorities.

  • Manage the quality and performance of our India-based outsourced accounting team and of in-country auditors, tax advisers, and accounting providers, and turn statutory and conversion workpapers into standard templates the team can run with minimal rework.

  • Partner with Business Technology to automate statutory reporting, VAT, and e-invoicing in NetSuite, design and document the related controls, and bring new entities and regulatory changes (for example, FRS 102 amendments and German and Saudi e-invoicing mandates) into the process ahead of effective dates.

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or CPA) with 14+ years of relevant accounting experience

  • Proven ownership of multi-entity UK statutory reporting under UK GAAP (FRS 102) and the Companies Act 2006, including leading statutory audits end to end

  • Experience converting US GAAP to local GAAP and reviewing GAAP bridge workpapers (for example, leases and accrued vacation)

  • Experience managing outsourced or offshore accounting teams, including setting quality standards and reviewing output across time zones

  • Proficiency with NetSuite, ideally in a multi-subsidiary environment

  • Sound judgment on materiality and filing risk, and clear communication with auditors, advisers, and partners across EMEA, the US, and India

Nice to have:

  • Big 4 or top-tier public accounting background, and in-house experience at a software/technology multinational

  • Hands-on German GAAP (HGB) and GmbH statutory experience

  • Exposure to Swedish (K2/K3) or Saudi (IFRS, zakat, ZATCA e-invoicing) statutory reporting, or other EMEA local GAAPs and languages

  • Working knowledge of VAT, Making Tax Digital, and e-invoicing requirements across EMEA

  • Experience designing internal controls (SOX or audit readiness) and testing finance system automation, including applying AI tools to accounting workflows

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

About the Role

The way legal work gets done is changing, and Engagement is at the centre of that transformation. This is a role for someone who has led change inside large, complex organisations and knows that real transformation is designed and managed. You will own the adoption and long-term success of strategic enterprise accounts: building deep, multi-level relationships, defining the outcomes and serving as the trusted adviser who turns Legora into an embedded part of how those teams operate.

Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function.

At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge.

You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work.

What You'll Do

You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts. Specifically, you will:

  • Execute against that strategy, sequencing initiatives from the first pilot teams through to function-wide and global adoption across regions, practice areas and business units.

  • Build and run executive governance with each client, including steering committees, executive business reviews and success plans owned jointly with GC and legal operations leadership.

  • Act as a strategic adviser who deeply understands enterprise in-house legal priorities (cost, cycle time, risk, global consistency and doing more without adding headcount), surfaces high-impact opportunities and guides teams towards maximum value from Legora.

  • Partner closely with GTM on renewals, expansion and other key commercial moments, building the case for wider deployment and new use cases across the client's organisation.

  • Turn customer feedback into action by working closely with Product, Engineering and Marketing to shape the roadmap, positioning and enablement for enterprise clients.

  • Build reusable enterprise playbooks, governance templates and enablement material from what works, so the whole Engagement team gets better as you go.

What You Bring

You care deeply about customer outcomes and you know that transformation has to be designed and led. You're proactive, strategic and comfortable steering demanding, senior stakeholders through significant change. You take pride in being the reason customers adopt, grow and succeed.

We're looking for:

  • At least 5 years' experience in management consulting, legal, LegalTech or customer success, ideally with enterprise clients in an AI-native B2B vertical.

  • Experience leading large-scale rollouts and adoption programmes at enterprise or global organisations. We want someone who has taken a new way of working into a large, multi-jurisdictional in-house function, navigated procurement, IT, security and sceptical stakeholders, and made it stick.

  • A consulting or transformation background, with a track record of designing and delivering change-management programmes inside large, matrixed organisations.

title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.

About the Role

As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands
  • Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path
  • Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running
  • Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery
  • Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on
  • Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices
  • Grow the team through hiring

Our humble expectations

  • You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers
  • You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations
  • You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code
  • You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers
  • You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones
  • You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure

What we offer

A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Engineering manager
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid, based in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office. We are flexible but would like you to be in the office at least once per week.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Initial conversation: a chat with someone from our Talent team about your experience, what you’re looking for and the role

  • System design interview: a 60-minute technical conversation exploring how you approach architecture, trade-offs and complex engineering decisions

  • Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation focused on people leadership, delivery and cross-functional collaboration

  • Bar raiser: a 45-minute conversation with colleagues from outside the immediate team, focused on our operating principles and how you approach your work

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

title: Enterprise AI Product Owner
descriptionHtml:
About Legal 500

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role

Our new Enterprise AI Product Owner will own the adoption and value of AI in how Legal 500 works. You'll use our enterprise AI tools, with Microsoft Copilot and the wider Microsoft 365 AI capability as the main platform. You'll recommend what should be built or adopted and why, put governance in place where none yet exists, and make sure people across the business use the tools well.

This is a business-facing product role that starts from how the business works, not a technical build role. Copilot is the primary tool of choice, but you'll also oversee the other AI tools the business adopts.

What you'll do

You'll sit centrally within our People & Business Operations function, reporting to the Director of People & Business Operations. Your remit covers the whole of Legal 500, not a single department. You'll:

  • Own the roadmap and prioritised backlog for our enterprise AI opportunities, recommending what to build or adopt, what not to, and why. You'll write clear user stories and acceptance criteria and hold a consistent line with senior stakeholders when demand exceeds capacity.

  • Start every opportunity from the end-to-end business process. You'll walk business owners through how work gets done today, often where no SOPs exist, map the pain points, coach them through mapping a future-state process, and find where Copilot, other AI tools or workflow changes will make a measurable difference.

  • Personally configure, test and refine Copilot skills, agents and team workflows. You'll take ideas through proof of concept and pilot, then hand ownership of the output to the business owner.

  • Design, implement and enforce AI governance from the ground up. This includes owning the intake and review process for new use cases, agents and workflows, working alongside our Data Protection Officer, Information Security and IT Operations

  • Own our enterprise AI libraries: the register of approved tools and the libraries of approved agents, prompts, templates and shared workflows. You'll keep them curated, current and compliant, and avoid duplication between tools.

  • Design and deliver upskilling yourself, including training sessions, guides, clinics and self-serve resources. You'll also lead AI working groups and champion networks.

  • Spot common patterns across teams and bring them together on shared processes and solutions, so the same problem isn't solved many times.

  • Define and track adoption and value, such as usage, time saved, quality and user confidence. You'll maintain an AI benefits register, report progress to senior stakeholders and feed role impact into workforce planning.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • A process-led consulting approach, with a structured way of walking business owners through end-to-end processes, including where no SOPs existed

  • Proven experience of setting up AI governance from scratch and enforcing it. This includes owning an intake and review process and working with specialists such as a Data Protection Officer and IT Operations

  • Hands-on Microsoft Copilot experience: you've personally configured Copilot skills, agents or team workflows. Using Copilot, or overseeing someone else configuring it, isn't enough

  • Strong product management skills: setting priorities, writing user stories, running a backlog and managing senior stakeholders well

  • Experience of owning enterprise libraries or other centralised controls

  • Experience of running enablement yourself: you've designed and delivered upskilling personally, without relying on an L&D team, and you're comfortable leading working groups

Desirable

  • A genuine interest in enterprise efficiency and how people actually work, with a track record of bringing teams together on shared ways of working

  • A background in internal transformation, process improvement or Microsoft 365/Copilot SME roles, ideally including evaluating, onboarding or governing other enterprise AI tools

  • An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets or other knowledge-intensive environments

What this role isn't

  • It isn't about owning AI models in production, and working with development teams isn't the main job. There will be occasional technical work, but if you're mainly motivated by software delivery, this probably isn't the role for you

  • It isn't about running governance within someone else's framework, or handing enablement off to an L&D team. We need someone who has set these up and delivered them personally

Role information:

  • Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

  • This role can be based in either London or Leeds

  • Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
descriptionHtml:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.

Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt

Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.

Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.

Deine Rolle

Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.

Deine Aufgaben

Kandidatengewinnung

  • Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

  • Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

  • Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

  • Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation

  • Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

  • Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess

  • Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

  • Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

  • Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

  • Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

  • Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern

  • Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

  • Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

  • Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

  • Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

  • Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

  • Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

  • Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

  • Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

  • Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

  • Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

  • Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. Unser Antrieb: SAP-Spezialisten in die Rolle zu bringen, in der sie wirklich wachsen, und dabei selbst jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Auf deine Kontaktaufnahme freuen wir uns.

title: ERP & Business Process Architect (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Wir sind IDEEMATEC – ein weltweit führender Hersteller innovativer Solar Tracker für große Photovoltaik-Kraftwerke. Seit über 20 Jahren entwickeln unsere Mitarbeitenden mit Fachwissen, Neugier und Engagement zukunftsweisende Lösungen. Mit über 80 Patenten und mehr als 10 GW installierten Trackern in über 30 Ländern steigern wir weltweit Energieerträge, erhöhen die langfristige Zuverlässigkeit und treiben die Energiewende voran.

Als ERP & Business Process Architect (gn) gestaltest du die Zielarchitektur der ERP- und Prozesslandschaft von IDEEMATEC – von der Prozessaufnahme über die herstellerneutrale Systemauswahl bis zur Einführung. Als fachliche Stimme der Auftraggeberseite übersetzt du die Anforderungen der Fachbereiche in ein tragfähiges Zielbild und erarbeitest Entscheidungsempfehlungen für die Linie. Im Rahmen der definierten Standards entscheidest du dabei eigenständig.

Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen, IT und Data & Analytics sowie externen Implementierungspartnern zusammen – für eine integrierte, skalierbare ERP-Landschaft, die das internationale Wachstum von IDEEMATEC als Unternehmen mit Projekt- und Auftragsfertigung wirksam unterstützt.

AUFGABEN & VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN

Zielbild, Prozesse & Anforderungen

  • Mitentwicklung der ERP-Zielarchitektur inklusive Schnittstellen- und Datenkonzept gemeinsam mit IT und Data & Analytics

  • Eigenständige Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung der fachlichen Prozessarchitektur mit Fokus auf End-to-End-Prozesse

  • Eigenständige Steuerung der Anforderungserhebung und -analyse in allen Fachbereichen sowie Analyse bestehender Prozesse auf Schwachstellen und Automatisierungspotenziale

  • Eigenständige Definition von Ziel, Scope und Abgrenzung von ERP-Vorhaben inklusive Handlungsbedarfen und Priorisierungsempfehlungen

Systemauswahl & Umsetzung

  • Herstellerneutrale Bewertung von ERP-Systemen und Lösungsoptionen (Standard- vs. Individuallösung) sowie Erarbeitung von Entscheidungsempfehlungen

  • Fachliche Verantwortung für Anforderungsspezifikationen und deren Übersetzung in ERP-Modulanforderungen inklusive Bewertung der Auswirkungen von Änderungen

  • Fachliche Steuerung von und Verhandlung mit Implementierungspartnern und Softwareanbietern

  • Planung und Koordination von Funktions-, Integrations- und Abnahmetests in Abstimmung mit den Fachbereichen

Datenqualität & Wissenstransfer

  • Eigenständige Analyse der Daten- und Prozessqualität, Initiierung von Verbesserungsmaßnahmen sowie Weiterentwicklung von Standards unter Einhaltung von Berechtigungs- und Compliance-Anforderungen

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines Key-User-Netzwerks, Befähigung der Key-User sowie Begleitung von Tests, Rollouts und Releasewechseln inklusive Dokumentation

WAS SIE MITBRINGEN

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, des Wirtschaftsingenieurwesens, der Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 5 Jahre oder mehr) in ERP-Business-Analyse, Prozessarchitektur oder ERP-Beratung, idealerweise in der Industrie mit Projekt- oder Auftragsfertigung

  • Erfahrung in der Begleitung von ERP-Auswahl- und Einführungsprojekten auf Auftraggeberseite

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Prozessmodellierung, Anforderungsmanagement sowie Daten- und Schnittstellenkonzepten

  • Herstellerneutrales Verständnis gängiger ERP-Systeme

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Tools zur Prozessmodellierung und Dokumentation sowie mit MS Office

  • Fließende Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

WARUM IDEEMATEC

Wir schätzen offene Kommunikation, unterstützen Ihre berufliche Weiterentwicklung und geben Ihnen vom ersten Tag an die Freiheit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Mit spannenden internationalen Projekten und einem starken Sinn für Purpose bietet die Ideematec einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem Ihre Arbeit Wirkung zeigt und Ihre Stärken wirklich etwas bewegen.

Was Sie bei uns erwartet:

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene, internationale Kultur, in der Ihre Ideen Gehör finden

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung ab Tag 1 – wir vertrauen Ihnen und fördern Ihren Gestaltungswillen

  • Strukturiertes Onboarding plus Zeit und Budget für Weiterentwicklung, die Sie wirklich weiterbringt

  • Moderne Ausstattung und ein flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Wallerfing, Plattling oder Ismaning)

  • 30 Tage Urlaub und flexible Arbeitszeiten mit Überstundenausgleich für echte Work-Life-Balance

  • 50 € steuerfreie Monatszuwendung als Shopping-Card

  • Attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss

  • Mehr Flexibilität durch die Möglichkeit, zeitweise aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

  • Firmenrad-Leasing und ein umfangreiches Corporate-Benefits-Programm

NEUGIERIG GEWORDEN?

Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören und deine Bewerbung zu erhalten. Was wir im ersten Schritt von dir benötigen:

  • Deinen aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf

  • Deine Verfügbarkeit

  • Angaben zu deiner Gehaltsvorstellung

title: Expansion Manager - (German speaking, Hamburg based, m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Lightspeed hat eine klare Mission: Wir bauen die Restaurant-Plattform, mit der Gastronom:innen sich anpassen, die Kontrolle zurückgewinnen und sich wieder auf das konzentrieren können, was sie am liebsten tun – ihr eigenes Business erfolgreich führen.

Als Expansion Manager*in (m/w/d) bist du Teil eines Teams, das die Art und Weise verändert, wie Restaurants arbeiten. Mit einem beratenden Ansatz sprichst du aktiv neue Restaurants an, baust Beziehungen auf und gewinnst neue Kund:innen in deiner Region. Du verstehst ihre individuellen Bedürfnisse und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die ihr Business wirklich voranbringen. Wir suchen deine Leidenschaft und Sales-Power, um die Marke Lightspeed in deiner Region weiter aufzubauen.

📍 Wichtig: Diese Position ist in Hamburg angesiedelt.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du erstellst Listen potenzieller Restaurants und steuerst den gesamten Sales-Prozess – vom ersten Anruf oder Walk-In bis zum Vertragsabschluss (Erfahrung mit selbst akquirierten Kund:innen ist ein großes Plus)

  • Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alles, was im Sales versprochen wird, auch umgesetzt wird

  • Du nutzt Salesforce (unser CRM), um alle Sales-Aktivitäten zu managen

  • Du behältst den Markt und den Wettbewerb im Blick und weißt, wie Lightspeed optimal positioniert wird

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du bist selbstmotiviert, kreativ und flexibel

  • Du fühlst dich wohl in einem schnellen, unternehmerischen Umfeld und arbeitest gern im Team

  • Du hast starke Kommunikations-, Organisations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und kannst auf allen Entscheidungsebenen überzeugen und verhandeln

  • Als Expansion Manager bist du täglich in deinem Gebiet unterwegs und liebst den direkten Kontakt zu deinen Kund*innen

  • Du hast eine allgemeine technische Affinität und kommst gut mit Software zurecht

  • Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Deutschkenntnisse

  • Erfahrung mit Salesforce CRM ist ein Plus

  • 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Neukundenakquise oder im Closing, in der Gastronomie oder in einem vergleichbaren Bereich ist von Vorteil

Was wir dir bieten:

Come live the Lightspeed Experience 🚀

  • Echte Karrierechancen – dein Wachstum richtet sich nach deiner Performance in einem stark wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Ungedeckelte Provision

  • Zusammenarbeit mit hochqualifizierten Kolleg:innen, die Sales & Marketing genauso lieben wie du

  • Ein Umfeld, das Eigeninitiative und Leadership fördert

  • Ein Team, das groß genug für Entwicklung ist, aber schlank genug, um wirklich etwas zu bewegen

  • Team-Events und Social Activities das ganze Jahr über – inklusive der legendären Sales-Summit-Party in Kanada 🇨🇦

Und natürlich jede Menge Benefits, die dich glücklich, gesund und (nicht) hungrig halten:

  • Lightspeed Equity Programm – wir sind alle Mitbesitzer:innen

  • Health & Wellness Budget: Bis zu 400 € pro Jahr für Fitnessstudio, Yoga, ein neues Fahrrad oder alles, was deiner Gesundheit guttut

  • Mental Health Support über die Modern Health App – von Meditation über Coaching bis hin zu professioneller Beratung

  • Monatliche Pauschale für unterwegs: Kaffee, Snacks und Mittagessen 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

title: Expert Cybersécurité
descriptionHtml:
Présentation de l’entreprise

Enracinée dans la région de la Marne depuis sa fondation en 2019, Anetsys incarne une entreprise dynamique du secteur informatique, basée à Reims. Son savoir-faire s'étend largement dans ce domaine, englobant les systèmes et réseaux, le développement de sites Web ainsi que la cyber-sécurité.

Dans le cadre du renforcement de ses équipes, nous recherchons un Expert Cybersécurité pour intervenir sur des environnements complexes de SOC, SIEM, sécurité réseau, DNS, EDR/XDR et Threat Intelligence.

Vos missions

· Administrer et exploiter les solutions SIEM/SOC : Elastic Security, Splunk, QRadar.

· Superviser et analyser les logs de sécurité : Elastic Agent, Beats, Rsyslog, Syslog-ng.

· Administrer et sécuriser les infrastructures DNS : Infoblox, BIND, DNSSEC, DNS Filtering.

· Exploiter les solutions Firewall / Proxy / Web Security : Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, Blue Coat, Zscaler.

· Analyser les alertes et incidents via les solutions EDR/XDR : CrowdStrike, Defender, SentinelOne.

· Réaliser des investigations réseau avec Wireshark, tcpdump et Zeek.

· Exploiter la Threat Intelligence avec MISP et VirusTotal.

· Développer et optimiser les règles de détection avec MITRE ATT&CK, Sigma et YARA.

· Automatiser les tâches de sécurité avec Python, Bash et REST API.

· Participer à la détection, l’investigation et la réponse aux incidents de sécurité.

· Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de l’architecture et des dispositifs de sécurité.

Vos compétences

SIEM / SOC : Elastic Security, Elasticsearch, Kibana, Logstash, Splunk, QRadar
DNS : Infoblox, BIND, DNSSEC, DNS Filtering
Network Security : Fortinet, Palo Alto, Check Point, Blue Coat, Zscaler
EDR/XDR : CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne
Threat Intelligence : MISP, VirusTotal
Network Analysis : Wireshark, tcpdump, Zeek
Systèmes : RHEL/Rocky Linux, Windows Server
Automatisation : Python, Bash, REST API, JSON, Regex
Infrastructure : Docker, Kubernetes
Détection : MITRE ATT&CK, Sigma, YARA
Monitoring / Data : Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Kafka

Profil recherché

  • Formation supérieure en informatique ou cybersécurité.
  • Minimum 5 ans d’expérience en cybersécurité opérationnelle ou poste similaire.
  • Très bonnes connaissances en SIEM, réseaux, DNS et analyse de logs.
  • Expérience sur plusieurs solutions de sécurité de l’environnement présenté.
  • Maîtrise de Python ou Bash appréciée.
  • Capacité à analyser des incidents complexes et à mener des investigations techniques.
  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit d’analyse et capacité à travailler en environnement critique.

Avantages

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Missions variées et challenges internationaux.
  • Travail dans un SOC dynamique et innovant.
  • Opportunité de prendre des initiatives et de contribuer à la stratégie globale de sécurité.
  • Conditions favorables à l’épanouissement personnel et professionnel.

title: Expression of Interest – Contractor Engagement – Bridge and Structures Inspectors
descriptionHtml:
About BakerHicks

BakerHicks is a leading design, engineering and project delivery consultancy, delivering complex infrastructure, industrial and built environment projects across the UK and Europe.

Our Infrastructure team supports a wide range of clients and frameworks, providing specialist engineering, inspection, surveying and asset management services. As our project portfolio continues to grow, we are expanding our network of trusted contractors to support current and future bridge inspection requirements across the UK.

Our strength lies in our collaborative approach, technical excellence, and ability to mobilise the right expertise at pace to support our clients’ requirements.

Our Bridges Team

At BakerHicks, our Bridges Team delivers expert engineering solutions across the full lifecycle of bridge and structures projects, from inspection and assessment through to design, refurbishment, strengthening, and replacement works. Our engineers work on a diverse portfolio of assets including highway bridges, railway bridges, footbridges, retaining structures, culverts, and other critical infrastructure across the UK.

We combine technical excellence with a practical, collaborative approach, working closely with clients, asset owners, local authorities, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams to develop safe, sustainable, and cost-effective solutions. Our experience spans inspections, structural assessments, repair schemes, asset management programmes, and the delivery of complex infrastructure projects in highly regulated environments.

The Opportunity

We are seeking Expressions of Interest from competent and experienced Bridge and Structural Inspectors to join our growing contractor talent pool.

This is not a live vacancy tied to a specific project. Instead, we are building a network of pre-qualified professionals who can be considered for assignments as needs arise across our infrastructure portfolio.
Applications are welcomed from anywhere in the UK. Site travel will normally be required, there is no requirement to be based near a BakerHicks office.

We are particularly keen to hear from inspectors based in Scotland, while welcoming applications from inspectors based in England.

What We're Looking For

We welcome inspectors with experience in one or more of the following activities and environments:

  • General inspections
  • Principal inspections, including close-up examination and access equipment
  • Safety, special and reactive inspections
  • Inspections for assessment and monitoring
  • Condition surveys (defect investigations and condition scoring)
  • Highway structures on trunk road and local authority networks
  • Railway structures
  • Inspection and access planning, and reporting
  • Team leadership and technical review by appropriately qualified Senior Inspectors

Relevant asset types and construction forms may include:

  • Road and rail bridges, including footbridges
  • Culverts and buried structures
  • Retaining walls
  • Tunnel structures
  • Sign and signal gantries, masts and other ancillary highway structures
  • Structures over or adjacent to watercourses, including scour-related inspections
  • Concrete, steel, masonry, timber, composite and post-tensioned structures

Knowledge & Experience

Applicants should be able to demonstrate the following, appropriate to the assignments sought:

  • Relevant UK bridge or structures inspection experience, with a clear record of inspection roles and asset types
  • Working knowledge of applicable standards and client procedures, including NR/L3/CIV/006 and/or DMRB CS 450 where relevant
  • Ability to identify, photograph and classify defects; record severity and extent; recognise urgent safety issues; and produce accurate reports and recommendations
  • Ability to plan and coordinate inspection works, including access arrangements and traffic or rail control measures.
  • Knowledge of structural materials, deterioration mechanisms, structural behaviour and inspection limitations
  • Experience with National Highways, Transport Scotland, Network Rail, local authorities or comparable asset owners and supply chains
  • Experience producing inspection reports and condition assessments, including reporting using Bridge Condition Indicators
  • IT Literacy – proficient in the use of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Depending on the assignment, the following will be required or advantageous:

  • Current Bridge Inspector Certification Scheme (BICS) certification at Inspector or Senior Inspector level, appropriate to the work. Required where mandated by the client, including relevant Transport Scotland assignments
  • Relevant BEng/MEng in civil or structural engineering qualification, or equivalent inspection experience
  • Current working-at-height and confined-space competence, where applicable
  • IPAF/MEWP, IRATA rope-access, PASMA mobile access towers, Ladder or other relevant access qualifications, where applicable
  • Current Safe Working Near Water (SWNW) or other equivalent competence, where applicable
  • Current Safe use of Trolley Equipment or Rail Trolley controller, where applicable
  • Valid CSCS or other required site-access certification
  • For rail work, current Personal Track Safety (PTS) and other role-specific competences; SSSTS or SMSTS for supervisory duties
  • Network Rail Competencies STE2 – 7 as defined in NR/SP/CTM/017

Why Register Your Interest?

By joining our contractor talent pool, you will:

  • Be considered for assignments matching your competence, location and availability
  • Build a working relationship with BakerHicks
  • Work alongside experienced infrastructure professionals
  • Support projects across a variety of sectors, clients and UK locations

How to Register Your Interest

Please submit your CV. Our Talent Acquisition team will review applications alongside our Infrastructure discipline leaders, and suitable candidates will be invited to an introductory discussion.

Engagement Details

  • Contract opportunities (Inside IR35 / PAYE engagement)
  • Flexible working depending on project requirements (office/site/hybrid)
  • Locations across the UK

Many of the positions within our company are subject to security clearance or security assurance levels. The successful candidate must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate level of security clearance or assurance level for this role, in line with client and sector requirements. In some cases, additional nationality or residency criteria may also apply due to specific client or national security obligations.

Further information on National security clearance levels can be found on the UK Government website: (National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK) 

About BakerHicks 

We’ve been innovating in design, engineering and project delivery since 1957 and operate from 14 locations for a truly European reach. For more about our company story, see: About | BakerHicks. 

BakerHicks. A Morgan Sindall Group company.  

Benefits 

Whatever your discipline, you’ll be alongside some of the most talented people in the industry. Our network of offices are appealing, friendly and comfortable spaces, easily accessible by car or public transport. And our salary and benefits packages are some of the best in the industry.  

BakerHicks is an equal opportunity employer. We care about creating an inclusive atmosphere and are committed to promoting diversity and inclusion throughout.  
BakerHicks is an inclusive organisation welcoming talent from all backgrounds. Applicants are assessed on the basis of personal merit and qualifications.

descriptionHtml:

title: Field CTO, Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

  • Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

  • Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

title: Field Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About SiTime

SiTime is the Precision Timing company.

Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.

Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit: www.sitime.com.

As SiTime’s Field Marketing Manager for EMEA, you are the regional marketing lead responsible for translating global campaigns and product launches into programs that build awareness, engagement, and qualified pipeline. Reporting to the Director, Growth Marketing and partnering with EMEA sales leadership, you are the voice of the region within corporate marketing; bringing local market intelligence, sales insights & priorities, and program performance data to inform marketing investments & programs across EMEA.

title: Fleet Administrator
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

As the Fleet Associate - Admin, you are the backbone of our vehicle operations. Your primary mission is to ensure that our fleet is fully compliant, legally documented, and that all vehicle related costs are accurately tracked. You are a highly organised administrator who thrives on keeping records up to date and resolving issues from insurance claims to parking fines with speed and precision.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Penalty Charge Notice (PCN) Management:

    Act as the primary lead for all incoming traffic fines and PCNs.

    • Identify the responsible driver for each contravention and raise the appropriate recoup charges in our internal systems.

    • Ensure all appeals or payments are actioned within the required legal timeframes to avoid late fees.

  • Insurance Claims Administration:

    • Coordinate the end-to-end administration for vehicle accidents and insurance claims.

    • Gather evidence, photos, and statements to submit to our insurers and follow up until each case is closed.

  • Vehicle Compliance & Documentation:

    • Maintain a "zero-error" digital archive for all vehicle documents, including V5Cs, MOTs, service records, insurance certificates and invoices.

    • Monitor expiration dates to ensure no vehicle is dispatched without valid tax, insurance, or safety certification.

  • Fleet Onboarding & Offboarding:

    • Manage the administrative workflow for bringing new vehicles into the fleet and removing decommissioned units.

    • Ensure all tracking hardware and vehicle specific documents are assigned or recovered correctly.

  • Communication & Inbox Management:

    • Oversee the fleet department’s central inbox, providing professional and timely responses to drivers, partners, and local authorities.

    • Act as the point of contact for external vendors regarding vehicle status and maintenance updates.

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • The Ultimate Organiser: You take pride in a clean inbox and a perfectly updated spreadsheet. You are someone who notices the smallest details that others might miss.

  • Effective Communicator: You can write clear, professional emails to local councils and handle firm but fair communication with drivers regarding fines or damages.

  • Resilient Administrator: You are comfortable managing a high volume of repetitive tasks and can stay focused on accuracy even during busy periods.

  • Tech-Literate: You are proficient with Google Sheets/Excel and are quick to learn new internal databases and fleet management software.

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - Kind to the planet, our team and our partners. We listen with purpose, leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - it requires us to be fair, consistent, honest, thoughtful and compassionate.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started. We never fight the urge to be inquisitive, to understand the world around us and to explore where others might not.

  • 🌍 We Are Resourceful - Our planet's resources are scarce and our future depends on our ability to use them wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Huge opportunity for learning in a high growth environment, with progression opportunities based on success in the role
