title: Fleet Operations Traing Lead, UK
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Fleet Operations Team

 

As the Fleet Operations Training Lead, UK, you will lead the development, delivery, and continuous improvement of training across our Fleet Operations teams. You will ensure that team members have the knowledge, practical skills, and confidence required to operate safely, consistently, and effectively.

 

Working closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other teams across the business, you will identify capability gaps and translate complex operational and technical information into engaging, practical learning experiences. You will establish consistent training standards across both regions while adapting programs to reflect local operational, cultural, language, and regulatory requirements.

 

We’re looking for someone who is organised, collaborative, and passionate about developing others: a pragmatic leader who is comfortable working in a fast-moving, safety-focused environment and can balance immediate training needs with a longer-term strategy. As our Fleet Operations function grows, you will develop scalable training programs and processes that can support additional geographies in the future.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 

  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive training strategy and roadmap for Fleet Operations in the UK, aligned with organisational priorities, operational requirements, and future geographical expansion

  • Design, implement, and regularly update onboarding, technical, safety, compliance, and professional-development programs for Fleet Operations teams

  • Partner with Fleet Operations leaders and subject-matter experts to assess skills, identify capability gaps, and prioritise training requirements

  • Deliver engaging instructor-led, virtual, practical, and blended learning experiences for employees with different levels of experience and technical knowledge

  • Establish consistent training and competency standards while adapting content and delivery to local languages, cultures, regulations, and operational environments

  • Create structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs that ensure employees are prepared to perform their roles safely and effectively

  • Define and monitor measures such as participation, knowledge retention, practical proficiency, time to competency, learner feedback, and operational performance

  • Use performance data, employee feedback, incident trends, and operational insights to continually improve training content, methods, and outcomes

  • Develop and manage train-the-trainer programs, supporting local trainers and Fleet Operations leaders to deliver learning consistently and effectively

  • Use learning technologies to make training accessible, scalable, and engaging, while maintaining accurate records of training, competency, and certification

  • Work closely with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and other stakeholders to ensure training reflects current technology, processes, risks, and business priorities

  • Support the introduction of new technologies, vehicles, processes, policies, and programmes through structured training and change-readiness activities

  • Champion continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and professional development across Fleet Operations

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 

  • Developing and delivering onboarding, technical, safety, and professional-development training

  • Building and maintaining competency frameworks, learning paths, and certification programs

  • Collaborating cross-functionally to ensure training keeps pace with operational and technological change

  • Evaluating training effectiveness using participation, performance, and feedback metrics

  • Running train-the-trainer initiatives and supporting local training delivery

  • Continuously iterating on training content, standards, and processes, making improvements based on data and feedback

  • Supporting operational change by creating learning experiences for new tools, vehicles, and systems

 

🙌 You should apply if

 

  • You have a strong track record of developing and implementing comprehensive operational training programs, including training-needs analysis, instructional design, delivery, and evaluation

  • You have demonstrated leadership experience within a high-velocity, safety-focused fleet, operational, or technical environment

  • You have experience supporting training across multiple locations, regions, or culturally diverse teams

  • You have excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical and operational information clear and accessible

  • You have experience creating structured learning paths, practical assessments, competency frameworks, and certification programs

  • You have strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify capability gaps and evaluate the effectiveness and operational impact of training

  • You possess strong stakeholder-management skills and can collaborate with Fleet Operations, Safety, Engineering, People, and subject-matter experts

  • You have excellent time-management and prioritisation skills, with proven ability to respond effectively to changing requirements in a fast-paced environment

  • You are able to work effectively across Europe and travel between operational locations when required

  • You are available to work on-site five days a week

  • You have a clean and compliant driving record in accordance with company requirements

  • You have a safety-conscious mindset, with the confidence to identify and escalate potential risks

 

Desirable

 

  • Experience establishing or scaling training programs across multiple countries or geographical regions

  • Experience adapting training for different languages, cultures, regulatory requirements, and operational contexts

  • Familiarity with learning-management systems, digital learning tools, and virtual or blended learning approaches

  • Experience developing train-the-trainer programs or leading a distributed network of trainers

  • Familiarity with advanced driver-assistance systems, including sensors and onboard hardware and firmware

  • Experience in fleet operations, particularly data collection and closed-loop testing of ADAS functions

  • Experience working within the automotive, autonomous-vehicle, robotics, AI, mobility, or another safety-critical industry

  • Japanese-language capability or previous experience working closely with teams in Japan

  • Experience working in a fast-moving technology company or startup

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

 

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

 

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Team Fit & Stakeholder Management; 2 hours total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Training, Quality Assurance, and Fleet Operations; 3 hours total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (1 hour)

 

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependent):

 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

title: Forward Software Engineer, Data
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About The Job


As a Forward Software Engineer, Data, you will build the systems behind some of the hardest problems Mistral takes on.

You join our team of engineers in Applied AI. We gravitate towards hard problems, decide how to solve them, and ship fast. You work closely with our customer-facing teams, and what works goes into production with our customers and across the company. When a project needs it, you work directly on customer engagements.

We're looking for a strong software engineer who builds end to end and has shipped ML or GenAI systems to production. You've felt the pain of models that pass every eval and fail on real data, and of quality that drifts after launch. You've also felt the data engineering pain: pipelines that break silently, schemas that change under you, and backfills that take a weekend. Data engineering is your edge. You turn messy, large-scale data into systems that hold up.

You think like a founder. You start from the customer's problem, not the technology. You measure success by the value you deliver, and you care about building experiences people love to use. You like working at the edge of what AI can do today, and you push past it.

Your scope is end to end, from first prototype to production. Your depth in data architecture helps set the standard for how the team designs and delivers systems. You know lakehouse and data mesh patterns well enough to know when they fit and when they're overkill. You've designed ontologies and data models, and you know that getting them right is as much art as science.

What you will do

  • Build AI systems end to end, from first prototype to production.

  • Design the data architecture underneath them: ingestion, processing, storage, and the data models and ontologies that make messy data usable.

  • Build distributed pipelines that process large volumes of documents, code, logs, and multimodal content for retrieval, agentic workflows, and fine-tuning.

  • Turn what works for one customer into patterns and platforms that work across many, without rebuilding each time.

  • Make systems hold up under real load: throughput, latency, cost, and failure recovery are part of the design from the start.

  • Build data governance into the systems themselves: ownership, access control, lineage, retention, and privacy for sensitive enterprise data.

  • Build the evaluation loop: labeling with LLMs and humans, versioned eval datasets, and checks that catch quality drift before customers do.

  • Set the standard for how the team designs and ships data systems.

  • Work with researchers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to turn hard problems into systems people rely on.

What We're Looking For

  • You have full ability to ship across the stack: proficient NodeJS e.g. NextJS/Express/Fastify or similar or Python e.g. FastAPI. You are confident with TypeScript + React/NextJS or similar. Solid beats polished.

  • You have 5+ years of experience building and running production data-intensive pipelines with distributed processing (for example Spark, Ray, Beam, or Dask) and orchestration tools (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect) with structured and unstructured data.

  • You have experience with retrieval-augmented generation, agentic use cases, or LLM evaluation, and a clear view of how data quality drives model quality.

  • You work autonomously: you find the problem, decide the approach, and own the outcome.

  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, and are fluent in English.

  • You ship in increments, are obsessed with time to value and are comfortable making and articulating product-technical tradeoffs.

Ideally you have

  • A passion for graph-based systems (e.g. Neo4j) and ontology design

  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines for LLM training, fine-tuning, or evaluation, and contributions to open-source projects, particularly in data or LLMs.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance and privacy requirements (for example GDPR), secure data handling, CI/CD and infrastructure as code, or an affinity for security engineering.

How We Work in Applied AI

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

What We Offer

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

In vielen Regionen Deutschlands finden Hausärztinnen und Hausärzte keine Nachfolge mehr. Patientinnen und Patienten stehen dann ohne Versorgung da. Wir ändern das, und suchen jemanden, der dabei vom ersten Tag an echte unternehmerische Verantwortung übernimmt.

Über PraxisEins
PraxisEins baut Deutschlands führenden Primärversorger auf. Wir übernehmen Hausarztpraxen, digitalisieren sie mit eigener Software und verbessern kontinuierlich die Patientenversorgung, gerade dort, wo sie am dringendsten gebraucht wird. Seit unserer Gründung 2022 sind wir auf über 400 Mitarbeitende gewachsen. Unser Managementteam kommt u. a. von BCG, McKinsey, Goldman Sachs und Oaktree Capital und hat bereits erfolgreich Unternehmen auf- und ausgebaut.

Die Rolle
Als Founders’ Associate arbeitest Du direkt mit unseren Gründern/Partner zusammen und siehst das gesamte Unternehmen von innen: Strategie, Operations, Wachstum, Produkt. Das ist kein Analysten-Job. Du setzt um, was Du erarbeitest, und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt eigene Führungs- und P&L-Verantwortung.

Was Du bewegst

  • Strategische Projekte: Von der Bewertung neuer Praxen über die Übernahme bis zur Integration in unser Netzwerk.

  • Unternehmertum: Du analysierst KPIs, identifizierst Hebel und verbesserst gemeinsam mit unseren Ärztlichen Leitungen und medizinischen Teams Abläufe in den Praxen.

  • Wachstum: Du erkennst organische und anorganische Wachstumschancen frühzeitig und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran.

  • Produkt: Mit unserem Product & Engineering Team entwickelst Du unsere Software weiter und bringst die Perspektive aus dem Praxisalltag ein.

  • Führung: Du übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung für Teams und Standorte und schaffst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Leistung bringen.

Dein Management Track

  1. Founders’ Associate: Du arbeitest an den wichtigsten Themen des Unternehmens und lernst unser Geschäft von Grund auf kennen.

  2. Standortverantwortung: Du übernimmst die P&L für mehrere Standorte und stellst unsere Qualitätsstandards sicher.

  3. Regionale Führung: Du gestaltest die Strategie Deiner Region und kannst Dich in kurzer Zeit in eine Prokuristen- oder Geschäftsführungsrolle entwickeln.

Das Tempo bestimmst Du durch Deine Leistung.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Praktikum oder Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. Strategieberatung (McKinsey, BCG o. Ä.), Investment Banking, Private Equity oder ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen

  • Starke analytische Fähigkeiten: Du erstellst Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen akribisch und kommunizierst sie überzeugend auf Führungsebene

  • Unternehmerisches Denken und echtes Ownership: Du treibst Lösungen eigenständig voran, statt auf Vorgaben zu warten

  • Lust darauf, Menschen zu führen, auch in medizinischen Teams

  • Die Motivation, im Gesundheitswesen etwas Positives zu bewirken

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in Organisation und Prozessmanagement

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch (mind. C1)

  • Reisebereitschaft: mind. 1 Tage pro Woche in unserer Zentrale in Frankfurt, die übrige Zeit an unseren Standorten in der Fläche oder aus dem Homeoffice

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Steile Lernkurve: Direkter Zugang zu den Gründern/Partner und einem erfahrenen Managementteam

  • Klarer Aufstiegspfad: Als schnellst wachsende Gruppe in der Primärversorgung bauen wir heute die Führungskräfte von morgen auf

  • Medizinische Grundausbildung: Auf Wunsch finanzieren wir Dir vollständig die berufsbegleitende Ausbildung zum Rettungssanitäter (ca. 4 Monate), damit Du medizinische Teams noch fundierter führen kannst

  • Gestaltungsfreiheit: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, Raum für eigene Ideen

  • Attraktive Konditionen: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt je nach Erfahrung und 30 Tage Urlaub

Klingt nach Dir?
Dann bewirb Dich direkt hier über LinkedIn. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Über PraxisEins

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. Zur besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Stellenanzeige das generische Maskulinum verwendet.

title: Founders Associate - Operations
descriptionHtml:
Heidi Systems baut das Energy-OS für Real Estate. Dafür digitalisieren wir einen der letzten großen analogen Märkte Europas und schaffen die Infrastruktur für intelligentes Energiemanagement in Gebäuden.

Wo wir stehen

  • 8 Personen
  • Starke Pipeline mit +5.000 aktiven Deals
  • Angel-Runde mit Unicorn-Foundern sowie Directors von Google und OpenAI
  • Auf dem Weg zu 10x in 2026

Wir rollen die Messdienstbranche neu auf – einen riesigen, verstaubten Markt, den seit Jahrzehnten kaum jemand angefasst hat. Als Prop- und ClimateTech verbinden wir Software, IoT und Operations zu einer Plattform, die Energie- und Verbrauchsdaten erstmals durchgängig digital, transparent und in Echtzeit verfügbar macht.

Wir wachsen stark und suchen jemanden, der unsere operativen Abläufe mit aufbaut, übernimmt und kontinuierlich besser macht.

Als Operations Manager bist du für die End-to-End-Umsetzung unserer Kundenprojekte verantwortlich. Aus einem gewonnenen Auftrag machst du ein erfolgreich umgesetztes Projekt.

Du koordinierst Kunden, Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure und weitere Partner, hältst Projekte auf Kurs und sorgst dafür, dass Probleme gelöst werden, bevor sie eskalieren.

Gleichzeitig baust du gemeinsam mit unserem Founder die operativen Strukturen von Heidi Systems weiter aus.

Die Rolle ist bewusst breit angelegt: Du bekommst kein fertiges Playbook. Du baust es mit auf.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst End-to-End Ownership für eigene Kunden und Objekte – vom Onboarding bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und laufenden Betreuung
  • Du koordinierst Hausverwaltungen, Eigentümer, Installateure, Mieter und weitere Partner und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten zur richtigen Zeit die richtigen Informationen haben
  • Du steuerst viele Projekte parallel und behältst eigenständig den Überblick, ohne, dass jemand dir hinterlaufen muss
  • Du bist zentraler Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden und Partner und kommunizierst schnell, klar und verbindlich
  • Du löst operative Probleme eigenständig. Wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, suchst du nach einer Lösung, bis es klappt und schreckst auch nicht vor unkonventionellen Methoden zurück
  • Du identifizierst manuelle, fehleranfällige oder repetitive Prozesse und entwickelst daraus skalierbare Prozesse und Systeme
  • Du automatisierst operative Abläufe mit No-Code-/Low-Code- und AI-Tools, z. B. n8n, Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Du baust Strukturen für Projekttracking, Dokumentation, Reporting und interne Kommunikation auf und stellst sicher, dass diese im Alltag funktionieren
  • Du analysierst operative Kennzahlen, erkennst Engpässe und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab
  • Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und Initiativen von der Problemdefinition über die Umsetzung bis zur Erfolgsmessung
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Founder zusammen und übernimmst mit wachsendem Vertrauen zunehmend größere operative Verantwortungsbereiche.

Qualifikation

Wir suchen jemanden mit hohem Drive, starkem analytischem Denken und Lust darauf, früh Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Studium in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL, VWL, Finance, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Fach.
  • Erste relevante Erfahrungen durch Praktika in Startups, Venture Capital, Consulting, Investment Banking, Tech oder einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen.
  • Du hast bereits gezeigt, dass du Dinge eigenständig vorantreiben kannst – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeiten.
  • Du bist analytisch stark und kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten.
  • Du kannst komplexe Probleme strukturieren und daraus konkrete nächste Schritte ableiten.
  • Du bist sehr organisiert und behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – auch mit Kunden und externen Partnern.
  • Du hast hohe Eigenmotivation und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand sagt, was du tun sollst.
  • Du hast Spaß daran, dich in neue Tools und Technologien einzuarbeiten und Prozesse mit AI und Automatisierung besser zu machen.
  • Du kannst mit Unklarheit umgehen und fühlst dich wohl, wenn es noch keinen perfekten Prozess gibt.
  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und fließendes Englisch sind Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit und tägliches Mentoring durch einen erfahrenen Gründer und eine extrem steile Lernkurve
  • Teil eines stark wachsenden Early-Stage-Startups zu werden, das einen riesigen Markt digitalisiert – mit viel Eigenverantwortung, hoher Geschwindigkeit und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Echte End-to-End-Verantwortung: Deine Projekte gehören dir – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung
  • Die Chance, unsere Operations von Anfang an mit aufzubauen und die Prozesse eines schnell wachsenden Unternehmens maßgeblich zu prägen
  • Die Möglichkeit, mit wachsender Verantwortung größere operative Bereiche und perspektivisch ein eigenes Team zu übernehmen
  • Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in Immobilien, Tech, Energie und Venture Capital
  • Ein High-Performance-Team in einer humorvollen und unterstützenden Kultur, mit regelmäßigen Team-Dinnern und gemeinsamen Events
  • Ein neu renoviertes Altbau-Office in Berlin Mitte direkt am Monbijoupark, gemeinsames Arbeiten an einem Tisch, kurze Wege und direkte Entscheidungen

title: Founder's Office Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Founding Customer Success Manager*in
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Yes ist die Software für Vertriebsteams von FMCG-Marken im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel. Außendienst, Key Account und Vertriebsleitung arbeiten in einem System: Tourenplanung, Storechecks, Aktionen, Ziele und Auswertungen in Echtzeit. Zu unseren Kunden gehören unter anderem nucao, ahead und Uludağ.

Wir sind ein stark wachsendes Early-Stage-Startup. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung, gestaltest Strukturen und Prozesse mit und arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen.

Die Rolle

Als Founding Customer Success Manager*in verantwortest du bei Yes alles, was nach dem Vertragsabschluss passiert. Du bringst die Teams unserer Kunden produktiv ins System, bleibst danach ihre feste Ansprechperson und legst dabei selbst fest, wie Onboarding, Betreuung und Support bei Yes funktionieren. Du entwickelst die Prozesse dafür von der Onboarding-Strecke über den Support bis zum Reporting. Du berichtest direkt an den COO.

So arbeitest du bei uns

  • Du priorisierst selbst, was als Nächstes dran ist, und holst dir Abstimmung, wenn du sie brauchst, nicht für jeden Schritt.

  • Du findest pragmatische Lösungen, auch wenn Informationen fehlen oder für einen Fall noch kein Prozess existiert.

  • Du gehst Kundenprobleme bis zur Ursache nach, statt sie weiterzugeben, und arbeitest dich dafür auch in die Daten und das Produkt ein.

  • Du wechselst innerhalb eines Tages zwischen Schulung im Markt, Datenimport und Prozessarbeit, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.

  • Du baust Abläufe beim ersten Mal so, dass sie beim zehnten Kunden noch funktionieren, und dokumentierst sie entsprechend.

  • Du sagst offen, wenn etwas nicht funktioniert, und bringst einen Vorschlag mit.

Deine Aufgaben

Onboarding und Implementierung (ca. 50 %)

  • Durchführung von Kickoffs und Onboardings neuer Kunden bis zum Livegang

  • Einrichtung der Kundenaccounts inklusive Nutzer*innen, Gebiete und Integrationen

  • Migration und Import von Kundendaten, zum Beispiel Stammdaten zu Märkten, Produkten und Besuchshistorie aus Excel, ERP- oder Altsystemen

  • Schulungen für Außendienst, Key Account und Innendienst, remote und vor Ort

  • Erstellung von Schulungsmaterial und Help-Center-Artikeln

Kundenbetreuung und Wachstum (ca. 35 %)

  • Betreuung des Kundenportfolios als feste Ansprechperson

  • Monitoring von Nutzung und Account-Health, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Churn-Risiken

  • regelmäßige Business Reviews mit den Vertriebsleitungen unserer Kunden

  • Identifikation und Vorbereitung von Rollouts, Upsells und Vertragsverlängerungen in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung

  • First-Level-Support und Abstimmung technischer Themen mit der Entwicklung

Aufbau und Produktfeedback (ca. 15 %)

  • Aufbau der Customer-Success-Prozesse von null: Onboarding-Strecke, Playbooks, SLAs und Ticketing

  • Definition und Reporting zentraler Kennzahlen wie Onboarding-Dauer, Nutzungsrate, Churn und Net Revenue Retention

  • strukturierte Weitergabe von Kundenfeedback an Produkt und Entwicklung

  • Pflege der Kundendaten in HubSpot

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Implementierung oder Account Management im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS

  • Erfahrung im Lebensmitteleinzelhandel, in der FMCG-Branche oder im Außendienst, sodass du Begriffe wie Listung, Distributionsgrad, Zweitplatzierung oder Besuchsrhythmus nicht erklärt bekommen musst

  • Erfahrung in einem kleinen Team oder frühen Startup, in dem du ohne vorhandene Prozesse gearbeitet hast

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Durchführung von Onboardings und Schulungen

  • Erfahrung mit einem eigenen Kundenportfolio und nachweisbare Erfolge bei Kundenbindung oder Expansion

  • Ausgeprägte technische Affinität und sicherer Umgang mit SaaS-Tools wie HubSpot

  • Erfahrung mit Datenmigrationen, also Aufbereitung, Bereinigung und Import von Kundendaten

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT und Erfahrung im Aufbau von Reportings und Dashboards

  • Sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Anwender*innen und Führungskräften

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft für Schulungen und Termine bei Kunden in Deutschland

Von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung als erste Person im Customer Success eines Unternehmens

  • Erfahrung mit Help-Center- oder Ticketing-Tools

  • Erfahrung mit ERP- oder Warenwirtschaftssystemen aus dem Handelsumfeld

Wir bieten

  • Fixgehalt plus Bonus auf Basis erreichter Expansion-Ziele

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und freie Wahl des Arbeitsorts

  • optional Workspace in Hamburg oder Düsseldorf

  • Dein Laptop nach Wahl

title: Founding Enterprise AE | France
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Your mission

telli is arriving in France. We are building a small, mighty team in Paris to make every customer interaction worth having. We have a product already used by leading B2C businesses, but the French market is still at the beginning. We will earn our place, one customer at a time.

We are outbound first. As a founding Enterprise Account Executive, you will create opportunities, win major French accounts, and help define how telli sells in this market. You will carry a quota and own the hard parts of the deal, from the first cold conversation to signature. Your work will shape the playbook for the team that follows.

What you'll do

  • Build your own enterprise pipeline through thoughtful outbound, calls, referrals, and a deep understanding of French customer operations.

  • Lead complex sales cycles end to end: discovery, demos, business cases, executive alignment, security, legal, procurement, and negotiation.

  • Find the real problem behind a customer's interest in AI, quantify the value of solving it, and earn trust across the buying group.

  • Work closely with the France team, founders, product, and deployment colleagues to turn early customers into lasting successes.

  • Keep an honest forecast and turn wins, losses, and objections into a repeatable French sales motion.

What makes you a great fit

  • You have personally sourced and closed complex B2B enterprise deals, ideally in software or AI, and can show how you earned them.

  • You are comfortable speaking with senior business leaders and working through IT, security, finance, legal, and procurement.

  • You enjoy the unglamorous work as much as the big meeting: prospecting, follow-up, and fixing what is broken.

  • You bring a bias for action, aim for excellence, take ownership, and work with low ego. Read the telli principles

  • You communicate with confidence and care in French and can work effectively in English with our international team.

  • You are based in Paris and can spend two weeks in Berlin for onboarding. You are ready to travel and visit prospects across France when needed.

You may not be a good fit if

  • You don't believe voice is the future of how people and businesses talk to each other.

  • You expect a ready-made book of business or marketing to build your pipeline.

  • You want to join deals only after discovery, and avoid cold outreach or the hard follow-through between meetings.

  • You need a fixed playbook before acting or pass on ownership when a deal gets messy.

  • You dislike working across executive, operations, IT, legal, and procurement stakeholders or learning openly from losses.

The reality of the role

France is a new market for us. There is no mature local playbook or book of business waiting for you. Some deals will be messy, and you will need to create momentum yourself. If you want ownership, direct feedback, ambitious colleagues, and the chance to do the best work of your career, this is the opportunity.

The hiring process

The hiring process itself is a case study in how you sell. Approach it as you would a complex account: research us, form a point of view, earn attention, ask and listen, follow through, and respond to feedback. We will evaluate how you create momentum and manage the process end to end, with the judgment and ownership you would bring to winning enterprise customers in France.

Compensation

€120,000–€180,000 gross annual on-target earnings (OTE), with a 50% base salary and 50% variable compensation at target, plus equity. We will discuss the equity terms during the hiring process.

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

title: Founding Growth - Alan Precision
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Alan Precision: why this exists

Your body knows before you do. The signals are there years before symptoms. And yet, in 2026, the system around us isn't catching them.

50% of non-communicable diseases (cardiovascular disease, type 2 diabetes, many cancers) are preventable with lifestyle changes, and we're not capturing them. Western countries have seen healthspan flatline for years, meaning we live longer, but not better. 46% of Europeans report mental health issues. The kind of deep, personalised health reading that could change this has been reserved for the few who could afford a 3,000€ check-up, and built for filing reports rather than changing lives.

We don't accept that.

Alan Precision is our bet on advanced prevention as the new norm of care. We combine biology, wearables, medical history, and lifestyle context, read it all as a connected system with AI supervised by physicians, and turn the result into a personalised protocol the member actually executes across sleep, nutrition, movement, stress, and supplementation. Then we retest, learn, and adapt. Health is a moving target. We move with it.

Our ambition: make Alan Precision the reference for advanced prevention in Europe by 2030.

⭐ The Founding Growth opportunity

Alan Precision is live, with fast week-over-week growth. Now we need to turn a new category into a habit: hundreds of thousands of customers in the coming years, and a measurable impact on their health. You will be the first growth and go-to-market person on the crew, accountable for two numbers: how many members subscribe to Precision, and how many stay, retest and renew.

The crew was launched by the founding team of ARO, acquired by Alan in 2026, to move fast and apply their learnings from building a preventive health company.

It is a unique playground. You get the means of one of France's biggest scale-ups (1M+ members reachable from day one, an ecosystem of products like Mo, Play and Clinic, and a brand carried by ambassadors like Kylian Mbappé) with the culture and pace of a fast-growing startup: small crew, short loops, everything still to invent.

🔭 Scope: Three go-to-market engines

1. Direct-to-member: turn Alan's 1M+ members into Precision subscribers.

Offering paid services that members subscribe to by themselves inside Alan is a pretty new go-to-market for us, and you invent it.

  • Build the CRM and lifecycle engine: segments, triggers, sequences, in-app moments.

  • Use product data to decide who to push Precision to, when and where: which actions, traits or life moments make it relevant, and which do not.

  • Position Precision inside the surfaces of other product crews (Mo, Play, Clinic, Shop), with their teams and push the right message at the right time.

  • Own recurrence: activation after the first check-up, retests, renewals, reactivation. Acquisition without retention does not count.

2. B2B: get Alan's client companies to offer Precision to their employees.

Almost everything is to define: business model, offer format, pricing logic, sales motion.

  • Work with our B2B Marketing team to understand the constraints of our Sales and Account Management teams, give them the right pitch and materials, and set the right targets with them.

  • Meet HR buyers yourself to learn what makes them pay.

3. Beyond Alan: take Precision to the open market.

Once the internal engine runs:

  • Apply the full B2C health and e-commerce playbook to acquire users that are not insured by Alan

  • Your levers will be numerous, across paid acquisition, influence, partnerships, brand.

Across all three:

  • Create demand in a market that is still being created. Talk to members every week, define the value proposition and the messages that make people want advanced prevention, and push for the product changes that go with them.

  • Build a brand people want, and explain it simply. Make advanced prevention desirable and easy to understand, with our Brand team, without overpromising.

  • Say what can be said. Health communication is regulated: medical biology, health claims, influencer rules, use of health data for targeting. You work with our medical and legal teams and turn these constraints into sharper, more credible messages.

  • Measure and decide. Funnels, cohorts, holdouts, channel performance. Pick the next bet, cut what does not work, share what we learned.

  • Own it end to end. From the idea of a strategy to the campaign live in production: you design it, write it, build it, ship it and iterate on it yourself. Sharp copywriting is a core part of the job.

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Fluent in French and English.

  • You have grown a B2C product from its early days. Ideally as the first growth or go-to-market person, on a subscription in health, wellbeing or e-commerce. You can tell us which channels you picked, which ones you cut, and why.

  • A creative Swiss army knife who prioritises. You can do a bit of everything and you find channels and angles nobody has thought of yet. You know the job is to pick the right one, execute it, measure it and move to the next.

  • Lifecycle and CRM at scale. Customer.io, Braze or equivalent: segmentation, behavioural triggers, in-app moments.

  • Analytical rigour. You read a funnel, build a cohort, set up a holdout and call a result. You measure success in subscribers, retention and revenue.

  • Hands-on, and a great writer. You love taking an idea all the way to production yourself: the strategy, the copy, the campaign, the dashboard. You write well and fast, and you turn a complex medical topic into a clear, desirable promise.

  • Customer-obsessed. You talk to members every week and you are just as comfortable in front of an HR director.

  • Fluent with AI. You build with AI every day: assets, copy variants, segments, analyses and even building your own tools. You use it to go faster, and you keep your judgment on what ships.

  • Driven by health, and rigorous about it. Health matters to you, and when something blocks, you find a way. You make people want to act with messages that hold up in front of a physician.

Nice to haves

  • Experience with regulated health communication (claims, health data, medical services).

  • B2B2C, employee benefits or HR tech.

  • Paid acquisition and influencer marketing in B2C.

  • Pricing and packaging of subscription offers.

  • You own your own health: Whoop, Oura, blood tests, supplements are no secret for you.

🌍 How we work

  • Location: Paris

  • Remote work: We offer remote work flexibility, but we value in-person collaboration.

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.
If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?
Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You want to know more about Alan?

  • 🤘 A strong culture: People joining Alan are often surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work.

title: Founding LPA Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Applicants from the EU and non-EU are welcome to apply

▪ Industry: Deep-tech / Active Muon Imaging & Laser-Plasma Accelerators

▪ HQ & Locations: Hamburg (DE) – HQ; Tallinn (EE)

▪ Size: 1–10 employees

Company Mission

The company develops safe, rapid and accurate active muon imaging solutions for industrial quality assessment, security and customs inspection and medical diagnostics. Their platform combines laser-plasma-accelerator-driven muon sources, next-generation particle detectors and AI to enable high-resolution 3D imaging with automated decision-making. The company operates at DESY in Hamburg, Germany, and Tehnopol in Tallinn, Estonia. Their main development partners span the energy, defence, aerospace and security industries. Their initial technology and business focus is on the quality and safety assessment of critical metallic and ceramic components, such as rocket engines, gas turbines, jet engines, and large-scale nuclear or industrial systems.

Core Values

Skunkworks approach: They work in small teams with full ownership. They keep it simple, stupid. Move fast: a shiny prototype means they spent too long on it. They build to learn. They polish later. Disagree together, commit together: they debate and challenge, regardless of title. Then they deliver the decision as one team. They win as a team. They pivot as a team.

Courage: they always make the call. A mistake isn't a failure: it's proof they're improving. Either way, the own the outcome. Honesty and transparency: they share what's really happening, good or bad. That lets everyone make the right call. They stay open. They stay honest.

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Assemble and lead the Muon Source team, covering LPA, converter, and optics; start hands-on, hire and structure the team as the work grows

  • Oversee the development of working points and a density-tailored plasma source that survives the thermal load of a 100 Hz, 100 TW focus—millions of consistent shots, not one good shot

  • Lead the development of the plasma source and execute experiments at user facilities to iterate the design toward powering the transportable muon source

  • Isolate the laser specs that matter most—pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality—and ensure they get delivered

  • Own the vacuum system and the laser transport line, including vacuum chambers, differential pumping, vibration management and thermal management, turning the LPA into a machine that fits inside a shipping container and runs 24/7

  • Define the requirements for the control system, the machine protection system, and the diagnostics suite that let the machine run unattended

  • Manage the budget and make technical decisions within your area of responsibility

  • Participate in hiring processes to expand the Muon Source team as the scope grows

Requirements

  • Team leadership. You've built and led a technical team before. You're ready to be hands-on again before this one exists

  • Hands-on LPA experience. You've built and operated a laser-plasma accelerator. Not just modeled one. Injection, dephasing, depletion, and guiding physics you've tuned on real hardware

  • Experimental leadership at user facilities. You've planned and run a multi-year experimental campaign before. You know how to iterate a design from real beamtime data

  • High-power laser system literacy. You can write a spec a laser manufacturer can build to: pulse energy, duration, pointing and energy stability, beam quality. You hold vendors to it

  • Vacuum and opto-mechanical engineering judgment. You know what vacuum chamber design, differential pumping, vibration isolation, and thermal management require to keep the LPA running under continuous, high-average-power use

  • Controls and diagnostics systems thinking. You can translate "runs unattended, 24/7" into concrete requirements for a control system, a machine protection system, and a diagnostics suite, even where another team builds them

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years postdoc experience

  • Doctorate (PhD / Dr.) required

  • At least full professional proficiency in English; German or Estonian is a plus

  • Willingness to work primarily on-site in Hamburg (no full remote; approximately one home-office day per week)

  • Occasional travel required to visit and work at different research facilities across the world

  • Ability to start in January 2027 or latest February 2027

Core Benefits

  • Key Role with Direct Impact: Without your LPA, our core product – the transportable muon source – cannot operate

  • Founding Role with High Autonomy: Build both the accelerator team and the machine from the ground up, taking full ownership of technical and budget decisions

  • Unique Deep-Tech Challenge: Hands-on work with laser-plasma accelerators at 100 Hz / 100 TW and active muon imaging technology that is revolutionizing industrial inspection

  • Access to World-Class Infrastructure: On-demand beamtime at multi-GeV facilities such as DESY PRIMA, plus collaborations with ELI Beamlines, EPAC, and ATLAS

  • Strong Network & Visibility: Collaborate with leading partners such as DESY, DLR, Siemens Energy, Marvel Fusion, and other high-tech organizations

  • Attractive Compensation Package plus a substantial employee equity program and relocation support, including for non-EU candidates

  • Culture of Ownership & Speed: A skunkworks approach, flat hierarchies, bold decision-making, and full transparency create an environment for personal growth

descriptionHtml:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

title: Frontend-Entwickler (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Einleitung

Wir suchen neue Kolleg:innen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Weg zur Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht und einem starken Team aus über 60 Kolleg:innen begleiten wir tausende Mandant:innen erfolgreich auf dem Weg zum deutschen Pass. Alle unsere Stellen sind Festanstellungen bei uns vor Ort in Cottbus.

Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich selbst einen Eindruck auf unserer Karriereseite. Denn wir können hier schreiben, was wir wollen, am Ende bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung.

Wir bieten Dir

Bei uns entscheidest du mit, wie unser Frontend aussieht, technisch und inhaltlich. Du hast echten Einfluss auf Architektur, Stack und Qualität und siehst täglich, was deine Entscheidungen bewirken.

  • Moderner Stack ohne Legacy-Blockaden
    Du arbeitest mit React/Next.js, Vue oder dem, was der Job erfordert. Kein Stack wird dir vorgeschrieben, und wenn du ein Tool kennst, das unsere Arbeit besser macht, wollen wir davon hören. Du arbeitest an neuen Projekten und modernisierst bestehende Komponenten, ohne dich durch veralteten Code kämpfen zu müssen.
  • Sichtbarkeit und große Reichweite
    Über 15.000 Website-Klicks täglich. Du siehst den Effekt deiner Arbeit nicht erst nach einem Quartal, sondern direkt: in den Core Web Vitals, in den Conversion-Rates, in den Nutzerzahlen.
  • High-End-Hardware nach Wahl
    Egal ob MacBook Pro oder Dell XPS mit Linux: Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, dazu 4K-Monitore, ein hochwertiges Headset und einen ergonomischen Arbeitsplatz mit höhenverstellbarem Tisch.
  • Musik bei der Arbeit
    Bei uns wird nicht mit der Stirn gerunzelt, wenn du dir Kopfhörer aufsetzt. Wenn es dir hilft (und niemanden stört), kannst du auch gern Heavy Metal über eine Soundanlage an deinem Schreibtisch pumpen.
  • Kurze Wege und kleine Teams
    Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt. Du musst dich nicht durch Hierarchien hangeln, um gehört zu werden, sondern sprichst direkt mit Kolleg:innen, Teamleads oder der Geschäftsführung. Entscheidungen fallen schnell, und niemand sitzt „im Elfenbeinturm“.
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit
    Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf das Leben von Menschen. Du unterstützt sie dabei, in Deutschland anzukommen, Sicherheit zu finden und ein neues Kapitel aufzuschlagen. Das ist keine trockene Büroarbeit, sondern Arbeit mit echter Bedeutung.
  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit und flexible Teilzeit
    Keine Kernzeiten, keine vorgeschriebenen Zeitfenster. Ob 4-Tage-Woche, 30 Stunden oder ein individuelles Modell: Dein Job soll zu deinem Leben passen, nicht andersherum.
  • Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung
    Grundsätzlich arbeiten wir im Büro, weil Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort für uns wichtig sind. Nach deiner Einarbeitung ist gelegentliches Homeoffice aber kein Problem, auch spontan.
  • Spontan frei, wenn das Leben dazwischenkommt
    Kranke Kinder, Elternabend, kurzfristiger Arzttermin oder einfach mal eine Auszeit: Wir planen unsere Teams so, dass auch spontane freie Tage möglich sind, ganz ohne Stress oder schlechtes Gewissen. Familie und Gesundheit haben bei uns Vorrang.
  • Modernes Altbau-Büro mit Fitnessraum
    Hohe Decken, viel Tageslicht, Pflanzen und ein Innenhof für die Pause zwischendurch, mitten im Herzen von Cottbus. Unser eigener Fitnessraum im Haus steht dir kostenlos und jederzeit zur Verfügung. Einen Einblick in unsere Räume bekommst du auf unserer Website.
  • Team-Events und Feel-Good-Angebote
    Sommerfest am See, Weihnachtsfeier, Halloween-Sause, gemeinsame Lunches oder Afterwork-Dinner: Wir feiern gern. Erscheinen ist keine Pflicht, und früher gehen ist auch kein Problem. Zwischendurch sorgt unsere Feel-Good-Managerin für kleine Auszeiten, von Nacken- und Schultermassagen bis zu kurzen Entspannungs-Sessions.

Mögliche Aufgabenbereiche

Als Frontend-Entwickler (w/m/d) bist du die Verbindung zwischen Design und funktionierendem Produkt. Du arbeitest eng mit UX/UI, Backend und Marketing zusammen, nicht als reine Umsetzung, sondern als technisches Gegenüber auf Augenhöhe. Du sagst Bescheid, wenn ein Design nicht performant umzusetzen ist, schlägst Alternativen vor und trägst aktiv zur Qualität des Gesamtprodukts bei.

  • Entwicklung responsiver UIs
    Du entwickelst moderne, performante Benutzeroberflächen und neue Features, ob für unsere Website, Apps, interne Tools oder zukünftige Projekte.
  • Arbeit mit modernen Frameworks
    Du baust modulare Komponenten und komplette Frontend-Applikationen mit modernen JavaScript-Frameworks wie React/Next.js, Vue.js oder Svelte.
  • Von Figma zu Code
    In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem UX/UI-Team setzt du Figma-Designs in sauberen Code um.
  • Landingpages
    Du baust performante Landingpages für Marketing-Kampagnen, denkst A/B-Tests von Anfang an mit und verstehst, dass Nutzerführung genauso zu deiner Verantwortung gehört wie sauberer Code.
  • Formulare & Nutzer-Flows
    Du gestaltest und optimierst Upload-Strecken, Formularlogiken, Validierungen und Schritt-für-Schritt-Flows in unseren Tools.
  • Dashboards & interne Tools
    Du entwickelst Custom-Tools und Dashboards auf Basis bestehender Daten und Schnittstellen, die unsere internen Prozesse wirklich voranbringen.
  • API-Integration
    Du bindest REST- und GraphQL-APIs ins Frontend ein, sorgst für stabile Datenflüsse und kümmerst dich um Fehlerhandling, Caching und logische UI-Reaktionen.
  • Performance-Optimierung
    Du analysierst und verbesserst unsere Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), optimierst Page Speed und Ladezeiten und nutzt Tools wie Lighthouse, um unsere Produkte messbar schneller zu machen.
  • Page-Builder-Entwicklung
    Gelegentlich unterstützt du das Webdesign-Team bei der Umsetzung in Elementor oder Bricks. Du weißt, wann das sinnvoll ist und wann ein eigenes Template besser ist.

Dein Profil

Bei uns zählen keine Abschlüsse oder Zertifikate, sondern Erfahrung und echtes Know-how. Du hast Frontend nicht nur ausprobiert, sondern wirklich betrieben: Komponenten, die skalieren. Interfaces, die performen. Code, den andere verstehen. Wenn du das mitbringst und Lust hast, bei uns echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

  • Erfahrung mit modernen Frameworks
    Du hast bereits mit React, Vue, Svelte oder Angular gearbeitet, echte Features damit gebaut, die im Live-Betrieb laufen, und weißt, welche Entscheidungen dabei eine Rolle spielen.
  • Festanstellung vor Ort in Cottbus
    Du möchtest fest bei uns angestellt sein und im Team vor Ort in Cottbus arbeiten. Für Freelance-Aufträge oder reine Remote-Stellen sind wir leider nicht die richtige Adresse.
  • Sichere Web-Grundlagen
    Du beherrschst HTML5, CSS3 (gern auch mit SASS/LESS) und modernes JavaScript. Saubere Struktur, modulares Denken und Wiederverwendbarkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich.
  • Performance im Blick
    Lazy Loading, Bundling, Caching, WebP: Du denkst Performance nicht als nachträgliche Optimierung, sondern von Anfang an mit.
  • KI-gestützte Entwicklung
    KI ist für dich kein Neuland. Wir stellen dir alle gängigen LLMs zur Verfügung und erwarten, dass du sie sinnvoll nutzt, um deine Arbeit zu optimieren und selbstständig Lösungen zu finden.
  • Dokumentation & Struktur
    Du schreibst klaren, verständlichen Code und hältst wichtige Dinge in kurzer Dokumentation fest.
  • Offenheit für Neues
    Du hast Lust, Neues auszuprobieren und moderne Webtechnologien in den Alltag einzubringen.
  • Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe
    Eigentlich wollen wir hier nichts Generisches schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist uns wichtig: Gute Zusammenarbeit zählt für uns genauso viel wie Know-how. Jemand, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos läuft, ist im Alltag oft wertvoller als jemand mit noch mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch, am besten beides (ca. B2-Niveau). Keine Sorge, einen Nachweis brauchen wir nicht.

title: Global Trainee Program - Outperformer Software Business Track (HILTI)
descriptionHtml:
4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage

Construction technology is being reinvented. Be part of it.

Construction is one of the world's largest industries, and one of its least digitized. That is changing fast. At Hilti, we are not only developing software products - we are building and growing digital businesses around them. Hilti is at the centre of that shift, with a growing portfolio of software products that connect jobsites, offices, teams, and tools across the entire construction lifecycle. We are looking for ambitious, internationally mobile early-career talents with a global mindset who are excited about technology but see their future in business and leadership rather than in a purely technical software career.

The Software & Digital Business Track of Hilti's Outperformer Program is a two-year accelerated development program that prepares you for a commercial, international leadership career in our software and digital businesses. You will learn how technology becomes customer value, how software businesses grow, how products are brought to market, and how commercial decisions are made. This is not a rotation program where you shadow senior leaders. From day one, you carry real responsibility.

What You'll do

The Software Track is designed to build the next generation of software business leaders at Hilti – Business Owners, Business Directors, Segment Managers and ultimately Senior Management Team members. If you want a structured path to running a business, this program is built for that outcome.

The program places you inside one of two business units:

Construction Software: Home to Fieldwire (Field Software for project and workforce management), ON!Track (asset management), and 4PS (construction business management). You will work directly with customers, product teams, and business leadership across Europe and beyond.

Fastening & Protection Solutions: Where design & engineering software for structural connections (e.g. PROFIS Engineering Suite), MEP supports and passive fire protection systems are developed and brought to market across a global customer base of structural and mechanical engineers.


For the Construction Software business unit, the program is structured to provide a balanced foundation in customer and market exposure, software product understanding, and business experience, while giving you the opportunity to work with at least two software products during the program:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month sales assignment, developing direct customer insight and understanding the business challenges addressed by our software solutions.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each across product and business teams, including exposure to an international project.

​For the Fastening & Protection Solution business unit, the program provides exposure to product management , software development, exposure to customers and start-ups and international project experience:

  • ​Year 1: Begin with a 12-month product management assignment, building product understanding and market insight.
  • ​Year 2: Undertake three rotations of 3–6 months each, involving international projects that broaden your business perspective and global exposure.

You will have a dedicated senior mentor from the start, direct exposure to executive leadership, and a peer cohort of Global Trainees across all Hilti business tracks globally.

What You’ll Bring

You are close to graduating or have recently completed a Master's degree - your degree is likely to be in construction management, civil engineering, or mechanical engineering with a focus on construction, Computer Science, or also Business study programs with an affinity for Software and construction. What matters more than your degree subject is the combination of traits below:

  • Global mobility - you are willing and able to relocate internationally, multiple times. A global thinker who is keen for diverse cultural experiences.
  • Digital and AI orientation - you think natively in digital workflows, comfortable with software tools, and know the power and potential of AI.
  • Language - you are fluent in English and/or German, Dutch, French, Spanish or Italian. 
  • Commercial instinct - you are drawn to how businesses grow, how customers make decisions, and how products create.
  • Low ego, high drive - you take the work seriously and yourself lightly. You seek feedback, move fast, and are energised by ambiguity rather than unsettled by it.
  • You are at the start of your career and have maximum three years of junior work experience.

What’s In It for You

​​Show us what you can do, and in return, we promise you the experience of a lifetime. We offer you a transformative journey filled with learning, growth, and invaluable experiences that will shape your perspective and personal and professional development. On top of that, you’ll also take part in some fascinating courses and events:

  • Introductory Global Summit: Experience 4 days at our global headquarters in Liechtenstein, featuring the presence of our Executive Board and Global Senior Leadership. The summit offers a comprehensive overview of our business, while fostering soft skill development and meaningful collaboration with fellow program participants.
  • Social Project Summit: 7 days dedicated to building a better future, with contribution to a hands-on, high-impact community project. This experience offers the chance to immerse yourself in a different culture while actively improving living conditions for those in need.
  • Leadership Summit: An enriching learning journey in partnership with a renowned business school, featuring online modules and collaborative projects with fellow program participants. The experience concludes with a 5-day on-campus summit to deepen insights and to foster business and leadership skills.

Why Hilti

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

Learn more about our recruitment process: https://careers.hilti.group/en/candidate-interview-preparation/

Commitment to Inclusion

​​At Hilti, inclusion is a key focus in how we work, lead, and grow together. We are committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an environment that is inclusive of everyone, everywhere. We continuously strive to ensure every voice is valued and every team member feels empowered to contribute. By building on this foundation, we strengthen our teams, our innovation, and our impact, making construction better together.

​Exciting software journey: You will dive into the fast-paced world of our construction software business, gaining exposure to innovative digital solutions that are transforming one of the world's largest industries.
​
​Global cross-team collaboration: You will work with colleagues worldwide and get guidance from a dedicated mentor as you grow in your career.

​We hire for a career, not for a position. If you are looking for long-term career prospects and opportunities to grow, this is the perfect start.​

​Are you ready to jumpstart your career? Our hiring process is designed to help you showcase your skills and experience. The process has multiple steps and requires a longer period of time:

  • It all starts with your application and a video interview.
  • Get connected with our HR team in an online interview.
  • Get ready to flex your problem-solving muscles with our online Business Case Round.
  • Impress our Business Line Managers with your presentation skills and insights during the next round.
  • And, if you make it to the end, you'll receive an invitation to our Assessment Center.

​Exciting, right? Let's get started!

4PS is part of the Hilti Group, which gives our people access to international opportunities and development programs within the wider Hilti organization. This vacancy is part of Hilti’s Global Trainee Program. Interested in joining the program? Please submit your application directly via Hilti Careerpage.

​The Assessment Center will take place in Liechtenstein at Hilti Headquarter on December 1st and 2nd, 2026. Applications will be reviewed in the order they’re received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible since there are limited spots for the Assessment Center!​

Learn more about our recruitment process:

Candidate Interview Preparation

​​For further questions, please feel free to contact Vanessa Furtner ----- and (My LinkedIn).
​
*For non-EU / EFTA citizens: Please state your eligibility status to work in EU or UK countries and note that if you do not own a valid work permit, Hilti cannot guarantee your final employment due to authority regulations.​
