title: Head of Compliance
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania or the FNTT.

  • Knowledge of Lithuanian AML law and Bank of Lithuania instructions.

  • Experience with clients across several EEA countries.

  • CAMS (ACAMS) or ICA certification.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • People who copy policies from templates without fitting them to the business.

  • People who say no without offering a compliant way forward.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Head Of Data Protection & DPO
descriptionHtml:
💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book,which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe, our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.

We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.


The Opportunity:

We're on a journey to steward AI into the NHS safely and responsibly. We've already deployed ambient voice technology to write up consultations, released our first AI triage products to help practices read and route hundreds of patient requests a day, and we're now working on deploying agents in healthcare settings.

The next few years will define how AI is used with patient data in the NHS. As Head of Data Protection and our in-house DPO, you'll help set that standard nationally: building the frameworks that let us move quickly and safely, and earning the trust of the patients, clinicians and organisations who rely on us.

This role is about building and shaping, not just running. You'll own data protection at Accurx end to end: the strategy, the statutory role, the team and the calls. You'll be a key leader in our Technology division, working as a trusted partner to our Chief Product Officer and Head of Legal.

Challenges you'll solve...

  • Steward AI into the NHS: set Accurx's positions on how we build, deploy and monitor AI products at scale, from controllership and assistive vs automated, to retention of AI inputs and outputs, sub-processors and model hosting, without ever undermining the trust we've built with our users

  • Set guardrails, not gates: define clear guardrails so product teams can move fast inside them without asking permission each time, and make our positions public and credible so NHS DPOs can rely on them rather than starting from scratch

  • Bring privacy into product design: work with product, design and engineering to embed privacy by design. Much of what we're building hasn't been seen in the health system before, so you'll need to be unapologetically forward-looking and comfortable taking informed, calculated risks

  • Turn decisions into reusable patterns: with our in-house privacy team, build governance templates, pre-approved data flows and plain-English privacy notice wording that healthcare organisations can pick up and use, and shape how we responsibly use our data to improve products and patient outcomes

  • Hold the statutory DPO role with independence: inform, advise and monitor compliance under UK GDPR, including our record of processing, DPIAs, training and audits. You'll be our named contact for the ICO, NHS customers and data subjects, and lead testing, breach assessment and reporting

  • Run corporate privacy: own our core privacy obligations and registrations, keep the evidence current for regulators, customers and bids, lead privacy due diligence on suppliers, partners and corporate transactions, and oversee how we handle employee and corporate data as well as patient data

  • Build a function that moves at product speed: lead and grow a small, bar-raising privacy and data function, and make it easy for 200+ colleagues to get fast, consistent answers to privacy questions

You should apply if...

  • You're product-minded about privacy: you've worked inside a product company and helped ship things, finding an approach that's both more private and better for the user. You've guided technology organisations through responsible innovation, especially where AI/ML meets sensitive data

  • You're AI-fluent with deep UK data protection expertise: you apply UK GDPR, the Data Protection Act 2018, the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and the common law duty of confidentiality in practice, understand how modern AI systems actually handle data, and have a view on ICO AI guidance and where regulation is heading

  • You've built and led privacy teams: you grow capability, bring your team into decisions, delegate real ownership and build trust across functions

  • You're confident externally: you can represent the business to regulators, NHS organisations and partners, and communicate complex positions clearly

  • You know health and the NHS, or have a fast route to it: controller and processor roles in primary care, DSPT, DTAC, the Caldicott Principles and the national data opt-out. You learn the NHS by going to see it

  • You challenge the status quo: you stay ahead of changes in digital health, AI and data ethics, and see privacy as something that enables the business to move at pace

What’s in it for you?

You’ll join a high-performing team on a mission to solve healthcare productivity, building a platform used by around 300k NHS staff every week, supporting the care of over 50 million NHS patients every year. We set a high bar, move fast, and give people the ownership and support to do the best work of their careers

  • £110,000 - £140,000 salary, plus a discretionary recognition bonus for exceptional performance and impact, nominated by managers and awarded by our leadership team

  • Equity: £100,000 in equal share options, so you share in the value you help create

  • Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life

  • Built for collaboration: We are an office-first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office for a minimum of 3 days a week

  • Close to our users: Regular hackathons, plus dedicated time to visit GP practices and other healthcare settings to see first-hand how our products are used

  • Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

  • Support at home: We offer enhanced parental leave, fertility support and parental loss support

  • We have our very own chefs: Free healthy breakfasts, snacks and lunches, plus a weekly sweet treat

Compensation: £110K – £140K • Offers Equity

title: Head of E-commerce
descriptionHtml:
On réinvente l'imperméable. Pour de vrai.

On crée des imperméables colorés, modulables et fabriqués à partir de tissus recyclés. Pas pour faire comme tout le monde, mais pour donner enfin envie de porter un imperméable.

Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une vingtaine, avec un modèle multicanal : un réseau retail en plein développement, un e-commerce qui fonctionne bien et un B2B qui accélère.

Et surtout, on a encore beaucoup de choses à construire et de barrières à faire tomber.

C'est là que tu entres en action.

Le poste

On cherche quelqu'un qui a déjà scalé un e-commerce dans la mode — et qui a envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à dire.

Pas un manager qui supervise. Pas un consultant qui conseille. Un(e) Head of E-commerce qui exécute, qui teste, qui itère, et qui vient chercher le résultat lui-même. Tu travailles en direct avec le fondateur, sans couche intermédiaire, sans réunion de validation à n'en plus finir.

Tu prends le lead sur l'e-commerce de A à Z — et le site, c'est ton produit. Pas un outil qu'on subit, pas un chantier qu'on repousse : quelque chose qu'on améliore en continu, avec méthode, avec des données, et avec l'obsession que chaque visiteur devienne client.

Tu comprends que dans la mode, performance et image de marque ne s'opposent pas — ils se construisent ensemble, sur le long terme. Tu sais qu'une bonne décision d'acquisition peut abîmer une marque, et qu'une marque forte réduit le coût d'acquisition. C'est exactement ce qu'on veut construire chez Flotte.

Si tu cherches un poste où on te demande de « définir uniquement la vision », ce n'est pas ce poste. Si tu cherches un endroit où tu construis quelque chose qui compte, avec quelqu'un prêt à aller vite et à prendre des risques calculés — bienvenue.

Vos missions

Tes responsabilités concrètes

Le site, c'est ton produit

  • Tu « owns » le site de A à Z — pas juste sa performance marketing, mais son expérience, son évolution, sa roadmap
  • Tu priorises les développements avec notre prestataire tech : ce qui sort, dans quel ordre, pourquoi
  • Tu A/B testes en continu — pas une fois par trimestre, mais comme réflexe de travail
  • Tu détectes les points de friction avant que les clients se plaignent
  • Chaque page, chaque étape du tunnel a une raison d'être et un indicateur qui le prouve

Performance & acquisition

  • Piloter et optimiser les campagnes Meta / Google / TikTok (et challenge l'agence qui s'en charge)
  • Construire une stratégie d'acquisition rentable, cohérente avec l'image de marque — pas juste du volume à tout prix
  • Gérer la saisonnalité mode : anticiper les pics, optimiser les périodes creuses, ne jamais sacrifier l'image pour remplir un objectif court terme
  • Déployer un vrai tracking et ne plus naviguer à vue

CRM & retention

  • Structurer la base client, segmenter, personnaliser
  • Email, SMS, automation — construire des flows qui transforment les acheteurs en fans
  • LTV : la faire grimper

Vision 360 & cohérence omnicanale

  • Assurer la cohérence de l'expérience digitale sur tous les canaux : e-commerce, retail, B2B
  • Apporter un regard digital sur la stratégie B2B portée par l'équipe dédiée — sans empiéter sur leur terrain
  • Garantir que le site et les outils digitaux servent l'ensemble des canaux, pas seulement le DTC
  • Être le garant d'une image de marque cohérente quel que soit le point de contact

Développement international

  • Identifier et prioriser les marchés européens à fort potentiel pour Flotte (UK, Benelux, DACH, Nordics...)
  • Définir la stratégie de pénétration marché par marché : positionnement, canaux, pricing, timing
  • Travailler en binôme avec le pôle marketing & communication pour adapter l'image de marque aux marchés cibles sans en diluer l'ADN
  • Tester, mesurer, ajuster — pas de grand plan sur 3 ans, mais une approche structurée et itérative
  • Piloter les partenariats locaux (distributeurs, revendeurs, marketplaces) quand c'est le bon levier

Pilotage

  • Définir les bons KPIs, les suivre, les challenger
  • Être force de proposition sur le budget, les outils, la stack tech
  • Recruter et structurer une petite équipe quand on est prêts

Vos compétences

Le profil qu'on cherche vraiment

Tu as déjà fait le chemin dans la mode — et tu as envie de recommencer avec une marque qui a quelque chose à prouver.

Tu connais les contraintes du prêt-à-porter : les collections qui se succèdent, les stocks à piloter, la saisonnalité qui dicte le calendrier marketing, et la pression permanente de défendre une image de marque tout en délivrant de la performance. Tu sais qu'on ne construit pas une marque mode comme on scale un pure player généraliste. Et tu crois qu'on peut faire les deux.

  • 5 ansd'expérience en e-commerce, obligatoirement dans la mode ou le prêt-à-porter, avec au moins une expérience de scale probante — et des chiffres à l'appui
  • Tu ne sacrifies pas l'image de marque sur l'autel du ROAS — tu sais que la désirabilité d'une marque mode se construit sur le long terme et se détruit très vite
  • Une vision long terme : construire une marque qui dure, pas juste optimiser une saison
  • Un profil entrepreneur dans l'âme : tu penses business autant que tu penses acquisition, tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire
  • Tu maîtrises Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Ads, un outil CRM (Klaviyo ou équivalent)
  • Tu exécutes — la stratégie c'est bien, mais sans exécution ça ne vaut rien
  • Tu es à l'aise pour travailler en direct avec un fondateur exigeant, sans filtre, avec franchise et sans ego
  • Anglais courant obligatoire.

Avantages

Ce qu'on t'offre

Une marque à construire, pas à gérer.

Chez Flotte, tu n'arrives pas dans une structure figée avec des process à respecter. Tu arrives dans une équipe qui construit encore — et qui cherche quelqu'un pour accélérer. Tu as un accès direct au fondateur, une vraie autonomie, et un impact qui se mesure.

On est convaincus qu'on peut devenir la référence de l'imperméable en France, puis en Europe. Ce poste, c'est le poste de quelqu'un qui veut être là quand ça arrive — pas juste le regarder de loin.

  • Rôle de direction dans une PME en croissance avec une vraie ambition de scale
  • Package attractif selon profil + variable sur objectifs
  • Une culture friendly, colorée, qui ne se prend pas au sérieux — mais qui prend ses résultats très au sérieux

Envoie-nous un message court avec ce que tu ferais en priorité si tu arrivais chez Flotte demain matin, et ce que tu as déjà construit dans la mode.

title: Head of Implementation
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

We're not your average benefits platform – we're the driving force that uplifts people's lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Head of Implementation, you will build the foundations that let implementation scale: the operating model, the process and the standards we need to grow well beyond where we are today. Enterprise implementation is slow and manual almost everywhere, so you will rebuild ours around agents, which almost no delivery leader gets the chance to do on live enterprise builds. Through all of it, you own how our largest customers experience Ben, from the enterprise sales conversation through to a confident go-live.

Things you will be working on

  • Transform how we implement enterprise customers: today we deliver well on the strength of the people doing it, and that ceiling is now the thing holding us back. Rebuild the operating model, the standards and the reusable components so we can take on far more without adding a person for every customer, and collapse the time it takes a customer to reach value.

  • Make implementation AI-native: our builds are technically complex (integrations, eligibility logic, huge volumes of data). Decide what agents can genuinely own, where humans stay in the loop, then rebuild delivery around that. We expect a function where your team's time goes on judgement and relationships while the repeatable work runs itself.

  • Own the ARR we launch: every pound of new revenue goes live through your team. Builds land on the date we promised, at a standard the customer never has to think about, from the first enterprise conversation through to go-live.

  • Open up partner-led delivery: as our partner operation grows, partners will implement alongside us. Set the standards, the enablement and the oversight that make a partner-led build hold the same bar as one of ours.

  • Be the person customers trust when it matters: when a build gets difficult, you are in the room. Hold the relationship with the executive sponsor, make the tough decisions, and see it through.

  • Lead the team through the change: you will lead 8 to 10 Implementation Managers through a transformation of how they work. Bring them with you, develop the people already leading within the team, and build the bench that lets this function keep growing.

  • Make the wider business faster because of you: partner with commercial, customer and product leaders so the journey joins up before, during and after a build, and so what your team learns changes what we sell and what we build.


You will love this role if you have...

  • Built an implementation function: you have scaled a delivery, implementation or professional services function in a scaling B2B SaaS company, including the operating model, the standards and the process. You can show what changed because of it: time to go-live, delivery quality, how many customers a team could carry.

  • Built and led teams: you have hired, developed and retained delivery people, including people who lead others. You can name individuals who are measurably better for having worked with you, and you have handled the harder conversations as well as the good ones.

  • Technical credibility: you hold your own on integrations, APIs, data mapping and configuration logic on a technical product. You can tell when a technical answer does not add up, and you know which calls are yours to make and which belong with your team.

  • Taken a team through an AI shift: you have changed how a delivery organisation works using AI, decided what machines own and what people own, and carried the team and your customers through that change. You have a view on what implementation looks like when agents handle the repeatable work, and the conviction to argue for it and resource it.

  • Carried a commercial number: revenue going live, delivery margin, retention in the accounts you launched. You are at home in enterprise sales conversations, setting scope and timelines in front of a customer that you are then held to.

Nice-to-haves

  • Benefits, HR or payroll: or another domain where the data volumes and the compliance rules both bite, and a mistake shows up in someone's pay.

  • A technical background: solutions engineering, pre-sales or technical support alongside implementation.

  • Partner or channel delivery: you have set up professional services or delivery partners to implement on your behalf, and held them to your own quality bar.

Why join us?

  • The remit is genuinely yours: implementation at Ben has a strong foundation and no fixed ceiling. You get to decide what this function becomes.

  • The work is properly complex: global enterprise customers, real integration and data depth, and benefits logic that changes by country. Every build asks something new of the team.

  • An AI-native function, built for real: we're an AI-native company, so a plan to rebuild delivery around agents gets resourced here. Very few delivery leaders get to run that experiment on live enterprise customers.

  • Implementation has a seat at the table: what your team learns shapes the product roadmap, and you'll have the access to make that happen.

  • The outcome is visible: our customers include large enterprise brands like BA, EY, Mondelez and Octopus Energy. The quality of your team's work is felt by hundreds of thousands of people every day.


Our Compensation & Benefits

title: Head of India
descriptionHtml:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

title: Head of IT
descriptionHtml:
Unternehmen

Die PolymerCycle Gruppe ist ein integriertes Kunststoffrecycling-Unternehmen und vereint die Best Plastic Management GmbH, PB Solutions GmbH, ATP Service & Consulting GmbH und Hoffmann+Voss GmbH. Gemeinsam machen wir aus Kunststoffabfällen hochwertige Rezyklate, die Neuware in anspruchsvollen Anwendungen ersetzen – etwa in der Automobil-, Elektro- oder Verpackungsindustrie.

Dabei decken unsere Gesellschaften jeden Schritt des Recyclingkreislaufs ab: vom Handel mit Sekundärrohstoffen und PCR-/PIR-Stoffströmen über die Trennung komplexer Kunststoffgemische mit innovativen Dichtetrennverfahren und die Regranulierung in großen Mengen bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Recompounds für technische Kunststoffe.

descriptionHtml:

About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


About the role

As Head of Platform Foundations, you’ll own the core foundations every Kaluza engineer and client builds on: the internal platform, production reliability, release pipelines and AI tooling. You’ll lead four teams (Platform Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Release Engineering, and AI & Enablement Engineering) through your engineering managers. The platform runs Kaluza Retail, Energy Optimisation and Customer Care across dedicated client instances in the UK, Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Your mission is to make Kaluza scale reliably, with more clients, markets and meters without a matching rise in cost or operational load. You’ll also turn our early gains from AI-assisted engineering into how the whole technology organisation works. (The data platform sits outside this role, though you’ll own the AWS accounts it runs in.)


What you’ll do

  • Set the multi-year platform strategy and roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, so platform investment follows client and commercial priorities

  • Make Kaluza scale repeatably at falling marginal cost, delivering new client instances, mass meter migrations and new markets

  • Lead Kaluza’s AI transformation in engineering, embedding tooling, agents and guardrails into the development lifecycle, measuring the impact, and partnering with Product on the AI capabilities we offer clients

  • Make reliability a feature clients trust, through SLOs, incident response and continuous improvement across all client instances

  • Own how software ships at Kaluza, with CI/CD and progressive-delivery practices that let teams deliver safely and often, using frameworks such as DORA to measure and improve velocity

  • Own cloud unit economics and FinOps, making investment and savings recommendations to the technology budget, and manage strategic partners including AWS and Datadog

  • Lead, mentor and grow a UK-based team with a global remit, building a culture of engineering excellence and developing the next layer of leaders, while working with Security and IAM to build in compliance (ISO 27001 / 22301) and data residency


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Proven experience in a senior leadership role running an organisation’s Platform function, with a track record of hiring, mentoring and scaling high-performing platform and SRE teams through engineering managers

  • Experience developing and delivering a multi-year platform strategy and roadmap with product counterparts

  • Hands-on experience implementing AI tooling across an engineering organisation and measurably changing how it builds software, not just piloting it

  • A track record of running production reliability at scale (SLOs, incident management, on-call) for a multi-tenant or multi-instance SaaS platform, with a strong grounding in modern cloud-native architecture (AWS preferred)

  • Experience owning cloud unit economics and making the investment case to Finance, plus strong partner management with technology vendors

  • Exceptional stakeholder management, including presenting platform strategy, risk and investment cases to executive leaders. Experience with DORA, internal developer platforms or platform-as-a-product thinking, regulated or data-sovereignty-sensitive markets (energy, utilities, financial services), or running a platform for external clients is a bonus


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

Come as you are

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, you will lead a multidisciplinary organisation of around 20 engineers, and growing, spanning electrical systems architecture, airborne electronics, airborne software, cell technology, high-voltage electrical systems, mechanical design and integration, and thermal management. You will set the technical direction, build the organisation and its development processes, and take the propulsion battery system from concept through development, qualification and certification to production readiness.

You will also own the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system, represent VÆRIDION on technical matters towards authorities, industrial partners and funding bodies, and contribute your expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Hold overall technical accountability for the propulsion battery system across its full lifecycle, from concept and architecture through development, validation & verification, qualification and certification to entry into service.

  • Define and maintain the propulsion battery system architecture together with the Electrical Systems Architect, ensuring that requirements are correctly allocated, interfaces are controlled, and trade-offs between safety, mass, energy, power, cost and certifiability are made deliberately and documented.

  • Lead, develop and scale the Energy Storage System department, comprising the Airborne Electronics, Airborne Software, Cell Technology, HV Electrical Systems, Mechanical Design & Integration and Thermal Management teams.

  • Recruit, coach and develop team leads and engineers, define clear roles and responsibilities, and align resourcing and hiring plans with the needs of the Microliner programme.

  • Take ownership of key technical decisions, chair design and gate reviews, and escalate programme-level technical risks to the CTO with clear options and recommendations.

  • Own the safety-driven design of the propulsion battery system, including thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and fault tolerance, and work closely with Safety and Systems Engineering on FHA, PSSA, SSA and common-cause analyses.

  • Establish and maintain development processes in line with ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, ensuring traceability, configuration control and verification evidence appropriate to the allocated Design Assurance Levels.

  • Shape the certification approach for the propulsion battery system in cooperation with Certification and Airworthiness and represent the ESS team in technical discussions with EASA, including Stage of Involvement (SOI) and compliance reviews.

  • Own the integration of the propulsion battery system with the aircraft, the electric propulsion system and the charging and ground infrastructure, including the definition and control of all associated interface requirements.

  • Develop and execute the intellectual property strategy for the propulsion battery system: identify patentable innovations, lead invention disclosures and work with patent counsel on filings, freedom-to-operate assessments and prior-art reviews.

  • Own the PBS department budget, including planning, forecasting and cost control for personnel, hardware, test campaigns and external services.

  • Select and manage key technology suppliers and partners, including cell suppliers, electronics manufacturing partners and suppliers of materials and components, ensuring technical performance, quality and security of supply.

  • Define and oversee the propulsion battery system test strategy, from component and subsystem testing through system-level, environmental, abuse and certification testing, together with the required laboratory and test infrastructure.

  • Prepare the transition from development to series production together with Manufacturing, Quality and Supply Chain, applying design-for-manufacture, design-for-assembly and design-for-test principles.

  • Represent VÆRIDION on technology matters towards authorities, industrial partners, research institutions and funding bodies, and support the preparation and execution of publicly funded research and development projects.

  • Contribute technical expertise to other key technologies of the Microliner and the company’s long-term technology roadmap.

  • Foster an engineering culture defined by technical rigour, accountability, open communication and continuous improvement.

 

Your Profile:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Automotive, Electrochemistry or a related discipline.

  • 15 or more years of professional experience developing complex, safety-critical systems, including at least five years leading multidisciplinary engineering teams.

  • Proven experience developing high-voltage battery systems for aerospace or automotive applications, from concept through qualification and production.

  • Sound technical understanding of lithium-ion cell technology, battery management systems, high-voltage electrical systems, thermal management and the mechanical integration of battery packs, with the ability to make well-founded decisions across these disciplines.

  • Experience with thermal-runaway containment, high-voltage safety and functional safety concepts for battery systems.

  • Practical experience with aerospace development and certification standards, including ARP4754A/B, ARP4761/ARP4761A, DO-254, DO-178C, DO-160G and DO-311A, is strongly preferred. Familiarity with CS-23 certification is advantageous.

  • A track record of building and scaling engineering organisations, including recruitment, development of team leads and the introduction of structured development processes.

  • Experience with budget responsibility, supplier selection and the management of strategic technology partners.

  • Experience generating and protecting intellectual property, including invention disclosures and collaboration with patent counsel.

  • Experience representing technical programmes towards authorities, partners, funding bodies and other external stakeholders.

  • The ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly to engineers, executive management and external stakeholders.

  • A structured, decisive and hands-on leadership style, with the ability to perform in a fast-paced start-up environment.

  • Fluent English-language skills are essential; German-language skills are beneficial.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Head of Sales – France & International
descriptionHtml:
À propos de Galénic

Fondée en 1978 par Pierre Fabre, Galénic est une Maison française de skincare scientifique qui associe excellence de la recherche, innovation et savoir-faire du luxe français.

Portée par son centre d'innovation scientifique à Toulouse et par l'ouverture de la Maison Galénic Paris, à quelques pas de la Place Vendôme, la marque entre dans une nouvelle phase de développement.

Notre ambition est de construire un modèle de distribution sélectif, international et omnicanal, conjuguant e-commerce, retail expérientiel, distributeurs premium et partenariats stratégiques.

Pour accompagner cette transformation, nous recrutons notre futur Head of Sales & Retail– Europe & International.

Votre mission

Rattaché(e) directement à la Direction Générale, vous aurez la responsabilité de construire, piloter et accélérer le développement commercial de Galénic en Europe et sur ses marchés internationaux prioritaires.

Vous serez responsable de la performance commerciale, de la croissance du chiffre d'affaires et de la rentabilité de nos différents canaux de distribution.

Vous interviendrez à la fois sur la définition des stratégies commerciales, leur exécution opérationnelle et la structuration progressive des équipes.

Votre objectif : transformer l'ambition internationale de Galénic en un business durable, rentable et scalable.

Vos responsabilités

  1. Piloter la stratégie et la performance commerciale

  • Construire et déployer la stratégie commerciale à trois ans, en cohérence avec les ambitions de la marque.

  • Définir les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires, de rentabilité et de développement pour chaque canal.

  • Piloter les budgets commerciaux, business plans, forecasts et P&L par canal.

  • Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés : Net Sales, marge, productivité, conversion, sell-in et sell-out.

  • Identifier les opportunités de croissance et optimiser les investissements commerciaux.

2. Accélérer le développement du e-commerce DTC

  • Piloter la performance commerciale du e-commerce en collaboration avec les équipes Digital et Marketing.

  • Développer le chiffre d'affaires, le taux de conversion, le panier moyen et la fidélisation client.

  • Suivre la rentabilité du canal, les coûts d'acquisition et la contribution commerciale des investissements marketing.

  • Développer une approche commerciale fondée sur la connaissance client, les données et la performance.

3. Développer la performance de la Maison Galénic Paris

  • Accompagner le développement commercial de notre Maison, véritable flagship expérientiel de la marque.

  • Piloter les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires des soins et des ventes retail.

  • Optimiser les réservations, le taux d'occupation des cabines, la conversion post-soin et la productivité commerciale.

  • Accompagner les équipes opérationnelles dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs, tout en préservant l'excellence de l'expérience client.

4. Construire et développer notre réseau de distribution international

  • Définir et déployer les plans de développement commercial sur les marchés prioritaires

  • Identifier, sélectionner et négocier avec les distributeurs et partenaires locaux.

  • Construire les business plans par marché : objectifs commerciaux, conditions de distribution, investissements, marges et rentabilité.

  • Piloter les relations avec les partenaires, leurs engagements commerciaux et leurs performances.

  • Accompagner les lancements et le développement progressif de nouveaux marchés.

5. Développer les partenariats stratégiques

  • Structurer un réseau sélectif de partenaires auprès des hôtels de luxe, palaces, spas, cliniques esthétiques, clubs privés et acteurs du luxe.

  • Identifier et développer les opportunités commerciales à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Construire des modèles de partenariat rentables et pérennes.

  • Piloter la contribution de ces partenariats au développement commercial et à la visibilité de Galénic.

6. Construire et animer l'organisation commerciale

  • Structurer progressivement les équipes commerciales, en fonction du développement de l'activité.

  • Manager et accompagner les responsables opérationnels et commerciaux.

  • Développer une culture de performance, de responsabilité et d'excellence commerciale.

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Global & Regional Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain et les partenaires internationaux.

Profil recherché

  • 10 à 15 ans dans la beauté, dont une expérience significative en distribution internationale et une exposition réelle au e-commerce et au retail.

  • Expérience confirmée de direction commerciale ou de business development senior dans l'univers du skincare premium, de la beauté sélective ou du luxe.

  • Expérience significative du développement international, notamment à travers des réseaux de distributeurs.

  • Très bonne compréhension des enjeux du e-commerce DTC et de la distribution physique premium.

  • Expérience dans la construction et le pilotage de business plans, budgets et P&L.

  • Capacité démontrée à développer de nouveaux marchés, négocier des accords commerciaux et structurer des équipes.

  • Forte sensibilité à l'univers du luxe, à l'expérience client et à la valeur de marque.

  • Profil entrepreneurial, pragmatique, autonome et orienté résultats.

  • Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement international, interculturel et en transformation.

  • Anglais courant indispensable.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un rôle stratégique au cœur de la transformation et du développement international d'une Maison française de skincare scientifique.

  • L'opportunité de construire une organisation commerciale multicanale, avec une véritable responsabilité sur la croissance et la rentabilité.

  • Une collaboration directe avec la Direction Générale et la Direction Marketing

  • Un environnement entrepreneurial combinant héritage français, innovation scientifique et ambition internationale.

  • Une rémunération attractive.

Localisation : Paris, avec déplacements à l'international.

Rattachement : Direction Générale Galénic Europe.

title: Head of SEO & AI Search (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Wir begeistern und inspirieren Millionen von Menschen! Als innovativer Hybrid aus Social Media Publisher und Social Media Agentur vereint das VS Mediahouse einzigartige Expertise in den Bereichen Content-Kreation, Markenaufbau und Performance-Marketing. Mit einem Team von über 50 Experten in Social Media, Design und Videoproduktion betreiben wir die beliebtesten Social-Media-Marken Deutschlands auf Facebook, Instagram und TikTok. Zu unseren Erfolgsmarken zählen unter anderem VS, Lieblingskollegen und Lieblingsmensch®. Unser tiefes Verständnis für die Dynamik von Social Media und unser Publishing-Know-how ermöglichen es uns, Marken wie Samsung, Schwartau, Bayer und Lexware im Bereich Social Media nachhaltig erfolgreich zu machen. Wir schaffen Verbindungen, erzählen Geschichten und setzen Trends – für echte Wirkung und messbaren Erfolg.

Deine Mission

Du beherrschst klassisches SEO in der Tiefe, mit mehrjähriger Senior-Erfahrung. Gleichzeitig ist dir klar: Kaum noch jemand sucht heute komplett ohne KI, sei es über ChatGPT, Gemini oder AI Overviews. Diesen Wandel willst du nicht nur beobachten, sondern aktiv gestalten. Klar ist dabei: Ohne solides SEO-Fundament funktioniert auch die beste GEO-Strategie nicht, deshalb bringst du beides mit.

Als Head of SEO & AI Search verantwortest du unseren SEO-Bereich strategisch, operativ und wirtschaftlich. Im Zentrum deiner Rolle stehen von Beginn an unsere größten und strategisch wichtigsten Bestandskunden: Hier baust du die SEO- und AI-Search-Strategie neu und mit voller Verantwortung auf Senior-Ebene auf, im direkten Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung des Kunden. Perspektivisch entwickelst du von dort aus den SEO-Bereich für weitere Kunden im Haus.

KI spielt dabei eine doppelte Rolle: erstens als Zielsystem, du machst Kunden auch in KI-gestützten Suchsystemen sichtbar. Zweitens als Arbeitsweise, du nutzt KI selbst für Recherche, Analysen, Briefings und Reporting. Ein fertiges Technik-Portfolio brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger sind echte Neugier und Lust, dich reinzuhängen. Bei uns wirst du zum KI-Poweruser deines Fachbereichs.

Was erwartet dich

  • AI Search & Sichtbarkeit – der Kern der Rolle, kein Nebenschauplatz: Du entwickelst Strategien, damit Inhalte in Google AI Overviews, AI Mode, ChatGPT, Gemini und Perplexity auffindbar, verständlich und zitierfähig sind. Du denkst Inhalte für generative Systeme mit: klar beantwortbare Absätze, saubere Q&A-Strukturen, belastbares Schema-Markup, damit KI-Systeme Inhalte einordnen und zitieren können.
  • Sichtbarkeit messbar machen: Du entwickelst Testsets und Prompt-Sammlungen, um systematisch zu beobachten, wann und wie Marken, Produkte und Inhalte in KI-Antworten genannt werden – idealerweise mit AI-Visibility-Tools wie Peec, Otterly oder Profound.
  • Einordnung statt Hype: Du ordnest GEO und AEO fachlich ein, statt Hype hinterherzulaufen, und vermittelst ehrlich, wo es heute schon belastbare Ergebnisse gibt und wo noch nicht.
  • Dein Case: Verantwortung von Tag eins. Du übernimmst die strategische, operative und wirtschaftliche Führung des SEO- und AI-Search-Mandats für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden, von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle. Du baust eine SEO- und GEO-Roadmap auf, die es in dieser Form bislang nicht gab, und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung.
  • Beratung auf Augenhöhe: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung des Kunden souverän in Workshops, Audits und Reviews.


Dein Alltag: KI als deine tägliche Arbeitsweise

Hier geht es nicht um die Arbeit für Kunden, sondern um deinen eigenen Alltag: Viele wiederkehrende Aufgaben erledigst du bei uns spürbar schneller, weil du KI dafür einsetzt – kein Kür-Thema, sondern Standard. Zum Beispiel:

  • Keyword-Clustering und Content-Gap-Analysen per KI vorbereiten, statt sie komplett von Hand zu erstellen.
  • Erste Content-Briefings und Gliederungsentwürfe mit KI entwerfen.
  • Crawl- und Search-Console-Daten von KI vorauswerten, bevor du selbst tief einsteigst.
  • Wiederkehrende Reports automatisieren, statt sie jede Woche neu zusammenzuklicken.
  • Die Qualitätskontrolle bleibt trotzdem bei dir: KI-Ergebnisse werden von dir eingeordnet und geprüft, nicht blind übernommen.


Was solltest du mitbringen

  • Bei SEO erwarten wir echte Tiefe. Bei KI muss es kein Fachwissen oder Abschluss sein, aber komplett bei null solltest du auch nicht stehen. Die technischen Hürden legen wir bewusst niedrig, ein bisschen eigene Praxis braucht es trotzdem.
  • Mehrjährige SEO- und AI-Search-Erfahrung aus Agentur- oder vergleichbarer Unternehmensumgebung, mit nachweisbaren Ergebnissen. Ein bestimmter Studienabschluss ist für uns nicht entscheidend, wichtiger sind Tiefgang, Ergebnisse und Neugier.
  • Tiefgehende Kenntnisse in Technical SEO, Content SEO, Onpage- und Offpage-Optimierung.
  • Erfahrung mit ganzheitlichen SEO-Strategien und Roadmaps, die du für unterschiedliche Kunden von der Analyse bis zur Erfolgskontrolle steuerst – inklusive technischer Audits (Crawling, Indexierung, Core Web Vitals, strukturierte Daten), Relaunches und Migrationen.
  • Keyword-, Content- und Autoritätsstrategien, die echten Mehrwert statt reiner Keyword-Abdeckung liefern.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google Search Console, GA4, Sistrix, Semrush oder Ahrefs sowie Screaming Frog oder Sitebulb.
  • Ein Bewusstsein für den Wandel zu KI-gestützter Suche: GEO, AEO oder AI Visibility sind dir zumindest ein Begriff, und du willst dich darin vertiefen. Du hast bereits eigene Erfahrung mit KI-Tools gesammelt, und sei es nur privat (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity & Co.). Ein Zertifikat oder eine Ausbildung brauchst du dafür nicht, wichtiger ist Lust, das jetzt systematisch für deine SEO-Arbeit einzusetzen.
  • Denken in Leads, Conversions und Kundennutzen statt nur in Rankings, dazu eine eigenständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sicheres Englisch.


Warum VS Mediahouse

Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen möchten, Mut für neue Ideen haben und das Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten wollen. Wir legen großen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Neben unseren modernen Büros im Herzen von Freiburg erwarten dich ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen in einem hoch dynamischen und wachstumsstarken Umfeld. Freue dich auf vielseitige Aufgaben mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerischem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie eine moderne, sachorientierte Entscheidungskultur ohne unnötige Hierarchien. Wir bieten dir fachliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Freiraum für Innovationen, kurze Entscheidungswege und individuelles Management-Coaching.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Wähle zwischen einem kostenfreien Jobticket (Deutschlandticket) oder nutze unser attraktives JobRad-Angebot.
  • Um dich fit und gesund zu halten, subventionieren wir deine Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft.
  • Du findest bei uns modernste Ausstattung mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen sowie Macbook & iPhone (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und natürlich ist das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice auch für uns kein Fremdwort.
  • Für Zwischendurch bedienst du dich an unserem regionalen Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Getränke und vieles mehr.
  • Neben deinem persönlichen Corporate Benefits Zugang erhältst du 50% Rabatt auf unsere Produkte in unserem Shop.
  • Erweitere deine Rente durch die Teilnahme an der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge.
  • Abgerundet wird deine Zeit bei uns natürlich auch mit verschiedenen Team-Events und Feiern.


Klingt nach dir?

Wir suchen niemanden, der nur Rankings reportet, und genauso wenig einen reinen KI-Enthusiasten ohne SEO-Substanz. Sondern jemanden, der SEO in der Tiefe beherrscht, Lust hat, KI in den eigenen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren, und bereit ist, für einen unserer wichtigsten Kunden von Anfang an echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Technisches KI-Vorwissen ist zweitrangig, echte Motivation nicht.

Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Beschreibe uns stattdessen kurz zwei bis drei SEO-Projekte, für die du verantwortlich warst (Ausgangslage, deine Rolle, Ergebnis), und beantworte:

1. Wie nutzt du KI heute schon in deinem Alltag, und was reizt dich daran, KI-gestützte Suche zum Kernteil deiner Arbeit zu machen?

2. Wo hast du KI schon sinnvoll in einem SEO-Prozess eingesetzt? Falls noch nicht: Was würdest du als Erstes ausprobieren?

3. Wie misst du SEO-Erfolg, wenn Rankings und Klicks allein nicht mehr reichen?

Wenn du mehr über unsere Arbeitskultur und das Arbeitsumfeld erfahren möchtest, laden wir dich ein, die Bewertungen unserer Mitarbeiter auf Kununu zu lesen. Dort findest du ehrliche Meinungen und Feedback von aktuellen und ehemaligen Mitarbeitern.

title: Head of Strategic Accounts
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to lead the top tier of our commercial organisation — the largest, most complex accounts driving 9fin’s next phase of growth. Strategics is our top segment: a targeted book of our largest ARR accounts across the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms who set the standard for how credit intelligence is bought and used.

You’ll build and lead a team of ~5–6 senior relationship managers in London, each owning a small portfolio of strategic accounts in a hybrid Account Management and Enterprise Sales role. You’ll partner closely with our Head of Strategic Accounts, EMEA to run a globally coordinated segment and work with senior Customer Success partners at the account level.

This is a builder role for a leader who has personally carried a large number, sold enterprise-scale deals into financial services, and knows how to raise the bar on rigour, presence, and multi-year deal execution.

This role requires 3 days in our London office.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the EMEA Strategics team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter across a book of $13M+ ARR accounts.

  • Coach and manage a team of ~5–6 Strategic Account Managers covering our most important banks, asset managers, hedge funds, private equity firms, and law firms in EMEA.

  • Drive multi-year deal execution, lock in early renewals, and structure enterprise agreements that grow durably over time.

  • Coach the team through complex commercial motions — MSAs, procurement, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Run weekly segment reviews focused on deals moved, deals at risk, pipeline health, and account-level path-to-close plans.

  • Set the operating cadence for the segment. Enforce our 3-day office minimum, and drive territory planning, account mapping, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Partner with the EMEA Head of Strategic Accounts to build geographic reciprocity, with EMEA AMs backing up EMEA coverage on global accounts, and vice versa.

  • Work in a “two-in-the-box” model with senior CSMs (product and usage) and Sales Engineering (pre-sales), and partner across Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product to remove barriers to growth.

  • Be the senior voice of our strategic clients into Product and Engineering — translating segment-level themes across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit into a clear point of view on the roadmap.

  • Represent 9fin externally with the C-suite — at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences, and roundtables — and become a recognised name in EMEA debt markets.

  • Build the operating system for the Strategics segment — deal reviews, path-to-close proposals, territory planning, and account planning frameworks that scale.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 12+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, including 4+ years leading strategic or enterprise sales teams selling into financial services (banks, asset managers, hedge funds, PE firms), law firms, or a mix.

  • Have personally carried and consistently exceeded a large individual quota on multi-million-dollar strategic accounts, and can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Bring a consultative approach to selling and want to become a strategic partner to our clients

  • Have deep familiarity with capital markets, credit, or the debt markets ecosystem across credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed, and private credit — you can hold your own with a restructuring lawyer, a leveraged finance banker, or a credit PM.

  • Have led teams through multi-year deal execution and understand what it takes to secure meaningful year-over-year uplifts, early renewals, and complex enterprise agreements.

  • Can coach reps through complex procurement, MSA negotiation, legal review, and executive alignment at the MD, Partner, PM, Head of Desk, and C-suite level.

  • Bring C-suite presence and cross-organisational credibility. You show up sharp, prepared, and trusted by both your team and your customers.

  • Are a proactive coach, not a reactive manager. You share process, mentor your reps, and help them plan deals in advance rather than reacting to slipped forecasts.

  • Have run a disciplined operating cadence — weekly deal reviews, forecast rigour, territory and account planning, and a shared deal methodology across the team.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous, and can be a credible senior voice of your team’s clients into Product and Engineering.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organisation and can partner effectively with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing, and Product.

  • Set a high bar and lead through presence and standards rather than fear. You drive accountability without burning your team out.

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

Hybrid Policy

title: Health Solution Architect - CDI Paris - Theodo
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire de Theodo et son succès

Depuis 2009, Theodo conçoit, développe et déploie des produits digitaux ingénieux. Notre approche : le meilleur de la technologie, au service de la création de valeur, porté par l'approche Lean.

Notre approche unique est fondée sur 3 principes :

  • nous avons développé des expertises reconnues dans les technologies clés de la conception et du développement produit;
  • quelle que soit l’étape du projet, notre priorité à chaque décision est la création de valeur pour nos clients;
  • nous recrutons les meilleurs talents digitaux et cultivons leur ingéniosité grâce à l’approche lean.

En 15 ans, nous sommes devenus un groupe de plus de 700 Theodoers, organisé en entités spécialisées par technologie (Apps, Cloud, Data & AI) et par industrie (Fintech, Govtech, Healthtech, Consumer Products Goods). En 2025, le groupe génère 100M€ de CA.



Tes missions

La santé se digitalise. Les données de vie réelle explosent. Elles facilitent le soin et accélèrent la recherche, notamment via les entrepôts de données de santé.

Ces données sont extrêmement sensibles et réglementées. Nos clients ont donc besoin de notre expertise pour bâtir des applications sur des architectures Cloud conformes à la réglementation HDS. L'arrivée des LLM ajoute un défi : exposer ces données à des agents pour aider les soignants et les patients, sans jamais transiger sur la sécurité.

Dans notre équipe, tu travailleras sur des sujets concrets, au service du soin et de la recherche. Des projets utiles, pour des produits qui comptent.

Ton rôle : concevoir, convaincre et déployer

Ta mission est avant tout opérationnelle. Tu conçois, tu présentes et tu mets en place des architectures Cloud qui répondent aux besoins fonctionnels, de sécurité et de conformité de nos clients.

Concrètement :

  • Avant-vente : traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée, et convaincre le client que c’est la plus ingénieuse pour le projet.
  • Déploiement : infrastructure as code, de bout en bout.
  • Audit : conformité HDS et bonnes pratiques des standards Cloud.
  • Développement d’assets : agents, boilerplates, projets open source.

    • À plus long terme, nous voulons t’impliquer dans la structuration des offres et des équipes Theodo.

    Autonome sur ton expertise, fort en équipe

    Sur l'architecture Cloud, tu dois pouvoir être autonome. C'est ton domaine, tu le pilotes.

    Mais tu ne travailles jamais seul. En avant-vente, tu fais équipe avec l'Account Manager et le Solution Architect. En projet, tu collabores avec l'Engineering Manager et les autres DevOps. La collaboration est au centre de chaque mission.

    L'équipe que tu rejoins

    Theodo est certifié infogéreur HDS. Nous avons développé notre propre framework de mise en conformité, et assurons la maintenance HDS d'une vingtaine d'applications en production.

  • Ton manager : Ludovic Descateaux, Group Manager de Theodo Healthtech.
  • En avant-vente : un binôme Account Manager (ex. Marine Accolas) et Solution Architect.
  • En projet : un Engineering Manager (ex. Thomas Walter).
  • L'équipe Run HDS, riche de plus de 50 projets, t'épaule sur les architectures.
  • Tu participes aux guildes Sécu, DevOps, Agentique, et aux rituels hebdomadaires de formation.

    • Tes perspectives d'évolution (moyen / long terme)

  • Business : Partnership, avec la responsabilité d'une plateforme business et/ou d'une practice du groupe.
  • Managériale : Group Manager.

    • Profil recherché

    Expériences

  • 6 à 14 ans d'expérience.
  • Une expertise en infrastructure Cloud.
  • Une expérience en service (ESN ou conseil).
  • Nice to have : Une expérience dans la santé et des notions de réglementation HDS.

    • Compétences clés

  • Concevoir des architectures qui accélèrent le développement tout en respectant la réglementation.
  • Traduire un besoin en architecture adaptée aux contraintes du client.
  • Utiliser les agents LLM de façon structurée pour améliorer la qualité du code.
  • Présenter et convaincre sur la pertinence d'une solution.
  • Maîtriser Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes, ArgoCD et un cloud public (AWS / GCP / Azure / Scaleway).

    • Mots clés :

    Medtech, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, ISO 27001, MDR, Dispositif Medical, Health Data Hub,

    DevOps, Cloud, Terraform, AWS, GCP, Azure, OVH, Scaleway

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    L'environnement :

    💼 Un groupe de 700 personnes, avec de vraies possibilités d'évolution cross-entités. 🤝 Un coach interne dédié, avec des séances hebdomadaires sur ton quotidien et ta carrière. 🎯 Des projets associatifs via la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…). 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d'entreprise annuel.

title: Implementation Manager - Spend/ERP
descriptionHtml:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Merchant Services team partners with our clients to realise their full potential through the adoption of Airwallex products that drive their growth and success. Within Merchant Services, our Spend and card implementation specialists sit at the heart of how customers design, launch, and scale their global spend programmes on Airwallex.

We influence revenue growth across our Spend and issuing portfolio and collaborate with sales, strategy, product, and engineering teams to provide the best experience for our most valued customers. Our team works alongside commercial teams throughout the pre‑sales, solution design, and integration stages, then owns the orchestration from contract signature through go‑live and early adoption. We are committed to empowering businesses with the tools they need to run high‑performing, compliant, and scalable spend programmes across EMEA.

What you’ll do

As the Implementation Manager for our Spend Team, you will own the end‑to‑end delivery of complex Spend and corporate card implementations that bring our global spend management products to life for enterprise and high‑growth customers across EMEA. You will turn agreed business requirements and solution designs into actionable implementation plans, orchestrating cross‑functional teams and external stakeholders to deliver on time, on scope, and to a high quality bar.

You’ll sit at the intersection of Sales, Merchant Services, Solutions Engineering, Product, Operations, Risk and external partners (e.g. networks, processors, manufacturers), ensuring that every phase from pre‑sale through go‑live and early spend activation runs smoothly.

title: iOS Developer - AI Finance Agent
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for Doit's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What Will You Build

  • Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.

  • Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.

  • Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.

  • Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.

  • Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.

  • Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong native iOS experience using Swift.

  • Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.

  • Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.

  • Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.

  • Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

 

The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
