title: iOS Engineer - Design System
descriptionHtml:
About the team:

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns, empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

The Design System team works hand-in-hand with the Mobile Platform team to set standards and provide guidance across all product teams at SumUp. As we expand our ecosystem of merchant and consumer-facing products, this role offers a rare opportunity to shape the foundation that helps developers build faster and ship higher-quality experiences to millions of users worldwide.

What you'll do:

  • Shape the core experience for both users and developers interacting with SumUp's iOS ecosystem
  • Collaborate closely with product and design teams to build components that are maintainable, consistent, and beautiful
  • Embed accessibility best practices into every component — from content descriptions and touch target sizing to color contrast and dynamic type
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance to product teams to deliver on company priorities, including the upcoming support for landscape orientation
  • Review code contributions, enforce design system conventions, and mentor engineers on best practices for reusable UI development
  • Lead the migration of legacy UIKit-based components to SwiftUI while maintaining system stability
  • Proactively identify and address technical debt to uphold a high bar for engineering excellence and codebase health

You'll be a great fit for this role if you:

  • Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications
  • Are fluent in Swift, with deep hands-on knowledge of both SwiftUI and UIKit — and a clear view on when and how to use each
  • Bring experience building or contributing to a design system, component library, or shared UI framework, and understand what it takes to make components truly reusable and scalable
  • Take pride in crafting accessible user experiences — you know your way around VoiceOver, dynamic type, color contrast, and touch target standards, and treat accessibility as a first-class concern, not an afterthought
  • Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
  • Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
  • Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
  • Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

Why you should join SumUp:

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup
🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced
🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education
💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future
🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance
🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs
🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

We believe in the everyday hero.

Small business owners are at the heart of all we do, so we're creating tools that help them run their businesses. With a founder's mentality and a 'team-first' attitude, our diverse teams across Europe, South America and the United States work together to ensure that the small business owners we partner with can be successful doing what they love.

SumUp is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. SumUp does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. SumUp also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

SumUp will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

title: Storage IT Administrator (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Sind Sie es auch leid, ständig Angebote zu erhalten, die nicht auf Ihr Profil zutreffen? Möchten Sie stattdessen nicht lieber passgenaue Offerten erhalten, die Ihren Wünschen und Vorstellungen entsprechen? Wir hören Ihnen zu und begleiten Sie auf Ihrem Karriereweg – egal ob Berufseinsteiger oder erfahrener ITler. Von uns erhalten Sie nur lokale Angebote aus dem Großraum München.

Bei einer Vermittlung durch hubside helfen uns vor allem unsere durch langjährige Zusammenarbeit geprägten Kontakte zu renommierten Unternehmen, durch die wir Ihre Möglichkeiten vervielfachen und Ihnen sogar Zugang zu nicht öffentlichen Stellen gewähren können. hubside steht mit seinem Namen für ein Team von langjährig erfahrenen Beratern, das sich genau zwischen Kandidat und Unternehmen positioniert, um sowohl ein langfristiger Karrierebegleiter als auch vertrauensvoller Partner unserer Kundenunternehmen zu sein. Denn unsere Kandidaten sind der Schlüssel zum Erfolg unserer Kundenunternehmen und wir sind der Schlüssel zu deren beruflicher Verwirklichung. Dabei steht immer der Mensch im Mittelpunkt, wir sprechen in dem Zusammenhang und aufgrund unserer Expertise in der IT auch von der Formel Mensch hoch IT.

hubside ist die Recruitingwerkstatt für Fach- und Führungskräfte im Bereich IT. Von der IT Assistenz über den System Engineer bis hin zum Full Stack Developer besetzen wir Positionen in unseren drei strategischen Geschäftsfeldern, der Personalvermittlung, der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung und in der Vermittlung von freiberuflichen Experten. Wir besetzen den Handwerker der Zukunft!

In dieser Rolle als IT Enterprise Storage Administrator (m/w/d) betreust und optimierst Du komplexe Speicherinfrastrukturen und sorgst für eine zuverlässige Bereitstellung und Verwaltung geschäftskritischer Daten. Du integrierst Storage- und Backup-Technologien in bestehende Systemlandschaften und stellst deren reibungsloses Zusammenspiel mit Servern und Virtualisierungsumgebungen sicher. Darüber hinaus begleitest Du technische Modernisierungen und berätst bei infrastrukturellen Fragestellungen. Mit Deinem Know-how und Deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise trägst Du zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung moderner IT-Umgebungen bei.

Sie kennen jemanden, der auf die Stellenausschreibung passt? Dann holen Sie jetzt unseren Weiterempfehlungsbonus! Erkundigen Sie sich gleich telefonisch unter 089 9982966 46 bei mir.


Ihre Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreust leistungsfähige Speicherlösungen für unterschiedliche IT-Umgebungen und sorgst für einen zuverlässigen, effizienten Betrieb

  • Bei der Administration von NAS- und Filesystem-Architekturen kümmerst Du Dich um Themen wie NFS, SMB/CIFS, Snapshots, Berechtigungen, Quotas und Performance-Optimierung

  • Bestehende Speicher- und Backup-Systeme entwickelst Du weiter, begleitest Migrationen und integrierst neue Technologien in vorhandene Infrastrukturen

  • Als technischer Ansprechpartner unterstützt Du bei der Anbindung von Storage-Systemen an Linux- und Windows-Server, Virtualisierungsplattformen sowie Backup- und Recovery-Lösungen

  • Darüber hinaus wirkst Du an Infrastrukturprojekten mit, dokumentierst technische Konzepte und bewertest neue Technologien im Austausch mit Kunden und Fachbereichen


Ihr Profil

  • Mit Speicherprotokollen wie NFS, SMB/CIFS, iSCSI und Fibre Channel kennst Du Dich aus und verstehst die Anforderungen unterschiedlicher Storage-Architekturen

  • Eine IT-Ausbildung, ein entsprechendes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundiertem technischem Hintergrund bringst Du mit

  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, analysierst technische Herausforderungen systematisch und findest serviceorientierte Lösungen

  • Du verfügst über praktische Erfahrung mit Enterprise-Storage-Lösungen, beispielsweise von NetApp, Huawei, Dell oder Pure Storage

  • Erfahrung mit Linux- oder Windows-Servern sowie Virtualisierungslösungen wie VMware ESXi oder Proxmox ist ebenfalls vorhanden

  • Neue Technologien und fachliche Weiterentwicklung interessieren Dich, und Du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, Dein Know-how kontinuierlich auszubauen


Das Angebot

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten

  • Regelmäßige Weiterbildungen und individuelle Entwicklungsperspektiven

  • Innovative, dynamische und Knowhow starke Teams von Spezialisten

  • Outdoor-Lounge

  • Mitarbeiter-Events

  • 1000€ Bonus bei erfolgreicher Empfehlung!

title: IT-Generalist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei unserem Kunden handelt es sich um ein etabliertes Unternehmen, das seit rund 40 Jahren individuelle technische Schutz- und Einhausungslösungen für industrielle Anwendungen entwickelt und realisiert. Die Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichsten Industriebereichen und umfassen sowohl Anlagen- und Maschinenhersteller als auch Betreiber industrieller Produktionsstätten.

Das Unternehmen versteht sich als kompetenter Komplettanbieter und bietet seinen Kunden eine ganzheitliche Betreuung – von der individuellen Planung und Auslegung über die Fertigung und Lieferung bis hin zur fachgerechten Montage.

Dank der langjährigen Erfahrung, des umfassenden Know-hows und der internationalen Ausrichtung ist das Unternehmen weltweit tätig. Lieferung und Montage der modernen Lösungen erfolgen sowohl national als auch international.

Aufgaben

Deine Chance: Eine vielseitige IT-Position mit Perspektive und Gestaltungsspielraum

Für diese spannende Position suchen wir einen engagierten und vielseitigen IT-Generalisten (m/w/d), der technisches Know-how mit Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und einer positiven Grundeinstellung verbindet.

In dieser Funktion bist du interner Ansprechpartner für sämtliche IT-Themen und stellst den reibungslosen Betrieb sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der IT-Systeme und Infrastruktur sicher. Du kennst dich mit der Konfiguration, Betreuung und Administration von IT-Systemen aus und hast Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen, Lösungen zu entwickeln und pragmatisch umzusetzen.

Ein wichtiger Bestandteil deiner Aufgabe ist die enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem externen IT-Systemhaus. Dabei bist du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für technische Fragestellungen, sondern bringst dich aktiv in den Austausch ein: Du bewertest vorgeschlagene Lösungen, diskutierst technische Konzepte auf Augenhöhe und entscheidest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern, welche Maßnahmen sinnvoll und zielführend sind.

Dein langfristiges Entwicklungspotenzial: Die interne IT-Kompetenz und Eigenständigkeit kontinuierlich ausbauen. Daher wirst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung übernehmen und internes Know-how aufbauen, mit dem Ziel, bisher extern erbrachte IT-Leistungen zunehmend eigenständig abzudecken.

Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Betreuung, Konfiguration und Administration von IT-Systemen und IT-Infrastrukturen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse mit ERP Systemen

  • Ein breites technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, dich in unterschiedliche IT-Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Eine positive, offene und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Sicherheit, technische Themen mit externen Dienstleistern auf Augenhöhe zu besprechen

  • Die Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen zu bewerten, Prioritäten zu setzen und sinnvolle von weniger sinnvollen Lösungen zu unterscheiden

  • Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und den Wunsch, Dinge aktiv voranzubringen

Die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

Diese Position bietet Ihnen die Möglichkeit, aktiv und sinnvoll die IT-Landschaft mitzugestalten und dabei sichtbare Veränderungen zu bewirken. Sie treffen auf bestehende Strukturen und Prozesse, die weiterentwickelt werden können, und erhalten den Freiraum, eigene Ideen sowie neue Ansätze einzubringen und diese gemeinsam mit dem Unternehmen umzusetzen.

Mehr Freiraum – auch im Arbeitsalltag

Neben der außergewöhnlichen Gestaltungsmöglichkeit bietet die Position eine 4-Tage-Woche auf 36-Stunden-Basis – für mehr Freiraum und eine ausgewogene Balance zwischen beruflicher Verantwortung und persönlicher Zeit.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

title: IT Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

  • Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

  • Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

  • Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

  • Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

  • Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

  • Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

  • Experience managing servers and infrastructure in Windows, Linux, data-centre, or hybrid environments.

  • A strong interest in IT security, system reliability, access control, hardening, monitoring, and structured operations.

  • The ability to troubleshoot methodically, document solutions clearly, and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical users.

  • A degree, vocational qualification, professional certification, or equivalent practical experience in IT, computer science, systems engineering, or a related field.

Desirable experience/Things you will have the opportunity to support

  • Classified-information requirements such as VS-NfD or higher, BSI IT-Grundschutz, or similar security frameworks.

  • Access and permission management, system hardening, security monitoring, segregated networks, or environments with high protection requirements.

  • BSI-approved cryptography or other regulated information-security requirements.

  • Cloud computing, virtualisation, hypervisors such as Proxmox, virtual machines, Docker, or Kubernetes.

  • Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Ansible or Terraform, together with software-development experience.

  • Enterprise IT tools including mobile-device management, patch management, CMDB, ISMS, monitoring, or hardware and asset-management systems.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

Please submit applications in English

 

Compensation: €55K – €65K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus

title: Kundensupport (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Angefangen hat alles vor sieben Jahren als ambitionierte Idee. Heute sind wir Marktführer für Abschlusszeitungen in Deutschland. Jedes Jahr nutzen mehr als zwei Drittel aller deutschen Abschlussjahrgänge die nuggit App, um ihre Abschlusszeitung und ihre Abschlusstextilien zu gestalten und sich damit eine Erinnerung an eine gemeinsame Zeit zu schaffen, die bleibt.

Unsere Mission: Durch digitale Innovation und persönlichen Kundenkontakt sind wir für SchülerInnen der verlässliche Partner bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt. Dafür hinterfragen wir permanent den Status Quo und entwickeln neue, kreative Lösungen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit sehr großer Reichweite. Unsere Kunden sind SchülerInnen, die gerade ihre Abizeitung oder ihre Abschlusstextilien planen. Für viele ist das ihr erstes großes Projekt. Im Kundensupport (m/w/d) bist du ihre erste Anlaufstelle: per Chat, Telefon und Videocall, von der ersten Frage bis zur Lieferung. Standardfragen beantworten bei uns Chatbot und Helpcenter, du bist überall da, wo ein Mensch gebraucht wird. Das heißt viel direkter Kontakt, schnelles Feedback und echte Verantwortung.

Aufgaben

  • Support: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer SchülerInnen per Chat, Telefon und E-Mail. Schnell, freundlich und so, dass sie danach wirklich weiterkommen.

  • Problemlösung: Wenn etwas hakt, etwa bei Freigaben, Bestellungen oder Lieferterminen, findest du gemeinsam mit unserem Operations-Team eine Lösung und hältst den Jahrgang auf dem Laufenden.

  • Begleitung: Du begleitest Jahrgänge von der Angebotsannahme bis zur Lieferung und sorgst dafür, dass kein Projekt untergeht.

  • Video-Sprechstunden: Du führst buchbare Video-Calls, in denen SchülerInnen intensive Unterstützung bei ihrem Projekt bekommen.

  • Self-Service: Du erkennst, welche Fragen immer wiederkommen, und hilfst dabei, Chatbot und Helpcenter besser zu machen.

  • Feedback: Du gibst weiter, was SchülerInnen bewegt, damit wir Produkt und Abläufe verbessern können.

So arbeiten wir

  • Wir sprechen die Sprache unserer Kunden. Unsere Kunden sind 17, 18 oder 19 Jahre alt. Sie melden sich nach der Schule, in der Pause oder kurz vor der Deadline. Sie brauchen jemanden, der geduldig erklärt, verlässlich zurückmeldet und ehrlich sagt, wenn es eng wird.

  • Automatisierung entlastet dich, sie ersetzt dich nicht. Chatbot, Helpcenter und Onboarding-Videos nehmen dir die Standardfragen ab, damit du Zeit für die Gespräche hast, die wirklich zählen.

  • Eigeninitiative ist Pflicht, nicht Bonus. Du bekommst Ziele und Kontext, den Weg gestaltest du selbst. Niemand treibt dich an, aber alle verlassen sich auf dich.

  • Hybrid, ehrlich gemeint. Unser neues Office liegt im Mindspace in der Uhlandstraße 32, direkt am Kudamm und bestens angebunden, mit allen Annehmlichkeiten eines Coworking Space. Alle weiteren Mindspace Standorte kannst du temporär mitnutzen. Homeoffice und mobiles Arbeiten sind selbstverständlich möglich, solange das Ergebnis stimmt.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Kundenservice oder Support, idealerweise mit Endkunden. Quereinstieg ist ausdrücklich willkommen, etwa aus Hospitality, Hotellerie, Gastronomie, Einzelhandel, Jugendarbeit oder dem Lehramt, auch ohne abgeschlossenes Referendariat.

  • Du kannst gut mit jungen Menschen: locker im Ton, verbindlich in der Sache und geduldig, wenn dieselbe Frage zum dritten Mal kommt.

  • Du schreibst schnell, klar und freundlich. Am Telefon bist du genauso entspannt wie im Chat.

  • Du behältst auch bei vielen parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Unsere Saison hat klare Peaks.

  • Du lieferst zuverlässig und meldest dich, bevor jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Tools wie Chat-, Ticket- oder CRM-Systemen.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch. Das ist bei uns Voraussetzung, weil unsere Kunden deutschsprachig sind.

  • Du hast eine proaktive Haltung und arbeitest gerne eng mit anderen Teams zusammen.

Benefits

Unser Angebot

  • Du begleitest jedes Jahr Abschlussjahrgänge aus ganz Deutschland bei ihrem allerersten großen Projekt

  • Eine Rolle mit Perspektive: Wenn du willst, übernimmst du Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung

  • Kurze Wege und offene Ohren: Ideen landen bei uns direkt beim Entscheider, ohne Zwischenebenen

Die perfekte Bewerberin oder den perfekten Bewerber gibt es nicht. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn du die Anforderungen (noch) nicht zu 100 % erfüllst, du aber die Motivation mitbringst, dir die nötigen Fähigkeiten anzueignen. title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

  • Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

  • Architecture

 

What we're looking for

  • Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems

  • You get excited when working with a ton of data

  • Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required

  • You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it

  • Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL

  • Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges

  • Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters

  • CS or quantitative degree preferred

 

Bonus points:

 

  • Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure

  • Former founder

  • Background in building data-intensive systems at scale

 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

title: Lead Forward Deployed Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Artificial

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

Today, a key part of delivery has no clear owner: problem framing before configuration begins.

  • On the customer side, there are rarely UX specialists - only domain experts and sponsors who describe needs as pre-formed solutions.

  • On our side, configured workspaces are built by Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) in our Transform team: experts in the platform, accountable for shipping to a deadline, but not trained designers.

  • Our Platform teams have design expertise but are often too far removed from individual implementations to influence the moments that matter most.

The result is pretty predictable: we move quickly into “how” before we are confident about the “what” and “why.”

Your mandate is to slow down at the right moment and make sure we’re solving the right problem - then help the team implement the best platform-valid solution.

This is a founding role. You would be the first Forward Deployed Designer (FDD) at Artificial, hired into an enabling function within the Platform team, with the mandate to define how the function works and to build it out. Later, FDDs would join the Transform teams in hands-on client roles: you’d take part in hiring them (with our support), then line-manage them directly.

Responsibilities

You would work closely with the Transform team and customers throughout discovery and delivery. In practice, that means:

  • Establish the FDD function. Define the operating model, the patterns, and the ways of working from scratch.

  • Grow and manage the team. Take part in hiring subsequent FDDs and line-manage them as they join.

  • Join customer + FDE sessions early (problem framing and discovery), not only at reviews once decisions are already fixed.

  • Translate requests into problems. For example, turn “we need a confirmation button before this step” into:

    • the user behaviour driving the request

    • two or three platform-valid approaches

    • a recommendation, with trade-offs explained

  • Prototype and test ideas quickly using the most effective medium (written specs, wireframes, workflows, or light code). We care more about clarity and platform realism than polished artefacts.

  • Provide credible pushback when the customer’s proposed solution doesn’t address the underlying problem.

  • Codify patterns and precedents so knowledge moves from individual memory into shared team infrastructure.

  • Level up the FDE team’s design instincts over time. You shouldn’t be the only person who can think about UX across the two teams; part of the job is coaching, so the capability can spread.

  • Use workspace signals (e.g. session data and call analysis) to surface risks early - before they become escalations.

About you

You are a designer who thrives in ambiguity and constraints, someone who can bring structure, judgement, and clarity to complex, real-world delivery.

You likely have experience in enterprise/B2B software where:

  • the design system already exists

  • the hard part is framing the right problem and navigating stakeholders

  • solutions must work within meaningful technical and organisational constraints

You understand technical concepts fluently. Part of the role would involve writing code (with plenty of LLM and human assistance) using our in-house DSL (Domain Specific Language). We don’t want you to be an engineer, but we do need you to be comfortable reading and writing some code, reasoning about how a configurable system behaves, and understanding what the platform can and can’t express, well enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers and to explain these constraints to customers when necessary.

You have managed designers. You’re comfortable with line management of a small team (roughly three to five people) and have hired designers before. Early on, you’d do this hands-on yourself; as the function grows, you’d manage the FDDs who follow.

Insurance or Lloyd’s experience is a plus, but is not a requirement. We care more about how you think about complex platforms and stakeholders than about prior domain knowledge, which you can learn here.

We especially want to hear from you if you have

  • Collaborative skills with an emphasis on product quality.

  • Experience in insurtech, insurance or related industries.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Experience in a distributed work environment.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance

  • Income protection insurance

  • Life insurance of 4 * base salary

  • On-site gym and shower facilities

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Team social events and company parties

  • Salary exchange on pension and nursery fees

  • Access to Maji, the financial wellbeing platform

  • Company stock options managed through Ledgy

  • Milestone Birthday Bonus and a Life Events leave policy

  • Generous holiday allowance of 28 days plus national holidays

  • Home office and equipment allowance, and a company MacBook

  • Learning allowance and leave to attend conferences or take exams

  • YuLife employee benefits, including EAP and bereavement helplines

  • For each new hire, we plant a tree through our partnership with Ecologi Action

  • The best coffee machine in London, handmade in Italy and imported just for us!

    We’re proud to be an equal opportunities employer and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities around us. If there’s anything you need to make the hiring process more accessible, just let us know—we’re happy to make adjustments. You’re also welcome to share your preferred pronouns with us at any point.

    Think you don’t meet every requirement? Please apply anyway. We value potential as much as experience, and we know that raw talent counts.

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Purpose

The Manager, Procurement Operations & Transformation will be the functional owner responsible for both the strategic evolution and the daily operational execution of Checkout.com’s Procurement and Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) functions.

The role is structured across four core pillars:

  • Transformation: Setting the long-term vision, target operating model, and multi-year transformation initiatives, roadmaps, business cases, and cost-benefit analyses across all operating model components: Service Delivery Model, People, Process, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Operations: Managing the day-to-day Procurement Operations team, monitoring functional health, data quality, and operational metrics, as well as eliminating bottlenecks and escalations across sourcing and corporate travel.

  • Business Partnering: Acting as the primary strategic bridge between Procurement and core business functions (Technology, InfoSec, Risk, Legal, and People) to ensure cross-functional alignment and service delivery.

  • Program Management & Governance: Leading programmatic execution, centralizing compliance and regulatory inputs, servicing audit requirements, and managing functional roadmaps with support teams.

The primary objective is to modernize Procurement and TPRM into high-performing service functions delivering superior customer experience, strict SLAs, advanced automation, and scalable tooling architectures.

Key Responsibilities

1. Transformation & Operating Model Strategy

  • Define and execute the global strategy, target operating model, and vision across all Procurement & TPRM components: Service Delivery Model, Process, People, Reporting & Data, Governance & Controls, and Automation/AI.

  • Map strategy into prioritized roadmaps supported by concrete business cases and cost-benefit analyses.

  • Define the functional AI and automation strategy, sponsoring the delivery of automated capabilities in partnership with Technology to maximize throughput and operational efficiency.

  • Establish and monitor core operational metrics, KPIs, and SLAs to track function health, service quality, and risk posture.

  • Partner with Accounts Payable to drive end-to-end Source-to-Pay process optimization and touchless execution.

2. Operational Leadership & Escalation Management

  • Lead and manage the Procurement Operations team, ensuring category management teams receive required data, analytics, and operational support.

  • Own vendor master data governance to maintain maximum accuracy and integrity across downstream systems and reporting.

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for operational blockers across Procurement, corporate travel, and P2P handoffs.

  • Maintain functional relationships with platform providers and monitor tooling health, releases, and integrations in collaboration with Technology.

3. Tooling Ecosystem Ownership

  • Zip: Act as joint business owner with Accounts Payable, functionally managing intake-to-contract workflows, vendor onboarding, and P2P handoffs.

  • OneTrust: Functionally own TPRM risk assessment workflows and vendor risk oversight.

  • Navan: Functionally oversee corporate travel management tools, user support, and policy administration.

  • Partner with Technology on business requirement definitions (BRDs), backlog prioritization, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

4. Regulatory, Compliance & Audit Enablement

  • Act as the functional Procurement lead for internal and external audits, SOX controls, and regulatory assessments.

  • Deliver operational support for global market expansion, ensuring supply-chain and TPRM standards satisfy new market license applications and regulatory filings.

  • Programmatically centralize, manage, and track regulatory, audit, and compliance inputs and remediation actions across the team.

Requirements

  • Transformation & Operating Model Leadership: Proven track record designing, delivering, and scaling target operating models, large-scale procurement transformations, and process re-engineering in fast-paced enterprise environments.

  • Procurement Operations & People Management: Demonstrated experience leading a Procurement Operations team, driving daily operational discipline, and resolving cross-functional bottlenecks.

  • Tooling & Digital Enablement: Hands-on functional ownership, administration, or implementation experience with modern enterprise platforms: Zip, OneTrust, and Navan (or comparable modern P2P and TPRM tools).

  • Automation & AI Strategy: Proven ability to identify, scope, and sponsor automation and AI initiatives, partnering closely with Technology and Engineering to deliver technical solutions.

  • TPRM & Regulatory Governance: Strong background in Third-Party Risk Management frameworks, regulatory compliance requirements, and audit management.

  • Program Management: Strong capability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder programmatic roadmaps and drive alignment across Finance, Legal, Risk, and Technology.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operating Model Transformation: Multi-year transformation roadmap is executed efficiently, delivering measurable productivity gains and modernizing the functional architecture across Procurement and TPRM.

  • Automation & AI Execution: Automation and AI use cases are successfully delivered alongside Technology, driving touchless handoffs, faster cycle times, and optimized workflows.

  • Operational Excellence: Operational SLAs and KPIs are consistently achieved, vendor master data maintains high integrity, and operational bottlenecks are rapidly resolved.

  • Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Zero critical audit findings across Procurement and TPRM operations, with dependable operational execution for international license applications and filings.

  • High-Performing Operations Team: An engaged, well-structured Procurement Operations team that consistently provides reliable, high-quality operational support to category managers and internal stakeholders.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

title: Marketing Manager - Benelux
descriptionHtml:
Location: London, with regular time in Benelux

Finance Deserves Better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out. We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our ledger records every transaction across every entity in real time, so the numbers hold up from day one.

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We’re looking for a Benelux Marketing Manager to make Light the default finance platform for scaling companies across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. You’ll be grounded in our London GTM hub and spend lots of time in the region, getting to know the market up close.

We already have great momentum in Benelux, and our new Benelux Sales Director has joined to lead sales in the region. Now we need someone to support the Benelux hub and get our brand out there, so that when a Benelux finance team outgrows its current setup, Light is the obvious next move.

You’ll own the Benelux marketing plan end to end. You’ll have a dotted line into the Benelux hub, which spans sales, implementation and customer success, and you’ll work closely with our central growth team to find new ways to drive demand through digital channels.

We’re open on level. Whether you’re earlier in your marketing career or have years of experience behind you, we’ll shape the role around the person we hire.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Building and running the Benelux marketing plan, with pipeline targets you share with the Benelux hub.

  • Running a field and events programme across Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Brussels, Antwerp, Luxembourg and any other city you think makes sense, from intimate CFO dinners to flagship moments people talk about for months.

  • Growing partnerships with the accounting firms, advisors, investors and communities that Benelux finance leaders trust and that extend our voice across the region.

  • Localising our story, content and campaigns so they land with Benelux finance teams in their own language and context.

  • Creating content with our customers, product and design teams that turns what Light does into stories people want to share.

  • Working with our central growth team to test and scale digital demand generation in the region.

  • Building relationships with local press and the people who shape the Benelux tech and finance conversation.

What We Think* You’ll Need

  • Experience in B2B marketing, ideally at a fast-growing SaaS company, with hands-on time in field, events, partnerships or content.

  • The judgement to know which lever to pull and when, and the drive to learn the ones you haven’t pulled yet.

  • A feel for what lands with Dutch, Belgian and Luxembourgish audiences, and how to localise a brand for each of them.

  • Comfort working with sales, implementation and customer success as one team, with pipeline as the shared goal.

  • Deep curiosity about how AI is reshaping finance teams and the companies they serve.

  • A great storyteller across video, text and meme.

  • A can-do, empathetic and collaborative spirit. No brilliant jerks here, please.

  • Fluency in English and Dutch. French is a bonus.

  • A passport. Expect to spend lots of time across Benelux, plus trips to our teams in Copenhagen, Munich, New York and elsewhere.

*If the core of the role sounds compelling but you don’t tick every box, we’d still love for you to reach out and convince us you’re the right person.

The Good Stuff

🏢 A five-day, in-office culture with a high-density team in London, whenever you’re not on the road in Benelux.
💸 A competitive salary and potential stock options.
🏝 25 days of annual leave plus UK public holidays.
🥳 Regular socials and two company offsites a year. The last 2 were in Tuscany & Provence!
🚀 The chance to put Light on the map in Benelux and shape a category from the inside.

Light is an equal opportunity employer.

The Famous Last Words

We already have momentum in Benelux, and now we want every scaling company in the region to know our name. If you know the market, love building from the ground up and want to help retire the ERP for good, let’s talk.

title: Marketing Manager

BeyondMath is a pioneering startup, backed by top-tier VCs, on a mission to reshape the frontiers of engineering through Foundational AI models for Physics. We are replacing traditional, slow, and expensive simulation methods with AI that rivals accuracy at orders of magnitude higher speed.

You will work closely with the leadership team, our GTM and technical account teams, and our engineers and researchers, turning deeply technical work with global OEMs, Formula 1 teams and aerospace innovators into content and moments the market notices. You will not inherit a marketing machine; you will build one, with real autonomy, a direct line to leadership, and the BeyondMath brand system already in place to work from.

  • Own Our Social Channels: Run BeyondMath's LinkedIn and other relevant channels day to day — content calendar, copy, visuals, scheduling, community engagement and reporting — with a consistent voice and an on-brand look.

About You

  • You have a "founder's mentality": you are a builder who is comfortable being the first person in a function, and who will set up the system and then run it yourself.

  • You are at home with deeply technical subject matter and genuinely curious about engineering, simulation and AI. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to enjoy working with them.

title: Mechanical Engineer - Equipment Engineering
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

 

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Build the machine that builds the machine. Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

  • Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology. Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

  • Do work that matters, and see it grow. The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

  • Make an impact you can point to. In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

Design and build the machines, fixtures, and tooling used to manufacture HTS magnet coils.

Develop the manufacturing processes that turn new equipment into a repeatable production line.

Work hands-on with technicians to build, debug, and commission equipment on the shop floor.

Own equipment and process development together, from clean-slate concept through production readiness.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Design new manufacturing equipment and fixtures for magnet manufacturing; from concept generation and trade studies through the whole equipment life cycle.

Perform proof-of-concept calculations, benchtop testing, and tolerance stack-up analysis to validate design decisions before committing to build.

Own subsystem designs, BOMs (Bills of Materials), specifications, and drawings, and manage changes as designs mature.

Develop, coordinate and document assembly procedures, commissioning and operation for the equipment you design.

Support technicians during equipment build, assembly, and commissioning.

Supporting the production team troubleshooting issues and iterating on design or process as needed.

Drive non-conformances to root cause and turn findings into concrete process or design improvements.

Provide DFM (Design for Manufacturing)/DFA (Design for Assembly) input to magnet design engineers to keep coil designs manufacturable.

Select and manage external vendors and machine shops for components, subassemblies, and fabricated parts.

Recommend equipment, tooling, or facility improvements needed to scale manufacturing capacity as production ramps.

Participate in design reviews, and communicate design and process decisions clearly to cross-functional partners.

WHO YOU ARE

4–6 years of experience in mechanical design or manufacturing engineering, ideally building complex electromechanical systems, automated equipment, or precision assemblies.

Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred) including GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) and drawing creation for fabrication and inspection.

Experience designing parts and equipment across multiple manufacturing processes: machining, sheet metal, welding, fabricated assemblies.

Hands-on experience building, assembling, and debugging equipment or prototype, not just designing on paper.

Solid technical writing skills for work instructions, assembly procedures, and design documentation.

Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements in a fast-paced startup environment.

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

Exposure to automation systems, control cabinets, PLCs (Programmable Logic Controllers), or industrial sensors.

Experience with FEA (Finite Element Analysis) tools (SolidWorks Simulation, Ansys) for structural or thermal analysis.

Familiarity with cryogenics, vacuum systems, or superconducting/high-precision electromechanical hardware.

Experience with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)/MES (Manufacturing Execution Systems) tools for BOM and change management.

Rapid prototyping skills: 3D printing, mill, lathe, or hand tools.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

title: ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops)
descriptionHtml:
StellDirVor is an independent consulting, trade and technology company specializing in immersive technologies for healthcare. We support organizations in implementing digital innovations — Virtual, Augmented and Mixed Reality as well as AI — particularly for learning, training and real-time assistance in clinical and care environments. By combining technology and healthcare, we help optimize processes, improve knowledge transfer and enhance quality of care.

Supported by a Germany (ZIM) and Taiwanese (GIPIP) partnership grant, we are currently developing ARAIAS — an AR- and AI-based hands-free training and assistance system for chronic wound care. Using AR smart glasses, the system enables 3D capture, AI-supported analysis, and standardized remote expertise and documentation directly at the point of care.

As our ML Engineer (Computer Vision & ML Ops), you will build the AI capabilities at the core of ARAIAS: evaluating and fine-tuning computer vision models on smart glasses data, running the ML operations behind them, and applying generative AI to create synthetic medical images for education. We're at an early stage — moving from concept to working prototype — so the near-term focus is on validating models and building toward a proof of concept we can test in real education and clinical settings.

As part of a small team, you will own the full data lifecycle end to end — from sourcing, consent and annotation to preparation — alongside model development and deployment.

We welcome candidates at different experience levels. What matters most is a solid ML foundation and genuine awareness of the medical imaging domain.

Notes:

Due to the nature of the project, we can only consider candidates who are already residing in Germany.

Tasks

  • Select and benchmark pre-trained models and/or validated architectures for medical image analysis and adapt them to domain-specific data, ensuring robust performance under real-world conditions

  • Identify and adapt suitable generative AI models to create realistic synthetic medical images for education and training

  • Evaluate and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) for voice interaction — speech-to-text, intent understanding and text-to-speech — optimized for low-latency or on-device use with smart glasses

  • Research and assess state-of-the-art ML models and emerging trends, including Explainable AI (XAI), cybersecurity for ML, and deployment and distribution modes (edge vs. cloud, federated learning, model compression)

  • Plan and execute the ML operations pipeline — data gathering, annotation, preparation, training, testing and deployment

  • Propose a data collection strategy — research suitable public and clinical data sources, recommend patient consent and other administrative requirements for ML training (e.g., data protection agreements, ethics approval), and define collection and annotation protocols with clinical experts, including labeling guidelines and quality checks

  • Identify and validate factors that affect model performance — image conditions, dataset bias, patient diversity, data privacy and regulatory requirements

  • Define test strategies and metrics, and validate model outputs against clinician assessments

  • Perform build vs. buy analyses for models, tools and services, including cost comparison

  • Estimate compute and training costs and propose budgets for model training and deployment

  • Choose and set up training environments flexibly — local hardware or cloud — based on cost, data privacy and performance

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for the current prototyping stage and document results clearly

  • Maintain clear, traceable documentation of data sources, models, experiments and design decisions to support audits and quality reviews

  • Evaluate and integrate additional sensors where feasible (e.g., depth, LiDAR, thermal, multispectral) and fuse them with RGB input

Requirements

Must-Have

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Engineering, Mathematics or a related field — or equivalent practical background

  • Strong Python skills and hands-on use of PyTorch, OpenCV or TensorFlow

  • Solid understanding of computer vision — classification, object detection and image segmentation, 3D Reconstruction and Multi-View Geometry

  • Hands-on knowledge of transfer learning — adapting pre-trained models and fine-tuning them on custom datasets

  • Working knowledge of the full ML lifecycle — data preparation, training, evaluation and deployment

  • Basic knowledge of generative models (diffusion models or GANs) and common open-source libraries

  • Comfortable training models both locally (GPU workstation) and on cloud platforms

  • Able to estimate ML compute costs and compare build vs. buy options to support budget decisions

  • Awareness of medical imaging challenges — limited data, label variability between clinicians and class imbalance

  • Awareness of healthcare data privacy and ethics (e.g., GDPR, patient consent, anonymization) and why explainability and bias matter in clinical AI

  • Able to read research papers and apply them pragmatically

  • Self-directed and pragmatic — able to take initiative and own problems end-to-end in a lean team

  • Fluent in English — German is a bonus

Strong Plus

  • Projects or coursework in medical imaging or clinical AI

  • Familiarity with semi-supervised learning — leveraging limited or partially labeled data

  • Experience with 3D data processing — depth maps, point clouds or mesh reconstruction

  • Exposure to multi-modal learning — combining RGB and depth or LiDAR data

  • Edge AI or wearable deployment (e.g., TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, model quantization)

  • Knowledge of explainability methods (e.g., Grad-CAM, SHAP) or adversarial robustness

  • Familiarity with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC, Docker)

  • Awareness of medical device regulation for AI software (e.g., EU MDR, IEC 62304)

  • Familiarity with small language models (SLMs) and speech pipelines (e.g., Whisper, on-device speech recognition and text-to-speech)

Benefits

  • Meaningful work — You help shape how technology redefines education and training in healthcare, with real impact on clinical outcomes

  • Ownership and creative freedom — You work autonomously, contribute your ideas directly, and have a genuine say in how the system is built

  • A learning culture — We support personal and professional growth through knowledge sharing, access to innovative tools and methods, and a dedicated learning budget

  • Flexible working — Remote-friendly setup with the option to work from our Munich office

  • Flat hierarchies and team spirit — A small, open, and trust-based team where communication is direct and everyone's voice matters

  • International collaboration — Work alongside a Taiwan-based partner covering technology, hardware and research

We are only able to respond to candidates selected for further consideration. If you have not heard from us within four weeks of applying, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time.
