title: ML Systems Engineer — Inference Acceleration
descriptionHtml:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians

Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

Optimize the execution and serving of modern AI models on Arago's custom accelerator. Work across kernels, model execution, multi-device distribution, runtime, and inference serving, while helping shape the software stack around the capabilities of Arago's hardware.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong experience in high-performance ML inference, GPU/accelerator programming, or ML systems engineering.

  • Deep understanding of computer architecture, accelerator/GPU execution models, memory hierarchies, parallelism, and performance bottlenecks.

  • Experience developing and optimizing custom kernels using CUDA, Triton, ROCm/HIP, or equivalent low-level programming environments.

  • Experience with operator fusion, tiling, scheduling, data movement optimization, graph execution, and profiling of compute- and memory-bound workloads.

  • Strong understanding of distributed model execution, including tensor, pipeline, sequence, and/or expert parallelism and communication/computation overlap.

  • Hands-on experience with modern inference-serving systems such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent, including KV-cache management, continuous batching, paged attention, and prefill/decode scheduling.

  • Strong C++ and Python skills, and comfort working on a custom accelerator stack where compiler, runtime, kernels, and abstractions are actively being developed. Exposure to or experience with MLIR and MLIR dialects is a strong plus.

  • Language: English at a proficient level.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze modern AI workloads and identify kernel-, runtime-, memory-, and system-level bottlenecks on Arago's accelerator.

  • Develop and optimize custom kernels, fused operators, and execution strategies to maximize device utilization.

  • Design efficient mappings of models and operators across multiple Arago devices, including communication and synchronization strategies.

  • Develop inference-serving techniques such as continuous batching, paged KV caches, prefix/context caching, chunked prefill, and prefill/decode interleaving or disaggregation.

  • Build profiling, benchmarking, and performance-analysis infrastructure spanning kernels, full models, and serving workloads.

  • Work closely with Arago's hardware, compiler, and runtime teams to co-design software abstractions and influence future hardware features based on real model workloads.

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

title: Operations analyst - Transfers
descriptionHtml:
Hybrid with 2 days a week in our Edinburgh or Bath office

 

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform that’s on a mission to helping more people to invest – and invest well.

 

We’re B-Corp certified with an amazing product-market fit, impressive early traction and the potential to transform an outdated industry, for the better. We've been growing fast and will scale even faster over the next few years.

 

We’re also proud to be part of Octopus, the £multi billion group that's on a mission to breathe new life into broken industries, through companies like Octopus Energy, Octopus Investments and Octopus Money.

 

Check out the Seccl website for the latest on our products and our mission to shape the future of investments.

 

The role

We’re looking for an Operations analyst to join our Transfers team, where you’ll be responsible for processing transfers accurately and on time across multiple wrapper types. This is a fast paced and varied role that will require you to adapt quickly to changing priorities, move seamlessly between different tasks and processes, and stay focused in a busy operational environment.

You’ll balance pace with precision, managing competing demands while consistently delivering high quality outcomes. Working closely with colleagues across Operations and our customer facing teams, you’ll help processes run efficiently and resolve queries and issues within agreed service levels. Alongside day to day processing, you’ll use your operational knowledge and experience to improve processes, reduce risk and support automation, helping us build a more scalable and resilient operations function for the future.

 

On a typical day you will be…

  • Supporting your Senior analyst with regular business reporting

  • An analytical problem solver, delivery focussed and a trusted member of the team, you will support the wider business by answering queries in a timely manner

  • Investigating and taking end to end ownership of our transfer processes. Ensuring issues are resolved in line with regulatory and customer agreed SLAs

  • Reviewing operational workflow and, where possible, suggesting process improvements

  • Working closely with the customer, product and engineering teams to explore better ways of working and to support our scalability

  • Supporting with training for new members of the team

  • Supporting other areas of Operations as and when required

 

This role’s for you if...

  • You have a good understanding of the platform industry

  • You have proven experience in handling transfers efficiently

  • You have the ability to identify, analyse and resolve any complex issues working to strict deadlines

  • You have good domain knowledge of investment platforms, particularly knowledge of the CASS environment

  • You have strong communication and organisation skills with the ability to describe to both technical and non-technical audiences

 

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

     

What’s in it for you…

 

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

 

💰 A salary between £30,000 and £35,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 Length of service award – one month paid sabbatical at eight years

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced Parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 home office set up budget

📖 £750 per person learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

 

Our culture

 

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation.

 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this, (following an initial chat with one of our Talent team):

🌈 Our aim is to build a diverse and inclusive company of awesome people, with unique skills, passions and experiences. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: Paid Social & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Wir sind everdrop – eine schnell wachsende D2C Brand mit der Mission, die Welt der Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte nachhaltig zu verändern. Als Paid Social & Analytics Manager (m/w/d) bei everdrop werden das deine Hauptaufgaben sein:

  • Reporting & Optimierung: Marktübergreifende Koordination der Performance, Erstellung fundierter Reports und Ableitung datenbasierter Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management.


DAS BIST DU

Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im META-Performance-Marketing im D2C-Umfeld oder in einem dynamischen Agenturumfeld auf hohem Skalierungsniveau.

  • Analytische Fähigkeiten: Du bist absolut sicher im Umgang mit Daten sowie Tools wie Excel/Sheets (Pivot-Tabellen) und hast bereits Erfahrungen mit Tableau oder GA4 gesammelt.

  • Plattform-Expertise: Du bist stets am Puls der Zeit, was META-Best-Practices, Algorithmus-Updates und neue Ad-Formate angeht.

  • Performance-Mindset: Du verstehst die zentralen Wachstumsmetriken und weißt genau, wie du CAC, Conversion Rates und Umsatz optimal in Einklang bringst.

  • Bonus: Erfahrung mit Kampagnen auf TikTok oder Pinterest.

  • Kommunikation: Verhandlungssicheres Englisch und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau). Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

DAS IST EVERDROP

Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Im Jahr 2020 sind wir mit unseren Reiniger-Tabs gestartet. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Unsere Benefits 🍲💪🏡

  • flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice Möglichkeiten

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub (plus am 24.12. und 31.12. frei)

  • Zusätzlich 2 Tage bezahlter Urlaub pro Jahr für eigene umwelt- oder gemeinnützige Projekte ("Green & Social Impact Days”)

  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, mit unserem Partner DYNO provisionsfrei und ETF-basiert möglich

  • Mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb der EU für bis zu 20 Tage im Jahr

  • Eine Outdoor-Fitnessanlage neben dem Büro sowie eine Special Rate für deine EGYM Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft

  • JobRad-Leasing für dein neues Traumradl

  • Kostenloses veganes Mittagessen einmal pro Woche und Kaffee aus der Siebträgermaschine

  • ein monatlicher Gutschein für everdrop Produkte in unserem Mitarbeitershop

  • Familien- und Freunde-Rabattcodes für everdrop und andere Startups for Tomorrow-Unternehmen

  • Mitgliedschaft und Discounts über FutureBens & Corporate Benefits


Darüber hinaus erwarten dich ein wunderschönes, offenes Büro in der Nähe der Isar, ein Macbook solange du bei everdrop arbeitest, regelmäßige Team-Events, ein starker Teamgeist und ganz viele Office-Hunde die sich schon darauf freuen, dich kennenzulernen!

Unsere Werte 💛🏳️‍🌈🤝‍

Unser Commitment, die Welt ein Stück besser zu machen, ist mit JEDI-Prinzipien verbunden. JEDI steht für Gerechtigkeit, Chancengerechtigkeit, Vielfalt und Inklusion (= Justice, Equity, Diversity, Inclusion). Wir verstehen diese Prinzipien als Grundlage unseres alltäglichen Handelns – sowohl intern beim Recruiting und innerhalb unserer Arbeitsabläufe, als auch gegenüber unseren Kund*innen und der Gesellschaft. Wir verpflichten uns dazu, daran zu arbeiten, systemische Barrieren abzubauen und eine Kultur zu fördern, in der jede Stimme gehört wird. Dies setzen wir durch konkrete Maßnahmen um:

  • Im Unternehmen: Wir schaffen Awareness und Flexibilität, z. B. durch bedingungslose 'Power Days' für menstruierende Kolleg*innen oder unsere 'Green & Social Impact Days' für gesellschaftliches Engagement.

  • In der Community: Wir nutzen unsere Plattform, um das Bewusstsein für soziale und ökologische Gerechtigkeit zu stärken.

Im Arbeitsalltag orientieren wir uns an unseren vier “Core Values”. Sie geben ganz klar vor, wie wir als Individuen und im Team miteinander arbeiten wollen:

#1 WE ARE AMBITIOUS

#2 WE TAKE OWNERSHIP

#3 WE ARE SOLUTION-ORIENTED

#4 WE ARE AWARE

Wir behandeln jeden Menschen gleich, unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Aussehen, Sprache, Kultur, Nationalität, Familienstand, sexueller Orientierung oder körperlicher Einschränkung.

Wir sind ganz bestimmt nicht perfekt – aber wir wollen jeden Tag besser werden und mit jedem Schritt etwas Neues dazulernen. Genau darum geht es ja bei jeder Reise. Kommst du mit?

title: Partnerships Lead, Southern Europe
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partnerships Lead, Southern Europe to lead our partner sales and development team for Southern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Southern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production.

  • Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners.

  • Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and aligning account or territory coverage across a region.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional partner sales or co-sell business at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience aligning sales and partner delivery organisations to support enterprise implementations and sustained production adoption.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms, modern cloud architectures, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise procurement models.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

title: Performance Marketer, Paid Search
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR - We're looking for a hands-on paid marketer to run search and display across Google, Microsoft, The Trade Desk and emerging channels such as ChatGPT ads. You'll build agents with Lovable that read performance, move budgets, catch issues, and make changes. This is an IC role for someone senior who likes being in the detail and building the machine, not just operating it.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years running paid search and display channels. You've owned significant budgets across Google, you know your way around Microsoft Ads, and you've worked in at least one DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk).

  • Automation-led. You don't do by hand what a script or an agent could do. You've built automations for reporting, budget pacing, or optimisation, and you're comfortable with platform APIs and pulling your own data.

  • A social-creative scaler. You understand social scales on creative, and you can keep a diversified asset pipeline moving with the creative team. You've taken a paid social channel from small to large and kept it efficient on the way up.

  • Efficiency-minded. You think in CAC and payback, and you can tell efficient growth from spend that just looks like growth.

  • Hands-on by choice. You'd rather be in the account driving impact than in a deck. You like the detail, and you build things yourself.

  • Already building with AI. You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.

  • Technical spiking. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.

What you’ll do

  • Run paid search and display end to end. Own the channels across Google, Microsoft, The Trade Desk and emerging AI surfaces like ChatGPT Ads. You set the account structure, the bids, the budgets, and the targets.

  • Automate the day-to-day. Build agents and automations with Lovable that read performance, pace and shift budgets, flag issues before they cost us, and make the changes. The goal is a paid program that mostly runs itself, with you steering.

  • Scale through creative. Keep a steady supply of diversified assets in market, and know which creative to push when. You've scaled Youtube before, so you know volume and variety are what keep it working.

  • Go programmatic where it pays. Use a DSP (DV360, Criteo, or The Trade Desk) to extend into prospecting, retargeting, and new inventory, and hold the same efficiency bar there as everywhere else.

  • Protect the signal. This is where your technical depth shows up, and you deliver it yourself rather than handing it to a data team. Build and debug the tracking (server-side/CAPI, pixels, cookies, consent, and deduplication), and write the queries that judge channels on incrementality instead of platform-reported ROAS alone.

  • Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, bids, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

Du triffst Entscheidungen eigenständig und übernimmst echte Budgetverantwortung. Weil unsere Kunden ausschließlich im B2B-Umfeld aktiv sind, sind die Budgets höher und die Ansätze deutlich anspruchsvoller als im klassischen B2C-Marketing. Starten kannst du ab sofort.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für ganze Werbeaccounts und triffst eigenständig die wichtigen Entscheidungen über ihre Entwicklung.
  • Du planst den Aufbau neuer Werbekonten strategisch und arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Branchen ein.
  • Du erstellst und steuerst Paid-Search- und Paid-Social-Kampagnen auf Google, Microsoft, Meta und LinkedIn. Eine Spezialisierung auf einen oder mehrere Kanäle ist möglich.
  • Du behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und reagierst schnell, wenn dir Unstimmigkeiten oder Potenziale auffallen.

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.
  • Erfahrung: Du hast bereits Paid-Search- oder Paid-Social-Kampagnen mit vier- bis fünfstelligen Monatsbudgets aufgebaut und gesteuert.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest analytisch, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert.
  • Motivation: Du willst mit erfahrenen Leuten Werbeaccounts für führende B2B-Unternehmen mit fünf- bis sechsstelligen Monatsbudgets aufbauen und steuern.

Benefits

  • Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.
  • Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.
  • 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote.
  • Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook.
  • Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket.
  • Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.
  • Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.

Bereit mit uns die deutsche B2B-Software Branche zu entwickeln?

Sneak Peek: So läuft dein Bewerbungsprozess bei Arvana ab

  1. Kurzes Kennenlernen
    Nach deiner Bewerbung melden wir uns schnell bei dir. In einem 20-minütigen Call lernen wir uns kennen und finden gemeinsam heraus, ob wir zusammenpassen.
  2. Personal Fit
    Im zweiten Gespräch, das ca. 30 bis 45 Minuten dauert, lernen wir dich richtig kennen und erfahren, was dich antreibt. Gleichzeitig zeigen wir dir, wie wir bei Arvana arbeiten, und beantworten all deine Fragen.
  3. Case Study vor Ort & Meet the Team
    In unserem Office in der Rosenstraße 17 gehst du live mit uns durch einen echten Google-Ads-Account und zeigst uns, wie du ihn analysierst. Dabei lernst du unsere Gründer Arne und Mirco persönlich kennen und kannst mit dem Team quatschen. In ca. 90 Minuten nehmen wir dich mit in unsere Prozesse, unsere Mission und unseren Business-Plan. Danach melden wir uns innerhalb von 2 Tagen bei dir.

title: PHP / Joomla Entwickler (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

Dabei arbeitest du sowohl an der Backend-Entwicklung mit PHP und Joomla als auch an der Umsetzung moderner, responsiver Benutzeroberflächen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anbindung externer Systeme: Du integrierst externe Dienste und Datenquellen über Schnittstellen, insbesondere REST-APIs, und entwickelst bei Bedarf eigene Schnittstellenanbindungen.
  • Wartung und Qualitätssicherung: Du übernimmst die technische Pflege bestehender Webseiten, führst Updates durch, analysierst Fehler und sorgst für einen sicheren und stabilen Betrieb.

Das bringst du mit

  • Verständnis für Webstandards: Du kennst die Grundlagen moderner Webentwicklung hinsichtlich Performance, Sicherheit, Responsivität und Browserkompatibilität.

So arbeitest du

title: PR Teamlead (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40-köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und will mehr.

Als PR Teamlead bist du nicht nur senior in deiner eigenen PR-Expertise, sondern gibst dein Wissen weiter, entwickelst erfahrene PR-Köpfe und Nachwuchstalente und trägst Verantwortung für ein wachsendes Kundenportfolio.

Bist du dabei?

Deine Rolle

Als Teamlead arbeitest du nicht mehr selbst operativ auf Kund*innen, sondern ausschließlich über dein Team – dein Impact entsteht durch gute Führung, nicht durch eigene Pitches.

  • Teamentwicklung: Du bist Vorbild und Fels in der Brandung. Mit weekly 1:1s, regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und individuellen Entwicklungsplänen erkennst du Stärken und Entwicklungspotenziale. Du entwickelst deine Teammitglieder individuell, vom Junior bis zum Senior.
  • Kundenportfolio: Du hast den Überblick über den Status aller Kund*innen im Team, bist strategische Ansprechperson auf Entscheiderebene und erkennst frühzeitig Risiken, ebenso wie Upsell-Potenziale und Wachstumschancen. So sorgst du langfristig für ein gesundes Portfolio in deinem Team.
  • Unternehmerisches Handeln: Dein Team ist eine kleine unternehmerische Einheit innerhalb von getpress: Du triffst strategische Entscheidungen auf Basis von KPIs und steuerst Team- und Kundenplanung. Dabei bist du nicht scheu, Entscheidungen zu treffen, zu priorisieren und zu delegieren.
  • Sales & Recruiting: Du arbeitest punktuell eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen, etwa bei Neukund*innenpitches. Genauso eng arbeitest du mit People & Culture zusammen, wenn es um Mitarbeiterentwicklung, Onboarding und Recruiting geht.
  • Struktur & Qualität: Du baust Prozesse, die dein Team wirklich braucht, basierend auf den Bedürfnissen, die du erkennst. Du sorgst für gemeinsame Routinen, begleitest das Onboarding und trägst die Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung im Team.

Wer du bist

  • Du bringst über 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR mit (idealerweise im Agenturumfeld) und hast selbst Kund*innen aus dem Mittelstand und vergleichbaren Unternehmensgrößen direkt betreut, weiterentwickelt und nachweislich in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert. Diese Erfahrung ist deine Basis.
  • Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, disziplinarisch wie fachlich. Idealerweise hast du schon Change-Prozesse begleitet und weißt, wie man ein Team sicher durch Phasen des Wandels führt.
  • Du bringst erprobte Führungsskills, eine hohe emotionale Intelligenz und ein ehrliches Interesse für Menschen und ihre Entwicklung mit.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch und hast ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Geschäftsstrategien. KPIs nutzt du bewusst und regelmäßig, um daraus strategische Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du bist Kommunikator*in durch und durch – im Team hörst du zu und nimmst Menschen mit; extern kommunizierst du souverän mit Kund*innen und Stakeholdern über Hierarchieebenen hinweg, vom CEO bis zum Marketing-Ansprechpartner.
  • Der Einsatz von KI in der PR-Arbeit ist für dich gelebter Alltag, keine Theorie. Du bist neugierig, testest aus, was möglich ist und teilst dein Wissen im Team.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland.

Was dich erwartet

  • Echte PR-Arbeit. Bei uns geht es um echte Pressearbeit, individuell und zielgerichtet. Keine Standard-Pressemitteilungen, sondern individuelles Pitchen bei Journalist*innen in einer breiten Range an Medien.
  • Optimismus. Wir glauben, dass man aus Fehlern lernt und dass eine optimistische Grundhaltung den Unterschied macht. Das merkt man nicht nur in unserem Daily Doing, sondern auch bei spontanen Coffee-Talks oder unseren regelmäßigen Teamevents, ob digital oder vor Ort.
  • Impact. Wir haben hohe Standards an unsere eigene Arbeit, aber auch an die Unternehmen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten. Vor allem in Europa gibt es mehr Hidden Champions als sichtbare Erfolgsgeschichten. Das ist die Lücke, die wir schließen wollen.

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) für Konstruktion & Robotik
descriptionHtml:

Mit unserer universellen TruNIVERSE Robotik Plattform – bestehend aus dem TruOS-Betriebssystem, der KI-Engine TruMind™ und über 300 modularen Hardwarekomponenten – realisieren wir Automatisierungslösungen für Logistik, Automotive, Pharma und Fertigung. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht an Spielzeugprojekten, sondern an echten Robotersystemen von Humanoiden bis zu autonomen Staplern, die direkt im Industrieeinsatz laufen.

Aufgaben

  • Mitarbeit bei der mechanischen Konstruktion von AMR-Trägersystemen, Cobot-Endeffektoren und Stationsbaugruppen (CAD: Fusion360)

Qualifikation

  • Laufendes Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Konstruktionstechnik, Robotik oder vergleichbar (Bachelor ab 4. Semester / Master)
  • gute Kenntnisse in mit Fusion360 oder ähnlichem CAD System
  • Technisches Verständnis für Kinematik, Mechanik und Fertigungsverfahren
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (Kundendokumente auf Deutsch)
  • Eigeninitiative, Lernbereitschaft und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1 – keine Kaffeeprojekte, sondern Kundenprojekte im Industriemaßstab
  • Tiefe Einblicke in Cobots, AMRs, KI-Reasoning und Edge-Computing
  • Mentoring durch erfahrene Ingenieure
  • 1.000–1.500 €/Monat (Praktikum)
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Option auf Übernahme oder Abschlussarbeit (Bachelor/Master)

title: Praktikant (m/w/d) - Praktikum Marketing & Präsentationsgestaltung (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Karriereservice,de steht für professionelle Karriereberatung, praxisnahe Führungstrainings und modernes Outplacement. Wir begleiten Menschen auf ihrem beruflichen Weg – ob beim Karriereeinstieg, in der Neuorientierung oder beim nächsten Karriereschritt. Darüber hinaus wirkst Du an Blogartikeln sowie weiteren Marketing- und Kommunikationsmaßnahmen mit und bringst eigene Ideen für unseren Außenauftritt ein.

Start & Dauer: Idealerweise startest Du im November oder Dezember und unterstützt uns für etwa drei Monate. Den genauen Zeitraum stimmen wir gerne gemeinsam mit Dir ab.

Aufgaben

Freue Dich auf die Arbeit in einem modernen und offenen Beratungsunternehmen. Bei uns bist Du von Anfang an mittendrin statt nur dabei und gestaltest aktiv mit. Dich erwarten abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben, Raum für eigene Ideen und Einblicke in unseren Beratungsalltag:

Qualifikation

Du studierst beispielsweise BWL mit Schwerpunkt Marketing, Kommunikations- oder Medienwissenschaften, Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign oder ein vergleichbares Fach. Entscheidend sind für uns Dein Interesse an Marketing und Kommunikation sowie Deine Freude daran, Inhalte und Ideen ansprechend aufzubereiten.

Außerdem bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du hast ein Gespür für Gestaltung und Freude daran, Präsentationen, Grafiken und andere Materialien übersichtlich und ansprechend zu gestalten.

  • Du formulierst klar und verständlich und hast Spaß daran, Texte zu entwickeln, zu überarbeiten und auf unterschiedliche Zielgruppen abzustimmen.

  • Du interessierst Dich für Karriere, Arbeitswelt und Persönlichkeitsentwicklung und arbeitest Dich gerne in neue Themen ein.

  • Du bist digital affin: Erste Erfahrungen mit PowerPoint, Canva oder vergleichbaren Gestaltungsprogrammen sind willkommen. Kenntnisse in Social Media oder der Webseitenpflege sind ein zusätzliches Plus.

  • Du bist neugierig auf die Möglichkeiten von KI und möchtest sie für Recherche, Texte und Gestaltung sinnvoll einsetzen. Erste Erfahrungen sind willkommen. Vieles kannst Du auch bei uns lernen.

  • Du hast Lust auf Zusammenarbeit, tauschst Dich gerne mit unserem Beraterteam und anderen Werkstudierenden aus und bringst eigene Ideen ein.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtig ist, dass Du Lust hast, Neues auszuprobieren, dazuzulernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas umzusetzen.

Benefits

  • Lernen & Weiterentwicklung: Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung, erhältst konstruktives Feedback und erweiterst Deine Kenntnisse in Gestaltung, Kommunikation und KI.

title: Prescriptions Coordinator
descriptionHtml:
At Montu, every department plays an important role in delivering exceptional patient care. From our clinical and pharmacy teams to the people working behind the scenes, we all share the same goal of ensuring our patients receive the care, treatment and support they need.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Prescription Coordinator, to join our Operations team at Kings Cross. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in a busy environment, has a keen eye for detail and enjoys working collaboratively to make a real difference.

With thousands of patients relying on our service, getting the little things right really does matter. We are looking for someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys problem-solving and wants to be part of a team that is helping to shape the future of medical cannabis in the UK.

This is a full-time, working 40 hours per week.

 

About the Role

As a Prescription Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting our patients, clinicians and pharmacy teams, helping to ensure prescriptions are managed accurately and efficiently throughout the patient journey.

Working as part of our busy Operations team, you will be responsible for maintaining patient records, responding to enquiries, coordinating with internal and external teams and ensuring patients are kept informed about their prescriptions.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where no two days are quite the same. You will need to be organised, adaptable and comfortable managing multiple priorities while maintaining a high standard of accuracy and patient care.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Responding to patient enquiries via telephone and email, providing a friendly, professional and helpful service.

  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic patient records and prescription information.

  • Working closely with our pharmacy and clinical teams to ensure prescriptions are processed efficiently and medication reaches patients without unnecessary delays.

  • Keeping patients informed of any changes or updates relating to their prescriptions.

  • Liaising with external pharmacy partners to ensure prescriptions are received, dispensed and delivered correctly.

  • Supporting our clinicians with day-to-day operational queries and ensuring they have the information they need.

  • Assisting with operational and clinical recruitment and onboarding activities when required.

  • Recording and escalating patient feedback, complaints, incidents and significant events in line with company procedures.

  • Working with our Governance team to ensure concerns are appropriately documented and addressed.

  • Liaising with our Product and Technology teams to help resolve technical issues affecting patients or clinicians.

  • Identifying opportunities to improve processes and working collaboratively with colleagues to make our service even better.

  • Maintaining compliance with company policies, standard operating procedures and mandatory training.

  • Supporting the wider team with operational activities and attending relevant meetings as required.

  • Demonstrating flexibility to support shift-based working when required.

     

What You Will Need

  • At least two years of experience in an administrative, customer service or operational role.

  • Experience working in healthcare or another regulated environment would be advantageous, but is not essential.

  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate records.

  • Strong communication skills and a confident, professional telephone manner.

  • A patient-focused approach with empathy, patience and a genuine desire to help others.

  • Good IT skills and the confidence to learn new systems and technology.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • An understanding of the importance of confidentiality, compliance and following established procedures.

  • A proactive, adaptable attitude and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

  • A willingness to learn, take ownership and contribute to the continued improvement of our service.

     

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • 25 days annual leave, increasing to 27 days after one year and 30 days after two years, plus bank holidays

  • 5% matched pension contribution

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay

  • Cycle-to-work scheme

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

  • The opportunity to be part of a rapidly growing business in an exciting and evolving area of healthcare

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment where your ideas and contributions are valued

     

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis-based medicines (CBPMs). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and delivering an exceptional standard of patient care.

As we continue to grow, we are focused on building talented, passionate teams who share our commitment to improving the patient experience and making medical cannabis more accessible across the UK.

Joining Montu means becoming part of an ambitious and evolving business where you will have the opportunity to develop your career, contribute your ideas and make a meaningful difference to the patients we support.

Compensation: £29.5K

title: Principal Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets, and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We're hiring a Principal Compliance Associate to take on the function's most complex casework, and help shape how we detect and cover market abuse as the business scales.

 

The opportunity

  • Own complex investigations end to end, writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on, and present conclusions to a range of stakeholders.

  • Lead or contribute to periodic threshold and model reviews, recalibrating surveillance rules and alert thresholds as trading behaviour, products and market structure evolve.

  • Support the design, build-out and integration of surveillance platform capability, including onboarding new products, venues and data sources onto the surveillance system.

  • Contribute to market abuse risk assessments, helping identify and score risk across products, jurisdictions and entities, and translate findings into surveillance coverage.

  • Use AI and automation tools responsibly to speed up evidence-gathering, case reconstruction and detection-model development, always with human judgement over the final call.

  • Support conflicts of interest, information barrier, and personal account dealing matters across Markets Compliance, extending beyond surveillance casework where buy-side or asset management experience is directly relevant.

  

What you bring

  • Experience investigating market abuse or trading conduct inside a firm subject to market conduct regulation, such as an exchange, broker-dealer, trading venue, or comparable regulated trading business.

  • A track record running investigations end to end, including writing findings up to a standard a regulator can rely on and presenting conclusions to stakeholders.

  • Working knowledge of core market abuse typologies e.g. spoofing, wash trading, insider trading, front running, ramping.

  • Experience with, or strong working knowledge of, threshold and model calibration, surveillance platform integration, market abuse risk assessments, and audit remediation.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the human oversight regulated casework requires.

  • Familiarity with a surveillance platform (such as Scila, Nasdaq SMARTS, Eventus, or NICE Actimize) and comfort with SQL or a similar query tool for evidence-gathering.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication - your case files, escalations and regulatory drafts will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Exposure to crypto-asset markets is welcomed but not required. What matters most is regulated-market investigation experience; strong candidates from traditional securities or derivatives markets are encouraged to apply.

  

Nice to haves

  • E-comms surveillance experience.

  

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

descriptionHtml:
About AlphaSense: 

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

The Team:

AlphaSense’s Design team is a strategic driver of product differentiation, shaping how the world’s leading companies make high-stakes decisions with confidence. We believe great UX is not just about usability, it’s about deeply understanding our customers’ workflows and building experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and indispensable to how they work.
As AlphaSense evolves into an AI-native platform, Design plays a critical role in defining how AI shows up in real workflows, from search to synthesis to decision-making. We partner closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex data and advanced AI capabilities into cohesive, intuitive, and high-quality experiences.
Our team is a global group of craftspeople, systems thinkers, and innovators who care deeply about quality, velocity, and impact. We operate with a strong sense of ownership, a bias toward action, and a commitment to raising the bar for what great product design looks like in an AI-first world.

About the Role:
We are seeking a Principal Design Engineer to play a key role in shaping the future of AlphaSense’s product experience. This is a senior individual contributor role, where you’ll lead through craft, systems thinking, and technical excellence, building AI-powered experiences that feel tailored, intelligent, and essential to our customers’ workflows.
You will operate at the intersection of design, engineering, and product strategy, translating complex, data-rich problems into high-quality, production-ready experiences. You won’t just prototype ideas; you’ll define how they are built, scaled, and experienced in the product.
As a senior member of the Design team, you’ll act as a multiplier—mentoring others, guiding technical and design decisions, and strengthening the connection between user needs, business goals, and engineering realities.

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (EMEA)
descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

The Role

Docker Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) embed directly with our most strategic customers to solve important, complex technical problems and turn ambitious ideas into production outcomes. FDEs take on the most challenging technical challenges using existing Docker products and patterns when possible, and work across customer, Docker Product and Engineering teams to realize new approaches when required.

 

As a Docker FDE, you will work side-by-side with customer engineering teams to deeply understand their goals, problems, constraints, and technical landscape; identify the highest-leverage opportunities; and design, build, and ship solutions with them. You own the technical journey from discovery and architecture through prototyping, implementation and production rollout.

 

The solutions you build may use existing Docker products, extend Docker into new environments, integrate deeply with customer and third-party systems, or reveal capabilities that Docker should build next. You work closely with Docker Solutions Architects to evolve existing patterns, and Docker Product and Engineering to turn new learnings into reusable patterns and product capabilities.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Responsibilities

Build in Production with Customers

  • Embed with customer engineering teams to design, build, and ship solutions from first prototype through stable production rollout. Use existing Docker products and patterns when possible, invent, prototype and validate innovative solutions when necessary.

  • Deliver working technical artifacts to customers: custom MCP servers with tightly integrated Docker Sandbox environments for coding agents and containerized agents; Docker Compose definitions for multi-agent harnesses and model-backed applications; Hardened Image standardization and migration; New tools that unblock customer progress.

  • Integrate Docker's AI platform with the customer's existing stack, including identity providers (OIDC/SAML/SSO), secrets management, private and air-gapped registries, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tooling.

  • Own technical delivery on your engagements: scope the work, sequence it, make trade-offs between speed and quality, remove blockers early, and contribute directly to code whenever progress depends on it.

Make AI Adoption Safe and Governable

  • Translate customer security, compliance, and platform requirements into concrete plans and see those plans through from ideation to production.

  • Help customers define controls to enable them to adopt agentic AI to solve their unique business problems without compromising security, compliance, data sovereignty or end-user experience.

  • Establish quality and performance standards for customers and work closely with Docker Product and Engineering to quickly address issues that fall outside of established thresholds

  • Partner with customer security and platform teams to get agentic workloads through architecture review, threat modeling, and change control.

Partner with Solutions Architecture and the Field

  • Work closely with Solutions Architects to enable off-the-self solutions when possible and provide technical experience and leadership when a bespoke solution is necessary.

  • Feed implementation learnings back into reference architectures, SOW templates, and success patterns so that FDE innovations become standard features and implementation patterns.

  • Support the field with technical depth during proofs of concept, escalations, and expansion conversations when a working build is the fastest path to a customer adoption.

Close the Loop with Product and Engineering

  • As part of Docker Engineering FDEs work closely with Product and Engineering teams to fold FDE innovations, learnings, and design patterns into existing or new products and services.

  • Work with Customers, Product and Engineering to establish quality and performance thresholds, ensuring customer environments meet them consistently, and responding quickly and decisively when they don’t.

  • Be the voice of the customer. Deliver data-driven and actionable feedback to Product and Engineering: what works well; what does not; what customers are asking for; and what blocks their adoption and forward progress. FDE experience directly influences the roadmap.

Shape the Practice

  • Define the FDE engagement model, delivery standards, and quality bar, and codify them so that engagements are consistent across customers, regions, and delivery partners.

  • Mentor and lead other Forward Deployed Engineers, and participate in hiring loops to grow the team.

  • Act as the senior technical escalation point on the hardest problems impacting your customers. Every incident is an opportunity to improve Docker products and services.

  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agentic AI stack: LLMs, APIs, MCP, coding agents, model and harness evaluation approaches, performance and quality thresholds, deployment patterns.

  • This role may require participation in an on-call rotation to provide support outside of standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

_______________________________________________________________________

 

Qualifications

Required

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role such as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Professional Services Engineer, or Software Engineer with consulting or technical founder experience.

  • Technical leadership across multiple engagements, teams, or domains, with a proven ability to set delivery standards, define repeatable patterns, and influence product direction through field evidence.

  • Expert production coding skills in Go, Python, or TypeScript, with a track record of shipping and operating software that other people depend on and of leading technical design reviews.

  • Deep, hands-on Docker expertise: Dockerfiles and multi-stage builds, Docker Compose, image and registry operations, container networking and storage, and container security fundamentals.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including tool use and function calling, the Model Context Protocol (MCP server and client implementation), prompt and context engineering, and evaluation of agent behavior.

  • Working knowledge of software supply chain security: SBOMs, image signing and attestation, vulnerability management, minimal and hardened base images, and secure CI/CD.

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems: identity providers (Okta, Entra ID, LDAP/Active Directory), federated identity protocols (OIDC, SAML), secrets managers, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Ability to scope and deliver complex work in ambiguous, fast-moving customer environments, making sound trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality.

  • Excellent communication skills with engineers, security and platform teams, and executive stakeholders, with a low-ego, collaborative approach and the ability to lead through influence rather than authority.

  • Proven track record of technical mentorship and of raising the bar for the engineers around you.

  • High agency and comfort operating autonomously in distributed, remote-first teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Travel to customer sites to build in person with customer teams, estimated at up to 50%.

Bonus

  • Experience with Docker Hardened Images, Docker Scout, MCP Gateway, MCP Toolkit, Docker Sandboxes, or Docker Model Runner.

  • Experience deploying and operating coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, or similar) in team or enterprise settings.

  • Experience with air-gapped, regulated, or compliance-driven environments in financial services, healthcare, government, or similar sectors.

  • Contributions to open source projects in the container, Kubernetes, or MCP ecosystems.

  • Prior experience founding or scaling a Forward Deployed Engineering or Professional Services practice.

Visa sponsorship: Docker considers visa sponsorship on a case-by-case basis based on business needs.

_______________________________________________________________________

Compensation & Equity

All full-time roles include equity. Final compensation is determined on factors including but not limited to experience, skills, qualifications, and location.

Europe: €121K – €198K base

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

title: Principal Research Scientist - AI Safety
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Faculty conducts critical red teaming and builds evaluations for misuse capabilities in sensitive areas, such as CBRN, cybersecurity and international security, for several leading frontier model developers and national safety institutes; notably, our work has been featured in OpenAI's system card for o1.

Our commitment also extends to conducting fundamental technical research on mitigation strategies, with our findings published in peer-reviewed conferences and delivered to national security institutes. Complementing this, we design evaluations for model developers across broader safety-relevant fields, including the societal impacts of increasingly capable frontier models, showcasing our expertise across the safety landscape.

About the role

The Principal Research Scientist for AI Safety will be the driving force behind Faculty's small, high-agency research team, shaping the future of safe AI systems. You will lead the scientific research agenda for AI safety, focusing on large language models and other critical systems. This role involves leading researchers, driving external publications, and ensuring alignment with Faculty’s commercial ambition to build trustworthy AI, giving you the opportunity to make a high-impact contribution in a rapidly evolving, critical field.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading the AI safety team's ambitious research agenda, setting priorities aligned with long-term company goals.

  • Conducting and overseeing cutting-edge AI safety research, specifically for large language models and safety-critical AI systems.

  • Publishing high-impact research findings in leading academic conferences and journals.

  • Shaping the research agenda by identifying impactful opportunities and balancing scientific and practical priorities.

  • Helping to build and mentor a growing team of researchers, fostering an innovative and collaborative culture.

  • Collaborating on delivery of evaluations and red-teaming projects in high-risk domains like CBRN and cybersecurity.

  • Positioning Faculty as a thought leader in AI safety through research and strategic stakeholder engagement.

Who we're looking for:

  • You have a proven track record of high-impact AI research, demonstrated through top-tier academic publications or equivalent experience.

  • You possess deep domain knowledge in language models and the evolving field of AI safety.

  • You exhibit strong research judgment and extensive experience in AI safety, including generating and executing novel research directions.

  • You have the ability to conduct and oversee complex technical research projects, with advanced programming skills (Python, standard data science stack) to review team work.

  • You bring excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences.

  • You have a deep understanding of the AI safety research landscape and the ability to build connections to secure resources for impactful work.

    Our Interview Process

    1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

    2. Experience & Theory interview (45 mins)

    3. Research presentation and coding interview (75 mins)

    4. Leadership and Principles interview (60 mins)

    5. Final stage with our CEO (45 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

What you’ll do
