title: Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. title: Senior Launch / Onboarding Manager (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As our Launch Manager, you’ll own the end-to-end delivery of our partner onboarding, from kick-off through go-live and post-launch activities, turning complex, regulated brokerage integrations into predictable, high-quality launches.

Our partner universe is evolving: alongside our direct business with fintechs and neobanks, we’re building a combined offering with dwpbank, bringing a new wave of partners and increased cross-organization complexity. We’re therefore building a dedicated Launch Manager function to run these onboardings with clear ownership.

In this setup, you’ll provide the coordination we’re building, driving the launch plan, steering stakeholders, and ensuring a clean handover to Partner Management once the partner is live. You’ll sit at the center of cross-functional execution, aligning Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions (and, where relevant, dwpbank) to keep delivery on time, within scope, and operationally sound.

In this role you will:

  • Lead end-to-end partner launches by owning the onboarding plan, milestones, and delivery rhythm across Partnerships, Product, Engineering, Operations, and second-line functions — so partners go live faster and with fewer surprises.

  • Drive alignment and decision-making between partnership leads, product counterparts, and executive sponsors — so scope, priorities, and trade-offs are clear and execution stays on track.

  • Run cross-functional workstreams (e.g., API integration readiness, ops/process setup, compliance & controls, partner enablement) to reduce delivery risk and ensure high-quality outcomes in a regulated environment.

  • Design and continuously improve an onboarding playbook (templates, checklists, risk log, status reporting, launch criteria) to standardize onboarding and scale partner delivery without scaling chaos.

  • Own stakeholder communication and reporting to leadership, internal steering committees, and partner counterparts — so progress, risks, and dependencies are transparent and manageable.

  • Manage complex/time-sensitive post-launch activities (feature expansions, new functionalities, operational changes) so existing partners can grow their offering without destabilizing day-to-day operations.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You bring 5+ years of experience in launch management or project/program management within brokerage, fintech, or banking environments.

  • You have a deep understanding of B2B onboarding, including how to structure plans, manage dependencies, and steer stakeholders through complex delivery.

  • You bring strong financial services domain expertise (brokerage knowledge is a plus) and can translate regulatory/operational constraints into actionable delivery plans.

  • You have led complex cross-functional teams across business, product, engineering, and second-line functions, driving outcomes without formal authority.

  • You are comfortable mixing methods (waterfall, agile, hybrid) and pragmatically using tools like onboarding plans, risk logs, and reporting to get the job done.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and complexity, take ownership end-to-end, and can zoom out for the plan while still digging into the messy details needed to execute.

  • Communicate exceptionally well in English and German (C1+) building trust quickly, leading tough conversations calmly, and keeping momentum across senior internal and external stakeholders.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 day or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Joure
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Joure. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • middagdienst: 11:00 tot 19:30 uur;

  • nachtdienst: 02:00 tot 11:30 uur.

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  4. Aanbod: is er een match? Dan doen we je een aanbod.

title: Senior long-term oil analyst
descriptionHtml:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
About the Role

As a Senior Long-Term Oil Analyst, you will own Kpler’s strategic multi-decade outlook for crude oil, refined products, and alternative liquid fuels within the evolving global energy system. Bridging macro-economic forecasting and physical trade flows, you will anchor long-term supply, demand, and transition scenarios directly into Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level intelligence. In this high-visibility research role, your insights and published analysis will guide executive decision-makers, commercial traders, and investors navigating structural market transformations, capital allocation, and decarbonization pathways.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead long-term market research and scenario modeling: Spearhead Kpler's multi-decade (5 to 25+ year) research coverage and fundamental supply, demand, and trade scenarios for crude oil, refined products, NGLs, and low-carbon fuels.
  • Analyze structural market drivers and transition pathways: Deliver in-depth research on upstream capital investment, OPEC+ and non-OPEC capacity shifts, refinery configuration trends, transport electrification, and evolving environmental policies.
  • Anchor macro projections in granular trade flows: Leverage Kpler’s proprietary cargo-level tracking to translate multi-decade macro perspectives into actionable implications for regional balances, trade routes, refining margins, and midstream infrastructure.
  • Author authoritative research publications: Produce regular, high-impact outlook publications, strategic research notes, and thematic market commentary under Kpler’s Insights banner, clearly framing key assumptions and structural uncertainties.
  • Synthesize cross-commodity dynamics: Collaborate with Kpler’s Gas, LNG, and Power research analysts to ensure cohesive, system-wide market assumptions, while benchmarking models against international agencies such as the IEA, EIA, and OPEC.
  • Serve as a trusted market authority: Represent Kpler’s research in executive client briefings, commercial advisory sessions, industry webinars, and specialist media engagements.

    • Experience & Background

    Essential:

  • 5+ years of prior experience in energy market analysis, energy modelling or strategy, with a focus on oil and liquids markets
  • Proven experience building and maintaining supply and demand or scenario models, including a good understanding of the drivers of long-term outlooks
  • Strong understanding of the oil and refined products value chain and of energy transition dynamics
  • Experience in producing independent market analysis and insights
  • Skilled at conducting complex analyses across multiple datasets using advanced data analytics tools
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

    • Desirable:

  • Knowledge of gas, LNG, power or low-carbon fuels and how they interact with liquids markets
  • Previous experience using Kpler data or other cargo tracking tools
  • Experience with SQL, Python, R, or other data science tools

title: (Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
(Senior) M&A Manager Healthcare (w/m/d)

München – Vollzeit, Hybrid-Modell, mit VSOP

Du willst nicht einfach nur Deals abschließen, du willst die hausärztliche Versorgung in Deutschland nachhaltig verändern.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Zahlen, hier geht es um Menschen, die dank deiner Arbeit wieder rechtzeitig die richtige Behandlung erhalten.

10–20 Telefonate pro Tag, mehrere Parallel‑Deals und ein Jahresgehalt von bis zu 120 k € sind für dich Normalität, nicht Ausnahme.

Unser Kunde

Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich Digital Health und moderne medizinische Versorgung mit Sitz in München.

Das Unternehmen verbindet klassische hausärztliche Versorgung mit digitalen Lösungen und baut deutschlandweit ein Netzwerk moderner Praxen auf. Ziel ist es, Versorgung für chronisch kranke Patienten messbar besser zu machen und gleichzeitig Ärzten moderne Strukturen zu bieten.

Die Rolle sitzt direkt an der Schnittstelle aus Healthcare, Wachstum, Strategie und M&A.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Du führst M&A-Prozesse eigenständig von Erstkontakt bis Signing

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Ärzten und Praxisinhabern statt nur mit Datenräumen

  • Du bekommst viel Verantwortung in einem stark wachsenden Umfeld

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Management und Investorenumfeld zusammen

  • VSOP-Beteiligung sorgt dafür, dass Wachstum nicht nur auf PowerPoint existiert

  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit und echter Einfluss auf die Expansion

  • Die Mischung aus Healthcare, Verhandlung, Beziehungsebene und M&A ist selten. Viele reden über „Impact“, hier beeinflusst deine Arbeit tatsächlich Versorgungstrukturen.

Aufgaben

  • Du steuerst den gesamten Akquisitionsprozess von Arztpraxen und MVZs deutschlandweit

  • Du führst Verhandlungen direkt mit Praxisinhabern und Entscheidern

  • Du koordinierst externe Partner für Legal, Financial und Commercial Due Diligence

  • Du baust Beziehungen zu Ärzten, Maklern und relevanten Netzwerken auf

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Finance Business Cases und Bewertungen

  • Du bereitest Entscheidungsunterlagen für Management und Board auf

  • Du steuerst mehrere parallele Deals und behältst Timelines, Risiken und Erfolgswahrscheinlichkeiten im Blick

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre nachweisbare M&A‑Erfahrung mit direkter Akquisition von Hausarztpraxen oder MVZs, inklusive erfolgreich abgeschlossener Transaktionen

  • End‑to‑End‑Deal‑Ownership: Du hast eigenverantwortlich von der Sourcing‑Phase bis zum Closing gesteuert

  • Ausgeprägte operative Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Deals gleichzeitig zu managen

  • Stark ausgeprägte Beziehungs‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten gegenüber Praxisinhabern und Ärzt:innen

  • Masterabschluss (M.A., M.Sc. o. Ä.)

  • Deutsch C1‑Niveau und exzellente Kommunikations‑ sowie Empathiefähigkeiten

  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise und idealerweise Erfahrung im Healthcare‑Umfeld

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Keine praktische Erfahrung im Erwerb von Arztpraxen oder MVZs – reine M&A‑Theorie reicht nicht

  • Nur beratende Tätigkeiten ohne eigenständige Transaction‑Ownership

title: Senior Manager, Australia Communications
descriptionHtml:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril is building technology for the defence challenges of today and tomorrow. In Australia, that means working with the ADF, industry and partners to develop and deliver capabilities that can make a difference in the defence of our nation.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to help tell that story. You will turn complex programs and technology into clear, credible communications for Australian audiences. You will lead media engagement, develop narratives around our work, support senior leaders and help the team communicate through major milestones and fast-moving issues.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set direction, write exceptionally well and deliver at pace. You will work across the Australian business and with colleagues internationally, balancing long-term reputation building with the demands of a busy news cycle.

The Australian business is growing rapidly, with over 300 employees, so this role will also support our internal comms work, engaging our employees and making sure our people are bought into the mission.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute communications plans that support Anduril’s priorities in Australia.
  • Build relationships with defence, technology, business and national media; identify opportunities to tell substantive stories about our work.
  • Write and edit announcements, speeches, opinion pieces, briefing materials, social content and executive messages.
  • Advise Australian leaders on messaging, interviews, speaking opportunities and sensitive issues.
  • Work with program, engineering and business teams to understand their work and explain its relevance to customers and the broader public.
  • Plan communications for product and program milestones, partnerships, events and other significant moments.
  • Manage reactive media enquiries and help prepare for issues or crises with sound judgement and clear processes.
  • Coordinate with global communications colleagues so Australian communications reflect local priorities and the company’s wider direction.
  • Own internal communications for Anduril Australia, keeping employees informed about business priorities, program milestones and decisions that affect their work.
  • Partner with Australian leaders to plan and deliver clear, timely updates, including all-hands meetings, leadership messages and major announcements.
  • Help teams understand how their work contributes to Anduril’s mission, connecting progress across programs, functions and locations.
  • Measure what is working and improve plans based on outcomes, feedback and changes in the external environment.

What you’ll bring

  • Significant experience in communications, media relations or public affairs, including ownership of complex projects from strategy through execution.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to make technical subjects understandable without losing accuracy.
  • Strong knowledge of the Australian media and policy environment, ideally including defence, national security or technology.
  • A record of advising senior leaders and working in executive communications
  • Confidence working directly with journalists and handling sensitive or high-stakes issues.
  • The curiosity to learn how a product works, the judgement to know what matters to an audience, and the discipline to check the details.
  • A practical, collaborative approach and the ability to move between strategic planning and hands-on delivery.
  • Aligned on the mission and the opportunity and challenge that faces our nation today
  • A sense of humour and a collaborative spirit!

Experience in technology, defence, government or a similarly complex sector would be valuable. What matters most is your ability to earn trust, find the real story and communicate it clearly.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including: 

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

  • No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

  • Please always verify communications:
    • Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an ----- address.
    • Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to

    • Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is ----- before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

    • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to 

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/. 

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

title: Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement
descriptionHtml:
Every team has AI. Few have mastered it. Humans were built to adapt, but AI is now moving faster than most workforces can.

Multiverse is the AI adoption layer: the missing link between the AI tools that companies have invested in and the people expected to use them.

Our ambition is to put AI capability in every worker’s hands. Apprenticeships got us started: we’ve trained over a third of the UK’s data and AI apprentices, worked with a third of the FTSE 100, and generated £2bn+ in verified ROI. Now Mastry, our new adaptive learning platform, takes that further, guiding a company’s AI workforce transformation from start to finish. Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

Senior Manager, Coach & Instructor Enablement

FTC 14 months

Coach & Instructor Enablement exists to make the delivery organisation measurably better at retaining learners and delivering successful outcomes consistently, predictably and at scale.

You will enhance our existing strategy and lead the team through its exciting next stage of growth. The team will form around four capability pillars and a new Enablement Operations platform. You will be building that structure while it delivers across a large delivery organisation that supports thousands of learners. Priorities will shift underneath you as delivery data moves, and part of the job is deciding what starts, what stops, and most importantly what must not slip.

This is a role for a strong operator who excels at influencing and collaborating across complex teams and departments. A proven track record of getting work done across teams with clear asks, embedding shared measures of success, and creating an environment where there is no ambiguity about who owns what is are the keys to success within this role.

You will lead a team of six specialists supporting hundreds of coaches and instructors across all learner programmes.

What you'll own

  • Delivery Fundamentals: the standard for what good coaching and instruction look like, QA against that standard, calibration in partnership with Delivery and Quality

  • Operational & Regulatory Change: every coach and instructor has the process, tooling and regulatory knowledge to deliver, and gets it before the change reaches a learner.

  • Technical Skills & Programme Requirements: coaches and instructors are current and designated on the technical content they deliver.

  • Timely Assessment & Achievement: shared ownership for timely learner achievement.

  • Enablement Operations & Systems: the foundation underneath all four.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set the direction and deliver results.. Define the owner, mandate and measures for each pillar, help prioritise and sequence work, and make trade-offs needed to deliver the greatest business impact.

  • Build Enablement Operations SMEs own skills and requirements while operations gets the enablement to the right people, on time, and tracks who did it.

  • Prioritise and re-prioritise without drama. Run a single visible enablement roadmap, say no clearly, and re-sequence when delivery data, business need or regulatory change demands it.

  • Delivering through other teams. Partner with Learning on programme and content change, Operations on process, Quality on the coaching standard, and Delivery on learner retention and achievement.

  • Close the feedback loop with Delivery Leadership. React to performance trends from monthly calibration, observations and delivery data.

  • Lead and develop six specialists through regular 1:1s, feedback, and clear individual measures.

Skills & Qualifications

  • A proven track record of balancing cross functional relationships and their priorities while still delivering impact in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

  • A demonstrable operator. You have taken something loosely defined and made it run: clear owners, measures, cadence, reporting. You are comfortable in the detail and you finish things.

  • Fluent cross-functionally. You have delivered outcomes that depended almost entirely on teams you did not manage, and you can explain exactly how.

  • Comfortable in ambiguity and shifting priorities. You decide on incomplete information, name the risk you are accepting, and change course without losing momentum or the team's confidence.

  • Data-led. You use performance data to decide where to intervene and to hold others accountable.

  • AI-native operator. You build cadences that use AI to do the collating and chasing, so the process scales with the team rather than growing headcount alongside it.

  • Experience of enablement, L&D, capability building, delivery operations or quality in an at-scale frontline organisation.

  • Apprenticeships, regulated education or another regulated delivery environment is a strong advantage. You can hold quality, compliance and pace at the same time.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write the one-pager a senior leader acts on, and run the calibration session a coach finds useful.

Benefits

  • Time off: 27 days holiday (including 3 winter shutdown days) and bank holidays, plus 5 extra days off (1 life event, 2 volunteer days and 2 summer shutdown days).

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

  • Equity for all: we believe that when Multiverse wins, we all win, which is why every permanent employee receives share options.

  • Financial security: life insurance at 3x salary, a workplace pension with 4% contribution from us, Cycle to Work and a Tech Scheme.

  • Family support: enhanced maternity and paternity leave, adoption and shared parental leave, paid leave after pregnancy loss, and a workplace nursery scheme.

  • Hybrid working: 3 days a week in the office - except for Coaches & Instructors who come into the office 1 day per month. Plus 10 days a year to work from anywhere.

  • Work perks: quarterly team socials, company-wide events, happy hours, lunch delivered to the office once a week, fully stocked snack bar and a drinks fridge!

We’re an equal opportunities employer. And proud of it. Every applicant and employee is afforded the same opportunities regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. This will never change. Read our Equality, Diversity & Inclusion policy here.

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

Multiverse is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of our learners. We expect all employees to share this commitment and adhere to our Safeguarding Policy, our Prevent Policy and all other Multiverse company policies. Successful applicants will be required to undertake at least a Basic check via the Disclosure Barring Service (DBS).

descriptionHtml:

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself.   • Make the call on buildability issues before release for construction, balancing cost, schedule, quality and maintainability.

Sequencing and modular interfaces

  • Set installation and workface strategies aligned with procurement, commissioning and site logistics.

  • Define modular and off-site interfaces with OSM, including module sizes, tolerances, transport and lift constraints.

Assurance and improvement

  • Report constructability risk and performance to delivery leadership and drive changes into the reference design.

  • Turn site lessons into standards that cut rework from one site to the next.

What we are looking for

  • Senior construction delivery leadership on data centres or complex mission-critical projects.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical, electrical and structural interfaces, sequencing, logistics and temporary works.

  • Experience using BIM or coordinated models to resolve buildability issues at scale.

  • Credibility to challenge designers, contractors and senior stakeholders and get decisions made.

Nice to have

  • Modular or off-site manufactured infrastructure.

  • High-density AI facilities and liquid-cooled equipment installation.

  • International construction programmes.

title: (Senior) Manager People & Organisational Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a passion for organisational design and a drive to boost effectiveness?

At Valcon, we are looking for experienced candidates with an ambition to improve organizational effectiveness and a passion for organisational design. Besides a proven track record in this domain, we value strong team players with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to carry out great ideas in practice. You fit in our team when you have highly developed analytical and conceptual thinking skills and when you can easily draw insights and conclusions from complex matters.

What will you do?

Your primary focus lies in the organizational transformation process, where translation of ambition and strategy to an effective orgnisational design take a center stage. In close collaboration with our clients, you analyse challenges and identify improvement potential in the integral organisational design, such as processes, systems, functions and organisational structure. You play an important role in advancing Valcon’s capabilities with a strong emphasis on the People & Organisational Transformation domain.

  • A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy.

  • At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models.

  • Affinity with the translation of strategic goals into resulting implications for employees.

  • Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders.

  • Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills.

  • Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships.

  • Fluent in Dutch and English.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Managing organisational changes, from problem analysis, optimization of processes to designing and implementing new business models.

  • Developing different organisational transformation strategies and approaches (making an ambition strategy, design and guiding principles, organizational structure and required communication and engagement plans) that fits the client’s challenge best.

  • Managing and regulating Organisational Transformation projects, with high emphasis on both delivery as stakeholder management.

  • Building and maintaining a relevant network with current and new clients

  • Managing and guiding consultants during projects and in their personal development.

  • Co-develop one of the industries in which Valcon is present.

  • Building and promoting ‘Valcon’; focus on expanding the Business Change Capability, and primary Organisational Transformation.

What do we offer you?

  • Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues.

  • An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting.

  • Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself.

  • Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Competitive and transparent salary according to our pay structure, an annual bonus of up to 4 months’ salary (depending on seniority level, individual performance, and company results), and a monthly expense allowance of €95.

  • A company car or mobility budget.

  • A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year).

  • An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners.

  • The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year.

  • A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events.

What do you bring to the table?

  • A completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degree with a numerical component.

  • At least 5 years of relevant work experience including experience in consultancy.

  • At least 3 years of experience with the implementation of new business models.

  • Affinity with the translation of strategic goals into resulting implications for employees.

  • Strong personality; you can retain your point of view while managing difficult stakeholders.

  • Real team-player with excellent communication & analytical skills.

  • Commercial expertise; experience in building and maintaining customer relationships.

  • You’re fluent in both Dutch and English.

Ready to apply?

Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? title: Senior Manager Retail & Products met Supply Chain-ervaring
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een Manager of Senior Manager met een focus op Supply Chain en ben jij klaar voor de volgende stap? Ben je op zoek naar een club waar ondernemerschap en groei centraal staan? Mis je de ruimte om echt impact te maken in je huidige rol? Spreekt groei en het meewerken aan innovatieve ontwikkelingen je aan? Dan is dit dé vacature voor jou!

Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's die echt verandering en uitdagingen omarmen, hebben we een unieke "high-daring", "high-caring" cultuur gecreëerd, die buitengewone mensen aantrekt en hen inspireert om de grenzen voor zichzelf en onze klanten te verleggen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Manager Retail & Products ben je dé gesprekspartner voor bestuurders in de retail, FMCG, (maak)industrie, logistiek en groothandel die hun supply chain klaar willen maken voor de toekomst. Of het nu gaat om een toekomstbestendig DC-netwerk, slimmere planning en/of forecasting, of een omnichannelstrategie die ook in de operatie werkt: jij vertaalt hun ambitie naar een scherpe strategie en zorgt dat de verandering ook echt landt.

Daarvoor werk je met multidisciplinaire teams uit strategieconsulting, data & AI, technologie en organisatorische en digitale transformatie. Zo combineer je analyses, scenario’s en businesscases met de technologie en verandering die nodig zijn om resultaat te boeken.

Als senior manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor grote klanttrajecten en een vertrouwde sparringpartner op C-level. Je bouwt accounts uit, ziet de volgende vraag van de klant al aankomen en zet die om in nieuwe opdrachten. Daarbij krijg je alle vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel voor het project als voor de accountontwikkeling.

Daarnaast bouw je mee aan het Retail & Products-team zelf: je ontwikkelt onze supply chain-proposities, helpt collega’s groeien en bent een drijvende kracht achter onze verdere gezamenlijke groei.

Wat betekent dit voor jou?
Je komt te werken bij een Great Place to Work met zeer tevreden medewerkers en klanten (NPS > 65; ruim boven het marktgemiddelde). Bovendien realiseren we groei met dubbele cijfers en hebben we onze blik stevig gericht op verdere uitbreiding. We zitten met onze eigen succesvolle transformatie midden in een spannend avontuur! Waarom zou je er geen deel van uitmaken?

Wat zeggen je toekomstige collega's?

“IG&H is echt anders dan andere strategieconsultants. Wij hebben een warme benadering en een zorgzame cultuur. De scherpte van IG&H-consultants en de state-of-the-art digitale oplossingen, die leiden tot daadwerkelijke resultaten bij onze klanten, halen het beste in mij naar boven – elke dag.” Cazijn Langeler – Managing Director Retail & Products

“De huidige groeifase van IG&H biedt een geweldige kans om mezelf te ontwikkelen op een breed spectrum aan vaardigheden, omringd en ondersteund door heel veel intelligente mensen.” Guus Boonstra – Manager Retail & Products


Wat neem jij mee?

· Afgeronde universitaire master.

· Minimaal 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren in strategie en digital consulting.

· Sterke management- en communicatievaardigheden; je weet stakeholders te verbinden en C-levelklanten te activeren.

· Sterk analytisch vermogen en conceptueel denken.

· Diepgaande kennis van Supply Chain en Logistiek.

· Een relevant netwerk in de Retail, Industriële, Logistieke, Groothandel en/of FMCG-sector.

· Je ontwikkelt geavanceerde businessmodellen en langetermijnstrategieën.

· Ondernemende instelling en drive om verandering en groei te realiseren – zowel bij onze klanten als binnen onze eigen organisatie.

Wat we jou bieden:

· Werken bij een Great Place to Work met een prettige werksfeer en enthousiaste collega's die je ondersteunen.

· Een mooie kans om een actieve bijdrage te leveren aan de verdere groei van de organisatie.

· Direct een vast contract voor onbepaalde tijd.

· Uitstekend salaris en arbeidsvoorwaarden.

· Auto van de zaak / goede mobiliteitsregeling.

· Een fulltime dienstverband, maar indien gewenst ook de mogelijkheid om (al dan niet tijdelijk) parttime te werken (80%), minimaal 4 dagen per week.

· Wij ondersteunen incidenteel werken in het buitenland voor maximaal 4 weken per jaar.

· 25 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er meer op te nemen.

· De mogelijkheid om na 3 jaar dienstverband een sabbatical op te nemen.

· IG&H faciliteert een Healthy Human-programma, waarbij je begeleiding krijgt bij alle aanpassingen in het leven, zoals het krijgen van een kind of het verzorgen van een ziek familielid.

· Royale bonusregeling.

· En nog veel meer, waar we je graag meer over vertellen.


Waarom IG&H?

IG&H helpt toonaangevende bedrijven in de sectoren Gezondheid, Retail & Products en Financial Services te transformeren. Samen met onze technologiepartners van wereldklasse helpen we onze klanten vooruit en blijven we relevant. Met inzichtelijk advies, mooie designs en ongeëvenaarde digitale platforms. Onze uitzonderlijke resultaten komen voort uit het succesvol op elkaar afstemmen van mensen, bedrijfsprocessen en technologie. Met meer dan 900 getalenteerde collega's in de verschillende teams, die verandering en uitdagingen oprecht omarmen, hebben we een unieke, zeer gedurfde en zorgzame cultuur gecreëerd. We trekken bijzondere mensen aan en inspireren hen om de grenzen te verleggen voor zichzelf en onze klanten.


Ben je enthousiast?

Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met één van onze recruiters via

We willen dat onze werknemers de diversiteit van de maatschappij weerspiegelen. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is er trots op een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een baan, ongeacht hun afkomst, religie, geslacht, genderexpressie, seksuele geaardheid, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit! Maar het allerbelangrijkste is dat we allemaal trots zijn op onze prestaties bij onze klanten en daarom zijn we niet voor niets een Great Place to Work.


Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij werken met preferred suppliers. Stuur ons alstublieft geen ongevraagde cv's.

title: (Senior) Manager Risk & Restructuring – Leveraged Finance / Special Situations (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:

title: Senior Marketing Manager*in - Customer Journey (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
eRecht24 ist als eine der bekanntesten digitalen Informationsplattformen rund um die Themen Internetrecht, Datenschutz und E-Commerce am Legal Tech Markt vertreten und hilft täglich tausenden Webseitenbetreibern und Agenturen dabei ihre Webseiten rechtssicher zu gestalten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit im Bereich Marketing mit Fokus auf Customer Journey, die Verantwortung übernimmt, strategische Entscheidungen mitprägt und unsere Marketingmaßnahmen entlang der gesamten Customer Journey nachhaltig weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest die Customer Journey bei eRecht24 End-to-End - vom ersten Markenkontakt über organische Kanäle bis zur langfristigen Kundenbindung. Du sorgst dafür, dass aus isolierten Kanal-Aktivitäten ein zusammenhängendes Kundenerlebnis wird.

  • Du entwickelst und pflegst eine kanalübergreifende Customer Journey Map, die alle relevanten Touchpoints, Phasen und Übergänge sichtbar macht

  • Du identifizierst die kritischen Momente in der Journey - wo verlieren wir potenzielle Kunden, wo liegen die größten Conversion-Hebel?

  • Du orchestrierst die Zusammenarbeit der Marketing-Teams entlang der Journey, damit Kanäle sich gegenseitig verstärken statt in Silos zu arbeiten

  • Du entwickelst Konzepte für Schlüsselmomente im Lifecycle: Onboarding, Activation, Upgrade, Retention und Win-back

  • Du schärfst Buyer Personas auf Basis von echten Nutzerdaten und sorgst dafür, dass unterschiedliche Zielgruppen die richtige Journey durchlaufen

  • Du bringst die Kundenperspektive in datengetriebene Marketing-Entscheidungen ein und verbindest quantitative Funnel-Analysen mit qualitativen Insights

Qualifikation

Must-haves

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing mit Schwerpunkt Customer Journey, Lifecycle Marketing oder Growth Marketing

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung im Mapping und Optimieren von Customer Journeys über mehrere Kanäle und Funnel-Stufen hinweg

  • Starkes Verständnis des gesamten Funnels - von Awareness über Lead-Generierung und Nurturing bis Conversion und Retention

  • Cross-funktionale Arbeitserfahrung: Du kannst Brücken zwischen Spezialistenteams bauen und kanalübergreifend denken

  • Analytisch und konzeptionell stark: Du kombinierst Daten (Conversion Rates, Attribution, Kohorten) mit Nutzerverständnis

  • Erfahrung im SaaS- oder Subscription-Umfeld (Freemium-to-Premium, Churn-Prevention, LTV-Optimierung)

  • Fließend Deutsch mindestens (C2)

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation und Journey-basierter Kommunikation

  • Kenntnisse in Attribution Modeling und Cross-Channel-Tracking

  • Legal-Tech- oder B2B-SaaS-Hintergrund

Benefits

  • Ein dynamisches Team mit Zusammenhalt und offener Kommunikation

  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

  • Gründliches Onboarding und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Modernes Büro in Berlin-Charlottenburg (Nähe Ku’damm)

  • Kostenlose Snacks, Suppen, Kaffee, Limonaden und Wasser

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und lockere Get-togethers

  • Leistungsgerechte Vergütung

Deine Rolle: Du arbeitest nicht in einem einzelnen Kanal, sondern cross-funktional über alle Marketing-Teams hinweg. Du bist die Person, die das große Bild hält und sicherstellt, dass die einzelnen Disziplinen gemeinsam eine kohärente Journey liefern. Du reportest direkt an die Marketing-Leitung.

Kontext: eRecht24 ist Deutschlands führende Legal-Tech-Plattform mit über 400.000 Nutzern. Unsere Customer Journey hat mehrere klar definierte Stufen - von organischem Erstkontakt über kostenlose Tools bis zum Premium-Abo. Die Journey ist in den einzelnen Kanälen teilweise gut verstanden, aber das kanalübergreifende Bild fehlt noch. Genau das ist dein Job.

Arbeitsweise: Remote-first, mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in Berlin für Workshops und Strategie-Sessions. Wir arbeiten datengetrieben und setzen KI-Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag ein.

Standort: Hybrid in Berlin, mindestens drei Präsenztage pro Woche vor Ort

title: Senior Methods Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Methods Engineer to join our production plant in Wissous. In our context of fast growth, you will act as the connector between Production, Quality, Supply Chain, and our Industrialisation & Automation team.

We are not asking for you to maintain what someone else built, we are asking for you to build it yourself: every process, standard, lean system.

  

Responsibilities

An ideal day in this position starts on the shopfloor: quick walk, performance standup, catching issues early.

Mid-day splits between desk work (time studies, routing updates, ERP automation) and cross-functional sessions with Production, Quality, and the Automation team.

Afternoons are hands-on: kaizen walks, work instruction updates, problem-solving with supervisors.

You close the day feeding data back into the system.

Roughly 50% floor, 50% structured engineering work, every day. In a nutshell:

  • Continuous Improvement & Shopfloor Performance

  • Production Line Design & Internal Flow

  • Process Knowledge & Documentation

  • Automation Roadmap Contribution

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Diploma in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Production Engineering. A strong profile from a different engineering discipline associated with strong shopfloor experience is also valued.

  • Experience in building methods structure in a fast-moving manufacturing environment (written work instructions from scratch, run time studies, 5S,...). Has owned a lean improvement roadmap, not just contributed to one.

  • Ideally has navigated a ramp-up, a new plant launch, or a new product introduction where the structure did not exist yet.

  • Detail-oriented, rigorous, and comfortable working on the shop floor.

  • Team player with good communication skills.

  • Very good level of English and French

  • Full alignment with Harmattan AI's mission and willingness to go the extra mile to support our growth.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Senior ML Ops (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for a Senior MLOps Engineer to join the ML Platform (TIGER) team in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.

Your mission will be to power every ML and AI initiative at Doctolib — from experiment to reliable production service. You will build and operate the foundations that let data scientists, ML engineers, and AI teams ship models and agents safely, fast, and at scale, from classic machine learning to self-hosted generative AI. You will contribute directly to the reliability and performance of AI-powered features that improve the daily lives of millions of patients and thousands of healthcare professionals across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Partner with data scientists, ML & AI engineers to take models from experimentation to reliable, scalable production deployment.

  • Operate and evolve the orchestration layer for training, serving and evaluation workloads, built on GCP and AWS using Kubernetes (GKE) and Ray-based platforms (Anyscale) — including CI/CD, versioning and automated testing pipelines that carry a model from the registry to a served endpoint.

  • Build the tools, templates and best practices (Terraform modules, Kubernetes CRDs and operators, GitOps workflows, internal libraries) that let any ML team deploy and operate their models and agents safely and consistently.

  • Ensure the availability, reliability and performance of ML systems in production across training, serving and the agents platform; define and track SLOs; take part in on-call and incident response for the whole stack.

  • Build and maintain observability for ML systems: infrastructure and model health via Datadog, and evaluation/quality signals via Braintrust, catching regressions before they reach users.

  • Work hand in hand with AI inference engineers on the shared foundations of our self-hosted LLM stack (model registry, deployment automation, shared GPU capacity), and stay current with MLOps practices for classic ML, generative AI and agentic systems alike.

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have prior experience as an MLOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer for ML applications, AI Infrastructure Engineer, or Platform Engineer for AI, or in a similar role

  • Are proficient in Python, Shell scripting and Terraform, with a solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, concepts and trends

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production and GitOps tools (e.g. ArgoCD), and have built MLOps pipelines for containerizing models and solutions with Docker

  • Have experience with cloud platforms such as GCP (GKE, BigQuery) and/or AWS or Azure equivalents, and with observability tools such as Datadog

  • Have hands-on experience with an experiment tracking/model registry tool (e.g. MLflow) and an LLM evaluation/observability tool (e.g. Braintrust)

  • Are a strong team player with excellent communication and documentation skills, comfortable with an evolving scope, and pragmatic about build vs. buy decisions

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have hands-on experience with Kubernetes-native agent abstractions (CRDs/operators, e.g. kagent) or building production agent runtimes

  • Have experience with ML model quantization and optimization

  • Have experience with GPU sharing/partitioning technologies (e.g. NVIDIA MIG, time-slicing, MPS)

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

Our interview process

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

title: Senior Mobile Security Developer - Contract (Inside IR35)
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Mobile Security Developer (Inside IR35) for an exciting new 6-month initial contract joining our world-class digital technology consultancy, home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. As a Senior Mobile Security Developer, you will define squad-level technical architecture and technical approach. You are a technical expert who ensures quality, security, and compliance across projects, driving robust and scalable solutions.

This role will be pivotal in building, delivering, and driving the security of our mobile platform, while being an integral part of our full-stack mobile practice, contributing to end-to-end development and security excellence across both front-end and back-end mobile systems.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Design and Delivery of a World-Class Security Framework: Lead the design and delivery of security services, including mobile penetration testing, research, consultancy, and advisory engagements.

  • Technical Strategy & Architecture: Define secure technical approaches, identify risks, and develop effective threat models and mitigation strategies.

  • Strategic Planning: Translate business objectives into technical strategy and ensure technical roadmaps align with long-term client goals.

  • Agile Practices: Expertise in Agile methodologies, with a focus on resolving impediments and driving adoption across teams.

  • Client Engagement: Communicate effectively with clients, manage expectations, and provide practical, risk-based security recommendations.

  • Continuous Improvement & Collaboration: Drive innovation, adopt emerging security practices, share knowledge, and support team success.


What you'll bring:

We are seeking a highly technical expert with a strong focus on mobile platform security. You should bring:

  • Mobile Security Expertise: Strong hands-on knowledge of Android and iOS security fundamentals, common mobile threats and vulnerabilities, security architecture, controls, and mitigation techniques.

  • Mobile Security Testing: Practical experience in mobile penetration testing, security assessments, threat modelling, and implementing or assessing security controls.

  • Security Problem Solving: A systematic and analytical approach to identifying, investigating, and resolving mobile security issues.

  • Authentication & Cryptography: Strong understanding of authentication, authorisation, cryptography, encryption, and secure design principles, with the ability to recommend appropriate cryptographic controls.

  • Continuous Improvement: A proactive approach to improving security practices, tooling, controls, and ways of working.

Desirable knowledge & experience:

  • Mobile Security Tooling & Analysis: Experience with reverse engineering, analysis techniques, and tools such as Burp Suite Pro, Frida, Objection, JADX, IDA Pro, Hopper, Radare, ADB, Apktool, YARA, Xcode, and Android Studio.

  • Development & Reverse Engineering: Familiarity with C, Java, Kotlin, Objective-C, Swift, JavaScript, Python or Bash, and ideally ARM/ARM64 assembly.

  • Security Research: Awareness of emerging security technologies, Cloud security, and developments in mobile operating systems, APIs, tools, and security libraries.

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

title: Senior National Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
The Practical Detail
Location: Hybrid | Remote

Why this role matters
In your first year, you will deliver an ambitious growth plan for Flora Food Group's largest customer, Bidfood, driving both sales and margin across the full P&L. This role is critical to strengthening Flora's position in the food service market by embedding a joint business plan that aligns Flora's brand priorities with Bidfood's commercial strategy. You will shape how our brands are listed, promoted, and grow within a key account that influences menus and food trends across the UK. Your work will directly impact the availability and innovation of better food in kitchens nationwide.

What you'll do

  • Own the Bidfood P&L, managing pricing, promotions, trade spend, and trade promotion management accruals to achieve sales and margin growth.
  • Lead the joint business plan and negotiate annual trading terms to ensure Flora's brands are well positioned and invested in.
  • Build and maintain relationships across all levels of Bidfood, from senior buyers to depot and logistics teams, to improve service and unlock commercial opportunities.
  • Deliver new product development and innovation launches on time and at the right price, collaborating closely with culinary and new business teams.
  • Champion the push-pull strategy by engaging Bidfood's end users—contract caterers, pubs, hotels, restaurants and Quick Serve Restaurants (QSR) — to grow brand presence and volume.

Performance
You will own the full P&L for the Bidfood account, driving measurable growth in sales and margin while managing trade spend within budget. Your leadership of the joint business plan will ensure alignment between Flora's brand ambitions and Bidfood's commercial goals. Success will be seen in improved brand listings, timely innovation launches, and strong trading terms that support sustainable growth.

Care
You will report directly to Helen Scott and collaborate with internal teams including new business, culinary, supply chain, and demand planning to ensure seamless service delivery. Externally, you will engage with multiple Bidfood functions such as buying, logistics, marketing, and category teams. Your decisions will balance commercial ambition with operational integrity, supporting a lean team environment during a period of organisational change.

Passion
Bidfood is at the heart of food service trends, where culinary culture is shaped. You will connect Flora's innovation pipeline directly to the chefs and kitchens that bring our products to life. Your role will influence how plant-based, indulgent, and culinary food categories evolve in the out-of-home market. Your curiosity about taste, nutrition, and functionality will drive meaningful innovation and brand growth.

About you
You'll bring solid food service experience, ideally managing Bidfood, Brakes, or Booker accounts, with a deep understanding of this route to market. You are commercially rigorous, confident in owning a P&L, and skilled at negotiating assertively while maintaining productive relationships. You sell on brand value, not price, and thrive in a fast-changing, lean environment. Your resilience and solution-oriented mindset help you navigate complex commercial and cultural challenges. You are genuinely interested in food culture and curious about how consumer behaviour and future food trends shape innovation. You understand that strong brands are built by anticipating what's next in taste, nutrition, and functionality, and by translating insight into meaningful consumer experiences.

Where this could lead to
This role typically leads to broader commercial leadership opportunities within Flora Food Group, including potential European roles as the business integrates into a larger unit. There is also scope to move into retail or new business functions. With success, you may take on direct reports and progress into senior management positions within 2 to 3 years.

What's next

title: Senior Partnerships Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to source, negotiate, and scale partnerships that fuel Square seller acquisition, retention, and business growth across the United Kingdom. Partners include referral networks, distributors, service providers, technology platforms, and strategic ecosystems where there is mutual benefit through lead generation, co-sell, co-marketing, and product enablement.

This is a highly visible, hands-on role at the intersection of business development, growth, product, and go-to-market strategy. You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of strategic partnerships — from sourcing and deal structuring through to activation and ongoing optimisation — with a focus on creating partnerships that deliver incredible user experiences for Square sellers. You will work in tight collaboration with Product Marketing to shape partner narratives, positioning, and GTM motions, and partner cross-functionally to drive measurable growth outcomes for the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Sourcing & Deal Execution: Identify, evaluate, and secure high-impact partners; lead negotiations and close large-scale partnership deals and product integrations that advance Square's capabilities and growth.
  • Product Partnership Development: Collaborate closely with Product and Product Marketing to design partnership experiences that delight sellers — ensuring integrations are seamless, valuable, and well-positioned in market.
  • Growth Accountability: Deliver measurable results in lead generation, seller acquisition, and pipeline contribution through your portfolio of strategic partnerships.
  • Activation & Scaling: Launch partnerships with clear GTM plans, co-marketing
    initiatives, and integrated roadmaps; work hand-in-hand with Product Marketing to bring partnerships to life for sellers.
  • Executive Relationship Management: Build and sustain senior-level relationships with partners, ensuring long-term value creation and mutual growth.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Product Marketing, Operations, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to ensure smooth execution and maximum impact. Bring an ownership mentality to how the team operates — actively contributing to team processes, rituals, and ways of working that make us better together.
  • Measurement & Optimisation: Define and track KPIs for partnership success, adjusting strategy and tactics as needed to drive continuous growth.

You Have

  • 8+ years in business development, strategic partnerships, and/or product partnerships, with demonstrated progression in scope and impact
  • Hands-on experience sourcing, negotiating, and closing large-scale partnerships and product integrations
  • Strong collaboration skills with Product Marketing; experience shaping partner positioning, co-marketing, and GTM narratives
  • Demonstrated ability to connect partnership strategy directly to measurable seller acquisition and revenue outcomes
  • Experience working cross-functionally with a broad range of teams, with an ownership mentality
  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with experience engaging at the executive level
  • SaaS, fintech, or payments background strongly preferred.

title: Senior People Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll own initiatives end to end, combining practical People Operations expertise with the ability to build smarter, more automated ways of working across the employee lifecycle.

The job

Taptap Send is growing, with hubs in London, Paris, New York, Dubai and Morocco. You'll shape how its People function scales internationally.

  • Open new countries for hiring: take a jurisdiction from entity and payroll set-up through contracts, benefits and local compliance, so the business can hire there cleanly.

Put AI and automation into practice. Go beyond using AI to write emails or summarise documents. Build workflows, automate repetitive processes and find practical ways to eliminate manual work across People Operations.

You've spent 8+ years in People Ops, HR or a similar operational role, ideally across several countries.

When business priorities and the employee experience pull in different directions, you weigh both and make the call.

London, Dubai or New York. This is an in-person role, with five days a week in the office. As we scale internationally, in-person collaboration is important to how we work, solve problems and build together.
