title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale.

You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation.

You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we're all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes.
  • Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure.
  • Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention.
  • Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact.
  • Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud.
  • Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements.
  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role.

  • 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production.
  • Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language.
  • Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred.
  • Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems.
  • Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms.
  • Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams.
  • Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery.
  • Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk.
  • Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Staff Applied AI Researcher (Agentic Search)
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Staff Applied AI Researcher to join a fast-growing team building an agent-native search platform - the web access layer for AI systems.

You can think of this as Google search, but for AI agents: a system designed for machines, not humans. We are building agentic search, where AI systems actively plan, retrieve, evaluate, and refine information rather than simply returning results. As AI becomes the primary interface to the web, this layer will replace the role of traditional search engines.

We are designing these systems to search and reason over web data in real time, under strict latency and reliability constraints. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

This role comes with ownership over key parts of our applied AI research direction and system design, with a strong expectation of defining new approaches and shipping measurable impact in production. In the first year, you will own a specific part of the search stack, e.g. ranking or iterative retrieval.

What you'll work on:

  • Designing an agent-native search system that handles everything from low-latency single-hop search to complex deep search tasks requiring iterative planning, querying, refinement and reasoning.

  • Training ranking and retrieval models optimized for agent-driven workflows under real world constraints

  • Bringing the latest advances from the research community to our search stack and ship it to production.

Your responsibilities:

  • Drive applied research and technical direction across retrieval and ranking systems

  • Design and evolve multi-stage retrieval architectures (query understanding, rewriting, retrieval, reranking and iterative retrieval)

  • Lead experimentation on modern retrieval approaches (embedding research, sparse and hybrid retrieval, reranking, context compression) and bring them into production

  • Develop methods for grounding LLMs in real-time web data at scale, using trust, quality and freshness signals to surface reliable sources

  • Partner with the evaluation team to define new metrics for agentic systems, where correctness is not reducible to clicks

  • Analyze trade-offs across relevance, latency, and cost, and work closely with engineering to deploy systems that operate at web scale

  • Mentor researchers and engineers and help raise the technical bar of the team

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of experience in applied AI, ML, or software engineering

  • Proven track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production at scale

  • Deep experience with search, retrieval, ranking or building RAG-based assistants

  • Strong understanding of modern deep learning, especially transformers and embeddings

  • Experience with LLM-integrated or knowledge-intensive systems

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and metrics for ML systems

  • Strong programming skills in Python

  • Top-tier publications (ICLR, ICML, NeurIPS, AAAI, EMNLP, ACL)

  • Ability to operate in a fast-moving, product-driven environment with high ownership and autonomy

Nice to haves

  • Background in agentic AI systems (agents, tool use, autonomous workflows)

  • Experience with RL post-training of LLMs or VLMs

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR – We’re looking for an experienced, Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to help build the future of AI-powered software creation. You will be a founding member of our FDE function, working directly with our customers to translate ambitious ideas into real products. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will design, write, and ship production code. It’s a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems with AI that no one has solved before.

 

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

About the role

Most engineering roles place you either close to the product or close to the customer. This role gives you both.

You’ll build alongside customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving technically difficult problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn’t simply to make individual deployments successful: it’s to identify what should become part of the Lovable platform and then build it.

As one of our first Forward Deployed Engineers, you’ll also help define the function - from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it collaborates with customers and our core product teams.

If you want to stay deeply hands-on while shaping a product, a team and a new engineering discipline, this is that role. As you’ll be working directly with customers, travel up to 50% could be required depending on needs.

 

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience building and shipping production software

  • Extensive software engineering skills across the application stack with a track record of writing maintainable, well-tested code and owning what you build in production

  • Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems

  • Ability to prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into production-quality solutions

  • Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users

  • Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and end-to-end ownership

Bonus if you’ve:

  • Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs before

  • Led zero-to-one product development

  • Worked in a founding or early startup environment

 

What you’ll do

  • Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and problems

  • Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs and working production systems

  • Design, code, test, deploy, and operate solutions across Lovable’s frontend and backend

  • Translate insights from real usage into foundational platform improvements

  • Own projects end-to-end—from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration

  • Debug complex issues across application, infrastructure, and AI-system boundaries

  • Shape how Forward Deployed Engineering operates at Lovable, including its engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks

  • Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations

 

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Golang & Rust

  • Frontend: React, Typescript

  • Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers

  • Tooling: Github Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more

 

How we hire

  1. Fill out a short form and hop on a brief intro call with our recruiting team.

  2. Complete a quick live coding exercise.

  3. Show us how you approach problems during several technical interviews.

  4. Show us something you’ve built that makes you proud.

 

About your application

  • Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language

  • We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested please apply through our careers portal.

The team builds and operates highly reliable, scalable and efficient event streaming infrastructure, including Kafka, Event Streaming abstractions (internally called EventBus), messaging platform capabilities, and future streaming technologies. The team also partners closely with Database Reliability, Storage, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure teams to ensure our most critical data and messaging systems remain reliable, operable and cost-efficient at global scale.

These systems support Tier-0 workflows and are foundational to how engineering teams build reliable, event-driven products at scale.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for our event streaming and messaging platforms, balancing reliability, scalability, cost, operability and developer experience.
  • Lead team-level and cross-team initiatives for Kafka, EventBus and related streaming infrastructure, from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, delivery, rollout and adoption.
  • Act as a trusted technical advisor for Kafka, messaging, storage-adjacent and DBRE-related platform decisions across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • Design durable, extensible systems and platform capabilities that can be leveraged by other engineers and teams, reducing duplicated effort and operational risk.
  • Lead the resolution of complex distributed systems problems, including reliability incidents, performance bottlenecks, capacity constraints, data-safety risks and production-operability gaps.
  • Raise the operational excellence bar for Tier-0 infrastructure through observability, automation, incident response, runbooks, operational readiness and continuous improvement.
  • Proactively build alignment with partner teams, including EventBus, Storage, DBRE, SRE, Data Platform and Core Infrastructure, shaping joint goals and mitigating cross-org delivery risks.
  • Mentor and grow engineers through technical guidance, design, feedback, code review, incident review facilitation and knowledge-sharing across the engineering community.
  • Evaluate emerging streaming, storage and automation technologies, including AI-enabled operational tooling where appropriate, and champion pragmatic adoption where they can materially improve quality, velocity or efficiency.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in several of these areas and the judgment to lead others through ambiguity:

  • Significant experience building, operating and evolving distributed systems in production, ideally for platform or infrastructure teams supporting critical workloads.
  • Deep hands-on experience with Kafka or comparable event streaming systems as a platform, infrastructure service or business-critical production dependency.
  • Strong technical leadership skills, with a track record of defining technical direction, shaping roadmaps and leading multi-engineer or cross-team initiatives.
  • Ability to make and own technical decisions in ambiguous situations, using data, operational signals, customer needs and long-term system health to guide tradeoffs.
  • Strong coding ability in Java, Go, Python or similar languages, with a focus on reliable, maintainable, observable and scalable production systems.
  • Experience improving production reliability through automation, observability, capacity management, incident response, operational readiness and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including Linux, networking, storage, JVM-based systems, fault tolerance, backpressure, capacity planning and performance tuning.
  • A force-multiplier mindset: you create leverage through reusable technical foundations, clear documentation, strong engineering practices, mentoring and removing single points of failure.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence platform, infrastructure, product and reliability teams without relying on authority.

Nice to have

  • Experience contributing to Kafka or related open source distributed systems.
  • Experience with Redpanda, WarpStream, AutoMQ, Pulsar or similar streaming technologies.
  • Experience with JVM tuning, diskless streaming architectures or multi-region event streaming platforms.
  • Experience operating Tier-0 infrastructure at large scale, including incident leadership and post-incident improvement programs.
  • Experience with database reliability, storage systems, data platforms or DBRE practices in addition to event streaming.
  • Experience using automation or AI-assisted operational tooling to improve reliability, developer experience or incident response quality.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo (Doordash), you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better.

Working here you can expect to:

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale. Work on complex, always-on infrastructure that impacts millions every day.
  • 🌱 See your impact, fast. Shape the direction of foundational platforms used by teams across Deliveroo, DoorDash and Wolt.
  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership. Lead ambiguous, high-impact technical problems with strong support from peers and leaders.
  • 🌎 A culture built for builders. High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.
  • 💰 Share in the success you help create. Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine. Our interview process typically includes 3–4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

#LI-LW1

 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Staff Software Engineer - Streaming
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Job Description

About the role

Checkout.com is looking for an ambitious Staff Data Engineer to join our Data and AI Platform Team. Our team’s mission is to build a platform where you can create reliable, scalable, AI-powered streaming and batch data applications, and share data across Checkout.com to improve business performance.


The Data and AI Platform team is here to ensure internal stakeholders can easily collect, store, process and utilise data to build AI use cases and data products aiming to solve business problems. Our focus is on maximising the amount of time engineers spend on solving business problems and minimising time spent on technical details around implementation, deployment, and monitoring of their solutions.

We're building for scale. As such, much of what we design and implement today is the technology/infrastructure which will serve hundreds of teams and petabyte-level volumes of data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with stream processing technologies (Kafka and Flink) to build a continuously available large-scale event streaming platform

  • Leverage subject matter and technical expertise to provide leadership, mentoring, and strategic influence across the organisation whilst building strong relationships with engineers and engineering managers

  • Build tooling (modules/SDKs/DSLs) and associated documentation to foster the adoption of the streaming platform by enabling upstream teams and systems to easily publish data and deploy streaming applications

  • Implement all the necessary infrastructure to enable end users to build, host, monitor and deploy their own streaming applications

  • Provide consultancy across the technology organisation to drive the adoption of the platform and unlock event-driven use-cases

  • Participate, translate, run and execute the collection of requirements and architecture/design initiatives into action plans

  • Provide hands-on support for all event-based systems including incident triage and root cause analysis


About You

While experience with our specific tech stack is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in data systems who are eager to learn. The core remit of this role is to own and scale our event streaming capability, not to serve as a general DevOps or infrastructure engineer.

  • Strong presentation and communication skills with a proven track record of influencing engineering organisations

  • Strong engineering background with a track record of implementing and owning event streaming platforms

  • Hands-on experience working with stream technologies, ideally Kafka

  • Experience designing and implementing stream processing applications with Flink

  • Experience working with cloud-based technologies such as AWS (MSK, S3, Lambda, ECS, SNS)

  • Experience with Kubernetes (either self-hosted or on the cloud)

  • Experience with SQL databases

  • Experience working with Docker, container deployment and management

  • Experience describing infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar) as well as designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines

  • Excellent programming skills with at least one of Java or Python

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Tijdens je stage werk je toe naar een van de grootste events binnen Priva: GreenTech Amsterdam in juni 2027. Een event waar veel bij komt kijken en waar je vanaf de voorbereiding tot en met de eventdagen bij betrokken bent. Van planning en leverancierscontact tot materialen, logistiek en de uitvoering op locatie: je ziet letterlijk het resultaat van jouw werk terug op de beursvloer.

Na GreenTech 2027 zit jouw stage erop. Een mooie manier om je stageperiode af te sluiten én een event van formaat van dichtbij mee te maken.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Priva! Priva is een familiebedrijf, gevestigd in het Westland. Het is de missie van Priva om een ​​optimale omgeving te creëren waarin zowel planten als mensen kunnen werken, groeien en zich ontwikkelen. Wij bieden wereldwijde oplossingen voor de tuinbouw, gebouwautomatisering en alles daartussenin. Wij zijn toonaangevend in de ontwikkeling en productie van technologie voor het optimaliseren van omgevingsomstandigheden en processen.

Onze ambitie is om bekend te staan ​​als de toonaangevende technologie- en dienstverlener voor duurzame stedelijke delta's. We zijn er trots op dat onze oplossingen resulteren in een lager verbruik van natuurlijke hulpbronnen, zoals energie en water. Om onze missie en ambitie waar te maken, zijn we op zoek naar toegewijde collega's. We zijn er trots op dat we met ruim 500 collega's, in 16 internationale vestigingen verdeeld over 12 landen samen met meer dan 400 internationale installatiepartners werken aan het leveren van onze duurzame oplossingen en diensten in meer dan 100 landen.


Wat zoeken we in jou?
We zoeken geen student die afwacht tot er een taak wordt gegeven. We zoeken iemand die ziet wat er moet gebeuren en het leuk vindt om het te regelen. Iemand die creatieve ideeen heeft en durft voorstellen te doen.

Je:

  • zoekt een meewerkstage en geen afstudeerstage;

  • bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar;

  • bent georganiseerd en houdt ervan om overzicht te creëren;

  • Beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • vindt het leuk om met verschillende mensen en leveranciers te schakelen;

  • hebt interesse in zakelijke events, beurzen en marketing.

Ervaring met events is mooi meegenomen, maar enthousiasme, initiatief en organisatietalent vinden we belangrijker.

Wat krijg je ervoor terug?
Bij Priva krijg je geen stage waarin je vooral meekijkt. Je wordt onderdeel van het team en krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.Je krijgt:

title: Stage Frontoffice
descriptionHtml:

Een goede eerste indruk maken én jezelf ontwikkelen in gastvrijheid en communicatie? Daar krijg je tijdens jouw meewerkstage bij de Frontoffice volop de kans voor. Omdat we internationaal werken, krijg je ook te maken met buitenlandse bezoekers en telefoongesprekken. Je hoeft natuurlijk nog geen perfecte Engelse gesprekken te voeren. Het belangrijkste is dat je het leuk vindt om Engels in de praktijk te gebruiken en hierin steeds beter te worden. Wanneer het rustiger is bij de Frontoffice, dan ondersteun je bij Travel. Je helpt bijvoorbeeld met de administratie rondom zakelijke reizen, het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens en, waar mogelijk, het boeken van hotels en vluchten. Zo ontdek je niet alleen hoe de Frontoffice werkt, maar krijg je ook inzicht in het organiseren van zakelijke reizen.

  • Bezoekers ontvangen en leren hoe je zorgt voor een gastvrije en professionele ontvangst;

  • Werken met administratieve werkzaamheden en systemen;

  • Ondersteunen bij Travel, bijvoorbeeld bij het verwerken en controleren van reisgegevens;

  • Waar mogelijk helpen bij het boeken van hotels en vluchten voor zakelijke reizen;

Het belangrijkste resultaat van jouw stage? Dat je steeds zelfstandiger kunt meedraaien bij de Frontoffice en jezelf verder ontwikkelt in gastvrijheid, communicatie en administratie. Daarnaast krijg je inzicht in Travel en leer je hoe de organisatie van zakelijke reizen er in de praktijk aan toegaat.

title: Stage - Ingénieur.e SQA Python, banc de test physique - H/F
descriptionHtml:
Chez Withings, nous souhaitons redonner aux individus le contrôle de leur santé.

Nous avons l'obsession de créer des produits beaux et intuitifs, afin que chacun puisse les utiliser facilement au quotidien; nos balances connectées, montres hybrides, tensiomètres, moniteurs de sommeil et tous les dispositifs de notre gamme sont aujourd'hui utilisés par des millions d'utilisateurs.

Notre objectif : permettre la prévention, le dépistage et l'accompagnement d'un certain nombre de maladies chroniques via des produits et des services innovants, afin de révolutionner la manière dont on prend soin de notre santé.

Intégré.e au sein de l'équipe SQA, vous prendrez en main un banc de test physique déjà en production : il valide chaque nuit l'installation, la mise à jour et la configuration d'une vingtaine de modèles de produits Withings (balances, montres, tensiomètres…), pilotés en UART et relais, intégrés à notre CI Jenkins. Ce stage a pour but de penser, concevoir et produire une version améliorée permettant d'automatiser les interactions physiques — prendre une mesure, monter sur une balance, porter une montre, appuyer sur un bouton, vérifier ce que l'écran du dispositif affiche — afin de convertir en tests automatiques (python) les cas de tests exécutés à la main.

En forte interaction avec la QA Firmware, vos principales responsabilités incluront :

- Automatiser les mesures simulables : injection de mesures en dblib côté firmware, synchronisation réelle, vérification dans l'app.

- Explorer l'émulation de device : étudier et prototyper la simulation complète d'un produit sur Raspberry Pi (comportement BLE/Wi-Fi, cycle d'installation, génération de mesures)

- Étendre la couverture du banc existant : nouveaux modèles de produits, nouveaux scénarios (installation, firmware, synchronisation)

- Concevoir, modéliser et réaliser les jig de tests : impression 3D de supports et d'actionneurs, pilotage de relais et d'instrumentation série, lecture de l'état des dispositifs (écran, LED).

- Développer et maintenir les scripts d'automatisation en Python (Appium, pytest) qui orchestrent app mobile (iOS et Android), backend et instrumentation physique.

- Intégrer chaque nouveau scénario à la CI Jenkins pour qu'il tourne chaque nuit, et mesurer la réduction du volume de tests manuels qu'il permet.

- Travailler avec les outils d'aujourd'hui : l'équipe développe avec un harness d'agents de code (Claude Code…) — pipeline de génération de tests, revues assistées ; vous l'utiliserez et contribuerez à l'améliorer.

- Analyser les résultats, remonter les bugs et documenter les composants hardware et software ; participer aux revues de code.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant.e en dernière année d'une formation Bac+5 (école d'ingénieur ou université) et recherchez un stage de fin d'études ;
  • Une excellente maîtrise de Python est indispensable, notamment pour l'automatisation et l'interfaçage avec le hardware (ex : pyserial) ;
  • Des connaissances en conception mécanique et/ou en impression 3D (ex : FreeCAD, Fusion 360, Cura) seraient un atout majeur — le jig est autant mécanique que logiciel ;
  • Des bases en électronique (schémas simples, capteurs, relais, UART) seraient un plus ;
  • Une curiosité pour les agents de code (Claude Code, Codex…) est un plus ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les environnements MacOS et Linux ;
  • Vous êtes passionné.e par les produits high-tech innovants, l'IoT et les enjeux de la qualité logicielle et hardware ;
  • Vous êtes curieux.se, rigoureux.se, autonome, force de proposition et vous disposez d'une bonne capacité d'adaptation pour progresser dans un environnement en constante évolution ;
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour communiquer vos idées et travailler en équipe ;
  • Vous maîtrisez l'anglais technique (lecture et écriture de code et de documentation).

Benefits

Rejoindre l’aventure Withings, c’est :

  • Intégrer un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronic Show
  • Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux pour la santé de demain dans un environnement agile et en constante évolution
  • Intégrer une entreprise internationale, membre de la FrenchTech 120, dont les équipes sont basées à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong-Kong et Shenzhen
  • Participer à l’amélioration continue de nos produits et services en les bêta-testant avant leur sortie, notamment lors de nos nombreuses sessions sportives entre collègues
  • Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, réductions pour des activités culturelles et sportives, restaurant d’entreprise, et bien plus encore
  • Collaborer avec des collègues passionnés et célébrer ensemble chacune de nos réussites !


Toutes les candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’origine ethnique, des opinions, des croyances, de la religion, du genre, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de la santé des candidats. Withings aspire à offrir et garantir l’égalité des chances aux candidats et seules les personnes habilitées (RH et Management) auront accès aux informations concernant votre candidature.

title: Strategic Account Executive, DACH
descriptionHtml:
Why Harvey

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are seeking an Strategic Account Executive to lead commercial growth across the DACH region. This role is responsible for identifying opportunities, managing complex sales cycles, and building long-term relationships within the legal and professional services sector.

This position will play a key role in expanding Harvey’s presence in the DACH region, working cross-functionally to deliver tailored solutions to clients.

What You’ll Do

  • Deliver against sales targets with a focus on sustainable growth and performance excellence.

  • Own and grow a portfolio of named accounts across DACH, driving full-funnel sales activity from prospecting through to commercial negotiation and onboarding.

  • Understand client pain points, organisational structure, and buying processes; tailor solutions that align with strategic outcomes.

  • Lead high-impact product demos and client meetings that clearly articulate Harvey’s business value and technical capabilities.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, legal, engineering, and GTM to inform roadmap and surface client needs.

  • Develop deep, long-term relationships with legal, innovation, and executive stakeholders across the region.

  • Document learnings, iterate on messaging, and help build scalable processes to accelerate regional growth.

What You Have

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in enterprise B2B SaaS sales, preferably with exposure to AI, legaltech, or vertical software

  • Track record of success managing complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical products to non-technical audiences

  • Interest in the legal industry and a commitment to enhancing knowledge work through technology

  • Familiarity with enterprise sales practices in the DACH region

  • Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a collaborative approach to working cross-functionally

Additional Information for Postings

  • Location: Munich

  • Work eligibility: Must have valid German work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role

What We Offer

  • Be part of building something special as a founding member of our DACH team

  • Opportunities to work on cross-functional go-to-market initiatives, with a focus on scaling sales strategy and driving revenue growth

title: Strategic Account Executive - Travel, Transport and Logistics
descriptionHtml:
SLSQ128R13

Do you want to help solve the world's toughest problems with big data and AI? This is what we do every day at Databricks.

We are looking for a Strategic Account Executive to join our Travel, Transport, Hospitality & Logistics (TTLH) team in the UK, to make the most of the phenomenal market opportunity that exists for Databricks within the UK rail and public transport sector. Your mission will be to grow one of our most strategic customers in the sector. It is a dedicated, single-account role and is already one of the top three spending customers in our TTLH vertical. Experience selling to the transport or public sector is preferred, as is experience in running large, complex accounts with multiple stakeholders.

This is a pivotal moment to step into a mission-critical role within one of the UK’s most vital infrastructure sectors. As the transport landscape undergoes its most significant modernisation in a generation, our key enterprise customers are bringing complex, multi-operator environments together into unified, state-of-the-art platforms.

Reporting to the Director, Enterprise for TTLH, as a Strategic Account Executive at Databricks you will bring an informed and compelling point of view on the Big Data, Advanced Analytics and AI space. That view will guide your strategy and, together with our teams and partners, allow you to provide exceptional value to our customer.

The impact you will have:

  • You will co-develop a strategic account plan with your team and ecosystem partners that accelerates customer success and exceeds quarterly and annual usage and booking goals
  • You will lead your team, customer and partners to identify impactful big data and AI use cases, and prove out their value on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform
  • You will deliver your customer's big data and AI transformation goals through a combination of strategic partnerships, well-scoped professional services, training and targeted executive engagement
  • You will position Databricks to coexist with and complement the hyperscaler ecosystem, building a joint "better together" strategy
  • You will orchestrate a wide range of Global Solution Integrators (GSIs) and delivery partners towards shared outcomes
  • You will develop an understanding of technical product details and roadmap to build trust with executives and business and technical champions

What we look for:

  • Experience developing strong relationships with large enterprise accounts, managing virtual teams and leading complex sales campaigns in major transport, infrastructure or public sector accounts is preferred
  • A strong understanding of the hyperscaler ecosystems and a proven ability to position Databricks alongside them, coexisting with and complementing a customer's wider cloud strategy
  • Experience co-selling and scaling your business with Cloud Vendors (AWS, Azure and Google Cloud teams) and Global Solution Integrators (GSIs)
  • The resilience and patience to drive progress in large, complex organisations with long decision cycles, and the drive to make things happen
  • Experience working in Big Data, AI, Cloud or SaaS industries
  • Proof of exceeding sales quotas in high-growth enterprise software companies
  • Experience driving usage and commit-based engagement models and strategies, working with professional services and training teams
  • Experience co-developing business cases and gaining support from C-level executives
  • Experience of value-based selling

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you’ll own our largest accounts — the global banks, top-tier law firms, multi-strategy hedge funds, asset managers, and private equity firms. This is a rare combination of Account Management and Enterprise Sales: you’ll be the trusted senior relationship owner for the account and the commercial lead responsible for expanding 9fin into every relevant team, desk, and geography inside it.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Owning the end-to-end relationship and commercial success of a small portfolio of 9fin’s largest most complex accounts, including global banks, top-tier law firms, hedge funds, asset managers and PE sponsors.

  • Acting as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for MDs, Partners, PMs, Heads of Desk and C-suite stakeholders — building deep, multi-threaded relationships across each organisation.

  • Building and executing strategic account plans that map the org, identify white space, and lay out a clear path to materially growing ARR over multi-year horizons.

  • Driving expansion by qualifying and closing new opportunities inside your accounts, new teams, new desks, new asset classes, new geographies — running full enterprise sales cycles alongside your renewal motion.

  • Leading commercial negotiations on multi-year renewals, uplifts and enterprise agreements, partnering with Legal and Finance and on complex procurement and MSA processes.

  • Deeply understanding each client’s workflows in credit, leveraged finance, restructuring, distressed and private credit, and translating those into concrete use cases 9fin can solve.

  • Partnering closely with Product and Engineering to bring the voice of your clients into the roadmap — you are their most credible advocate internally.

  • Representing 9fin externally at client offsites, executive briefings, industry conferences and roundtables, becoming a recognised name in debt markets.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 7+ years managing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, ideally selling data, SaaS, research or workflow platforms into global banks, buy-side firms, or law firms.

  • Have a proven track record of owning multi-million-dollar accounts and materially expanding them — you can point to specific accounts you’ve grown from $X to $Y and explain exactly how.

  • Combine the depth of a top-tier Account Manager with the commercial edge of a top-tier Enterprise Account Executive — you’re equally comfortable running a strategic QBR with an MD and closing a net-new expansion into a team that’s never used 9fin.

  • Have credibility with senior stakeholders in debt or credit markets, whether from selling to them, working in the industry, or both, and a genuine intellectual interest in the space.

  • Are commercially sharp and operationally rigorous: skilled at navigating complex procurement, legal review, executive alignment, and internal cross-functional work at scale.

Our benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

 

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity options

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Strategic Client Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients are hugely important to Flock: they have more vehicles, more data and more opportunity to benefit from everything our connected proposition can offer, and we want to give them an even better experience as we grow. We’re looking for a Strategic Client Manager to become the primary face of Flock for our largest customers. From multi-national operations, to well known brands, and growing sector leaders, we want you to own these relationships, making sure they get the very best Flock service.

Nearly all of our business comes through brokers, and that remains central to how we work: you’ll sit at the heart of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business to deliver a brilliant joined-up service. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution, and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts, manage client queries and improve reporting, freeing up more time for relationships and problem-solving.

You’ll have the opportunity to build our corporate client management approach from the ground up: shaping account reviews and performance reporting, bringing together claims, safety, underwriting and finance for our biggest clients, and taking real ownership when something needs to get done. Success is simple: our clients stay with us, get more value from Flock and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution.

  • Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience.

  • Preferable: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to the claims process or to building an account management or client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Strategic Partnership Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Andela:

At Andela, we know brilliance is evenly distributed around the world, but opportunity is not. For over 10 years, Andela has connected its customers with top global, remote technical talent from over 135 countries with the majority residing in emerging markets like Africa and Latin America.

As one of the world’s largest talent marketplaces, Andela gives companies greater flexibility to quickly deploy qualified technologists. With talent highly skilled in advanced technologies to support Application Development, Artificial Intelligence, Cloud & DevOps, Data Engineering, and much more, customers experience 33% faster project delivery. The company’s exclusive AI-powered platform, Andela Talent Cloud, is the industry’s only unified platform managing the complete global talent lifecycle and enables customers to fill individual roles or engage fully managed teams up to 66% faster.

Andela is on the precipice of two breakout industry transformations: one in staffing/hiring and the other in software development, both accelerated by generative AI.

Are you an exceptional, hungry leader seasoned in scaling businesses through transformation and growth? Join us and change the world.

Job Summary

Strategic Partnership Manager · London, UK

Andela is hiring a London-based Strategic Partnership Manager to own and grow our co-sell partnership with GitHub, one of our most strategic technology partners, across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. GitHub is one of our highest-priority partnerships, and EMEA is where our co-sell momentum with them is strongest.

You will own the partner relationship and be accountable for the partner-sourced and

partner-influenced revenue it produces. That means building trust with GitHub's field sellers and partner team, running deal registration and co-sell, mapping accounts, and keeping our program standing current so the partner sends us more opportunities and continues to invest in us.

GitHub is the anchor, but the role is built to flex. You will work across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem, including co-sell, consumption credit and partner funding programs. As activity grows in region, you will extend the same motion to our AI lab partners. This is a revenue-generating role with a base-plus-variable compensation structure tied to partner-sourced and partner-influenced bookings.

Exceptional Leadership:

As an Andelan, you’ll serve as a role model for the rest of the company. Think about the feedback your peers typically give you – if it usually sounds like the below, we want to hear from you.

  • Low ego, low drama, servant leader: You share credit, take blame. You like being wrong because it means someone else had an even better idea.

  • One team mentality: You break silos across teams. You put the company and mission first above your team alone.

  • Great listener, hungry for feedback: You’re always seeking to improve – our product, our business, yourself. You solicit diverse opinions and deeply listen.

  • Owner, not renter: You see a problem, you fix it or find someone who will. The buck stops with you.

  • Player-coach: You fly high (create strategy) AND low (know the details that matter). You roll up your sleeves and get scrappy. You do this proactively collaborating with your team while actively engaging in important details.

  • Business problem solver: You’re not just a functional expert; you consistently get praise for approaching your function through the lens of solving business problems.

Key Responsibilities

Own the GitHub partnership in EMEA

  • Build and maintain relationships with GitHub's EMEA field sellers, partner managers, solution engineers and services leaders, so Andela is the partner they bring into accounts first.

  • Own the joint Partner Business Plan for the region, and run the QBR cadence and monthly deal reviews with GitHub.

  • Represent Andela in person at partner offices, sales kickoffs, field events and executive meetings across EMEA.

Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue

  • Source new opportunities from the partner's field organization and qualify them before bringing in Andela sales and Solutions Managers.

  • Run co-sell on live deals: connect partner sellers with Andela sellers, keep the partner informed through close, and remove blockers on both sides.

  • Map accounts with GitHub to agree on which customers we target together, then align Andela's EMEA sales team on how to pursue them.

  • Build and manage partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, with clean attribution in Salesforce.

Run deal registration, funding and program mechanics

  • Register every partner-involved opportunity so Andela receives credit for the consumption and seats we drive (for example, platform seats and cloud consumption).

  • Identify and secure deal-based partner funding, including co-investment and incentive programs, so sellers have more pricing flexibility on competitive deals.

  • Manage marketplace listings and partner program tiers: track designation and specialization requirements, certification counts, customer references and registered-deal thresholds, and file what is needed to maintain or move up a tier.

  • Maintain partner attribution tooling, such as partner portals and deal and consumption tagging.

Work across the Andela partner team

  • Bring Solutions Managers into qualified opportunities and partner enablement sessions, and relay what partner sellers need back into our offers.

  • Partner with the Partner Marketer on campaigns to partner sellers, joint customer campaigns and events, and own follow-up with partner sellers on the leads they produce.

  • Feed wins back into customer stories and references that strengthen our standing with each partner.

  • Report on partner pipeline, bookings, funding secured and program status to the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership.

Extend the motion to more partners

  • Apply the same co-sell playbook across GitHub's wider cloud ecosystem in EMEA.

  • As activity grows, support our AI lab partners in region: partner seller relationships, deal registration, program tiers and marketplace presence.

How success is measured

  • Partner-sourced bookings (primary), with partner-influenced bookings credited at a lower weight.

  • Deals registered and accepted by the partner, and co-sell opportunities with a partner seller engaged.

  • Partner-sourced pipeline against a coverage target, and co-sell wins.

  • Partner funding secured, and partner consumption driven (platform seats, cloud consumption, AI licenses).

  • Program status: designations achieved, tier requirements met, business plans current and QBRs held on schedule.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in partner, alliance or channel management at a technology services firm, consultancy, systems integrator or ISV.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with the GitHub partner program or a comparable cloud or developer-platform partner program: co-sell, deal registration, partner portals and partner funding claims.

  • A track record of carrying a partner-sourced or partner-influenced revenue target and growing pipeline through a partner's field sellers.

  • Experience running joint business plans, QBRs and account mapping with a large technology partner.

  • Enough technical fluency in software development, DevOps, platform migration or AI adoption to qualify an opportunity before bringing in a solutions specialist.

  • Comfortable working through others: you influence partner sellers and internal sales teams without direct authority.

  • Strong organization and follow-through on program mechanics, with clean CRM hygiene (Salesforce preferred).

  • Based in or able to work from London, and able to travel across EMEA for partner meetings and events.

Preferred

  • An existing network inside GitHub's EMEA partner and field organizations.

  • Experience managing partner tiers, designations, specializations and marketplace listings (for example, cloud marketplace listings and partner designations).

  • Exposure to AI lab partner programs, or interest in growing into them. We value candidates with a strong GitHub or cloud partner foundation who can carry that motion into newer programs.

  • Background selling or partnering on developer tooling, cloud modernization, engineering talent or technical training services.

  • Experience working across European and African markets.

  • Experience at a company building a partner function from an early stage.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ

Which team will I join?

At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.  

What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?

  • As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. title: Talent Acquisition Partner (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Help build the team behind the AI workforce for procurement!

Following our $30M Series A, Lio is entering a defining chapter: scaling internationally and assembling the exceptional team that will shape the future of procurement.

As our Talent Acquisition Partner, you’ll build and own a core talent vertical: Engineering, AI Implementation, Go-to-Market, or our growing U.S. organization.

You’ll work directly with our founders and leadership team to attract the people who will drive Lio’s next stage. This is your opportunity to do more than recruit for a great company: it’s your opportunity to help build one!

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end recruiting for core talent verticals

  • Partner with hiring managers to define requirements, challenge assumptions, and develop effective search strategies

  • Proactively identify and engage exceptional passive talent through LinkedIn and other relevant channels

  • Build strong, diverse pipelines for current and future hiring needs

  • Advise hiring managers throughout the selection process and drive confident, evidence-based hiring decisions

  • Manage candidates from initial outreach through offer, negotiation, and close

  • Create an exceptional, personal, and consistent candidate experience

  • Build and continuously improve interview processes, scorecards, sourcing strategies, and recruiting workflows

  • Track recruiting metrics and use data to improve quality, speed, and conversion across the funnel

  • Strengthen Lio’s employer brand and develop creative ways to reach high-performing talent

  • Select and manage external recruiting partners when additional support is needed

Your Profile

  • You have several years of experience owning end-to-end recruiting, ideally within a fast-growing technology company, startup, or recruiting agency

  • You have successfully hired across technical and commercial functions; experience with senior or leadership searches is a strong plus

  • You know how to identify and engage exceptional candidates who are not actively looking

  • You are a trusted partner to hiring managers and are comfortable challenging, advising, and influencing senior stakeholders

  • You combine strong candidate judgment with a structured, data-informed approach

  • You understand how to create recruiting processes that are both rigorous and fast

  • You are proactive, highly organized, and motivated by ambitious hiring goals

  • You thrive in dynamic environments and enjoy building processes from the ground up

  • You are fluent in German and English

Why Lio?

  • Build the company: Every hire you make will directly shape Lio’s future

  • High ownership: Own critical searches and help define our global talent strategy

  • Strategic influence: Work closely with our founders, leadership team, and hiring managers

  • Exceptional talent: Recruit across AI, Engineering, Product, and enterprise Go-to-Market

  • Build from the ground up: Create the recruiting structures, standards, and candidate experience that will support our next stage of growth

  • International impact: Help scale our teams across Munich and New York

This is an opportunity to do more than fill roles. You’ll build the team creating the future of procurement!

title: Talent & Growth Intern - Germany
descriptionHtml:
DRYFT

Ideas only change the world when you build them at scale. That’s what Dryft is here for.

Dryft builds models that automate complex human decisions in manufacturing operations. We capture the knowledge of experienced operators across supply chain, production planning, engineering and more, simulate the consequences of their decisions, and use this understanding to help run their business. Our customers include some of the largest robotics, machine and component manufacturers in the world.

We’re a small, talent-dense team with modest roots and a love for the physical world: cars, machines, planes. Our team includes graduates from Stanford, Berkeley, CDTM and TUM, winners of Stanford TreeHacks, recipients of Fulbright & Haniel scholarships, and people who have built everything from robots and race cars to software with millions of downloads.

What matters more to us than credentials is how people work: humility, hard work, speed, kindness, deep customer care, and a willingness to take on problems others avoid. Working at Dryft is hard. You get unusual ownership early on, with real responsibility. But that’s also what makes it one of the biggest learning experiences of your life.

We’re backed by founders and operators behind some of the most legendary tech companies of our time, Tier-1 U.S. venture firms, and board members of global industrial companies.

ERPs ran the physical world for half a century. Dryft is building the intelligence layer that will power the next.

​

THE ROLE

Every great company starts with exceptional people, and the best of them are rarely looking. As our Talent & Growth Intern, you'll work directly with our founders to find them early, put Dryft on their radar, and get them excited to build with us. Think of it as venture capital, except your portfolio is people. One day you're spotting the standout at a hackathon, the next you're hosting a dinner for the most ambitious people in the city, and in between you're turning a "maybe later" into a "when can I start?"

  • Scout the outliers: find the people who'll be impossible to hire in three years, from lecture halls and competitions to every other corner of the market, and get to them first

  • Make Dryft the place to be: throw the hackathons, founder dinners and parties nobody wants to miss, and launch the campaigns and stunts that bring people to us before we ever reach out

  • Build the team that builds Dryft: turn your top finds into hires, get every one of them to yes, and grow into a full-time role in Talent, Growth or Special Projects

Building the world's best team is Dryft's highest priority. You'll meet more exceptional people in six months than most do in a decade, and you'll be the reason they choose Dryft.

​

YOU

  • Fast-paced experience: you've thrived somewhere fast-moving, like a high-growth startup, a student initiative or something you built yourself, and you're obsessed with startups and the people who build them

  • Community builder: you've grown a student initiative, an event series or a network from nothing, and the best people kept coming back

  • Talent magnet: you spot who is going to make it long before their CV does, and after ten minutes with you, they want in

  • Sense of urgency: you keep fifty conversations moving at once, and when you meet someone exceptional, they hear from you that same day

  • Genuine & zero ego: you're honest with people even when the answer is no, and you'd rather see the team win than get the credit

  • Language: you speak native-level German and fluent English

  • Relocation: you're ready to work onsite in Munich

title: Team Lead Engineering - Finance Automation (f/m/d)
