title: Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As Team Lead Fuselage, Doors & Windows (all genders) in our Structures Team, you will lead the structural design and development of VÆRIDION’s fuselage, door, and windows work packages for our CS-23 all-electric aircraft.

Your mission is to guide a small team of engineers in delivering lightweight, manufacturable, certifiable, and production-ready structural solutions. You will be responsible for technical direction, work-package execution, team coordination, cross-functional alignment, and delivery quality within your scope.

This role combines hands-on aircraft structures expertise with strong leadership. You will not only execute engineering work yourself, but also enable others, remove blockers, anticipate risks, and represent the Structures function in internal and external discussions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Lead complete fuselage, doors, and windows work packages independently.

  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of structures engineers.

  • Set priorities, assign tasks, track progress, and ensure high-quality delivery.

  • Own technical coordination for fuselage structures, door surrounds, window cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, and installations.

  • Drive design maturity from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production release.

  • Anticipate and mitigate technical, schedule, manufacturing, supplier, and certification risks.

  • Represent Structures in cross-functional meetings, design reviews, supplier reviews, and certification discussions.

  • Align stakeholders across Stress, Systems, Production, Certification, Quality, Procurement, and external partners.

  • Challenge assumptions, bring practical design improvements, and help the team make sound technical decisions.

  • Review key engineering outputs, including CAD models, drawings, interface definitions, and design documentation.

  • Build team capability by improving methods, standards, templates, and ways of working.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of aerospace structural design experience.

  • Proven experience leading technical work packages and coordinating engineering teams.

  • Strong leadership skills: clear communication, prioritization, decision-making, conflict resolution, and team development.

  • Experience in at least two full aircraft development programs, such as clean-sheet aircraft, major modifications, prototype-to-certification programs, or production ramp-ups.

  • Strong experience with metallic fuselage structures, aircraft doors, windows, cut-outs, reinforcements, fittings, interfaces, or major airframe assemblies.

  • Strong understanding of metallic and composite aircraft structures, load paths, manufacturability, inspectability, repairability, and certification constraints.

  • Deep proficiency in CATIA V5 or 3DX and configuration-controlled design data.

  • Solid understanding of airworthiness and certification principles related to aircraft structures, ideally including EASA CS-23.

  • Ability to anticipate risks, create clarity, align stakeholders, and deliver results through others.

  • Confidence to represent the function internally and externally.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: Team Leader - Cambridge
descriptionHtml:
Team Leader

Location: Cambridge

Working pattern: Onsite | 30 hours per week (Shift rotation)

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Site Operations team powers the physical side of our marketplace through HOP (our rapid grocery delivery service) and Editions (our network of delivery-only kitchens). From launching new sites to ensuring operational excellence across markets, we combine retail and hospitality expertise with operational rigour. If you thrive in hands-on environments and want to help redefine how food and groceries reach customers—come join us on the ground.

We’re looking for a Team Leader to join our Cambridge team. In this role, you’ll support Site Management in achieving peak performance and operational excellence, ensuring our restaurant partners and customers receive world-class service.

Get to know our Site Operations team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be joining the Deliveroo Editions team. Editions are our delivery-only kitchens that partner with incredible restaurants like Wagamama and Starbucks to bring high-quality food to more doorsteps. You will be at the heart of this fast-paced hub, ensuring every shift runs smoothly.

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Lead shift operations by effectively prioritising tasks and delegating to the team to meet all company performance goals.

  • Supervise compliance and safety by coaching the team on standard operating procedures (SOPs) and conducting essential H&S checks.

  • Optimise the dispatch process to ensure accurate order handling for riders and a seamless experience for our restaurant partners.

  • Drive site standards by maintaining high levels of food safety and ensuring a clean, organised, and professional environment.

  • Manage team performance through accurate timekeeping oversight and fostering a positive, cooperative culture on every shift.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Proven leadership ability, with experience training others and the confidence to run shifts independently.

  • Strong hands-on mentality and the ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced operational environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, including proficiency in written and spoken English to coordinate with riders, partners, and stakeholders.

  • A results-oriented mindset with a track record of consistently meeting or exceeding KPI targets.

  • Commitment to excellence, ensuring all tasks are completed in a safe, legal, and compliant manner.

  • Right to work in the UK.

Our Interview Process

  • Step 1: Apply – Apply for any role you’d like to be considered for. We’re looking forward to hearing from you.

  • Step 2: Online assessment – If your application is successful, you’ll receive an assessment from our AI hiring assistant, Maki People. Please note: this must be completed to continue.

  • Step 3: Initial conversation – One of our Recruitment team will get in touch to talk through your experience and what you’re looking for next.

  • Step 4: Final Onsite interview – You’ll be invited to an onsite interview with one of our Site Managers.

  • Step 5: Outcome – We’ll get back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the result!

Why Join Us?

We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community organisers and more. All energised with an entrepreneurial, relentless spirit which helps us do big things as a team. In Operations, you’re at the heart of our marketplace — working directly with customers, riders and partners to keep Deliveroo moving.

  • 🔧 See the impact of your work in real time: Solve problems as they happen, turning challenges into positive experiences.

  • 🌱 Grow through doing: Develop leadership skills in a fast-paced environment with real opportunities to step into management.

  • 🤝 Be part of a tight-knit culture: Work collaboratively in an environment that values support, ownership, and resilience.

What We Offer

  • Pay: £14.30 per hour

  • Free monthly Friday lunch on Deliveroo

  • 25 days’ holiday (with increases based on service)

  • Career development and access to learning opportunities

  • Life assurance and wellbeing support

  • Free Deliveroo Plus—no delivery fees on your orders

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

+ Verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een aantal bestaande maatwerkprojecten en indien nodig niet terugdeinst voor een nieuwe maatwerk opdracht.

Hoe jouw werkweek eruitziet

Op maandag spar je met de teamleden en zorg je ervoor dat iedereen weet waar ze aan moeten werken, en dat ze daar ook verder mee kunnen. Je pakt zelf een wijziging op die vraagt om een nieuwe schaalbare service en je denkt direct mee over architectuur en security-impact. Later in de week review je code van collega’s en help je een medior op weg met een complexe async-workflow. Je overlegt met onze product owners en engineering manager en zorgt ervoor dat het team op één lijn zitten en weten wat er speelt. Tussendoor onderzoek je nieuwe technische mogelijkheden en voer je verbeteringen door waarmee klanten nóg fijner met onze software kunnen werken. Je werkt hybride en vindt zo de ideale balans tussen focus en samenwerking.

"Bij Whitevision hebben we meer dan 20 jaar aan rijke software-ontwikkeling achter ons liggen. Wat begon als een flexibele oplossing, is uitgegroeid tot een essentieel platform met integraties in diverse ERP-systemen. Onze groei van de afgelopen jaren laat zich onder andere zien in de ontwikkeling van een moderne React-frontend en de start van migraties naar Azure Functions, die we verder willen doorontwikkelen. Daarnaast richten we ons op onderhoudbaarheid, internationalisering en integraties met nieuwe bedrijven zoals Inconto. Ons platform, gebouwd in C#.NET, wordt continu doorontwikkeld door een groeiend team. Als Tech Lead krijg je de kans om niet alleen het technische hart van ons product verder vorm te geven, maar ook strategisch mee te denken over de toekomst van ons platform en onze producten. Met jouw visie en leiderschap help je onze software klaar te maken voor de volgende 20 jaar." - Serge Settels (Lead Software Developer).



Jij hebt het

+ Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Back-end Developer, waarvan een deel in een Lead of minstens Senior rol;

+ Coaching-ervaring en de drive om technisch leiderschap te tonen;

+ Uitgebreide kennis van C#, .NET (Core), Databases en REST API’s;

+ Ervaring met complexe SaaS-architecturen;

+ Ervaring met MS SQL Databases, en performance tuning/troubleshooting op DB niveau;

+ Kennis van infrastructuur-principes en voldoende begrip van front-end aspecten om goed samen te werken en te beoordelen;

+ Ervaring met FluentMigrator, Aspose, en algemene testautomatisering is een pré;

+ Ervaring met low-code is een pré.

Ook breng je mee:

+ Analytisch vermogen: je doorgrondt complexe datastromen en neemt onderbouwde besluiten voor schaalbaarheid en security;

+ Communicatieve samenwerking: je zorgt voor een sterke verbinding binnen het multidisciplinaire team;

+ Eigenaarschap: je houdt overzicht, anticipeert op risico’s en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat;

+ Een proactieve houding: je neemt initiatief, en zorgt ervoor dat benodigde informatie actief opgehaald wordt zodat projecten vlot doorlopen.

Onze Whitevision manier van werken is met respect, daadkracht, betrokkenheid en ambitie.

Deze kernwaarden passen dan ook uitstekend bij jouw persoonlijkheid.

Dit verdien jij
+ Een salaris waar je blij van wordt, €5.500 - €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur, 8% vakantiegeld, 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om 5 extra dagen te kopen (o.b.v. 40 uur) en flexibele werktijden.

+ Een mooi kantoor in Zoetermeer. We bieden ook de mogelijkheid om ook twee dagen per week thuis te werken, maar veel van onze collega’s vinden het zo leuk om op kantoor te werken dat zij dit minimaal doen.

+ Een gezellig team met kantoren in Zoetermeer, de Goorn, Rotterdam en Breda. We werken hard, maar lachen minstens zo veel met elkaar!

+ Onderdeel worden van een snelgroeiend SaaS-bedrijf in Breda met de missie om repeterend werk de wereld uit te helpen.

title: Tech Lead IA (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Tech Riders est un cabinet de conseil qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs enjeux SI en proposant des services d’excellence sur deux domaines essentiellement :

  • Conseil à la DSI (Gouvernance, Optimisation des Processus, Gestion des risques et Audit informatique etc.),
  • Accompagnement Projet (Chefferie de projet, Product Management, Business Analyse, Développement, etc.).

Nous croyons fermement que l'épanouissement professionnel est intimement lié à un équilibre sain entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle, une évolution de carrière fluide grâce à l'acquisition de nouvelles expertises, ainsi qu'une rémunération équitable.

Conscients des priorités et attentes de nos collaborateurs, nous nous engageons à construire une entreprise à taille humaine, fondée sur des valeurs et des principes solides tels que la cohésion d'équipe, la transparence, l'équilibre de vie, et le partage de connaissances et de prospérité.

Vos missions

Dans le cadre du renforcement de notre équipe IA et pour répondre à un projet stratégique de notre client, nous recherchons un(e) Tech Lead IA. Le profil aura un rôle de référent, en charge de challenger et d’accompagner des équipes transverses, afin de garantir la pertinence des choix techniques et la bonne industrialisation des solutions IA.

Vos responsabilités

En tant que Tech Lead IA, vous assurerez le rôle de référent technique auprès des équipes projet et IT. Votre fonction couvrira 3 domaines clés :

Gestion de projet IA :

  • Intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des projets IA : idéation, expérimentation (POC), passage à l’échelle et industrialisation
  • Définir et promouvoir les standards techniques et des bonnes pratiques IA (qualité de code, performance, sécurité, maintenabilité, intégration via API, déploiement sur le cloud)

Choix d’architectures IA / conception technique :

  • Apporter une expertise technique IA et challenger les choix d’architecture et de modélisation
  • Sélectionner et superviser l’utilisation des modèles LLM (commerciaux, open-source, cloud) et guider l’implémentation des bonnes techniques RAG
  • Assurer que les modèles IA répondent aux exigences de performance, de conformité et de sécurité, tout en garantissant leur bonne adoption et exploitation par les métiers
  • Être garant de la scalabilité, la robustesse et l’interopérabilité des modèles avec les systèmes existants tout en optimisant les performances et la consommation des ressources
  • Contribuer à la définition des indicateurs clés de performance environnementaux liés à l’usage des modèles d’IA, en intégrant des critères tels que la frugalité énergétique, l’empreinte carbone et l’utilisation des ressources GPU
  • Aider à l’analyse des tendances des KPI, et proposer des actions d’optimisation pour améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et réduire l’impact environnemental des solutions IA
  • Assurer une veille continue sur les avancées en IA et proposer des améliorations techniques innovantes

Coordination d’équipes techniques :

  • Accompagner des équipes transverses (Développeurs, Data Scientists, Architectes) pour l’utilisation des bonnes pratiques de développement IA et d’industrialisation de solutions IA
  • Assurer, en collaboration avec l’éditeur et l’exploitant, le déploiement et l’intégration des modèles d’IA au sein des infrastructures techniques de notre client (cloud, on-premise)
  • Proposer et superviser la mise en œuvre d’améliorations techniques et méthodologiques pour optimiser l’intégration et le déploiement des modèles IA

Vos compétences

  • 7 ans d’expérience ou plus, en tant que Tech Lead IA / Lead Data / ML Engineer senior avec une capacité avérée à gérer des projets technologiques riches et à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires

Gestion de projet IA :

  • Solide connaissance des processus projets IA (idéation, expérimentation, industrialisation) et des bonnes pratiques de développement IA (structuration du code, tests, versioning, déploiement)
  • Bonne connaissance des normes de conformité (éthique de l’IA, IA Act, RGPD, sécurité informatique) et des pratiques de gouvernance associées (mécanismes de contrôle et d’audit des modèles)

Choix d’architectures IA / conception technique :

  • Expérience significative dans la conception et l’implémentation d’architectures IA en production, incluant l’intégration via API, le déploiement sur infrastructures cloud (ex : Azure, AWS, GCP…) et on-premise
  • Maîtrise confirmée des modèles génératifs d'intelligence artificielle (ex. Mistral, Gemini, QWEN, DeepSeek). Expérience dans l’évaluation, sélection et optimisation de ces modèles en tenant compte des critères de performance, sécurité, conformité et impact environnemental et de la stratégie du client
  • Connaissance approfondie des infrastructures GPU, des stratégies d’optimisation des performances pour l’entraînement et l’inférence des modèles d’IA générative, et des solutions pour optimiser leur consommation énergétique
  • Maîtrise de plusieurs langages de programmation dont les indispensables Python et Java

Coordination d’équipes techniques :

  • Capacité à challenger et à fédérer des profils techniques seniors (Développeurs, Data Scientists, Architectes)
  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de structuration
  • La connaissance du secteur banque et assurance est un plus

Rejoignez la famille Tech Riders et devenez les Leaders de demain ! Découvrez un environnement où l'excellence, la qualité, et l'humanité sont au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons.

title: Technical Deployment Manager
descriptionHtml:

At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops.

🚀 The Adventure Ahead

In this hybrid technical-consulting role, you will be the architectural backbone and trusted advisor guiding global organizations through complex onboarding milestones, bespoke workflows, and seamless platform connectivity. You'll bridge the gap between high-level customer vision and deep technical execution, directly unlocking the full power of Docebo’s AI-driven learning suite for enterprise teams around the globe. If you love solving technical puzzles, building automated workflows, and delivering tangible "aha!" moments to customers, your next big career adventure starts right here.

🛠️ The Day-to-Day

  • Lead the Charge: Partner directly with diverse, global enterprise clients to translate ambitious business objectives into crystal-clear technical success criteria and project roadmaps.

  • Curiosity & Fast Learning: A boundless appetite for mastering new technologies, digging deep into platform mechanics, and evolving into a go-to Docebo product authority.

  • Customer-First Communication: Exceptional relationship-building skills with the ability to ask the right questions, understand nuanced needs, and turn technical jargon into clear business value.

🌟 Bonus Points

  • Enterprise Ecosystem Know-How: Background navigating large-scale enterprise deployments and integrating complex HRIS, CRM, or enterprise calendar ecosystems.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉

  • Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul.

About Docebo 💙

At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs (TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. title: Technical Enablement Associate
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry, which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Client Education team

Every hx customer's success depends on their teams knowing how to use our platform well - not just how to click through it, but how to build genuinely good pricing models with it. Client Education exists to make that happen. We sit at the intersection of Product, Partnerships, and Customer teams, turning new features and platform capability into training, certification, and documentation that our clients and delivery partners can actually learn from.

The team owns the full learning journey: onboarding new clients, building certification pathways, producing courses and video content, and supporting partners who deliver training on our behalf. As hx's product surface has grown - Decision Engine, Pricing & Rating, Portfolio Intelligence, Submission Triage, and our AI agents - so has the volume and complexity of what we need to teach, and we're growing the team to keep pace.

We're looking for a Client Education Associate to join as a core part of this effort. Your focus will be delivering technical training directly to clients and partners, and supporting the team in building and maintaining the courses and certifications that make that training possible. You'll need enough technical grounding to be credible in front of a room of actuaries and developers, and enough teaching instinct to make complex material land.

What you'll be doing

  • Deliver technical training sessions, live and online, to clients and partners - covering everything from platform fundamentals to how to build pricing models using hx's AI agents and product tooling.

  • Build and maintain high-quality course content (online modules, video tutorials, workshop materials) that keeps pace with new product releases and evolving client needs.

  • Support the design and delivery of certification assessments, including practical exercises where candidates build real pricing tools in the hx platform.

  • Partner with Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to translate new features into training material clients can actually use from day one.

  • Contribute to our partner enablement programme, helping external delivery partners onboard and deliver hx training to a consistent standard.

  • Help maintain and improve our course health and documentation processes, flagging content that's fallen out of date or out of line with current product naming and messaging.

What you'll need to have done

  • Delivered training, workshops, or technical explanations to a non-technical or semi-technical audience, and can point to material you've built or taught from.

  • Studied Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or built equivalent hands-on comfort with programming languages (Python or similar) through experience.

  • Worked hands-on with SaaS tools, APIs, or similar technical products, even without a formal software engineering background.

  • Taken the initiative to build or improve a course, process, or piece of learning content, rather than just following someone else's structure.

  • Communicated confidently and clearly with clients or external stakeholders, adjusting technical depth to fit the audience in front of you.

  • Worked well in an environment where scope shifts and you're expected to figure things out rather than wait for a fully defined brief.

You're unlikely to thrive here if

  • You'd rather follow a fixed curriculum than build and adapt training material as the product changes under you.

  • You're not comfortable being hands-on with technical concepts and tooling, even at a foundational level.

  • You prefer working in isolation rather than pulling in context from Product, Customer, and Partnerships teams to get training right.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you'll do your best work. We're building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we're committed to salary transparency. You'll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we're working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we're building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don't always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that's competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview Process

  1. Initial call with our Talent team to kick things off (30 minutes)

  2. Manager interview with Dom (60 minutes)

  3. Practical training assessment: build and present a short curriculum plan for a real hx feature, followed by discussion (60-90 minutes)

  4. Values interview (60 minutes)

  5. Meet the CEO

  6. We offer!

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer's are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure.

If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

The Role

AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast.

The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product.

As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical.

This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here.

What You'll Do

  • Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed.

  • Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground.

  • Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck.

  • Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice.

  • Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you.

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on.

  • Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have.

  • Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment.

  • You'll keep experimenting with AI tooling as it evolves, and bring what works back to the rest of the team.

About You

We don't expect you to have done this exact job before.

TL;DR: you're a technical, customer-facing problem-solver who's as comfortable elbow-deep in an API integration as you are explaining what went wrong to a CFO's technical lead.

  • 3-8+ years in a customer-facing technical role - technical support engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or similar - at a fast-growing SaaS company

  • A technical background: a Computer Science or Engineering degree, prior experience as a software developer or engineer, or strong hands-on experience with SQL, APIs, and system integrations

  • Strong systems intuition: comfortable diving into unfamiliar platforms, reasoning about architecture, and figuring out where in a complex system something's actually broken

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to speed up investigation and first-draft fixes, with the judgment to know what to trust and what to double-check

  • An excellent communicator who can flex between a technical deep-dive with an engineer and a clear explanation for a non-technical stakeholder

  • Entrepreneurial and comfortable with ambiguity: you want to help build the standards and playbook for this function, not just follow one that already exists

  • High ownership: when something's broken, you own it through to resolution, and you raise your hand for the hard problems rather than waiting to be assigned them

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Technical Writer, Frontier AI Best Practice
descriptionHtml:
About the AI Security Institute

The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.

We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.

The deadline for applying to this role is Sunday 29th November 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.

About the team

AISI's Technical Standards and Best Practice team identifies what best practice is needed to manage the most serious risks from frontier AI development and leverages AISI’s position to get it adopted. 

AI capabilities are advancing faster than the science and practices used to manage their risks. Risks now emerge earlier, during training, internal deployment and evaluation, not just at public release, and evaluation methods are struggling to keep pace. Yet there is no consensus on the set of practices needed to safely use and develop the most capable AI systems, and high-level principles are not enough to manage these risks. What's needed is concrete technical guidance that developers agree is necessary. 

AISI is uniquely placed to lead on parts of this industry-wide effort to establish best practice. We house researchers with state-of-the-art technical insight on keeping AI secure during internal use, hold existing relationships with industry and other frontier AI organisations, and offer a neutral third-party home to establish best practice collaboratively. This role directly delivers on part of the Prime Minister’s September 2026commitment that the UK will work towards principles and standards that ensure the most capable AI systems are developed securely and with appropriate transparency. It builds directly on our October 2026 publication Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development, setting out our view of the most urgent priorities. 

This is a new, growing team with high ambitions. It is a cross AISI initiative that draws on and collaborates with researchers and engineers from across AISI's research teams, as well as our Communications, International and Strategy teams. We're now building a dedicated core team and expect it to grow as the work does. 

Why this team matters:

AISI is uniquely placed to shape this guidance, and this team is how we'll do it: 

  • Technical expertise: AISI has roughly 10 technical and research teams whose expertise can be drawn on; one of the largest groups working on AI risk outside the frontier AI companies. AISI has evaluated more than 55 frontier models before release and published research on topics such as safety cases, monitorability and control. 
  • A research institute within government: we work directly with leading AI developers, other governments, and third-party evaluators, and can bring them together around practices no single company would set on its own. UK AISI also coordinates the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science – a group of 10 AI security institutes and equivalents – which has already published its own and socialised others’ best practices.  
  • A track record of shaping industry practice: AISI has already helped establish voluntary practices such as pre-release testing, and built Inspect, now the standard framework for leading third-party evaluators. 

We're not seeking to mandate requirements. We want to contribute our expertise to an industry-wide effort to develop technical best practice that could later inform formal standards. 

What we're working on:

Examples of our first priority areas include: 

  • Overseeing AI systems: what monitoring and controls developers need to make sure AI systems behave as intended, and how to preserve that oversight as systems become more capable. 
  • Sharing information on the speed of AI development: which metrics best track progress, including AI's use in its own development, and when they should be shared with governments and the public. 
  • Assessing and documenting risk: what risk assessments and safety cases should cover, and what standard of evidence they should meet.

About the role

Primary objective: turn AISI's technical expertise into authoritative best-practice documents that frontier AI developers find valuable and use, and into clear explanations of why those practices matter. 

You'll work closely with AISI researchers and the standards team on two kinds of writing. 

Example responsibilities:

  • Best-practice documents (about 50%) 

    • Work with researchers to decide what form each piece of best practice should take, and how it should be structured. 
    • Own delivery of best-practice documents, co-drafting by managing researchers’ technical input and editing to ensure each practice is coherent, specific, testable and technically accurate. 
    • Set out the technical rationale for each practice, drawing on research findings, threat models and evaluation results, so the case for it is evidence-based and credible to a diverse set of expert readers.  
    • Develop a consistent style, templates and terminology for AISI best practice documents, and run review rounds with internal and external experts.

  • Explainers (about 50%) 

    • Write public explainers and technical blog posts setting out the reasoning behind AISI's best practice: why it matters, and what it means for developers, policymakers and the public. For example, the series that follow our agenda, Towards technical best practice for frontier AI development. 
    • Manage multi-stakeholder drafting processes, engaging with feedback from industry, wider government and expert third parties. 
    • Adapt material for different audiences, from technical researchers to non-technical policy readers, working with AISI's communications team.

Reporting and growth:

You'll report to the Head of Technical Standards and Best Practice. This role by default has no line management responsibilities thought responsibility will scale as the team grows. You'll learn from AISI's researchers across a wide range of frontier AI safety topics, and help shape a new team as it grows.

What we are looking for

We're flexible on the exact profile and expect successful candidates will meet many, but not necessarily all, of the criteria below. This role is most likely to fall at Level 4, but we are open to exceptional candidates at other levels. 

Essential:

We're looking for someone who can: 

  • Understand nuanced technical AI safety work well enough to explain its claims and limitations accurately, 
  • Write precise, structured documents that set out what organisations should do and why, 
  • Explain the same technical topics clearly and engagingly to non-technical readers 

For example, you might have: 

  • Written or co-written AI research papers, such as preprints on arXiv. 
  • Written in-depth technical communication on AI working directly with researchers, such as AI company blog posts or technical reports. 
  • Written technical guidance, standards or documentation in a complex field. 
  • Written for public or policy audiences on technical topics. 

You don't need all of these. For a sense of the level and style we're looking for, see the work our research teams publish on the AISI blog by our research teams. 

Desirable:

  • Familiarity with one or more of our priority areas: monitorability, safety cases and risk reports, or AI research automation. 
  • Extensive experience communicating AI security concepts for policy audiences. 
  • Experience running the writing of a multi-author document: gathering input from several experts, resolving conflicting feedback and getting it to publication. 
  • Familiarity with how frontier AI developers, evaluators or standards bodies work, for example from working at or alongside them. 

Example backgrounds:

  • An AI safety researcher who has published several papers and especially enjoys the writing and framing side of research. 
  • A technical writer or science communicator with a machine learning degree or AI background, who has co-written papers or reports on AI research. 
  • A research engineer or analyst at an AI safety organisation who has led writing on published frameworks or reports. 

Core requirements 

  • You should be able to spend at least 4 days per week working with us. 
  • No security clearance is needed to apply. Eligibility for Security Check (SC) clearance is preferred, but not essential. More detail on clearance eligibility can be found on the UK Government website: National security vetting: clearance levels - GOV.UK.

Interview process

Candidates should expect to go through some or all of the following stages once an application has been submitted:   

  • Initial interview   
  • Technical take home test   
  • Second interview and review of take home test   
  • Third interview   
  • Final interview with members of the senior team 

What We Offer 

Impact you couldn't have anywhere else 

  • Incredibly talented, mission-driven and supportive colleagues. 
  • Direct influence on how frontier AI is governed and deployed globally. 
  • Work with the Prime Minister’s AI Advisor and leading AI companies. 
  • Opportunity to shape the first & best-resourced public-interest research team focused on AI security. 

Resources & access 

  • Pre-release access to multiple frontier models and ample compute. 
  • Extensive operational support so you can focus on research and ship quickly. 
  • Work with experts across national security, policy, AI research and adjacent sciences. 

Growth & autonomy 

  • If you’re talented and driven, you’ll own important problems early. 
  • 5 days off and annual stipends for learning and development, and funding for conferences and external collaborations. 
  • Freedom to pursue research bets without product pressure. 
  • Opportunities to publish and collaborate externally. 

Life & family* 

  • Modern central London office, or where applicable, option to work in similar government offices in Birmingham, Cardiff, Darlington, Edinburgh, Salford or Bristol. 
  • Hybrid working, flexibility for occasional remote work abroad and stipends for work-from-home equipment. 
  • At least 25 days’ annual leave, 8 public holidays, extra team-wide breaks and 3 days off for volunteering. 
  • Generous paid parental leave (36 weeks of UK statutory leave shared between parents + 3 extra paid weeks + option for additional unpaid time). 
  • On top of your salary, we contribute 28.97% of your base salary to your pension. 
  • Discounts and benefits for cycling to work, donations and retail/gyms. 
     

*These benefits apply to direct employees. Benefits may differ for individuals joining through other employment arrangements such as secondments. 

Salary

Annual salary is benchmarked to role scope and relevant experience. Most offers land between £65,000 and £145,000 made up of a base salary plus a technical allowance (take-home salary = base + technical allowance). An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary. 

This role sits outside of the DDaT pay framework given the scope of this role requires in depth technical expertise in frontier AI safety, robustness and advanced AI architectures. 

The full range of salaries are available below: 

  • Level 3: £65,000–£75,000 (Base £40,850 + Technical Allowance £24,150–£34,150)
  • Level 4: £85,000–£95,000 (Base £48,540 + Technical Allowance £36,460–£46,460)
  • Level 5: £105,000–£115,000 (Base £63,165 + Technical Allowance £41,835–£51,835)
  • Level 6: £125,000–£135,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £48,525–£58,525)
  • Level 7: £145,000 (Base £76,475 + Technical Allowance £68,525)

Additional Information

Use of AI in Applications

Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

Use of AI tools in recruitment

We may use AI tools to help our hiring team review applications, for example by summarising application materials and helping us prioritise them against the published criteria. We do not use AI tools to find information about you from other sources, including online. People make every decision. We do not make solely automated decisions about candidates. Find out more, including your rights, in our recruitment privacy notice: https://www.aisi.gov.uk/careers/privacy-policy.

Internal Fraud Database 

The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.  For more information please see - Internal Fraud Register.

Security

Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get baseline personnel security standard (BPSS) clearance before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for counter-terrorist check (CTC) clearance. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement. See our vetting charter here.

Nationality requirements

We may be able to offer roles to applicant from any nationality or background. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard nationality requirements (opens in a new window).

Working for the Civil Service

The Civil Service Code (opens in a new window) sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants. The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria. The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.

Diversity and Inclusion

The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window) and the Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window). As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&I. You can see how we process this data here: Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK.

descriptionHtml:
The Role

Black Semiconductor is seeking a hands-on and flexible Equipment & Process Development Technician to support the installation, qualification, operation, maintenance, process development, and ramp-up of our FabONE semiconductor manufacturing facility.

You will work across CMP, wet cleaning, plating, and Graphene processes and equipment, supporting both R&D and manufacturing activities.

This is a flexible, multi-functional role where responsibilities will adapt to business priorities and FabONE needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support equipment installation, commissioning, qualification, startup, operation, and maintenance.

  • Perform preventive/corrective maintenance, calibration, troubleshooting, and equipment recovery.

  • Act as a first responder for equipment alarms, abnormal conditions, and OOC events.

  • Monitor tool health, equipment performance, and process conditions to maintain high uptime and reliability.

  • Support CMP, wet cleaning, plating, Graphene and Chemical supply systems.

  • Manage critical consumables such as CMP pads, diamond disks, filters, PVA brushes, plating consumables, and chemicals.

  • Support process development, engineering experiments, process qualification, characterization, and optimization.

  • Support Graphene transfer, wet processing, patterning, equipment operation, and process development.

  • Assist Process and Equipment Engineers with tool tuning, recipe optimization, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.

  • Collect and document equipment/process data and maintain accurate maintenance, qualification, and process records.

  • Support development and improvement of SOPs, PM procedures, and equipment standards.

  • Follow all cleanroom, chemical handling, EHS, and contamination-control requirements.

  • Work cross-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Facilities, EHS, R&D, and equipment suppliers.

  • Support other technical activities as required based on business and FabONE priorities.

Your Qualifications

  • Technical degree, apprenticeship, technician certification, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3-5+ years of semiconductor equipment, process, manufacturing, or technician experience.

  • Hands-on experience in one or more areas: CMP, wet cleaning, plating, wafer processing, equipment engineering, process development, or chemical systems.

  • Strong hands-on troubleshooting and maintenance experience.

  • Basic knowledge of pumps, valves, filters, tubing, sensors, motors, vacuum, chemical/fluid delivery, and equipment controls.

  • Experience with process development, equipment qualification, calibration, or optimization is a plus.

  • Graphene or advanced materials processing experience is a plus.

  • Ability to learn and support multiple equipment platforms and technologies.

  • Strong problem-solving, teamwork, communication, and documentation skills.

  • English proficiency required; German is a plus.

  • Willingness to work hands-on in a cleanroom and support a fast-paced startup/new-fab environment.

What Success Looks Like

  • Safe, reliable, and available equipment.

  • Fast and effective response to equipment and process issues.

  • Stable and qualified CMP, Cleaning, Plating, and Graphene processes.

  • Strong support for R&D, engineering, and manufacturing activities.

  • Continuous improvement in uptime, reliability, process stability, quality, and efficiency.

  • Flexibility to support changing FabONE and business priorities.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

descriptionHtml:
Ferry‑Capitain est une entreprise familiale de 300 salariés basée à Joinville (Haute‑Marne, Grand Est), membre du Groupe CIF, qui compte environ 1 200 collaborateurs répartis sur plusieurs sites en Europe.

Une expertise historique et industrielle
Depuis sa création en 1831, Ferry‑Capitain s’est forgé une renommée mondiale dans les domaines de la fonderie, l’usinage de très grande dimension (jusqu’à Ø 10 m) et l’assemblage mécanique. L’entreprise est aussi un acteur majeur dans la conception d’engrenages, de pièces pour l’aéronautique, l’énergie ou la cimenterie.

Une culture humaine et familiale

Intégrer Ferry‑Capitain, c’est rejoindre le Groupe CIF, un ensemble industriel français tourné vers l’innovation et la performance durable, combinant tradition et modernité pour relever les défis techniques de demain

Tu as le goût de la technique et tu souhaites rejoindre une entreprise industrielle reconnue pour son savoir-faire dans la fabrication d’engrenages et de transmissions mécaniques ?

Avantages

title: Technicien Qualité (Quality Technician)
descriptionHtml:
À propos

Harmattan AI est un acteur de nouvelle génération dans le secteur de la défense, spécialisé dans la conception de systèmes autonomes et évolutifs. En combinant ingénierie avancée, robotique et intelligence artificielle, nous développons des capacités opérationnelles pensées pour le terrain.

Notre croissance rapide reflète une ambition claire : équiper les forces armées avec des systèmes à la hauteur des enjeux actuels. Nous recherchons des profils prêts à s’engager dans un environnement technique exigeant, avec un fort sens de la mission et de l’impact.

  

Rôle

Nous recherchons un Technicien Qualité pour rejoindre notre bureau de Paris. En travaillant sur le terrain aux côtés des équipes d'ingénierie, de fabrication et de qualité, vous veillerez à ce que la qualité soit intégrée à nos produits, du prototype jusqu'à la livraison au client. Vous rapporterez au Responsable Qualité.

  

Responsabilités

Support à la fabrication de prototypes :

  • Fournir un support qualité lors de l'assemblage des prototypes, en veillant à ce que les constructions soient conformes aux plans, aux instructions de travail et aux spécifications.

  • Identifier et documenter les pièces non conformes, soutenir le traitement et les actions correctives aux côtés de l'équipe d'ingénierie.

  • Aider à définir les méthodes d'inspection et les critères d'acceptation pour les nouveaux composants.

 

Revue de premier article (FAI) :

  • Réaliser des revues de premier article sur les pièces de développement.

  • Préparer et maintenir les rapports FAI avec une traçabilité complète des résultats d'inspection.

  • Assurer le suivi des conclusions de la FAI et veiller à ce que les actions correctives soient clôturées avant la mise en production.

 

Mur Qualité – Produits en développement :

  • Gérer le point de contrôle du mur qualité, en vérifiant que chaque unité de développement répond aux critères définis avant de passer à la phase suivante.

  • Tenir à jour les registres du mur qualité et donner de la visibilité sur l'état des produits et les motifs de blocage.

  • Faire remonter les défauts récurrents à l'Ingénierie Qualité et à la Conception pour résolution.

 

Support après-vente et tri chez le client :

  • Participer aux activités de support après-vente, y compris l'inspection sur site et le tri des produits chez les clients si nécessaire.

  • Effectuer des contrôles visuels et dimensionnels pour identifier les unités non conformes, isoler les produits défectueux et documenter les résultats.

title: Transactional Financial Controller
descriptionHtml:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

The Transactional Financial Controller owns the full Accounts Payable, Billing function, Credit control, working capital management, and banking operations across the group, while also leading the ongoing automation and optimisation of the finance systems that underpin transactional finance. This is a hybrid role based in London combining hands-on operational leadership of AP, Billing and credit control teams and processes with responsibility for driving system-led improvement, control, and efficiency across the wider finance systems landscape along with the Finance transformation team.This role has line management responsibility for a team based in London and Porto, working under hybrid and remote arrangements

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Transactional Finance (AP, Billing and Credit control) Management

  • Full management of the Accounts Payable and Billing and Credit control functions, including team leadership, prioritisation and quality control.

  • Oversight of all banking and expense transactions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and appropriate controls.

  • Own working capital management, including planning and execution of payment runs.

  • Implement and manage the Purchase Order (PO) system end-to-end, liaising with stakeholders across the business to ensure compliance and efficient processing.

  • Act as the escalation point for AP, Billing and Credit control queries, both internal and external, ensuring timely and professional resolution.

  • Oversee & drive DSO performance improvement, setting and monitoring cash collection targets and driving corrective action where collection is behind plan by using escalation channels with various business stakeholders

  • Overseeing the review AR ledgers regularly, identifying and escalating aged debt in line with credit control policy.

  • Line-manage direct reports based in Portugal & London, while providing day-to-day supervision and quality oversight of AP, Billing and Credit Control activity across the UK, Portugal, Germany and Spain.

  • Partner with the Director of Financial Control and wider Finance team on reporting, audit requirements and process governance.

Finance Systems & Process Improvement

  • Support along with Finance Transformation the finance systems automation roadmap, driving the elimination of manual processes and delivering scalable, efficient finance operations.

  • Own the optimisation of the finance systems landscape, reviewing and enhancing NetSuite integrations with Moss, Precoro, Abacum, Salesforce and QV to ensure scalability, data integrity, and accurate revenue recognition.

  • Drive continuous improvement of finance system integrations and workflows, proactively identifying and resolving issues to enhance performance, reliability, and user experience.

Je bent dagelijks zichtbaar aanwezig, signaleert kansen in de regio en bouwt aan duurzame samenwerkingen met scholen en ouders. Daarnaast ben je actief onderdeel van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en ondersteun je leerlingen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding. Juist die combinatie van management en persoonlijke begeleiding maakt deze rol zo afwisselend en betekenisvol.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • leidinggeven aan, coachen en ontwikkelen van een team studentbegeleiders;

  • voeren van intake-, evaluatie- en adviesgesprekken met leerlingen en ouders;

  • organiseren van roosters, administratie en plannen van aanpak;

  • opbouwen en onderhouden van relaties met scholen en andere stakeholders in de regio;

  • actief onderdeel zijn van de dagelijkse praktijk op de vestiging en leerlingen ondersteunen tijdens de huiswerkbegeleiding;

  • realiseren van groei, kwaliteit en resultaat binnen jouw vestiging.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Jij krijgt energie van het combineren van onderwijs, management en ondernemerschap. Je bent zelfstandig, besluitvaardig en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het succes van jouw vestiging. Daarnaast weet je overzicht te bewaren, kansen te signaleren en relaties op te bouwen met leerlingen, ouders, scholen en collega's. Je begrijpt dat kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en resultaat hand in hand gaan. Ervaring in een leidinggevende, coördinerende of ondernemende rol helpt je om snel succesvol te zijn in deze functie.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

• hbo werk- en denkniveau;

• affiniteit met het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van jongeren;

• ondernemende instelling en verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel;

• commercieel inzicht en oog voor groei en resultaat;

• sterke organisatorische en communicatieve vaardigheden;

• we zoeken kandidaten op goede reisafstand van jouw vestiging. We hebben momenteel kansen in de volgende plaatsen: Hengelo, Utrecht, Laren en Delft.

Jouw werkgebied

Lyceo heeft ruim 100 vestigingen en daarmee altijd een vestiging bij jou in de buurt. Wij zoeken vestigingsmanagers voor de regio’s: Bussum, Laren en Delft.

Je bent dagelijks aanwezig binnen de vestiging en werkt nauw samen met leerlingen, ouders, begeleiders en onderwijsprofessionals. Daarnaast onderhoud je contact met scholen en andere betrokkenen in de regio en bouw je actief aan de groei en kwaliteit van de vestiging.

Benefits

Als gedreven vestigingsmanager kun jij rekenen op:

Een zelfstandige managementfunctie met veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen een maatschappelijk betrokken en resultaatgerichte organisatie. Lyceo geeft je de ruimte om jouw eigen vestiging te runnen, ondersteunt je met professionele begeleiding en investeert actief in jouw ontwikkeling en groei.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

• volledig door Lyceo betaalde pensioenbijdrage van 6%;

• variabele beloningsmogelijkheden gekoppeld aan resultaten en groei;

• een jaarcontract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week, net wat past bij jouw situatie, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;

• vrij tijdens de schoolvakanties*;

• laptop en telefoon van de zaak;

• volledige ov-vergoeding of reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer;

• toegang tot de Lyceo Academie met diverse trainingen en opleidingen;

• persoonlijke begeleiding door een clustermanager en een eigen buddy;

• aantrekkelijke kortingen via Benefits At Work;

• regelmatige borrels, teamuitjes en een jaarlijks feest;

• betekenisvol werk, waarbij resultaat en impact hand in hand gaan.

*Naast de meivakantie en de laatste week van de zomervakantie ben je tijdens alle schoolvakanties vrij. Hiervoor wordt maandelijks 5,77% ingehouden ter compensatie van deze bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen, naast de 25 wettelijke vakantiedagen. Je bouwt vakantiegeld en pensioen op over je volledige bruto maandsalaris.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen via programma’s zoals huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen.

Als marktleider binnen dit domein is Lyceo volop in beweging. De organisatie groeit hard en heeft duidelijke ambities voor de toekomst. Je komt terecht in een betrokken en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat, maar waar ook ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën.

De impact is groot: scholen beoordelen Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger. We zoeken continu naar de beste samenwerking tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs en doen er alles aan om ieder kind tot z’n recht te laten komen.

title: Vice President Finance (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As Vice President Finance (all genders), you will lead and further professionalise our global Finance function, ensuring the company has the financial transparency, processes, and steering mechanisms required to scale successfully.

This role combines strategic financial leadership with hands-on ownership of all core finance activities, including financial planning, controlling, accounting, treasury, payroll, tax, reporting, and finance operations. You will lead a growing team and continue the transformation of Finance from a scale-up function into a mature, globally operating business partner.

Beyond running the existing function, you will proactively identify future challenges and opportunities, helping leadership make well-informed decisions through robust planning, forecasting, business insights, and financial modeling. You will act as a trusted partner to the C-Level and leadership, and our corporate shareholder, ensuring Finance is not only a reporting function but a strategic driver of long-term success.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1-2 days per week working from our Berlin office.

Your Mission

Financial Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the Finance team across all functional areas.
  • Manage and support direct reports, including Accounting, Controlling, and Finance Operations.
  • Build organisational capabilities, processes, and structures required for the next stage of growth.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on ownership, accuracy, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure appropriate resource planning and team development.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes from a financial perspective.
  • Develop scalable planning structures and financial governance frameworks across all departments.
  • Ensure financial targets are translated into operational plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Continuously improve forecast quality and business visibility.
  • Support leadership with scenario planning and strategic decision-making.

Controlling & Business Partnering

  • Further develop financial controlling processes and management reporting.
  • Partner with department leaders to improve financial planning, cost transparency, and performance management.
  • Challenge assumptions, identify risks early, and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Establish a culture of financial accountability throughout the organisation.
  • Drive improvements in cost tracking, resource planning, and investment prioritisation.

Financial Reporting & Accounting

  • Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting across all entities and markets.
  • Oversee accounting, payroll, tax, treasury, and financial operations.
  • Ensure compliance with statutory, tax, and internal reporting requirements.
  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes.
  • Coordinate external audits and relevant financial reviews.

Corporate & Shareholder Finance

  • Serve as the primary financial interface to our corporate shareholder and relevant stakeholders.
  • Prepare board and shareholder reporting materials.
  • Support capital planning and long-term financial strategy.
  • Ensure transparency and professionalism in all financial communications.

Global Finance Operations

  • Own Finance processes across all markets.
  • Ensure consistency of financial standards and reporting across countries.
  • Support international expansion through scalable financial structures and processes.
  • Promote best-practice sharing and operational alignment across markets.

Finance Systems, Data & Automation

  • Drive the professionalisation and automation of Finance processes.
  • Improve the quality, availability, and utilisation of financial data.
  • Define requirements for Finance tooling, reporting, and workflow improvements.
  • Collaborate with Strategic Operations, Data, Product, and Engineering teams on automation initiatives.
  • Leverage technology and AI-enabled solutions to increase efficiency and decision quality.

Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Continuously evaluate and improve Finance processes, controls, and governance structures with a strong focus on simplicity and ease of use.
  • Reduce manual effort through standardisation and automation.
  • Implement scalable operating models that support company growth.
  • Ensure Finance remains fit for purpose as organisational complexity increases.

Requirements

What You Need to Succeed

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 8+ years of experience in Finance, Controlling, FP&A, Accounting, or related fields.
  • Proven leadership experience in a scale-up, high-growth, or international environment.
  • Strong background in financial planning, forecasting, and business partnering.
  • Experience building and professionalising Finance functions and processes.
  • Exposure to corporate structures and shareholder reporting environments.
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, technology, or other regulated industries is beneficial.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
  • Outstanding financial planning and modelling skills.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication abilities.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-making at leadership level.
  • High degree of ownership and proactiveness.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, reporting structures, and process design.
  • Interest in automation, AI, and technology-enabled finance processes.

Languages:

  • Full professional fluency (written and spoken) in English and German

Benefits

Why getolo?

🌴 Salary & Vacation

  • Attractive fixed salary
  • Start with 28 vacation days, with an increase every two years (capped at 30 days). Holidays on December 24th and 31st.

🧑‍💻 Mobility & Flexibility

  • Choose between a free Swapfiets bike, or a Berlin/Brandenburg ticket (“VBB - Jobticket”) or BVG “Deutschlandticket” subsidized by us
  • Work hybrid - from your home office or in our office in Berlin-Mitte
  • Work abroad in the EU for up to 60 days

🧘 Health

  • Benefit from free coaching sessions with nilo.health, our mental health tool
  • Test our products yourself! Choose between dentolo, petolo or vitolo

📚 Development

  • Learning Budget starting from 750 € per year
  • Regular (360 degree) feedback

🌍 Berlin Based, International Mindset

  • We communicate, collaborate, and celebrate in English to ensure everyone is included
  • Our diverse team spans from 33 different countries

🧬 Values

  • Our values are not buzzwords, but actions that are a part of our individual and collective DNA:

  • #fast: We simplify, move with urgency, and focus on outcomes

  • #brave: We take bold decisions, challenge the status quo, and act with conviction

  • #accountable: We deliver end-to-end, reduce dependencies, and own our decisions

  • #caring: We treat each other with respect, build trust, and create an environment where everyone can thrive

🙌 And much more…

  • Legendary summer and winter parties
  • Regular team events
  • Many discounts on the corporate Benefits Platform

Sounds like the perfect job for you? We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you!

About getolo

Founded in 2015, getolo GmbH is an innovative and award-winning InsurTech company that offers comprehensive supplementary insurance plans in the areas of dental, pet health and liability, as well as health add-on coverage. Under the brands dentolo, petolo, patolo and vitolo, we serve over 265,000 customers across Germany, France and Spain, providing digital and hassle-free protection that seamlessly integrates into their daily lives.
We believe that prevention is always better than cure—which is why we focus on preventive care, customer-centric service, and financial security to protect our customers and their loved ones from unexpected costs. Thanks to the close collaboration of our team of market specialists and insurance experts, we continuously monitor industry developments to offer practical solutions for current challenges.
getolo's company culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and agility—always with a strong focus on the needs of our customers. With a team of around 300 employees, getolo is led by Daniel Gadea (CEO) and Laura Wulff (CGO). getolo is a partner of DA Direkt and part of the Zurich Group Germany.

getolo is an equal opportunity and diversity employer. We strive to create a friendly, safe, and welcoming environment for all our team members, regardless of ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, limitations and talents of any kind, physical appearance, social background, marital status, age, or religion (or lack thereof).
